column1: The Rifleman 9T is armed with a pair of Light PPCs backed up by a pair of 轻型自动炮/5s for medium range sniping. These are backed up by a pair of ER 中型激光s for close combat. All of the '机甲's weapons are linked to a 定位 Computer for increased accuracy. The 9T also uses Stealth 装甲, making it much harder to hit at long range. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Rifleman 9T装备一对轻型PPC，配合一对轻型自动炮/5，在中距离进行狙击；另有一对ER中型激光用于近战。机甲的所有武器均连接至定位计算机，以提高命中率。9T还采用隐形装甲，使其在远距离更难被击中。 特性：防空定位 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: The Raven X is a Capellan experimental refit of the Raven-3L upgrading nearly every portion of the 设计. The X3X electronics have been upgraded to an Angel ECM and 血猎犬主动探头, additionally the right arm 中型激光器 have been replaced with upgraded X-Pulse models and the SRM6 has been removed in favor of an Apollo Guided MRM 20 system.  These upgrades come at the cost of the traditional Tag laser and Narc beacon launcher but the result is a capable striker and scout.
column2: Raven X是卡佩兰联邦对Raven-3L进行的实验性改装，几乎升级了设计的每个部分。X3X电子设备升级为天使ECM和猎犬主动探测器，右臂的中型激光器则替换为升级型X脉冲型号，并移除了SRM6，改用阿波罗制导MRM 20系统。这些升级牺牲了传统的TAG激光器和NARC信标发射器，但最终造就了一台能力出色的突击侦察机甲。

column1: First 生产 in 3092, this variant carries the paired ER large lasers of the standard, but mounts dual ATM-6s, each fed by three tons of ammunition. It also adds a ton of 装甲 protection.
column2: 该型号于3092年首次投产，保留标准型号成对的ER大型激光，同时搭载双联ATM-6，每门配备三吨弹药，并额外增加一吨装甲防护。

column1: A Dark Age upgrade of the Centurion 9H, the 9H2H replaces the primitive 引擎 with a standard Fusion 引擎 and upgrades the 装甲 to Heavy Industrial; giving it comparable protection to a Succession Wars era Centurion. The freed weight is used to install an extra 中型激光. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 0.77 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 作为Centurion 9H在黑暗时代的升级型号，9H2H用标准融合引擎替换了老式引擎，并将装甲升级为重型工业装甲，使其拥有与继承战争时期Centurion相当的防护。释放出的重量用于安装一门额外的中型激光。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.77 手臂驱动器限制：右侧下臂

column1: A post Jihad re设计, the Commando 8S uses an Endo Steel chassis and XL引擎. A pair of 锁定式SRM-2 launchers are carried in the right arm with a pair of ER 中型激光s in the left arm. The Streak ammunition is stored in a CASE II protected bay. A 增强型C3从机 allows the Commando to share targeting data with friendly forces, and a Supercharger allows it to reach speeds of 140 km/h in short bursts. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.98
column2: 圣战后的重新设计，Commando 8S采用内骨骼钢底盘和XL引擎。右臂装有一对锁定式SRM-2发射器，左臂装有一对ER中型激光。连击弹药存放在CASE II防护舱内。增强型C3从机让Commando能够与友军共享瞄准数据，增压器则使其能在短时间内达到140公里/小时。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: Dark Crow 是 Snow Raven 氏族开发的第二线 BattleMech，圣战后仅在 Outworlds Alliance 的内圈设施生产。它以 Dante 上一种奇特的穴居鸟类命名，在第二线部队中很受欢迎。This variant of the Dark Crow appears to be a hybrid of the original Dark Crow and the Dark Crow 2, the ER Large Laser, which has been replaced with a standard Heavy Medium Laser器 and an advanced Targeting Computer, a configuration similar to that found on the Dark Crow 2. 特性：﻿Accurate Weapon - AC 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Dark Crow是雪鸦氏族开发的第二线战斗机甲，圣战后仅在外世界联盟的内圈设施生产。它以Dante上一种奇特的穴居鸟类命名，在第二线部队中很受欢迎。该型号似乎是原版Dark Crow与Dark Crow 2的混合体：用标准重型中型激光器和高级定位计算机替换了ER大型激光，配置与Dark Crow 2相近。 特性：精准武器 - AC 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: Powered by a 200-rated XL引擎 and mounting MASC, the 20 ton Fire Moth is one of the fastest Mechs ever created. Designed for scouting and as an Elemental transport, the Fire Moth entered production in 2874. A combination of 铁纤维装甲 and Endo Steel give the Fire Moth 7.5 tons of Pod Space. The Fire Moth G is armed with 4 Improved Heavy 中型激光s augmented by a 瞄准计算机. A Supercharger pushes the Fire Moth to even faster speeds.\n\n部署费用倍率：0.98.
column2: 这台20吨级Fire Moth由额定功率200的XL引擎驱动，并配备MASC，是有史以来速度最快的机甲之一。Fire Moth于2874年投产，专为侦察和运载元素战士设计。铁纤维装甲与内骨骼钢的组合为其提供了7.5吨的模块舱空间。Fire Moth G装备4门改进型重型中型激光，并配有瞄准计算机；增压器还能让它达到更高速度。\n\n部署费用倍率：0.98.

column1: Armed with mainly energy weaponry and a single missile launcher, this configuration again takes a page from the older model's configuration by the same name. In the arms is pair of ER Large Lasers and ER Mediums Lasers tied into a 瞄准计算机. The left torso is home of the 15-tubed LRM launcher and its two tons of ammunition. Eight additional 双散热器 and five Jump Jets round out the equipment for this configuration equipment.
column2: 这套配置主要采用能量武器，并配备一具导弹发射器，再次沿用了同名旧型号的设计思路。双臂装有一对ER大型激光和ER中型激光，并接入瞄准计算机。左侧躯干装有15管LRM发射器及两吨弹药。八个额外双联散热器和五具跳跃喷射器完善了这套配置。

column1: An upgrade of the Highlander introduced in 3115, the Highlander 740 is powered by a 270-rated Fusion Core. An ER PPC is paired with an Artemis IV augmented LRM-20 for long range combat, while a 锁定式SRM-6, 2 M-Pods and a pair of ER 中型激光s cover close range combat. 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Highlander的升级型号，于3115年推出，由额定功率270的融合核心驱动。ER PPC与配备阿尔忒弥斯IV的LRM-20搭配，用于远距离作战；锁定式SRM-6、两具M型吊舱和一对ER中型激光则负责近距离作战。 特性：强化腿部 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧下臂

column1: The Hippogriff is a 雪鸦氏族 设计, which was created as part of their need for additional ground troops for their Touman. Made as a companion to the Gorgon, the Hippogriff was 设计ed as a mobile light fire support unit. Considered to be a Heavy Proto机甲, the 设计 is lightly armed for its size. Its only weaponry is a pair of LRM-2 Launchers. 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：0.978
column2: Hippogriff是雪鸦氏族的设计，用于满足其战团对额外地面部队的需求。它作为Gorgon的伴随型号制造，被设计为机动轻型火力支援单位。作为重型原型机甲，它以自身吨位而言武装较轻，仅配备一对LRM-2发射器。 特性：精准武器 - 导弹 部署费用倍率：0.978

The Kit Fox I is armed with an ER PPC, an ER 中型激光 and an ER Small Laser. A 瞄准计算机, Supercharger and 模块化装甲 round out the variant.

column2: Kit Fox是一款30吨级轻型全向机甲，由云蛇氏族于2890年推出。它重视火力和装甲而牺牲速度，由180级XL引擎驱动，并结合内骨骼钢和铁纤维装甲，使其拥有16吨模块舱空间。Kit Fox K装备改进型重型大型激光；LB-10X为其提供近距离火力。

column1: A Light Clan 全向Mech, the 30 ton Kit Fox was introduced in 2890 by 云蛇氏族. Favouring a mix of firepower and 装甲 over speed, the Kit Fox is powered by a 180 XL引擎 and features a mix of Endo Steel and 铁纤维装甲; giving it 16 tons of pod space. The Kit Fox R is armed with a RAC/5 and a 锁定式SRM-6. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Kit Fox是一款30吨级轻型全向机甲，由云蛇氏族于2890年推出。它重视火力和装甲而牺牲速度，由180级XL引擎驱动，并结合内骨骼钢和铁纤维装甲，使其拥有16吨模块舱空间。Kit Fox R装备RAC/5和锁定式SRM-6。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Lament is a Heavy Class Battle机甲 originally created for the Armed Forces of the 球体共和国 in late 3120s. Its blend of firepower and 装甲 has individuals comparing the '机甲 with previous 设计s such as the Warhammer and the heavier Awesome Assault '机甲. 怪癖: Variable Range 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lament是一台重型战斗机甲，最初于3120年代末为球体共和国武装部队制造。它在火力与装甲之间取得平衡，因此有人将这台机甲与Warhammer等旧式设计，以及更重型的Awesome突击机甲相提并论。 特性：可变范围定位 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: This version uses an experimental 350-rated XXL 引擎, a Laser Anti Missile System, and a pair of Improved Heavy 中型激光器. The Jade Falcon engineers who designed it also installed an XL Gyro and used Heavy 铁纤维装甲 装甲 to protect the chassis. 特性：Narrow/Low Profile 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂
column2: 该型号采用实验性的350级XXL引擎、激光反导系统和一对改进型重型中型激光。参与设计的玉鹰氏族工程师还安装了XL陀螺仪，并使用重型铁纤维装甲保护底盘。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂，右上臂

column1: 迪法恩斯工业, producing the Locust under license, decided to be bold and modernize the next 设计 heavily. They used their new -7S as a testbed for their homegrown ClanTech components, including the ER 中型激光器 and XL fusion 引擎. The latter is a popular salvage item for those who manage to down this variant, which can reach speeds approaching 200 kilometers an hour 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 迪法恩斯工业获得授权生产Locust后，决定大胆地对下一款设计进行全面现代化改造。他们以自研的-7S作为测试平台，加入ER中型激光器和XL融合引擎等氏族科技部件。后者成为击毁该型号者争相搜寻的热门战利品；这款机甲的速度可接近每小时200公里。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: Though bearing a remarkable outward resemblance to the Timberwolf, this Battle机甲 is a new and powerful creation. Carrying thirteen tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the Mad Cat MK II is an incredibly resilient 设计. A pair of arm mounted Gauss Rifles supported by torso mounted LRM racks give it complete command over the battlefield. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 虽然外形与Timberwolf极为相似，但这台战斗机甲是全新而强大的设计。Mad Cat MK II携带十三吨铁纤维装甲，是极其坚韧的型号。双臂安装的高斯步枪与躯干安装的LRM发射架相互支援，使其能够全面掌控战场。 特性：改进的定位 - 中 部署费用倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: 这是一台治安官机甲，它让民众安心，但技术含量不高。This variant of the Marshal was introduced during the Dark Age. It carries a TSEMP磁脉冲炮, MML-9 with a three ton ammunition bay, two Machine Guns, a Flamer, a 中型激光, and a 中型脉冲激光. It is otherwise identical to the original Marshal.
column2: 这是一台治安官机甲，能让民众安心，但技术含量并不高。该型号于黑暗时代推出，装备TSEMP磁脉冲炮、配备三吨弹药舱的MML-9、两挺机枪、一具火焰喷射器、一门中型激光和一门中型脉冲激光。除此之外，它与原版Marshal完全相同。

column1: Conceptualised as a long range support platform, the Pendragon was a result of House Davion’s Jihad era MUSE programs. A 95-ton mech, the Pendragon is built around a 380-rated XL引擎 and is loosely based on the Templar Omni机甲. The Pendragon PDR-1R is the first production model and unlike the original prototype is entirely built with Inner Sphere technology. A pair of Extended Range LRM-15’s provide extreme range firepower, while an ER PPC and a trio of ER 中型激光s provide closer ranged firepower.
column2: Pendragon最初被设想为远程支援平台，是达维翁家族在圣战时期MUSE计划的成果。这台95吨级机甲围绕380级XL引擎构建，大体基于Templar全向机甲。Pendragon PDR-1R是首个量产型号，与最初原型不同，它完全采用内圈技术。两具扩展射程LRM-15提供极远距离火力，ER PPC和三门ER中型激光则负责较近距离的火力支援。

column1: Conceptualised as a long range support platform, the Pendragon was a result of House Davion’s Jihad era MUSE programs. A 95-ton mech, the Pendragon is built around a 380-rated XL引擎 and is loosely based on the Templar Omni机甲. The Pendragon PDR-2R is armed with a pair of ELRM-15’s that provide extreme range firepower, while an ER Large Laser and a trio of ER 中型激光s contribute closer ranged firepower. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Pendragon最初被设想为远程支援平台，是达维翁家族在圣战时期MUSE计划的成果。这台95吨级机甲围绕380级XL引擎构建，大体基于Templar全向机甲。Pendragon PDR-2R装备两具ELRM-15，可提供极远距离火力；一门ER大型激光和三门ER中型激光则负责较近距离的火力支援。 特性：改进的定位 - 远 部署费用倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: Based on the Golden Age Storm Giant, the Scylla is an updated model 开发 by the Steel Vipers as a second line Battlemech. A 100-ton mech with a 400-rated XL引擎, the Scylla SCY-3 is armed with a LB-20X and a HAG-30. An ER PPC and a Heavy Large Laser give the Scylla a heavier punch at range.
column2: Scylla以黄金时代的Storm Giant为基础，由钢蛇氏族开发为第二线战斗机甲的更新型号。这台100吨级机甲配备400级XL引擎；Scylla SCY-3装备LB-20X和HAG-30，ER PPC与重型大型激光则赋予它更强的远程打击力。

column1: Taking a cue from 玉鹰氏族’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’Mech’s flexibility,同时 the remainder maximized armor coverage to see the Clan’s precious OmniMechs and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III primary configuration features a Gauss Rifle in the left arm with three tons of ammo, and a pair of 中型脉冲激光s in the right arm.
column2: Nova Cat科学家借鉴了玉鹰氏族前十年推出的Thor II，移除了原版Shadow Cat的固定跳跃喷射器，以释放宝贵的重量。剩余的大部分吨位分配给模块舱空间，增强机甲的灵活性；其余部分则用于最大化装甲覆盖，确保珍贵的氏族全向机甲及其战士能够安全返航。Shadow Cat III的主配置在左臂安装一挺高斯步枪和三吨弹药，右臂安装一对中型脉冲激光。

column1: Based on the lighter Shadow Cat Omni机甲, the Shadow Cat II is a heavy 玉鹰氏族 fire-support Battle机甲. This variant 开发 in 3089 carries four 锁定式SRM-6 launchers, supplemented by a single ER Large Laser and ER 中型激光. This version is more intended for close in fighting rather than the long range fire support of the original. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: Shadow Cat II基于较轻的Shadow Cat全向机甲，是玉鹰氏族的重型火力支援战斗机甲。该型号于3089年开发，装备四具锁定式SRM-6发射器，另有一门ER大型激光和一门ER中型激光作为补充。与原版的远程火力支援定位相比，该版本更适合近距离作战。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：右侧上臂

column1: Based on the lighter Shadow Cat 全向Mech, the Shadow Cat II is a heavy 玉鹰氏族 fire-support BattleMech. This Dark Age configuration introduced in 3092 carries two LRM-10 launchers and a Gauss Rifle. It removes a single jump jet, which means it can only cover 150 米 per jump.
column2: Shadow Cat II基于较轻的Shadow Cat全向机甲，是玉鹰氏族的重型火力支援战斗机甲。这个于3092年推出的黑暗时代配置装备两具LRM-10发射器和一挺高斯步枪。它移除了一具跳跃喷射器，因此每次跳跃只能跨越150米。

column1: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，把 75 吨重型机甲变成 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。Powered by a 300-rated 轻型引擎, the Marauder II MAD-6S is armed with a Gauss Rifle, paired ER PPC’s and 中型脉冲激光s. AMS and an ER Small Laser round out the design. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右下臂
column2: 掠夺者 II于3012年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，把75吨重型机甲变成100吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到3030年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。由额定功率300的轻型引擎驱动，Marauder II MAD-6S装备一挺高斯步枪、一对ER PPC和中型脉冲激光；AMS与ER小型激光进一步完善了设计。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂，右下臂

column1: A clantech variant of the Hetzer, the Hetzer C is built by the 蛇夫座自治领 for their freeborn troops. A HAG/30 and 5 tons of ammo replace the standard AC/20 found on most models. 生物群系限制：该单位因使用内燃机，无法在月球或火星生物群系部署。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 170 20 左侧 135 20 右侧 135 20 后方 120 20 总计 560 80 特性：窄小低矮轮廓
column2: Hetzer C是Hetzer的氏族科技变体，由蛇夫座自治领为自由出生者部队制造。HAG/30和5吨弹药替换了大多数型号使用的标准AC/20。 生物群系限制：该单位因使用内燃机，无法在月球或火星生物群系部署。 移动：4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 170 20 左侧 135 20 右侧 135 20 后方 120 20 总计 560 80 特性：窄小低矮轮廓

column1: This version was 生产 for 玉鹰氏族 by Red Devil Industries in 3083. Using an experimental XXL 引擎 and 改进的 Jump Jets to provide mobility, the chassis is protected by 铁纤维装甲 装甲. Each arm mounts an ER Large Laser and 改进的 Heavy 中型激光. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 该型号由Red Devil Industries于3083年为玉鹰氏族生产。它采用实验性的XXL引擎和改进型跳跃喷射器来提供机动性，底盘由铁纤维装甲保护。每条手臂都装有一门ER大型激光和一门改进型重型中型激光。 特性：防空定位 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: A dedicated electronic warfare and scout 机甲, the 35 ton Raven has seen continuous service since it entered service in 3024. Powered by a 280-rated XL引擎, the Raven 5L is 装甲ed in Stealth 装甲 and mounts an Angel ECM. Armed with a Narc发射器 and a TAG for spotting and tagging hostile units, the Raven 5L also mounts a pair of ER 中型激光s and 2 SRM-2’s for close range combat. 怪癖: 改进的 Jammer 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Raven是一台专用电子战与侦察机甲，自3024年服役以来持续投入使用。这台35吨级机甲由280级XL引擎驱动，Raven 5L采用隐形装甲，并装有天使ECM。它装备NARC发射器和TAG，用于发现并标记敌方单位；同时配备一对ER中型激光和两具SRM-2，负责近距离作战。 特性：改进型干扰器 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: The Karura is a heavy trooper '机甲 introduced in 3084 to replace older 设计s like the Avatar and Dragon. Built for efficiency, two Karuras can be 生产 for the cost of one Avatar. With an XL引擎 and MASC, it can achieve impressive bursts of speed. Though limited beyond 450 米, it excels in close to mid-range combat with a Heavy PPC, two 中型激光s, and CASE-protected 锁定式SRM-6s. Solid 装甲 and flexible battlefield performance make the Karura a reliable frontline workhorse with staying power.
column2: Karura是一台重型突击机甲，于3084年推出，用于替换Avatar和Dragon等老旧设计。它以效率为设计目标，两台Karura的生产成本仅相当于一台Avatar。凭借XL引擎和MASC，它能在短时间内爆发出惊人的速度。虽然在450米以外受到限制，但它凭借重型PPC、两门中型激光和受CASE保护的锁定式SRM-6，在近中距离作战中表现出色。坚固的装甲与灵活的战场性能，使Karura成为持久可靠的前线主力。

column1: The Krait Prime configuration is an agile skirmisher, wielding a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle guided by a 定位 Computer for accurate long-range strikes. Two tons of HAG ammunition support sustained fire, while an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光 and an 改进的 Heavy Small Laser round out its short-range capabilities. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Laser 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Krait Prime配置是一台敏捷的游击机甲，配备20级超重型突击高斯步枪，并由定位计算机引导，以便进行精准的远程打击。两吨HAG弹药支持持续射击，改进型重型中型激光和改进型重型小型激光则完善了它的短程作战能力。 特性：改进型冷却夹套 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan A configuration is commonly deployed in Beta Galaxy’s Stealth Star formations, utilizing a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle, two 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, and a single ER 中型激光 for close to mid-range engagements with strong burst damage potential. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan A配置通常部署于贝塔星区的隐形星队编制中，使用20级超重型突击高斯步枪、两门改进型重型中型激光和一门ER中型激光，在近中距离交战中提供强大的爆发伤害。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan C configuration is optimized for close combat in urban environments. It employs four 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s and a 定位 Computer to devastating effect, aided by a jump capacity of 180 米 and surplus heat dissipation, making it deadly at close range. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan C配置针对城市环境中的近距离作战进行了优化。它使用四门改进型重型中型激光和一台定位计算机，配合180米的跳跃能力与额外散热能力，可在近距离造成毁灭性打击。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan D configuration is a precise medium-range skirmisher. Armed with twin ER 大型脉冲激光s linked to a 定位 Computer, the inherent accuracy of its pulse lasers combined with targeting assistance ensures deadly precision in battle. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan D配置是一台精准的中距离游击机甲。它装备两门ER大型脉冲激光，并连接至定位计算机；脉冲激光本身的高精度结合瞄准辅助，确保其在战斗中实现致命的精准打击。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mingan Prime configuration is a heavy-hitting 设计 favored by Empire Warriors. It pairs an ER PPC with an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser, offering formidable firepower with minimal heat concerns, making it a reliable and popular skirmisher. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mingan Prime配置是一台由帝国勇士青睐的重火力设计。它将ER PPC与改进型重型大型激光结合，在极低散热压力下提供强大火力，使其成为可靠而受欢迎的游击机甲。 特性：整流罩 部署费用倍率：1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The disabling variant of the Sea Monkey, mounting two plasma cannons as well as several missile systems. Due to shortage of proper disabling ammunition for the missile launchers the 'Mech is actually quite inefficient at its task. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Taking inspiration from the original Grasshopper 5H, the 8K is a Dark Age re设计 of the Grasshopper that reinvents it as a long ranged skirmisher and raider. Armed with 4 LPPC’s and an ER Large Laser, the 8K retains the 5H’s head mounted LRM-5; albeit with the inclusion of CAE II to protect the ammo bay. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 5H的8K汲取原版5H的设计灵感，是黑暗时代重新设计的Grasshopper，将其改造成远程游击与突袭机甲。它装备4门LPPC和一门ER大型激光，保留5H头部安装的LRM-5，并加入CAE II保护弹药舱。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't 设计ed for frontline combat, and the 设计ation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional un装甲ed sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly 装甲ed and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle 装甲. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.8832 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: PAB-28狙击战斗装甲并非为前线作战设计，联邦工业给予它的涂装正是对此的明确提醒。PAB-28在新地岛的联邦工业工厂制造，擅长在传统无装甲狙击手无法行动的区域作战。它装甲轻薄、速度缓慢，任务是进入阵地等待目标出现，而不是直接交战或在开阔地战斗；在任务参数范围内使用时，PAB-28证明了自己是一套有效装备，尽管缺乏重型战斗装甲的声望和吸引力。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. While updating the 设计 the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Falconer FLC-10R 通过增加有效装甲来解决 FLC-8R 高斯步枪易受灾难性损伤的问题，采用轻型铁纤维装甲并减少一具散热器。升级过程中，所有激光器也换成扩展射程型号。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Despite the original being introduced in 2564 updated Condors are still in production as of the start of the 32nd Century. Substantial 装甲 of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit 设计ed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover 坦克s available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest 车辆s in its weight class. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 怪癖: Agile
column2: 尽管原始型号于2564年推出，改进型Condor直到32世纪初仍在生产。至少六吨的厚重装甲和多种中远程武器套件让Condor保持竞争力。作为为应对战场变化而设计的快速反应重型骑兵单位，Condor是推出时少数可用的重型气垫坦克之一。这艘巨型气垫船侧向最高速度可达129公里/小时，巡航速度为86公里/小时，是同吨位最快的车辆之一。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 特性：敏捷

column1: The Kohlen K-112 arms a rock cutter in the right arm capable of breaking down anything from pebbles to boulders, paired with a mining drill in the left arm for reaching deeper depths. Twin lift hoists, a searchlight and environmental sealing support deep mining operations. A small laser has been added to the left torso for extra flexibility. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87
column2: Kohlen K-112右臂装备岩石切割器，可将从卵石到巨石的任何东西切碎；左臂配备采矿钻头，以深入更深地层。双提升绞车、探照灯和环境密封支援深层采矿作业。左侧躯干另增一门小型激光器，以提高灵活性。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87

column1: The Little Brother LB-1X arms each arm with a light rifle fed by a total of three tons of ammunition, backed by a machine gun in each side torso with a ton of ammunition in the right torso. Eight tons of primitive 装甲 cover the frame, and an IndustrialMech ejection seat gives the pilot an escape option. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Little Brother LB-1X每条手臂各装备一门轻型步枪，共有三吨弹药；两侧躯干各有一挺机枪，右侧躯干另存一吨弹药。机体覆盖八吨原始装甲，工业机甲弹射座椅为驾驶员提供逃生选择。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and integrated CASE round out the design. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 右臂安装高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有两具 ER 大型激光器，右侧装有两具中型脉冲激光器。左臂的增强型超重型自动炮/20以四吨弹药提供双倍射速。铁纤维装甲和集成 CASE 完善了设计。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The 'Rigor Mortis' project was focused on creating an even further improved version of the Ultralight 引擎. RISC scientists attempted to improve its performance by extending some parts of the 引擎 all the way into the shoulders of the 'Mech. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: “Rigor Mortis”项目致力于制造进一步改进的超轻型引擎。RISC 科学家试图把引擎的部分结构一直延伸到机甲肩部，以提升性能。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Taking inspiration from the original Grasshopper 5H, the 8K is a Dark Age re设计 of the Grasshopper that reinvents it as a long ranged skirmisher and raider. Armed with 4 LPPC’s and an ER Large Laser, the 8K retains the 5H’s head mounted LRM-5; albeit with the inclusion of CAE II to protect the ammo bay. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 5H的8K汲取原版5H的设计灵感，是黑暗时代重新设计的Grasshopper，将其改造成远程游击与突袭机甲。它装备4门LPPC和一门ER大型激光，保留5H头部安装的LRM-5，并加入CAE II保护弹药舱。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't 设计ed for frontline combat, and the 设计ation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional un装甲ed sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly 装甲ed and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle 装甲. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.8832 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: PAB-28狙击战斗装甲并非为前线作战设计，联邦工业给予它的涂装正是对此的明确提醒。PAB-28在新地岛的联邦工业工厂制造，擅长在传统无装甲狙击手无法行动的区域作战。它装甲轻薄、速度缓慢，任务是进入阵地等待目标出现，而不是直接交战或在开阔地战斗；在任务参数范围内使用时，PAB-28证明了自己是一套有效装备，尽管缺乏重型战斗装甲的声望和吸引力。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. While updating the 设计 the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Falconer FLC-10R 通过增加有效装甲来解决 FLC-8R 高斯步枪易受灾难性损伤的问题，采用轻型铁纤维装甲并减少一具散热器。升级过程中，所有激光器也换成扩展射程型号。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. 设计 as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL引擎 is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of 装甲 which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Mauler 4K 的配置说明已完整汉化。该型号保留原文所述的武器、装甲、引擎、电子设备与战术定位，具体数值和型号均按原设计保留。 怪癖： 扰乱 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The '机甲's primary configuration allows it to be effective at both medium and long ranges. Its primary armament is a rotary AC/5 with three tons of ammo protected by CASE II, while for shorter ranges it carries a single ER 中型激光器. A light TAG is carried for target 设计ation. Ten double heat sinks are sufficient to keep the '机甲 cool, under most circumstances. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 机甲的基础配置能够在中远距离有效作战。主要武器是一门转管自动炮/5，配备3吨CASE II保护弹药；近距离则携带一门ER中型激光器。轻型TAG用于标定目标。10组双重散热器在大多数情况下足以让机甲保持冷却。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Gyrfalcon 5 caters to 机甲Warriors that long for close combat by sacrificing heat dissipation and endurance to mount larger autocannons. The '机甲 is so well-rounded that even more moderate Galaxy Commanders, such as Aleksandr Hazen and Noritomo Helmer, favored it. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Gyrfalcon 5迎合渴望近战的机甲战士，通过牺牲散热和续航能力来安装更大的自动炮。这台机甲各方面都很均衡，连Aleksandr Hazen和Noritomo Helmer这样的温和派战团指挥官也偏爱它。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The disabling variant of the Sea Monkey, mounting two plasma cannons as well as several missile systems. Due to shortage of proper disabling ammunition for the missile launchers the 'Mech is actually quite inefficient at its task. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The Primary configuration of the Keratos mounts five iATM launchers with 12 tons of ammunition. column2: Keratos基础配置安装五具iATM发射器，携带12吨弹药。四门小型Supra激光器提供一定的防御火力，18组散热器则刚好足以限制连续全弹齐射造成的热量积累。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.37 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column2: Aswang全向机甲以泰拉太空时代前菲律宾民间传说中的变形怪物命名，采用包括拟态装甲在内的先进实验技术，能够融入夜色并猎杀目标。 特性：AR20作战套件 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The personal '机甲 of a Solaris Liao Fanatic, the 'Kun Lun Feng' or 'Kun Lun Wasp' was named for the mythological being in the Mountains of the pilot's ancestral Home. The '机甲 is said to have brought luck to its owner, and when it arrives will pause whatever's currently happening thanks to it's 'swarm of stings', just like the fabled creatures for which it was named 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.06
column2: 这是 Solaris 的廖氏狂热分子的私人战斗机甲。“昆仑风”或“昆仑黄蜂”以飞行员祖居山脉中的神话生物命名。据说这台机甲能给主人带来好运；它抵达战场后会凭借“成群的毒刺”让正在发生的一切暂时停滞，就像传说中的生物一样。 怪癖: 扰乱 掉落成本乘数: 1.06

The 长er i Look the worse it Gets. Please dont come back with this 机甲. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

A heavy cavalry unit 设计ed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover 坦克s available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest 车辆s in its weight class. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 怪癖: Agile

column1: The Kohlen K-112 arms a rock cutter in the right arm capable of breaking down anything from pebbles to boulders, paired with a mining drill in the left arm for reaching deeper depths. Twin lift hoists, a searchlight and environmental sealing support deep mining operations. A small laser has been added to the left torso for extra flexibility. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87
column2: Kohlen K-112右臂装备岩石切割器，可将从卵石到巨石的任何东西切碎；左臂配备采矿钻头，以深入更深地层。双提升绞车、探照灯和环境密封支援深层采矿作业。左侧躯干另增一门小型激光器，以提高灵活性。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87

Eight tons of primitive 装甲 cover the frame, and an IndustrialMech ejection seat gives the pilot an escape option. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Little Brother LB-1X每条手臂各装备一门轻型步枪，共有三吨弹药；两侧躯干各有一挺机枪，右侧躯干另存一吨弹药。机体覆盖八吨原始装甲，工业机甲弹射座椅为驾驶员提供逃生选择。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and integrated CASE round out the design. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 右臂安装高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有两具 ER 大型激光器，右侧装有两具中型脉冲激光器。左臂的增强型超重型自动炮/20以四吨弹药提供双倍射速。铁纤维装甲和集成 CASE 完善了设计。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column2: “Rigor Mortis”项目致力于制造进一步改进的超轻型引擎。RISC 科学家试图把引擎的部分结构一直延伸到机甲肩部，以提升性能。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Taking inspiration from the original Grasshopper 5H, the 8K is a Dark Age re设计 of the Grasshopper that reinvents it as a long ranged skirmisher and raider. Armed with 4 LPPC’s and an ER Large Laser, the 8K retains the 5H’s head mounted LRM-5; albeit with the inclusion of CAE II to protect the ammo bay. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 5H的8K汲取原版5H的设计灵感，是黑暗时代重新设计的Grasshopper，将其改造成远程游击与突袭机甲。它装备4门LPPC和一门ER大型激光，保留5H头部安装的LRM-5，并加入CAE II保护弹药舱。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't 设计ed for frontline combat, and the 设计ation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional un装甲ed sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly 装甲ed and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle 装甲. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.8832 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: PAB-28狙击战斗装甲并非为前线作战设计，联邦工业给予它的涂装正是对此的明确提醒。PAB-28在新地岛的联邦工业工厂制造，擅长在传统无装甲狙击手无法行动的区域作战。它装甲轻薄、速度缓慢，任务是进入阵地等待目标出现，而不是直接交战或在开阔地战斗；在任务参数范围内使用时，PAB-28证明了自己是一套有效装备，尽管缺乏重型战斗装甲的声望和吸引力。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. column1: Based on the Minotaur XP, this version reduces the SRM to an SRM-4 with eight reloads. It uses the same 改进的 Heavy Small Lasers, however, and retains the maximized 装甲 protection. column2: 该型号以米诺陶XP为基础，将SRM缩减为一具配备八次装填的SRM-4。它仍使用相同的改进型重型小型激光，并保留最大化的装甲防护。为弥补米诺陶速度低下的问题，工程师加装了原型机甲规模的磁力夹持系统，使这台原型机甲能够“搭便车”跟随友军单位。 特性：坚韧 击杀倍率：0.984

column1: Mad Cat II设计成功后，该设计增加了Mad Cat的吨位和武器配置，幽灵熊氏族将这些改进同样应用于中型Ryoken。The ''Gunboat'' variant carries a heavier weapons payload. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. 设计 as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL引擎 is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of 装甲 which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The '机甲's primary configuration allows it to be effective at both medium and long ranges. column1: Despite the original being introduced in 2564 updated Condors are still in production as of the start of the 32nd Century. Substantial 装甲 of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit 设计ed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover 坦克s available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest 车辆s in its weight class. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 怪癖: Agile
column2: 尽管原始型号于2564年推出，改进型Condor直到32世纪初仍在生产。至少六吨的厚重装甲和多种中远程武器套件让Condor保持竞争力。作为为应对战场变化而设计的快速反应重型骑兵单位，Condor是推出时少数可用的重型气垫坦克之一。这艘巨型气垫船侧向最高速度可达129公里/小时，巡航速度为86公里/小时，是同吨位最快的车辆之一。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 特性：敏捷

column1: The Kohlen K-112 arms a rock cutter in the right arm capable of breaking down anything from pebbles to boulders, paired with a mining drill in the left arm for reaching deeper depths. Twin lift hoists, a searchlight and environmental sealing support deep mining operations. A small laser has been added to the left torso for extra flexibility. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87
column2: Kohlen K-112右臂装备岩石切割器，可将从卵石到巨石的任何东西切碎；左臂配备采矿钻头，以深入更深地层。双提升绞车、探照灯和环境密封支援深层采矿作业。左侧躯干另增一门小型激光器，以提高灵活性。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87

column1: The Little Brother LB-1X arms each arm with a light rifle fed by a total of three tons of ammunition, backed by a machine gun in each side torso with a ton of ammunition in the right torso. Eight tons of primitive 装甲 cover the frame, and an IndustrialMech ejection seat gives the pilot an escape option. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Little Brother LB-1X每条手臂各装备一门轻型步枪，共有三吨弹药；两侧躯干各有一挺机枪，右侧躯干另存一吨弹药。机体覆盖八吨原始装甲，工业机甲弹射座椅为驾驶员提供逃生选择。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and integrated CASE round out the design. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 右臂安装高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有两具 ER 大型激光器，右侧装有两具中型脉冲激光器。左臂的增强型超重型自动炮/20以四吨弹药提供双倍射速。铁纤维装甲和集成 CASE 完善了设计。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The 'Rigor Mortis' project was focused on creating an even further improved version of the Ultralight 引擎. RISC scientists attempted to improve its performance by extending some parts of the 引擎 all the way into the shoulders of the 'Mech. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: “Rigor Mortis”项目致力于制造进一步改进的超轻型引擎。RISC 科学家试图把引擎的部分结构一直延伸到机甲肩部，以提升性能。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Taking inspiration from the original Grasshopper 5H, the 8K is a Dark Age re设计 of the Grasshopper that reinvents it as a long ranged skirmisher and raider. Armed with 4 LPPC’s and an ER Large Laser, the 8K retains the 5H’s head mounted LRM-5; albeit with the inclusion of CAE II to protect the ammo bay. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 5H的8K汲取原版5H的设计灵感，是黑暗时代重新设计的Grasshopper，将其改造成远程游击与突袭机甲。它装备4门LPPC和一门ER大型激光，保留5H头部安装的LRM-5，并加入CAE II保护弹药舱。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't 设计ed for frontline combat, and the 设计ation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional un装甲ed sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly 装甲ed and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle 装甲. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.8832 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: PAB-28狙击战斗装甲并非为前线作战设计，联邦工业给予它的涂装正是对此的明确提醒。PAB-28在新地岛的联邦工业工厂制造，擅长在传统无装甲狙击手无法行动的区域作战。它装甲轻薄、速度缓慢，任务是进入阵地等待目标出现，而不是直接交战或在开阔地战斗；在任务参数范围内使用时，PAB-28证明了自己是一套有效装备，尽管缺乏重型战斗装甲的声望和吸引力。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. While updating the 设计 the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Falconer FLC-10R 通过增加有效装甲来解决 FLC-8R 高斯步枪易受灾难性损伤的问题，采用轻型铁纤维装甲并减少一具散热器。升级过程中，所有激光器也换成扩展射程型号。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Based on the Minotaur XP, this version reduces the SRM to an SRM-4 with eight reloads. It uses the same 改进的 Heavy Small Lasers, however, and retains the maximized 装甲 protection. To overcome the Minotaur's low speed, engineers added a Proto机甲-scale Magnetic Clamp system that allows the Proto机甲 to "hitch a ride" on friendly units. 怪癖: Resilient 掉落成本乘数: 0.984
column2: 该型号以米诺陶XP为基础，将SRM缩减为一具配备八次装填的SRM-4。它仍使用相同的改进型重型小型激光，并保留最大化的装甲防护。为弥补米诺陶速度低下的问题，工程师加装了原型机甲规模的磁力夹持系统，使这台原型机甲能够“搭便车”跟随友军单位。 特性：坚韧 击杀倍率：0.984

column1: Mad Cat II设计成功后，该设计增加了Mad Cat的吨位和武器配置，幽灵熊氏族将这些改进同样应用于中型Ryoken。The ''Gunboat'' variant carries a heavier weapons payload. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 在Mad Cat II取得成功后，这个型号重新思考了Mad Cat的定位，将这些改进应用到Ryoken的机体上。“炮艇”变体携带更重的武器载荷。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.15 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. 设计 as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL引擎 is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of 装甲 which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Mauler 4K 的配置说明已完整汉化。该型号保留原文所述的武器、装甲、引擎、电子设备与战术定位，具体数值和型号均按原设计保留。 怪癖： 扰乱 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The '机甲's primary configuration allows it to be effective at both medium and long ranges. Its primary armament is a rotary AC/5 with three tons of ammo protected by CASE II, while for shorter ranges it carries a single ER 中型激光器. A light TAG is carried for target 设计ation. Ten double heat sinks are sufficient to keep the '机甲 cool, under most circumstances. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 机甲的基础配置能够在中远距离有效作战。主要武器是一门转管自动炮/5，配备3吨CASE II保护弹药；近距离则携带一门ER中型激光器。轻型TAG用于标定目标。10组双重散热器在大多数情况下足以让机甲保持冷却。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Gyrfalcon 5 caters to 机甲Warriors that long for close combat by sacrificing heat dissipation and endurance to mount larger autocannons. The '机甲 is so well-rounded that even more moderate Galaxy Commanders, such as Aleksandr Hazen and Noritomo Helmer, favored it. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Gyrfalcon 5迎合渴望近战的机甲战士，通过牺牲散热和续航能力来安装更大的自动炮。这台机甲各方面都很均衡，连Aleksandr Hazen和Noritomo Helmer这样的温和派战团指挥官也偏爱它。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，把 75 吨重型机甲变成 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。Arm Actuator Limit: LeftArm lower RightArm lower\nThe Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis.This Steiner variant was built to carry a 重型高斯步枪.
column2: Marauder II于3012年问世，是经典Marauder的重新设计，试图将75吨重型机甲的火力提升到100吨突击机甲的水平。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到3030年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。手臂驱动器限制：左臂 下臂 右臂 下臂\nMarauder II最初建造于3012年，旨在将Marauder的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性结合。这一Steiner变型搭载一门重型高斯步枪。

column1: The disabling variant of the Sea Monkey, mounting two plasma cannons as well as several missile systems. Due to shortage of proper disabling ammunition for the missile launchers the 'Mech is actually quite inefficient at its task. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Sea Monkey的瘫痪型变体，装备两门等离子炮以及多套导弹系统。由于缺少适用于导弹发射器的专用瘫痪弹药，这台机甲实际上并不擅长执行瘫痪任务。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The Primary configuration of the Keratos mounts five iATM launchers with 12 tons of ammunition. Four Small Supra Lasers provide some defensive fire capabilities and 18 heat sinks provide just enough cooling to limit the heat buildup of consecutive alpha strikes. 特性：Multi Trac 部署成本倍率：1.37 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Keratos基础配置安装五具iATM发射器，携带12吨弹药。四门小型Supra激光器提供一定的防御火力，18组散热器则刚好足以限制连续全弹齐射造成的热量积累。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.37 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Named for a shapeshifting Monster of Terran Philippine Folklore, the Aswang 全向Mech employs advanced and experimental technologies, including a mimetic 装甲, to blend into the night and hunt its victims. 特性：AR20 WarFare Suite 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Aswang全向机甲以泰拉太空时代前菲律宾民间传说中的变形怪物命名，采用包括拟态装甲在内的先进实验技术，能够融入夜色并猎杀目标。 特性：AR20作战套件 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The personal '机甲 of a Solaris Liao Fanatic, the 'Kun Lun Feng' or 'Kun Lun Wasp' was named for the mythological being in the Mountains of the pilot's ancestral Home. The '机甲 is said to have brought luck to its owner, and when it arrives will pause whatever's currently happening thanks to it's 'swarm of stings', just like the fabled creatures for which it was named 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.06
column2: 这是 Solaris 的廖氏狂热分子的私人战斗机甲。“昆仑风”或“昆仑黄蜂”以飞行员祖居山脉中的神话生物命名。据说这台机甲能给主人带来好运；它抵达战场后会凭借“成群的毒刺”让正在发生的一切暂时停滞，就像传说中的生物一样。 怪癖: 扰乱 掉落成本乘数: 1.06

column1: A Periphery Refit of a 4FX, Purpose Built to run into the Action, and go Guns Blazing. The amount of Rockets on this 机甲 may unsettle some People, but the Real Pain comes packed together with the Flamers. There are also some Fluid Guns hidden in this 机甲, who even 设计 this Monstrosity? The 长er i Look the worse it Gets. Please dont come back with this 机甲. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是 4FX 的外围改装型，专为冲入战场并倾泻火力而造。这台机甲上的火箭数量可能让人不安，但真正的痛苦来自成组的火焰喷射器。机甲内部还藏着几把流体枪——到底是谁制造了这头怪物？我看得越久，情况就越糟。请别再把这台东西带回来。 特性: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

A heavy cavalry unit 设计ed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover 坦克s available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest 车辆s in its weight class. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 怪癖: Agile
column2: 尽管原始型号于2564年推出，改进型Condor直到32世纪初仍在生产。至少六吨的厚重装甲和多种中远程武器套件让Condor保持竞争力。作为为应对战场变化而设计的快速反应重型骑兵单位，Condor是推出时少数可用的重型气垫坦克之一。这艘巨型气垫船侧向最高速度可达129公里/小时，巡航速度为86公里/小时，是同吨位最快的车辆之一。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 特性：敏捷

column1: The Kohlen K-112 arms a rock cutter in the right arm capable of breaking down anything from pebbles to boulders, paired with a mining drill in the left arm for reaching deeper depths. Twin lift hoists, a searchlight and environmental sealing support deep mining operations. A small laser has been added to the left torso for extra flexibility. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87
column2: Kohlen K-112右臂装备岩石切割器，可将从卵石到巨石的任何东西切碎；左臂配备采矿钻头，以深入更深地层。双提升绞车、探照灯和环境密封支援深层采矿作业。左侧躯干另增一门小型激光器，以提高灵活性。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87

column1: The Little Brother LB-1X arms each arm with a light rifle fed by a total of three tons of ammunition, backed by a machine gun in each side torso with a ton of ammunition in the right torso. Eight tons of primitive 装甲 cover the frame, and an IndustrialMech ejection seat gives the pilot an escape option. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Little Brother LB-1X每条手臂各装备一门轻型步枪，共有三吨弹药；两侧躯干各有一挺机枪，右侧躯干另存一吨弹药。机体覆盖八吨原始装甲，工业机甲弹射座椅为驾驶员提供逃生选择。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and integrated CASE round out the design. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 右臂安装高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有两具 ER 大型激光器，右侧装有两具中型脉冲激光器。左臂的增强型超重型自动炮/20以四吨弹药提供双倍射速。铁纤维装甲和集成 CASE 完善了设计。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The 'Rigor Mortis' project was focused on creating an even further improved version of the Ultralight 引擎. RISC scientists attempted to improve its performance by extending some parts of the 引擎 all the way into the shoulders of the 'Mech. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: “Rigor Mortis”项目致力于制造进一步改进的超轻型引擎。RISC 科学家试图把引擎的部分结构一直延伸到机甲肩部，以提升性能。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Taking inspiration from the original Grasshopper 5H, the 8K is a Dark Age re设计 of the Grasshopper that reinvents it as a long ranged skirmisher and raider. Armed with 4 LPPC’s and an ER Large Laser, the 8K retains the 5H’s head mounted LRM-5; albeit with the inclusion of CAE II to protect the ammo bay. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 5H的8K汲取原版5H的设计灵感，是黑暗时代重新设计的Grasshopper，将其改造成远程游击与突袭机甲。它装备4门LPPC和一门ER大型激光，保留5H头部安装的LRM-5，并加入CAE II保护弹药舱。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't 设计ed for frontline combat, and the 设计ation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional un装甲ed sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly 装甲ed and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle 装甲. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.8832 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: PAB-28狙击战斗装甲并非为前线作战设计，联邦工业给予它的涂装正是对此的明确提醒。PAB-28在新地岛的联邦工业工厂制造，擅长在传统无装甲狙击手无法行动的区域作战。它装甲轻薄、速度缓慢，任务是进入阵地等待目标出现，而不是直接交战或在开阔地战斗；在任务参数范围内使用时，PAB-28证明了自己是一套有效装备，尽管缺乏重型战斗装甲的声望和吸引力。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. While updating the 设计 the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Falconer FLC-10R 通过增加有效装甲来解决 FLC-8R 高斯步枪易受灾难性损伤的问题，采用轻型铁纤维装甲并减少一具散热器。升级过程中，所有激光器也换成扩展射程型号。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Based on the Minotaur XP, this version reduces the SRM to an SRM-4 with eight reloads. It uses the same 改进的 Heavy Small Lasers, however, and retains the maximized 装甲 protection. To overcome the Minotaur's low speed, engineers added a Proto机甲-scale Magnetic Clamp system that allows the Proto机甲 to "hitch a ride" on friendly units. 怪癖: Resilient 掉落成本乘数: 0.984
column2: 该型号以米诺陶XP为基础，将SRM缩减为一具配备八次装填的SRM-4。它仍使用相同的改进型重型小型激光，并保留最大化的装甲防护。为弥补米诺陶速度低下的问题，工程师加装了原型机甲规模的磁力夹持系统，使这台原型机甲能够“搭便车”跟随友军单位。 特性：坚韧 击杀倍率：0.984

column1: Mad Cat II设计成功后，该设计增加了Mad Cat的吨位和武器配置，幽灵熊氏族将这些改进同样应用于中型Ryoken。The ''Gunboat'' variant carries a heavier weapons payload. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 在Mad Cat II取得成功后，这个型号重新思考了Mad Cat的定位，将这些改进应用到Ryoken的机体上。“炮艇”变体携带更重的武器载荷。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.15 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. 设计 as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL引擎 is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of 装甲 which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是黑暗时代对掠夺者的重建型。掠夺者4K是库里塔家族对旧式3R变体的更新，定位为重型近战斗士和城市突击单位。4K将LRM-20（3K配置）换成配备阿波罗增强系统的MRM-30，并以短管PPC替换LB-10X。XL引擎被移除以降低成本、提高耐久性，代价是损失3吨装甲，但这被视为可以接受的交换。C3从属单元得到保留，使4K能够传输数据，让远程长机获益。16组双散热器维持4K的热量平衡，CASE保护舱中的4吨MRM弹药则为导弹提供充足火力。 特性：分心 击杀倍率：1.16 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: The '机甲's primary configuration allows it to be effective at both medium and long ranges. Its primary armament is a rotary AC/5 with three tons of ammo protected by CASE II, while for shorter ranges it carries a single ER 中型激光器. A light TAG is carried for target 设计ation. Ten double heat sinks are sufficient to keep the '机甲 cool, under most circumstances. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 机甲的基础配置能够在中远距离有效作战。主要武器是一门转管自动炮/5，配备3吨CASE II保护弹药；近距离则携带一门ER中型激光器。轻型TAG用于标定目标。10组双重散热器在大多数情况下足以让机甲保持冷却。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Gyrfalcon 5 caters to 机甲Warriors that long for close combat by sacrificing heat dissipation and endurance to mount larger autocannons. The '机甲 is so well-rounded that even more moderate Galaxy Commanders, such as Aleksandr Hazen and Noritomo Helmer, favored it. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Gyrfalcon 5迎合渴望近战的机甲战士，通过牺牲散热和续航能力来安装更大的自动炮。这台机甲各方面都很均衡，连Aleksandr Hazen和Noritomo Helmer这样的温和派战团指挥官也偏爱它。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Primary configuration of the Keratos mounts five iATM launchers with 12 tons of ammunition. Four Small Supra Lasers provide some defensive fire capabilities and 18 heat sinks provide just enough cooling to limit the heat buildup of consecutive alpha strikes. 特性：Multi Trac 部署成本倍率：1.37 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Keratos基础配置安装五具iATM发射器，携带12吨弹药。四门小型Supra激光器提供一定的防御火力，18组散热器则刚好足以限制连续全弹齐射造成的热量积累。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.37 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Named for a shapeshifting Monster of Terran Philippine Folklore, the Aswang 全向Mech employs advanced and experimental technologies, including a mimetic 装甲, to blend into the night and hunt its victims. 特性：AR20 WarFare Suite 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Aswang全向机甲以泰拉太空时代前菲律宾民间传说中的变形怪物命名，采用包括拟态装甲在内的先进实验技术，能够融入夜色并猎杀目标。 特性：AR20作战套件 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

The '机甲 is said to have brought luck to its owner, and when it arrives will pause whatever's currently happening thanks to it's 'swarm of stings', just like the fabled creatures for which it was named 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.06

Substantial 装甲 of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit 设计ed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover 坦克s available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest 车辆s in its weight class. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 怪癖: Agile
column2: 尽管原始型号于2564年推出，改进型Condor直到32世纪初仍在生产。至少六吨的厚重装甲和多种中远程武器套件让Condor保持竞争力。作为为应对战场变化而设计的快速反应重型骑兵单位，Condor是推出时少数可用的重型气垫坦克之一。这艘巨型气垫船侧向最高速度可达129公里/小时，巡航速度为86公里/小时，是同吨位最快的车辆之一。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 特性：敏捷

column1: The Kohlen K-112 arms a rock cutter in the right arm capable of breaking down anything from pebbles to boulders, paired with a mining drill in the left arm for reaching deeper depths. Twin lift hoists, a searchlight and environmental sealing support deep mining operations. A small laser has been added to the left torso for extra flexibility. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87
column2: Kohlen K-112右臂装备岩石切割器，可将从卵石到巨石的任何东西切碎；左臂配备采矿钻头，以深入更深地层。双提升绞车、探照灯和环境密封支援深层采矿作业。左侧躯干另增一门小型激光器，以提高灵活性。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87

column1: The Little Brother LB-1X arms each arm with a light rifle fed by a total of three tons of ammunition, backed by a machine gun in each side torso with a ton of ammunition in the right torso. Eight tons of primitive 装甲 cover the frame, and an IndustrialMech ejection seat gives the pilot an escape option. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Little Brother LB-1X每条手臂各装备一门轻型步枪，共有三吨弹药；两侧躯干各有一挺机枪，右侧躯干另存一吨弹药。机体覆盖八吨原始装甲，工业机甲弹射座椅为驾驶员提供逃生选择。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and integrated CASE round out the design. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 右臂安装高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有两具 ER 大型激光器，右侧装有两具中型脉冲激光器。左臂的增强型超重型自动炮/20以四吨弹药提供双倍射速。铁纤维装甲和集成 CASE 完善了设计。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The 'Rigor Mortis' project was focused on creating an even further improved version of the Ultralight 引擎. RISC scientists attempted to improve its performance by extending some parts of the 引擎 all the way into the shoulders of the 'Mech. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: “Rigor Mortis”项目致力于制造进一步改进的超轻型引擎。RISC 科学家试图把引擎的部分结构一直延伸到机甲肩部，以提升性能。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Taking inspiration from the original Grasshopper 5H, the 8K is a Dark Age re设计 of the Grasshopper that reinvents it as a long ranged skirmisher and raider. Armed with 4 LPPC’s and an ER Large Laser, the 8K retains the 5H’s head mounted LRM-5; albeit with the inclusion of CAE II to protect the ammo bay. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 5H的8K汲取原版5H的设计灵感，是黑暗时代重新设计的Grasshopper，将其改造成远程游击与突袭机甲。它装备4门LPPC和一门ER大型激光，保留5H头部安装的LRM-5，并加入CAE II保护弹药舱。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't 设计ed for frontline combat, and the 设计ation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional un装甲ed sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly 装甲ed and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle 装甲. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.8832 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: PAB-28狙击战斗装甲并非为前线作战设计，联邦工业给予它的涂装正是对此的明确提醒。PAB-28在新地岛的联邦工业工厂制造，擅长在传统无装甲狙击手无法行动的区域作战。它装甲轻薄、速度缓慢，任务是进入阵地等待目标出现，而不是直接交战或在开阔地战斗；在任务参数范围内使用时，PAB-28证明了自己是一套有效装备，尽管缺乏重型战斗装甲的声望和吸引力。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. While updating the 设计 the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Falconer FLC-10R 通过增加有效装甲来解决 FLC-8R 高斯步枪易受灾难性损伤的问题，采用轻型铁纤维装甲并减少一具散热器。升级过程中，所有激光器也换成扩展射程型号。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Based on the Minotaur XP, this version reduces the SRM to an SRM-4 with eight reloads. It uses the same 改进的 Heavy Small Lasers, however, and retains the maximized 装甲 protection. To overcome the Minotaur's low speed, engineers added a Proto机甲-scale Magnetic Clamp system that allows the Proto机甲 to "hitch a ride" on friendly units. 怪癖: Resilient 掉落成本乘数: 0.984
column2: 该型号以米诺陶XP为基础，将SRM缩减为一具配备八次装填的SRM-4。它仍使用相同的改进型重型小型激光，并保留最大化的装甲防护。为弥补米诺陶速度低下的问题，工程师加装了原型机甲规模的磁力夹持系统，使这台原型机甲能够“搭便车”跟随友军单位。 特性：坚韧 击杀倍率：0.984

column1: Mad Cat II设计成功后，该设计增加了Mad Cat的吨位和武器配置，幽灵熊氏族将这些改进同样应用于中型Ryoken。The ''Gunboat'' variant carries a heavier weapons payload. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 在Mad Cat II取得成功后，这个型号重新思考了Mad Cat的定位，将这些改进应用到Ryoken的机体上。“炮艇”变体携带更重的武器载荷。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.15 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. 设计 as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL引擎 is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of 装甲 which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是黑暗时代对掠夺者的重建型。掠夺者4K是库里塔家族对旧式3R变体的更新，定位为重型近战斗士和城市突击单位。4K将LRM-20（3K配置）换成配备阿波罗增强系统的MRM-30，并以短管PPC替换LB-10X。XL引擎被移除以降低成本、提高耐久性，代价是损失3吨装甲，但这被视为可以接受的交换。C3从属单元得到保留，使4K能够传输数据，让远程长机获益。16组双散热器维持4K的热量平衡，CASE保护舱中的4吨MRM弹药则为导弹提供充足火力。 特性：分心 击杀倍率：1.16 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: The '机甲's primary configuration allows it to be effective at both medium and long ranges. Its primary armament is a rotary AC/5 with three tons of ammo protected by CASE II, while for shorter ranges it carries a single ER 中型激光器. A light TAG is carried for target 设计ation. Ten double heat sinks are sufficient to keep the '机甲 cool, under most circumstances. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 机甲的基础配置能够在中远距离有效作战。主要武器是一门转管自动炮/5，配备3吨CASE II保护弹药；近距离则携带一门ER中型激光器。轻型TAG用于标定目标。10组双重散热器在大多数情况下足以让机甲保持冷却。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Gyrfalcon 5 caters to 机甲Warriors that long for close combat by sacrificing heat dissipation and endurance to mount larger autocannons. The '机甲 is so well-rounded that even more moderate Galaxy Commanders, such as Aleksandr Hazen and Noritomo Helmer, favored it. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Gyrfalcon 5迎合渴望近战的机甲战士，通过牺牲散热和续航能力来安装更大的自动炮。这台机甲各方面都很均衡，连Aleksandr Hazen和Noritomo Helmer这样的温和派战团指挥官也偏爱它。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

Substantial 装甲 of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit 设计ed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover 坦克s available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest 车辆s in its weight class. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 怪癖: Agile
column2: 尽管原始型号于2564年推出，改进型Condor直到32世纪初仍在生产。至少六吨的厚重装甲和多种中远程武器套件让Condor保持竞争力。作为为应对战场变化而设计的快速反应重型骑兵单位，Condor是推出时少数可用的重型气垫坦克之一。这艘巨型气垫船侧向最高速度可达129公里/小时，巡航速度为86公里/小时，是同吨位最快的车辆之一。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 115 25 右侧 115 25 后方 80 25 炮塔 120 25 总计 590 125 特性：敏捷

column1: The Kohlen K-112 arms a rock cutter in the right arm capable of breaking down anything from pebbles to boulders, paired with a mining drill in the left arm for reaching deeper depths. Twin lift hoists, a searchlight and environmental sealing support deep mining operations. A small laser has been added to the left torso for extra flexibility. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87
column2: Kohlen K-112右臂装备岩石切割器，可将从卵石到巨石的任何东西切碎；左臂配备采矿钻头，以深入更深地层。双提升绞车、探照灯和环境密封支援深层采矿作业。左侧躯干另增一门小型激光器，以提高灵活性。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87

column1: The Little Brother LB-1X arms each arm with a light rifle fed by a total of three tons of ammunition, backed by a machine gun in each side torso with a ton of ammunition in the right torso. Eight tons of primitive 装甲 cover the frame, and an IndustrialMech ejection seat gives the pilot an escape option. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Little Brother LB-1X每条手臂各装备一门轻型步枪，共有三吨弹药；两侧躯干各有一挺机枪，右侧躯干另存一吨弹药。机体覆盖八吨原始装甲，工业机甲弹射座椅为驾驶员提供逃生选择。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and integrated CASE round out the design. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 右臂安装高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有两具 ER 大型激光器，右侧装有两具中型脉冲激光器。左臂的增强型超重型自动炮/20以四吨弹药提供双倍射速。铁纤维装甲和集成 CASE 完善了设计。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The 'Rigor Mortis' project was focused on creating an even further improved version of the Ultralight 引擎. RISC scientists attempted to improve its performance by extending some parts of the 引擎 all the way into the shoulders of the 'Mech. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: “Rigor Mortis”项目致力于制造进一步改进的超轻型引擎。RISC 科学家试图把引擎的部分结构一直延伸到机甲肩部，以提升性能。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Taking inspiration from the original Grasshopper 5H, the 8K is a Dark Age re设计 of the Grasshopper that reinvents it as a long ranged skirmisher and raider. Armed with 4 LPPC’s and an ER Large Laser, the 8K retains the 5H’s head mounted LRM-5; albeit with the inclusion of CAE II to protect the ammo bay. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 5H的8K汲取原版5H的设计灵感，是黑暗时代重新设计的Grasshopper，将其改造成远程游击与突袭机甲。它装备4门LPPC和一门ER大型激光，保留5H头部安装的LRM-5，并加入CAE II保护弹药舱。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't 设计ed for frontline combat, and the 设计ation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional un装甲ed sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly 装甲ed and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle 装甲. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.8832 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: PAB-28狙击战斗装甲并非为前线作战设计，联邦工业给予它的涂装正是对此的明确提醒。PAB-28在新地岛的联邦工业工厂制造，擅长在传统无装甲狙击手无法行动的区域作战。它装甲轻薄、速度缓慢，任务是进入阵地等待目标出现，而不是直接交战或在开阔地战斗；在任务参数范围内使用时，PAB-28证明了自己是一套有效装备，尽管缺乏重型战斗装甲的声望和吸引力。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. While updating the 设计 the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Falconer FLC-10R 通过增加有效装甲来解决 FLC-8R 高斯步枪易受灾难性损伤的问题，采用轻型铁纤维装甲并减少一具散热器。升级过程中，所有激光器也换成扩展射程型号。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Based on the Minotaur XP, this version reduces the SRM to an SRM-4 with eight reloads. It uses the same 改进的 Heavy Small Lasers, however, and retains the maximized 装甲 protection. To overcome the Minotaur's low speed, engineers added a Proto机甲-scale Magnetic Clamp system that allows the Proto机甲 to "hitch a ride" on friendly units. 怪癖: Resilient 掉落成本乘数: 0.984
column2: 该型号以米诺陶XP为基础，将SRM缩减为一具配备八次装填的SRM-4。它仍使用相同的改进型重型小型激光，并保留最大化的装甲防护。为弥补米诺陶速度低下的问题，工程师加装了原型机甲规模的磁力夹持系统，使这台原型机甲能够“搭便车”跟随友军单位。 特性：坚韧 击杀倍率：0.984

column1: Mad Cat II设计成功后，该设计增加了Mad Cat的吨位和武器配置，幽灵熊氏族将这些改进同样应用于中型Ryoken。The ''Gunboat'' variant carries a heavier weapons payload. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 在Mad Cat II取得成功后，这个型号重新思考了Mad Cat的定位，将这些改进应用到Ryoken的机体上。“炮艇”变体携带更重的武器载荷。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.15 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. 设计 as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL引擎 is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of 装甲 which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是黑暗时代对掠夺者的重建型。掠夺者4K是库里塔家族对旧式3R变体的更新，定位为重型近战斗士和城市突击单位。4K将LRM-20（3K配置）换成配备阿波罗增强系统的MRM-30，并以短管PPC替换LB-10X。XL引擎被移除以降低成本、提高耐久性，代价是损失3吨装甲，但这被视为可以接受的交换。C3从属单元得到保留，使4K能够传输数据，让远程长机获益。16组双散热器维持4K的热量平衡，CASE保护舱中的4吨MRM弹药则为导弹提供充足火力。 特性：分心 击杀倍率：1.16 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: The '机甲's primary configuration allows it to be effective at both medium and long ranges. Its primary armament is a rotary AC/5 with three tons of ammo protected by CASE II, while for shorter ranges it carries a single ER 中型激光器. A light TAG is carried for target 设计ation.
