Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional un装甲ed sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly 装甲ed and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle 装甲. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.8832 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: PAB-28狙击战斗装甲并非为前线作战设计，联邦工业给予它的涂装正是对此的明确提醒。PAB-28在新地岛的联邦工业工厂制造，擅长在传统无装甲狙击手无法行动的区域作战。它装甲轻薄、速度缓慢，任务是进入阵地等待目标出现，而不是直接交战或在开阔地战斗；在任务参数范围内使用时，PAB-28证明了自己是一套有效装备，尽管缺乏重型战斗装甲的声望和吸引力。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. While updating the 设计 the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Falconer FLC-10R 通过增加有效装甲来解决 FLC-8R 高斯步枪易受灾难性损伤的问题，采用轻型铁纤维装甲并减少一具散热器。升级过程中，所有激光器也换成扩展射程型号。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Based on the Minotaur XP, this version reduces the SRM to an SRM-4 with eight reloads. It uses the same 改进的 Heavy Small Lasers, however, and retains the maximized 装甲 protection. To overcome the Minotaur's low speed, engineers added a Proto机甲-scale Magnetic Clamp system that allows the Proto机甲 to "hitch a ride" on friendly units. 怪癖: Resilient 掉落成本乘数: 0.984
column2: 该型号以米诺陶XP为基础，将SRM缩减为一具配备八次装填的SRM-4。它仍使用相同的改进型重型小型激光，并保留最大化的装甲防护。为弥补米诺陶速度低下的问题，工程师加装了原型机甲规模的磁力夹持系统，使这台原型机甲能够“搭便车”跟随友军单位。 特性：坚韧 击杀倍率：0.984

column1: Mad Cat II设计成功后，该设计增加了Mad Cat的吨位和武器配置，幽灵熊氏族将这些改进同样应用于中型Ryoken。The ''Gunboat'' variant carries a heavier weapons payload. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 在Mad Cat II取得成功后，这个型号重新思考了Mad Cat的定位，将这些改进应用到Ryoken的机体上。“炮艇”变体携带更重的武器载荷。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.15 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. 设计 as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL引擎 is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of 装甲 which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是黑暗时代对掠夺者的重建型。掠夺者4K是库里塔家族对旧式3R变体的更新，定位为重型近战斗士和城市突击单位。4K将LRM-20（3K配置）换成配备阿波罗增强系统的MRM-30，并以短管PPC替换LB-10X。XL引擎被移除以降低成本、提高耐久性，代价是损失3吨装甲，但这被视为可以接受的交换。C3从属单元得到保留，使4K能够传输数据，让远程长机获益。16组双散热器维持4K的热量平衡，CASE保护舱中的4吨MRM弹药则为导弹提供充足火力。 特性：分心 击杀倍率：1.16 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: The '机甲's primary configuration allows it to be effective at both medium and long ranges. Its primary armament is a rotary AC/5 with three tons of ammo protected by CASE II, while for shorter ranges it carries a single ER 中型激光器. A light TAG is carried for target 设计ation. Ten double heat sinks are sufficient to keep the '机甲 cool, under most circumstances. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 机甲的基础配置能够在中远距离有效作战。主要武器是一门转管自动炮/5，配备3吨CASE II保护弹药；近距离则携带一门ER中型激光器。轻型TAG用于标定目标。10组双重散热器在大多数情况下足以让机甲保持冷却。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Gyrfalcon 5 caters to 机甲Warriors that long for close combat by sacrificing heat dissipation and endurance to mount larger autocannons. The '机甲 is so well-rounded that even more moderate Galaxy Commanders, such as Aleksandr Hazen and Noritomo Helmer, favored it. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Gyrfalcon 5迎合渴望近战的机甲战士，通过牺牲散热和续航能力来安装更大的自动炮。这台机甲各方面都很均衡，连Aleksandr Hazen和Noritomo Helmer这样的温和派战团指挥官也偏爱它。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，把 75 吨重型机甲变成 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。Arm Actuator Limit: LeftArm lower RightArm lower\nThe Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis.This Steiner variant was built to carry a 重型高斯步枪.
column2: Marauder II于3012年问世，是经典Marauder的重新设计，试图将75吨重型机甲的火力提升到100吨突击机甲的水平。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到3030年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。手臂驱动器限制：左臂 下臂 右臂 下臂\nMarauder II最初建造于3012年，旨在将Marauder的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性结合。这一Steiner变型搭载一门重型高斯步枪。

column1: 长 range fire support assets, 火炮 车辆s mount the big guns that pound stuff into metallic dust. 设计 to support allies from range, 火炮 can throw a variety of payloads down range; ranging from standard 火炮 to FASCAM or Inferno loads. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 9/14 格 / 270/420 米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 125 25 左侧 70 25 右侧 70 25 后方 45 25 炮塔 110 25 总计 420 125 怪癖: Nimble
column2: 作为远程火力支援单位，Regulator Arrow调节者箭型载具装备了能够把目标轰成金属碎片的重炮。它们负责在远距离支援友军，可以向目标区域投射多种弹药，从标准炮弹到FASCAM或炼狱弹都能使用。 生物群系限制：该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动：9/14 米/秒 / 270/420 米。 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前部 125 25 左侧 70 25 右侧 70 25 后部 45 25 顶部 110 25 总计 420 125 特性: 灵巧

column1: Badb Catha（战鸦）以古老的 Terra 爱尔兰民间传说中的死亡与混沌女神命名，预示着即将到来的血腥冲突与混乱。Part of the Morrigan 全向Mech program, alongside the Mhacha and Anand. 特性：Morrigan C3i 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Badb Catha（战鸦）以古老泰拉爱尔兰传说中的死亡与混沌女神命名，预示着即将到来的血腥冲突与混乱。它是莫里甘全能机甲计划的一部分，与Mhacha和Anand并列。 特性：莫里甘C3i 部署成本倍率：1.05 部位装甲限制：全能

column1: A prototype that only ever entered limited development, the 2G swaps the standard HAG-20 for a Gauss rifle. An XL引擎 freed up the tonnage needed to mount the rifle and allowed for the incorporation of a light active probe. Needless to say, this wasn’t popular with most the warriors assigned to it. Production was eventually cancelled in 3074, due to unacceptably high losses under combat conditions.
column2: 2G是一款仅进行有限开发的原型机，用高斯步枪替换标准HAG-20。XL引擎腾出了安装步枪所需的重量，也使其能够搭载轻型主动探头。显然，这套配置并不受大多数驾驶员欢迎。由于实战损失高得无法接受，该项目最终于3074年取消。

column1: Well Thats one way to make an 'Assault Mech'.
column2: 嗯，这确实是一种制造“突击机甲”的办法。

column1: A rare modification of the R60L model, the R60T removes the unused 11th heat sink and the AC/20 and its ammo. A 重击者火炮 piece and a ton of ammo are installed in their place.
column2: R60T是R60L的罕见改装型，拆除了未使用的第11组散热器、AC/20及其弹药，改为安装一门重击者火炮和一吨弹药。

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you—it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy 装甲 and a grown-up-sized Howitzer! Unlike its smaller brethren, this Trashcan does not have to waddle into range before bringing its weaponry to bear.
column2: 别被矮胖的“Urbie”骗了——它看起来像一只会走路的垃圾桶，却能安装厚重装甲和成人尺寸的榴弹炮！与更小的同族型号不同，这台Trashcan无需蹒跚接近射程，就能发挥武器威力。

column1: A jack of all trades, the 中型坦克 is the generic stereotype of a tank. Trading speed or weapons for 装甲, the 中型坦克 can soak up a surprisingly heavy level of fire power. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 轻型铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 120 25 右侧 120 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 135 25 总计 635 125 特性：窄小低矮轮廓
column2: 中型坦克是万金油，也是坦克的典型代表。牺牲速度或武器换取装甲后，中型坦克能够承受出人意料的猛烈火力。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 轻型铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 25 左侧 120 25 右侧 120 25 后方 100 25 炮塔 135 25 总计 635 125 特性：窄小低矮轮廓

column1: The Urbanking UBK-044 replaces the Binary laser of the -042 with three ER 中型激光s, while still keeping the 长汤姆加农炮 in the 右侧 Arm. Otherwise it is utterly bland, it's most advanced feature the XL引擎. 特性：360° 躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Urbanking UBK-044用三门ER中型激光器替换-042的二元激光器，同时保留右臂的长汤姆加农炮。除此之外它平淡无奇，最先进的设备就是XL引擎。 特性：360° 躯干扭转 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Victor XR was a project by the Republic Institute of Strategic Combat to supersize a Victor and use it as a platform for the newly developed Micro Missile System, their replacement for the MRM. A number of variants were developed, some even including stealth or huge ballistic weapons, but all were based around the same two MMS-40 launchers. All models also share the same 445 Ultralight 引擎, compact Gyro and Buffered 车辆 DNI Cockpit. Overall the project was deemed a failure, just like the MMS itself, but enough of the 'Mechs were produced that they can still be found throughout the Inner Sphere.
column2: Victor XR是共和国战略战斗研究所的项目，旨在放大Victor机体，并将其作为新型微型导弹系统的平台，以取代MRM。项目开发了多个变型，其中一些甚至加入隐形系统或巨型弹道武器，但都围绕相同的两具MMS-40发射器构建。所有型号还共用445级超轻型引擎、紧凑型陀螺仪和带缓冲的车辆DNI驾驶舱。总体而言，该项目和MMS本身一样被判定为失败；不过仍有足够机体完成生产，因此如今在内天体各处仍能见到它们。

column1: Slow, insanely durable and packing the sort of firepower that makes an Atlas look like a pop gun, these units are the ultimate line breakers or line holders. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 950 140 左侧 625 140 右侧 625 140 后方 545 140 炮塔 700 140 总计 3445 700 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: 这些单位速度缓慢，却坚韧得近乎不可思议，火力强到足以让Atlas的武器像玩具枪一样。它们是突破或守住战线的终极单位。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 950 140 左侧 625 140 右侧 625 140 后方 545 140 炮塔 700 140 总计 3445 700 怪癖： 主战坦克

column1: 有什么能胜过指挥控制台或双驾驶舱？当然是两个独立的头部！至少那些设计出这个怪胎的疯狂海盗是这么认为的。And it even carries a huge wooden cudgel, that is clearly made from no type of tree I know of. Just look at that size of that trunk!
column2: 有什么能胜过指挥控制台或双驾驶舱？当然是两个独立的头部！至少那些设计出这个怪胎的疯狂海盗是这么认为的。它甚至还携带一根巨大的木棒，显然不是用我所知的任何树木制成的。看看那树干有多粗！

column1: A full on pirate custom built '机甲 from what I can see. Don't expect me to go near it, especially with all that dried blood painted on the cockpit walls.
column2: 从我看来，这是一台彻头彻尾由海盗定制打造的战斗机甲。别指望我靠近它，尤其是驾驶舱墙上还涂满了干涸的血迹。

column1: The disabling variant of the Sea Monkey, mounting two plasma cannons as well as several missile systems. Due to shortage of proper disabling ammunition for the missile launchers the 'Mech is actually quite inefficient at its task. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Sea Monkey的瘫痪型变体，装备两门等离子炮以及多套导弹系统。由于缺少适用于导弹发射器的专用瘫痪弹药，这台机甲实际上并不擅长执行瘫痪任务。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The Ferox 2 replaces the ER PPC of the 1 with two Gauss rifles and a head-mounted 大型脉冲激光. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.5 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Ferox 2用两门高斯步枪替换1型的ER PPC，并在头部安装一门大型脉冲激光器。 怪癖： 稳定 武器 部署费用倍率: 1.5 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: Probably the most potent alpha strike of the Cameron variants, the four arm mounted Gauss rifles and the Railgun of the CMR-V1X is definitely to be feared. A single larger laser has the role of a secondary damage dealer. 特性：巨无霸瞄准辅助系统 部署成本倍率：1.46 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: CMR-V1X很可能拥有Cameron系列最强的全弹齐射：四门安装在手臂上的高斯步枪和一门轨道炮绝对令人畏惧。另有一门大型激光器负责补充伤害。 特性：巨无霸瞄准辅助系统 部署成本倍率：1.46 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: When the RISC laboratories developed the superheavy version of the 幽灵抑制护盾系统, they wanted to see how it fared in actual combat at a larger scale before they re-geared to their own heavily over-utilized superheavy factories. Three of the Great Houses were persuaded to design a number of superheavy 'Mechs around the system, all three ending up with very similar looks due to the prototype stealth system requirements and pre-designed components supplied by the Republic. The house Liao result was the Hēi Lián, translating to Black Lotus from mandarin, a 170 ton superheavy focused on delivering a powerful punch at enough range to have a chance to remain hidden after firing.
column2: RISC实验室开发超重型幽灵抑制护盾系统后，希望在重新改造自家超负荷运转的超重型工厂之前，先在更大规模的实战中观察其表现。他们说服三大高等家族围绕该系统设计多台超重型机甲。由于原型隐形系统的要求以及共和国提供的预制部件，三家的成品外形都非常相似。辽家族的成果是Hēi Lián，普通话意为“黑莲”，这是一台170吨超重型机甲，专注于在足够远的距离释放强大火力，以便射击后仍有机会保持隐蔽。

column1: Seizing on lore of old, and finding historical records of mighty creatures that once roamed Terra, the mighty engineers of Takara industries come forth once more, to show us how a '机甲 can be the most fearful thing on the battlefield.
column2: Takara工业的工程师从古老传说中汲取灵感，查阅了曾在泰拉大地上漫游的巨兽历史记录，再次向我们展示一台战斗机甲如何成为战场上最令人恐惧的存在。

column1: Looks like pirates have raided a museum, took everything they found there, welded it all together, then strapped some dropship engines on it and called it a Land Air 机甲.
column2: 看起来海盗洗劫了一座博物馆，把找到的一切都焊在一起，再绑上几台空投舰引擎，然后称之为陆空机甲。

column1: A ClanTech redesign of the 斯科贝尔机甲工厂 Omega, upgrading all its weapon to deal a debilitating strike.
column2: 这是氏族技术人员对斯科贝尔机甲工厂Omega的重新设计，升级全部武器，以造成致命打击。

column1: The SBK-2B2 mounts a combination of LRM and SRM weapons, combined with a 重击者加农炮, two PPCs and two 中型激光s. Nothing in particular stands out about the model, but it fulfills its duties without issues. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.36 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: SBK-2B2结合LRM和SRM武器，并配备一门重击者加农炮、两门PPC和两门中型激光器。该型号没有特别突出的特点，但能够可靠完成任务。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.36 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: Originally a custom 设计 for a mercenary company, the -7K was well liked enough that it became a standard production model. Two typical PPC provide the main damage together with four 增程LRM-10 launchers. Two Brightbloom ER 中型激光s and one head mounted Intek Small Laser creates the secondary line of weapons together with an arm mounted SRM-4. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.36 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -7K最初是为一家佣兵公司定制的设计，因广受欢迎而成为标准量产型号。两门常规PPC与四具增程LRM-10发射器构成主要火力；两门Brightbloom ER中型激光器、一门安装在头部的Intek小型激光器，以及一具安装在手臂上的SRM-4组成辅助武器。 怪癖： 易于维护 部署费用倍率: 1.36 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The -8M combine MML and LRM launchers, together with one of the most common and easily maintained ballistic weapons in the Periphery, the Heavy Rifle. Two Brightbloom ER 中型激光s and a Blazefire ER Large Laser finish up the weapons loadout of the -8M. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.36 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -8M结合MML和LRM发射器，并采用边疆最常见、最易维护的弹道武器之一——重型步枪。两门Brightbloom ER中型激光器和一门Blazefire ER大型激光器完成-8M的武器配置。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.36 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: 拿一台基础型猎虎机甲，把它做得更大，你就得到独立武器公司的超级猎虎。这头115吨的野兽拥有纯粹的弹道火力，完全专注于自动火炮及其辅助系统。In an attempt to keep costs down, the Uberjager only mounts a 285 XL引擎 and has limited 装甲.
column2: 拿一台基础型猎虎机甲，把它做得更大，你就得到独立武器公司的超级猎虎。这头115吨的野兽拥有纯粹的弹道火力，完全专注于自动火炮及其辅助系统。为降低成本，Uberjager只安装一台285级XL引擎，装甲也很有限。

column1: The -B4 is focused on clustering ballistic weapons through its combination of LB-X AC/20 and 银弹高斯. Having not other weapons, it keeps to the design change of the second generation Uberjager to only focus on its ballistic weapons. 特性：精准武器—弹道 部署成本倍率：1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -B4通过LB-X AC/20和银弹高斯的组合，专注于集中使用弹道武器。由于没有其他武器，它延续了第二代Uberjager只专注弹道火力的设计变化。 特性：精准武器—弹道 部署成本倍率：1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Gullfaxi Omnimonitor was the second project by the 设计 team that made the Gulltoppr for Clan Wolf in Exile and the Lyran Commonwealth. Packing a significant percentage of its predecessors firepower into a smaller and significantly cheaper package. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲: 装甲 (C) 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 600 105 左侧 500 105 右侧 500 105 后方 400 105 炮塔 400 105 总计 2400 525 怪癖: 泰克铁康TC7000 Omni 车辆
column2: Gullfaxi全向监视坦克是为流亡狼族和莱拉联邦制造Gulltoppr的设计团队开发的第二个项目。它将前代相当比例的火力压缩进更小、成本低得多的机体中。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲: 装甲 (C) 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 600 105 左侧 500 105 右侧 500 105 后方 400 105 炮塔 400 105 总计 2400 525 怪癖： 泰克铁康TC7000 全向车辆

column1: 那是辆坦克，老板，对我来说它们都一个样。This one is pretty big though.
column2: 那是辆坦克，老板，对我来说它们都一个样。不过这辆确实大得多。

column1: The 2M is a 明尼苏达部落 upgrade variant of the old royal 1Gb. A pair enhanced PPCs, one of those Ion Stream Projectors, and a quintet of 中型激光器 makes this thing a nightmare. The Thermal Overload System and Particle Recyclers are just icing on the cake.
column2: 2M是明尼苏达部落对旧式皇家1Gb的升级型。两门增强型PPC、一门离子流投射器和五门中型激光器让它成为噩梦。热量过载系统和粒子回收器只是锦上添花。

column1: While this isn't as stealthy as other 灭绝者s we've seen, this thing is still far faster than it has any right to be.
column2: 虽然它不像我们见过的其他灭绝者那样隐秘，但这东西的速度依然快得离谱。

column1: The Highlander 751 expands upon the ancient 732b variant used by the SLDF by swaping the Gauss rifle for a Flechette 20, missile systems with Fire and Forget launchers, and the lasers with a triplet of 中型脉冲激光s. 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Highlander 751在SLDF使用的古老732b变型基础上扩展而来：用Flechette 20替换高斯步枪，用“发射后不管”发射器替换导弹系统，并用三门中型脉冲激光器替换原有激光器。 特性：强化腿部 部署成本倍率：1.22 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: Any Highlander is going to be dangerous but this one seems particularly scary for anything that relies on speed over 装甲.
column2: 任何Highlander都很危险，但对于依赖速度而非装甲的单位来说，这一台尤其可怕。

column1: An AC20 should not move that fast, boss. It just ain't right.
column2: 老板，AC20不该跑得这么快。这不对劲。

column1: A versatile 60 ton chassis 开发 by 明尼苏达部落 engineers, the Lunar Crab shares a lot of 设计 considerations in common with its lighter cousin, the Crab. The Lunar Crab 1E carries a pair of ER Large Lasers and six 中型激光s. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lunar Crab是明尼苏达部落工程师开发的多用途60吨底盘，与较轻的Crab拥有许多共同设计理念。Lunar Crab 1E携带两门ER大型激光器和六门中型激光器。 怪癖： 稳定 武器 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The Lunar Crab 1ES is an ambush conversion of the 1E, trading the 300XL for a 300-rating明尼苏达部落 Stealth 引擎, switching to Improved Large Lasers in the arms, and trading the 中型激光 compliment for a pair of Rocketstorm 90 batteries. 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lunar Crab 1ES是1E的伏击改装型，用300额定的明尼苏达部落隐形引擎替换300XL，在双臂换装改进型大型激光器，并将中型激光器组合替换为两组Rocketstorm 90电池。 特性：武器稳定 部署成本倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: A versatile 60 ton chassis 开发 by 明尼苏达部落 engineers, the Lunar Crab shares a lot of 设计 considerations in common with its lighter cousin, the Crab. The Lunar Crab 1F shoulders a Flechette 20 and carries a pair of 中型激光s and a Small Laser in each arm. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lunar Crab是明尼苏达部落工程师开发的多用途60吨底盘，与较轻的Crab拥有许多共同设计理念。Lunar Crab 1F装备一门Flechette 20，双臂各携带两门中型激光器和一门小型激光器。 怪癖： 稳定 武器 部署费用倍率: 1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: I'm not really sure we can call it a Panther at this point.
column2: 我真不确定现在还能不能把它叫作Panther。

column1: Built for long-range firepower, this Pulverizer relies on a Hyper PPC for firepower at all ranges and the inclusion of a standard 引擎 and Heavy Cockpit makes it sturdier than many of its contemporaries.
column2: 这台Pulverizer专为远程火力打造，以Hyper PPC在所有射程提供火力；标准引擎和重型驾驶舱使它比许多同时代机体更加坚固。

column1: For a light mech, this thing is pretty quick and pretty 装甲ed. Hard to go wrong with that.
column2: 对于一台轻型机甲来说，这东西速度很快，装甲也很厚。选择它很难出错。

column1: The Stag II 24M is a minor evolution of the 24G variant. The 24M trades in the short ranged Medium Pulse and Small Lasers in for an Ion Stream Projector in order to handle 战斗装甲 and Infantry while still being detrimental to BattleMechs. 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Stag II 24M是24G变型的小幅演进。24M用离子流投射器替换射程较短的中型脉冲激光和小型激光器，以对付战斗装甲和步兵，同时仍能有效威胁战斗机甲。 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: I don't know whose bright idea it was to bolt a Siege Laser on such a light 'Mech but at least they gave it a Stealth 引擎 to keep its profile down.
column2: 不知道是谁想出了在如此轻型的机甲上安装攻城激光的馊主意，但至少他们给它配了隐形引擎来降低信号特征。

column1: The Bulldog could be called a 'Jack of all trades', featuring a classic layout of one main gun and a few secondary weapons. It is easy to repair and said to be a reliable and cheap asset for any field commander that needs a backbone for his 车辆 forces. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 130 30 左侧 100 30 右侧 100 30 后方 100 30 炮塔 100 30 总计 530 150 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: Bulldog可以称作“万金油”，采用一门主炮加数件辅助武器的经典布局。它易于维修，也是任何需要为车辆部队提供骨干的战地指挥官都能信赖且负担得起的资产。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 130 30 左侧 100 30 右侧 100 30 后方 100 30 炮塔 100 30 总计 530 150 怪癖： 主战坦克

column1: The Arctos ACT-1 has a clear long range damage profile with its two 重型高斯步枪s and iATM-9 launchers. It does still mount a combination of Medium ER Pulse Lasers and Medium Supra Lasers for closer engagements, but the variant suffers at close range battles. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.45 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Arctos ACT-1拥有清晰的远程伤害定位，配备两门重型高斯步枪和iATM-9发射器。它还安装中型ER脉冲激光器和中型Supra激光器，以应对近距离交战，但该变型在近战中表现较差。 怪癖： 改进的 定位 - 长 部署费用倍率: 1.45 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: What...in...the...world!? Is this a 'Mech or ancient behemoth!? Look at all that 装甲, that protective plating, and all those latest tech weapons!
column2: 什么……这到底是什么！？这是战斗机甲还是远古巨兽！？看看这些装甲、那些防护板，还有所有最新科技武器！

column1: A refit made by the Society to the base Erebus designs, adding a lot more cutting edge technology. Titano-Carbide Lamellor 装甲, Endo-Titanium 结构 and a Radical Heat Sink kit are all amongst the upgrades. Even the cockpit systems have been upgraded with 增强成像 and a Nova CEWS.
column2: 这是Society对Erebus基础设计的改装型，加入了更多尖端技术。升级项目包括钛碳化物层叠装甲、内钛结构和激进型散热器套件；甚至驾驶舱系统也升级为增强成像和Nova CEWS。

column1: I'm pretty sure this thing growled at me, boss. Hyperion Prime 是a hell of a machine, despite being 25 tons heavier, it 是just as fast as an Atlas, 携带more 装甲, and those Arrow V missiles pack a hell of a punch.
column2: 老板，我很确定这东西刚才对我咆哮了。Hyperion Prime真是一台可怕的机器：虽然重了25吨，却和Atlas一样快，携带更多装甲，而那些Arrow V导弹的威力也极其惊人。

column1: The Primary configuration of the Keratos mounts five iATM launchers with 12 tons of ammunition. Four Small Supra Lasers provide some defensive fire capabilities and 18 heat sinks provide just enough cooling to limit the heat buildup of consecutive alpha strikes. 特性：Multi Trac 部署成本倍率：1.37 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Keratos基础配置安装五具iATM发射器，携带12吨弹药。四门小型Supra激光器提供一定的防御火力，18组散热器则刚好足以限制连续全弹齐射造成的热量积累。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.37 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: I've heard of the Dragon Fire, boss, but this thing ain't much like them other ones. This Dragon Fire IIC is an Omni-机甲 and sports all sorts of shenanigans that make it a force to be reckoned with in any configuration.
column2: 老板，我听说过Dragon Fire，但这东西和那些Dragon Fire不太一样。这台Dragon Fire IIC是全向机甲，拥有各种奇特装备，无论采用哪种配置都不容小觑。

column1: Despite the design being considered obsolete well before the Exodus, the schematics for the Helepolis siege mech survived the journey to the Pentagon Worlds where it went largely ignored until the Golden Century. A small group of Coyote scientists retooled the arcane design, increasing its tonnage and applying most of the weight saving techologies available, and submitted it to their Khan. Despite being rejected as a dishonorable design the HEP-IIC survived in Society caches and has slowly been upgraded over the years. The Z variant sports a Sniper 火炮 Piece and a Society MRM60.
column2: 尽管Helepolis攻城机甲的设计早在大迁徙之前就被认为过时，其蓝图仍随旅程抵达五角世界，并在那里基本无人问津，直到黄金世纪才重新受到关注。一小群Coyotes科学家重新设计了这套神秘图纸，增加吨位并应用当时可用的大部分减重技术，随后提交给他们的可汗。虽然被斥为不光彩的设计而遭拒，HEP-IIC仍保存在Society的储藏库中，并在多年间逐步升级。Z变型配备一门狙击火炮和一门Society MRM60。

column1: The 高地人 IIC Z is a Society prototype 开发 as an Assault test-bed for the new Advanced Torso-Mount Cockpit. The HGN-IIC Z keeps the iconic Gauss Rifle and Jump Jets of its predecessors but sports a pair of Society MRM30s  and a trio of Small Supra Lasers as its remaining armament.
column2: 高地人IIC Z是Society开发的原型机，用作新型高级躯干安装驾驶舱的突击试验平台。HGN-IIC Z保留前代标志性的高斯步枪和跳跃喷射器，并以两门Society MRM30和三门小型Supra激光器作为其余武器。

column1: Built on the 掠夺者 IIC workhorse chassis, the Z variant eschews the ERPPCs for a Society 重型高斯步枪, a quartet of Medium Supra Lasers, a prototype supercharged light 340SL 引擎 and four Jump Jets for mobility.
column2: Z变型采用掠夺者IIC的主力底盘，舍弃ER PPC，改装一门Society重型高斯步枪、四门中型Supra激光器、一台原型增压轻型340SL引擎和四具跳跃喷射器，以提升机动性。

column1: A Society refit of the Medusa 3, the Z drops the UAC20 and jump jets in favor of a Society 重型高斯步枪.
column2: 这是Society对Medusa 3的改装型，拆除UAC20和跳跃喷射器，换装一门Society重型高斯步枪。

column1: A Society configuration of the relatively young Shadow Cat Omni-机甲, the Z config replaces the Gauss Rifle with a Society MRM60 and the ER 中型激光s with Heavy 中型激光s. Where possible, Society engineers also incluided additional or upgraded systems and a Nova CEWS to provide superior EW capabilities.
column2: 这是相对较新的Shadow Cat全向机甲的Society配置。Z配置用Society MRM60替换高斯步枪，用重型中型激光器替换ER中型激光器。Society工程师还尽可能加入额外或升级系统，并安装Nova CEWS以提供卓越的电子战能力。

column1: A refit designed for garrison troops, the Urbanmech IICr was as a stop gap upgrade utilised by 雪鸦氏族 and later the 渡鸦同盟; to guard against piracy attacks on their frontier holdings. Trading the traditional IIC armament for a pair of Heavy Large Lasers and enough heat sinks to keep it more or less functional in combat, it is capable of delivering a knockout punch against adversaries far exceeding it’s own weight . The raw fire power of the Heavy Lasers forces the pilot to alternate their firing sequences to minimise heat build up or risk a shutdown. Never a popular mech, it found a new life as a training mech in the Alliance armed forces; teaching sibko the importance of heat management and battlefield awareness.
column2: Urbanmech IICr是为驻军部队设计的改装型，最初是雪鸦氏族、后来是渡鸦同盟为防范边疆领地海盗袭击而采用的过渡升级。它放弃传统IIC武器，换装两门重型大型激光器和足够的散热器，使其基本能够投入战斗，并能对远超自身重量的敌人造成致命打击。重型激光器的原始火力迫使驾驶员交替射击，以尽量减少热量积累，否则就有停机风险。这台机甲从未广受欢迎，却在同盟武装部队中获得了新用途，成为训练机甲，教导氏族学员掌握热量管理和战场态势感知。

column1: Slower than the 中型坦克, but possessing heavier 装甲 and fire power, the 重型坦克 is a fearsome combatant. Packing a potent array of heavy weapons, the 重型坦克 is a serious threat to any Tank or 机甲 that encounters it. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: Glazed (C) 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 285 30 左侧 235 30 右侧 235 30 后方 200 30 炮塔 225 30 总计 1180 150 怪癖: 主战坦克
column2: 重型坦克比中型坦克更慢，却拥有更厚的装甲和更强的火力，是令人畏惧的战斗单位。它配备大量威力强大的重型武器，对任何遭遇它的坦克或战斗机甲都是严重威胁。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 镀层装甲 (C) 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 285 30 左侧 235 30 右侧 235 30 后方 200 30 炮塔 225 30 总计 1180 150 怪癖： 主战坦克

column1: The Bandit-Z carries an iATM-9 with 3 tons of ammunition to support its infantry cargo. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：9/14 格 / 270/420 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 220 25 左侧 200 25 右侧 200 25 后方 115 25 炮塔 160 25 总计 895 125 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 全向 Vehicle Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.

column1: Originally 开发 by Vitesse Vehicles of Terra in 2611, the Prowler Multi-Terrain-Vehicle was the most common hostile and exotic environment military-grade exploration 车辆s. The Prowler was almost unsurpassed in its niche, the 设计 proving popular enough for Vitesse to halt production and merely license the 设计 to manufacturers across the Inner Sphere and Periphery. While never 生产 in large numbers, all post–Star League era Successor State militaries maintained a number of the 车辆 for combat on their most inhospitable planets. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 装甲 (C) 结构: 环境密封 数值 A S 前方 145 30 左侧 125 30 右侧 125 30 后方 100 30 炮塔 135 30 总计 630 150 怪癖: 增强型防火设备 Can carry 1 Battle 装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: Prowler多地形车最初由泰拉的Vitesse 车辆于2611年开发，是 hostile 和 exotic 环境中最常见的军用探索车辆。Prowler几乎在这一领域无可匹敌，其设计广受欢迎，以至于Vitesse停止生产，转而将设计授权给内天体和边疆的制造商。虽然从未大规模生产，但星盟时代之后的各继承国军队都保留了一批车辆，用于在最恶劣的行星上作战。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 4/6 格 / 120/180 米. 装甲: 装甲 (C) 结构: 环境密封 数值 A S 前方 145 30 左侧 125 30 右侧 125 30 后方 100 30 炮塔 135 30 总计 630 150 怪癖： 增强型防火设备 可搭载1个战斗装甲班，并设有射击孔。

column1: Named for a shapeshifting Monster of Terran Philippine Folklore, the Aswang 全向Mech employs advanced and experimental technologies, including a mimetic 装甲, to blend into the night and hunt its victims. 特性：AR20 WarFare Suite 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Aswang全向机甲以泰拉太空时代前菲律宾民间传说中的变形怪物命名，采用包括拟态装甲在内的先进实验技术，能够融入夜色并猎杀目标。 特性：AR20作战套件 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Designed and produced in limited numbers by 鲁西恩装甲工厂, the DRX Dragon II 全向 was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. The A variant carries an MRM-30 in the right torso, backed up by three medium X-Pulse lasers and a snub-nosed PPC.
column2: DRX Dragon II全向机甲由鲁西恩装甲工厂设计并少量生产，是后来DRG-11K的雄心勃勃的前身。A变型在右侧躯干安装一具MRM-30，并以三门中型X脉冲激光器和一门短管PPC提供支援。

column1: Designed and produced in limited numbers by 鲁西恩装甲工厂, the DRX Dragon II 全向 was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. The B configuration bears a 'Silver Bullet' Gauss Rifle on the right arm, backed up by a torso-mounted MML and the usual X-Pulse lasers on the left arm. An 'Iron Dome' AMS system and Angel ECM provide this loadout with ample long-range defenses.
column2: DRX Dragon II全向机甲由鲁西恩装甲工厂设计并少量生产，是后来DRG-11K的雄心勃勃的前身。B配置在右臂搭载一门“银弹”高斯步枪，左臂则配备躯干安装的MML和常规X脉冲激光器。一套“铁穹”AMS系统和天使ECM为该配置提供充足的远程防御。

column1: Designed and produced in limited numbers by 鲁西恩装甲工厂, the DRX Dragon II 全向 was an ambitious precursor to what would later become the DRG-11K. This particular configuration tests the limits of a 70-ton Mech's stability by fitting a 长汤姆加农炮 on the right arm. Like the other variants, the DRX-OD showcases a stunning variety of ammunition types, both for the 火炮 piece and the center-mounted 雷电10. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: DRX Dragon II全向机甲由鲁西恩装甲工厂设计并少量生产，是后来DRG-11K的雄心勃勃的前身。该配置在右臂安装长汤姆加农炮，考验70吨机甲的稳定极限。和其他变型一样，DRX-OD展示了惊人的弹药类型多样性，既适用于火炮，也适用于中央安装的雷电10。 特性：稳定 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: This is a hell of an interesting science project you've found, boss. As far as I could learn, this '机甲 was an attempt to beat the Clans at their own game. Everything else beyond that seems to be classified. We're probably on somebody's watchlist now.
column2: 老板，你找到的这个科学项目真够有意思。据我所知，这台机甲曾试图用氏族自己的方式击败氏族。除此之外的所有信息似乎都已列为机密。我们现在大概已经进入某些人的监视名单了。

column1: Based on the 布雷克圣言会 Raptor II BattleMech, similarly employing advanced Stealth technology and Electronics is the Raptor III even more capable of deep strike scout and intercept Missions, hardmounting a unique Advanced AMS System. 特性：Integrated Adv. AMS 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Raptor III以布雷克圣言会Raptor II战斗机甲为基础，同样采用先进隐形技术和电子设备，但更适合执行深度突击侦察与拦截任务，并固定安装独特的高级AMS系统。 特性：集成高级AMS 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Hailing from a Kuritan Gamesworld this Dragon got re设计ed to spit fire and destruction upon it's Enemy causing the crowd to go fiery wild.
column2: 这台Dragon来自库里塔的竞技世界，经过重新设计后能够向敌人喷吐火焰与毁灭，令观众陷入狂热。

column1: A custom refit of Skobels MKII Vulture, installing Skinwalker's 接口驾驶舱, experimental non-modular targeting computer and a rare Tracker Mk2 sensors to create an extremely effective long range sniper.
column2: 这是对Skobels MKII Vulture的定制改装，安装Skinwalker接口驾驶舱、实验型非模块化瞄准计算机和罕见的Tracker Mk2传感器，打造出一台极其高效的远程狙击机甲。

column1: This Crab has been modified to such an extent that whichever original designation it had is now meaningless. Known only by the bloodname of its pilot, "Hallis", this ancient war machine carries with it early examples of Clan weapons technology. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这台Crab经过如此彻底的改装，以至于原始编号已经毫无意义。它唯一的称呼来自驾驶员的血名“Hallis”；这台古老战争机器还携带着氏族武器技术的早期样本。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: As far as custom jobs go, this isn't anything too special, Boss. Standard electronic warfare additions, an 引擎 upgrade, et cetera. It's all pretty mundane, except for these Large Pulse Lasers. Probably some kinda early Clan technology, if I had to guess; they're leagues ahead of some of the stuff we usually go through.
column2: 就定制改装而言，这没什么特别的，老板。标准电子战组件、引擎升级之类的常规项目都在其中。唯一不寻常的是这些大型脉冲激光器。我猜它们可能属于早期氏族技术；性能远远领先于我们平时接触的某些装备。

column1: Hailing from the punishing arenas of Solaris VII, the Storm Wolf combines the latest and greatest of technology on the Arctic Wolf II 全向 Chassis. Capable of quickly traversing the battlefield and exploiting terrain to bring its payload to bear. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Storm Wolf来自Solaris VII残酷的竞技场，将最新、最先进的技术融合到Arctic Wolf II全向底盘上。它能够迅速穿越战场，利用地形发挥所携载武器的威力。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.12 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Well, this is something you don't see every day - missiles on a 黑骑士! These look like old designs, boss. Definitely Star League. We found some interesting pieces of combat data left over from when it was still operational that backs that up, too. Turns out this was some kind of rearguard unit.
column2: 每天都能见到在黑骑士上安装导弹的情况吗？当然不能！这些看起来像是老板你说的老式设计，绝对属于星盟时代。我们还发现了一些有趣的战斗数据，证明它仍在运作时确实使用过这些武器。结果表明，这似乎是某种后卫单位。

column1: Named after a mythological Pirate from pre-spaceflight Terra, this one has been given extensive upgrades in every direction. A heavier Hatchet lets this refit cleave 'Mechs of the same weight class apart with ease. Stealth 装甲 makes it hard to detect while it's closing in, and the 330-rated 引擎 makes sure it doesn't take long. Five 中型激光s and a SRM6 see to it that it's also a dangerous brawler for its weight class. Fifteen 双散热器 ensure this Buccaneer won't die of heatstroke out in the sun - or of a trigger happy mech-jock.
column2: 它以太空飞行前泰拉神话中的海盗命名，并在各方面进行了大幅升级。更重型的战斧让这台改装机能够轻松劈开同重量级的战斗机甲。隐形装甲使其接近目标时难以被发现，330额定引擎则确保接近过程不会耗时太久。五门中型激光器和一具SRM6让它在同重量级中也成为危险的缠斗者。十五组双重散热器确保这台Buccaneer不会在阳光下中暑，也不会被冲动的机甲驾驶员拖垮。

column1: As a PPC-toting '机甲, the Gunslinger Cicada refit was undertaken by 狼獾氏族. While the Clan's Enhanced PPCs were significantly ahead of the original Star League Snub-Nose variants, the increased weight necessitated the transfer of the 设计 to a full Endo-Steel chassis. The resulting loadout ran blisteringly hot over extended deployment, prompting the development of more efficient cooling jackets to mitigate the problem without adding even further bulk.
column2: 作为一台搭载 PPC 的战斗机甲，Gunslinger Cicada 改装由太阳神联盟完成。虽然氏族增强型 PPC 明显领先于最初的星盟短管型号，但增加的重量迫使改装方将结构转为完整的内骨骼钢底盘。最终武器装载在长时间部署中产生极高热量，因此开发了效率更高的冷却夹套，以缓解问题而不再增加体积。

column1: This Omnimech is better in any way compared to its other Models. Upgraded with an XL引擎, Ferro Fibrous and Endo Steel it shows the advantage it gets by Mounting 4 Medium Pulse, 1 Large Pulse and a Narc发射器. While you might think this Weapons Loadout is Underwhelming, the MASC makes it able to Brawl with any other Mech. Its also not as Underarmoured as Normal Clan Mechs, thanks to Blood Spirits different Thinking, so be Prepared. They even Mounted MG's on it to Fend off any Elementals that might come for your Mech.
column2: 这台全能机甲在各方面都优于其他型号。它升级了 XL 引擎、铁纤维装甲和内骨骼钢，优势体现在搭载四具中型脉冲激光器、一具大型脉冲激光器和一具 Narc 信标发射器。虽然这套武器看似火力不足，但 MASC 让它能够与任何其他机甲近距离缠斗。由于血魂氏族的不同理念，它的装甲也不像普通氏族机甲那样薄弱，请做好准备。他们甚至安装了机枪，用来击退试图攻击机甲的元素战士。

column1: The prototype Defiance was intended to be the flagship design of venerable 迪法恩斯工业, Described as a ''Warhammer on steroids'', it is visually similar to the original WHM-6R, carries a similar weapons array, and advanced TC
column2: Defiance 原型机原本是老牌企业的旗舰设计，被形容为“服用类固醇的 Warhammer”。它在外观上类似最初的 WHM-6R，搭载相近的武器阵列以及先进的瞄准计算机。

column1: Factory refit on Solaris S7 for a Collosseum Champion, this Fafnir forgoes basically all 引擎 power to replace its 移动 with 机甲anical 跳跃放大器s, turning it into something of a Flying 炮塔.
column2: 这是 Solaris 7 为竞技场冠军进行的工厂改装。该 Fafnir 放弃了几乎所有弹道武器，改用机械化跳跃喷射器替代移动系统，使其成为一台近似飞行机甲的单位。

column1: This Falconer found itself in a World of Pain boss. Extremely Rare Clantech, mixed with Inner Sphere Technology makes this a Walking Nightmare, for me. 2 Clan Gauss Rifles and 1 Large X Pulse Laser give it a 长 Range Armament, while the 4 Torso mounted Medium Xpulse Lasers give it 短 range Capabilities. The 引擎 is Still a XL but at a considerably lower Rating while 14 Clan Double Heatsinks also make it nearly Sweat as much. It even has a Very Sweet Ewar Package, i have to say.
column2: 这台 Falconer 曾陷入一场痛苦的首领战。极其罕见的氏族科技与内圈技术混合在一起，造就了我的行走噩梦。两具氏族高斯步枪和一具大型 X 脉冲激光器提供远程火力，四具安装在躯干上的中型 X 脉冲激光器则负责近距离作战。引擎仍是 XL 型号，但额定功率大幅降低；14 具氏族双散热器也让它几乎不会过热。不得不说，它还配备了非常出色的电子战套件。

column1: The personal '机甲 of a Solaris Liao Fanatic, the 'Kun Lun Feng' or 'Kun Lun Wasp' was named for the mythological being in the Mountains of the pilot's ancestral Home. The '机甲 is said to have brought luck to its owner, and when it arrives will pause whatever's currently happening thanks to it's 'swarm of stings', just like the fabled creatures for which it was named 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.06
column2: 这是 Solaris 的廖氏狂热分子的私人战斗机甲。“昆仑风”或“昆仑黄蜂”以飞行员祖居山脉中的神话生物命名。据说这台机甲能给主人带来好运；它抵达战场后会凭借“成群的毒刺”让正在发生的一切暂时停滞，就像传说中的生物一样。 怪癖: 扰乱 掉落成本乘数: 1.06

column1: A unusual Prototype 设计, while still Maintaining the 200 XL引擎 has the MASC removed for more Armour and Firepower. Still being a Fast mech, having increased armour and alot of Machineguns, this Firemoth was 设计ed to support Elementals that would be hanging off of it. The entire Cockpit has Upgrades in it, there are also Questionable Materials in here.\n\n掉落成本乘数: 0.98.
column2: 这是一台不寻常的原型机甲。它保留 200 级 XL 引擎，拆除 MASC 以换取更多装甲和火力。作为一台高速机甲，它拥有更厚装甲和大量机枪；这台 Firemoth 旨在支援悬挂在其上的元素战士。整套驾驶舱都经过升级，内部还使用了一些令人怀疑的材料。\n\n掉落成本乘数: 0.98.

column1: This Galahad looks Pretty alright Boss. Mixed Tech, but thats just how it Goes nowadays. The 2 UAC10's Provide the Mainstay of this 机甲, the Pulse Laser and SRM6 provide additional Firepower. The Sensors are a Good Package all together, While the 定位 Systems got special attention aswell. The XL引擎 was Increased in Rating, meaning this 机甲 will move Fast. Both Arms have Additional Armour Plates too, meaning those Weapons are all nice and Protected.
column2: 这台 Galahad 看起来相当不错，老板。如今混合技术已经司空见惯。两门 UAC/10 是这台机甲的主力武器，脉冲激光器和 SRM-6 提供额外火力。传感器整合得很好，瞄准系统也经过特别强化。XL 引擎的额定功率得到提升，因此这台机甲移动很快。双臂还增加了装甲板，让武器得到充分保护。

column1: 增强成像, Special Sensors and very nice Optics make this Glass Spider a Real Danger to anything it sees. The XL引擎 makes room for the Two UAC2's and Two UAC5's, complemented by the Lone Medium Heavy Laser. An 主动探头 and a 守护者ECM give this enough Ewar to make it look Sensible too, while the Laser AMS give it good Coverage. All in all, a Very nice, purpose Built Mech Boss, even if albeit a bit on the Slower Side of things.
column2: 强化结构、特殊传感器和出色的光学设备让这台 Glass Spider 对任何被它发现的目标都构成真正威胁。XL 引擎腾出空间，容纳两门 UAC/2 和两门 UAC/5，另有一具中型重型激光器。主动探头和守护者 ECM 提供足够的电子战能力，激光 AMS 则负责防御。总体而言，这是一台用途明确、设计精良的机甲，唯一缺点是速度略慢。

column1: This particular Hammer was built by a Cavalry Military Man that had enough freedom and CBills to do it. Having it mainly built for harassment tactics, it 'only' sports a trio of SRM launchers and a backup trio of 中型激光s. However, a MASC combined with the increased 引擎 size lets this 'Mech run circles around anything and turn it to swiss cheese. Upgraded 双散热器 make sure it doesn't run hot, while a Tag helps allies call down fire upon the enemy. I think I've seen this thing before on Solaris, Boss. Maybe there's more to this machine than it seems.
column2: 这台 Hammer 由一名拥有足够自由和资金的骑兵军官打造，主要用于骚扰战术，仅装备三具 SRM 发射器和三具中型激光器作为备用。然而，MASC 与加大的引擎结合后，让这台机甲能够绕着任何目标高速机动并将其打成蜂窝。升级型双散热器确保它不会过热，TAG 则帮助友军呼叫火力支援。我似乎在 Solaris 见过这东西，老板；这台机器可能比表面看起来更有来头。

column1: This customized Hellspawn variant appears to be a battlefield refit, featuring a mix of Clan and Inner-Sphere tech. Three tons of CASE-protected missile ammo feed a pair of MML-9 launchers, backed up by a heavy 中型激光器 in each arm. Defensively the '机甲 retains the Hellspawn's customary mobility, alongside an externally-mounted anti-missile system and a Clan-made heat bank to reduce the impact of incendiary munitions. Even the ECM has been upgraded to a Kuritan "Angel" suite.
column2: 这台定制 Hellspawn 改型似乎是战场改装品，混合采用氏族与内圈技术。三吨由 CASE 保护的导弹弹药为两具 MML-9 发射器供弹，双臂各有一具重型中型激光器。防御方面，它保留 Hellspawn 一贯的机动性，并加装外置反导系统和氏族制造的热能储存器，以减轻燃烧弹药的影响。甚至 ECM 也升级为库里塔“天使”套件。

column1: A typical Solaris Refit, the 'Flying Hollander' upgrades the chassis with a Clan-grade Extralight 引擎 and Endo Steel, all to carry a Jury Rigged Heavy PPC alongside 部分机翼s and 改进的 Jump Jets.
column2: 这是典型的 Solaris 改装型“飞行荷兰人”：底盘升级为氏族级超轻引擎和内骨骼钢，用于搭载一门应急改装的重型 PPC、机枪和改进型跳跃喷射器。

column1: Originally 开发 by 氏族火狒狒 during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 150-rated Fusion Core the Howler uses a combination of 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 and Endo Steel; allowing the 机甲 to carry 9-ATM's with 1.5 tons of ammo in a shoulder 炮塔. The additional Tonnage went into two Small lasers,one in the 左侧 Arm and the other in the Head, aswell as Additional Heatsinks. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.03
column2: Howler 20 吨轻型支援机甲最初由星盟开发于黄金世纪。它围绕 150 级聚变核心构建，采用铁纤维装甲和内骨骼钢，使机甲能够在肩部挂架中携带 9 具 ATM 及 1.5 吨弹药。节省的吨位用于两具小型激光器（一具在左臂，另一具在头部）以及额外散热器。 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.03

column1: This 驼背 IIC was in use for Clan Wolf... Wait, something here is wrong. The Clan Wolf emblem looks like an actual kid painted it. The colors are wrong too. Look at the weapons, those aren't AC20's, they're 化学激光s. What insane lunatic made this... thing! The IFF codes read Clan Wolf, but this looks like a Hunchback-4P stuffed with all those lasers. The e-sig reads that there are several Clan Battle computers in here… Boss, the mix of Inner Sphere and Clan Technology actually hurts my brain. If I didn't know any better, this was purpose built to confuse Clanners. They do know this is not very honorable... 右侧? 右侧???
column2: 这台 Hunchback IIC 曾在狼氏族服役……等等，这里不对劲。狼氏族徽记看起来像是小孩画的，颜色也完全错误。看看武器，那不是 AC/20，而是一堆能量激光器。到底是哪个疯子制造了这东西！敌我识别代码显示它属于狼氏族，但看起来却像把 Hunchback-4P 塞满了激光器。电子信号显示内部装有数台氏族战斗计算机。老板，内圈与氏族技术的混合简直让人头疼。如果不是亲眼所见，我会以为这是专门用来迷惑氏族人的。难道他们不知道这样一点也不荣誉……右臂？左臂？？？

column1: The "Mad Baby" was born from a fervent desire to downsize the ever-popular Marauder into a more pocket-sized package. Unfortunately, even a thirty ton BattleMech like the Hussar is still much larger than the average pocket. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: “疯狂宝宝”源于将广受欢迎的Marauder缩小为更便携尺寸的狂热愿望。遗憾的是，即使是 30 吨的战斗机甲Hussar，仍然比普通口袋大得多。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: This has to be the most adorable Battle机甲 I've ever seen. It's like those holovids of people dressing their pets up in cute outfits for Halloween.
column2: 这是我见过最可爱的战斗机甲。它就像全息影像里那些万圣节把宠物打扮得可可爱爱的人。

column1: 12 Clan Double Heatsinks and Special PPC Housings make this Jackal excel at using its Light PPC's, while a Streak SRM launcher makes sure it has Short Range capabilities. A Narc (C) and Guardian ECM (C) give it enough to also Support the Lance. The Innersphere XL引擎 and XL Gyro make enough Space for all of this.
column2: 12 具氏族双散热器和特殊 PPC 外壳让这台 Jackal 能充分发挥轻型 PPC 的性能；一具 Streak SRM 发射器确保它具备近距离作战能力。Narc（氏族）和守护者 ECM（氏族）使它还能支援长枪小队。内圈 XL 引擎与 XL 陀螺仪腾出了容纳全部设备的空间。

column1: In common with several lighter clan combat units this Jenner carries an impressive loadout of machine guns. The pair of heavy 中型激光器 are quite capable of punching a hole in 装甲 that you can pour bullets into.
column2: 与几种较轻的氏族战斗单位一样，这台 Jenner 搭载了惊人的机枪阵列。两具重型中型激光器足以在装甲上打出缺口，让机枪火力倾泻其中。

column1: Chompie goes Om Nom Nom Nom.
column2: Chompie 大口咀嚼，吧唧吧唧。

column1: The Behemoth, named after Terran mythology, this '机甲 is 设计ed to withstand more punishment than any other '机甲 conceivable while bringing its 2 LBX20's to bear.
column2: 以地球神话中的巨兽命名的 Behemoth，这台机甲设计用于承受任何其他机甲能够造成的打击，同时用两门 LBX/20 还击。

column1: This modification of the Kyudo replaces the LRM20 launcher with twinned SRM6 launchers coupled with Artemis IV fire control. A supercharger allows the '机甲 to reach speeds of over 100km/h, allowing it to easily close into range for its small laser banks. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: 这次Kyudo改装用双联 SRM-6 发射器和 Artemis IV 火控系统替换 LRM-20 发射器。增压器让机甲速度超过 100 km/h，能够轻松接近目标并使用小型激光器阵列。 特性: 易于驾驶 部署费用倍率: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper

column1: This 'Mech has some speed on her, Boss. Just as well, too - all these weapons are a helluva lot shorter range than the usual LRMs these things carry. 12 SRMs, 3 中型激光器, and 3 smalls should be enough to put the hurt on most things around the same weight class.
column2: 这台机甲速度不错，老板。这样正好——它搭载的所有武器射程都比通常配备的 LRM 短得多。12 具 SRM、3 具中型激光器和 3 具小型激光器，足以重创大多数同吨位目标。

column1: Designed as a replacement to the Timber Wolf, the 65 ton Linebacker entered production in 3052. Built around a 390-rated XL引擎, the Linebacker’s faster speed enables it to keep up with lighter star mates in running battles, something the Timber Wolf struggled to do. Increased Tons of Armour, aswell as the Upgrade to Ferro Lamellor make this Mech a Dangerous close range Brawler. The AP Gauss Rifles are Dangerous to BA, while the Masc and 全向 Capabilities make it an even more dangerous Foe.\n\n部署成本倍率：1.1.
column2: Linebacker 旨在替代 Timber Wolf，于 3052 年投入生产。它围绕 390 级 XL 引擎构建，更快的速度使其能在奔袭战中跟上较轻的星队友机甲，这是 Timber Wolf 难以做到的。增加的装甲吨位以及升级为铁层压装甲，使这台机甲成为危险的近战斗士。反人员高斯步枪对抗战斗装甲十分有效，而 MASC 与全能机甲能力让它更加危险。\n\n部署成本倍率：1.1.

column1: A stolen, rewired, repurposed Marauder-4HB has been upgraded to an extent that is almost unbelievable. Normally these would be fielded by the Marian Hegemony loyalist units, but by God, whoever touched this thing had an ego to rival Seto Kaiba. Instead of the cheap rockets mounted in the torsos, there are iATMs. A LOT of iATMs. Apart from those, the electronics, cooling, 引擎 and gyro have been upgraded. According to the onboard computer records, apparently there are multiple improvements that could be done, but they have been held back by 'Voices' in their head, telling them to put in different things or change that wire with another. Hope this doesn't happen to me while I work on this thing, Boss. I hate ghosts.
column2: 一台被盗、重新布线并改作他用的 Marauder-4HB，被升级到了近乎难以置信的程度。通常它们会由忠于玛丽安霸权的部队使用，但改造者的自负简直能与濑户海马匹敌。躯干中不再是廉价火箭，而是 iATM，而且是大量 iATM。除此之外，电子设备、冷却系统、装甲和陀螺仪都得到升级。机载计算机记录显示本来还能进行多项改进，但改造者脑中的“声音”阻止了他们，要求加入不同部件或更换线路。希望我工作时不会遇到这种事，老板，我讨厌鬼魂。

column1: Practically the posterchild of the SLDF's Gunslingers, the prized Marauder GSR refit was eagerly adopted as a platform for weapons research by Clan scientists. When the 改进的 Gauss Rifle was 开发, no time was wasted in replacing the aging LB-10-X Autocannon of the original 设计. Alongside the new Gauss armament are carried further improvements to the Clan's PPC and laser technologies.
column2: 作为 SLDF 枪手部队的标志性机甲，珍贵的Marauder GSR 改装型被氏族科学家积极采用为武器研究平台。当轻型高斯步枪问世后，他们立即用其替换原版机甲老旧的 LB-10-X 自动炮。同时，新高斯武器还搭配了氏族 PPC 与激光技术的进一步改进。

column1: In the late hours of the Amaris Civil War, there were rumors of an advanced stealth mech head hunter equipped with four gauss rifles. Now if this is true or just an urban legend, I couldn't tell you Boss. What I can tell you is that someone tried to impersonate this legend with a Nightstar. 4 Light Gauss rifles make this a very capable direct fire Long Range Mech. An AMS makes it survivable against Long Range Missiles. Where they got the Clan-XL引擎 from though, that's a mystery - Hell, it even has a full SLDF-spec 作战套件. This 'Mech is filled with a solid mix of IS and Clan technology to make an actual nightmare. Don't ask me about the name of this Mech we've started calling "Number 3". It's got 13 threes in its 17-digit serial number and the number '3' carved into the emergency ejection button.
column2: 阿马里斯内战末期，曾有传闻称一台装备四具高斯步枪的先进隐形猎头机甲出现。老板，我无法判断这是真事还是都市传说，但有人试图用 Nightstar 冒充这个传说。四具轻型高斯步枪让它成为极其出色的直射远程机甲，AMS 则提高了对抗远程导弹的生存能力。至于氏族 XL 引擎和完整的 SLDF 规格战斗计算机从何而来，没人知道。这台机甲混合了内圈与氏族技术，简直是一场噩梦。别问我们为什么把它叫作“3 号”：它的 17 位序列号里有 13 个数字 3，紧急弹射按钮上也刻着“3”。

column1: A Periphery Refit of a 4FX, Purpose Built to run into the Action, and go Guns Blazing. The amount of Rockets on this 机甲 may unsettle some People, but the Real Pain comes packed together with the Flamers. There are also some Fluid Guns hidden in this 机甲, who even 设计 this Monstrosity? The 长er i Look the worse it Gets. Please dont come back with this 机甲. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是 4FX 的外围改装型，专为冲入战场并倾泻火力而造。这台机甲上的火箭数量可能让人不安，但真正的痛苦来自成组的火焰喷射器。机甲内部还藏着几把流体枪——到底是谁制造了这头怪物？我看得越久，情况就越糟。请别再把这台东西带回来。 特性: 稳定 部署费用倍率: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Refitted for the 前方 line Warriors that did not like the Original Concept, This Rabid Coyote variant now Fields 36 Tubes of Streak SRM's, and 2 complementary 小型脉冲激光s. Not alot has changed otherwise, Still the same amount of Armour and Speed. 4 Tons of 弹药 supply this 机甲 with enough Firepower, while the Upgrades make sure that the Streaks are Faster at Target Acquisiton.
column2: 该改型为不喜欢原始设计的前线战士重新改装。现在的 Rabid Coyote 搭载 36 管 Streak SRM 和两具微型脉冲激光器，其他方面几乎没有变化，装甲和速度保持不变。四吨弹药为机甲提供了充足火力，而升级确保 Streak 导弹能够更快锁定目标。

column1: While the Armament might look a bit Small, believe me that for a 65Ton Mech, its scary enough. 2 RAC5's 2 MRM10's make a good Dent in any mech, while the 2 Small Xpulses make sure no pesky Infantry come close to it. The Bloodhound and Clan 守护者ECM give it a Very nice Ewar Package, Combined with the reduced but still respectable Speed, its nothing to Laugh at Boss.
column2: 这套武装看起来有些单薄，但相信我，对 65 吨机甲而言已经足够可怕。两门 RAC/5 和两具 MRM-10 能重创任何机甲，两个小型 X 脉冲激光器则防止讨厌的步兵接近。血猎犬与氏族守护者 ECM 提供出色的电子战套件；即使速度有所降低但仍然可观，这台机甲也绝不是可以嘲笑的对象。

column1: Based on the Raven Battle机甲, the Sha Yu, or ''Shark'', is one of the first '机甲s to incorporate the Stealth 装甲 开发 by the Capellan Confederation. A top speed of 118 km/h allows it to control where and when it engages a Target. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Sha Yu（“鲨鱼”）以 Raven 战斗机甲为基础，是最早采用卡佩兰联邦研发的潜行装甲的机甲之一。118 km/h 的最高速度让它能够控制交战的地点与时机。 怪癖: 灵巧 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Based on the Raven BattleMech, the Sha Yu, or ''Shark'', is one of the first 'Mechs to incorporate the Stealth 装甲 developed by the Capellan Confederation. A top speed of 118 km/h allows it to control where and when it engages a Target.
column2: Sha Yu（“鲨鱼”）以 Raven 战斗机甲为基础，是最早采用卡佩兰联邦研发的潜行装甲的机甲之一。118 km/h 的最高速度让它能够控制交战的地点与时机。

column1: This thing must've been crazy impressive in its time, Boss. Artemis fire controllers, 变色龙偏振护盾, Gauss rifles ... yeah. This was something, alright. Funnily enough, the parts aren't that hard to find these days - even if the 'Mech is once you've built it.
column2: 这东西在它的时代一定令人印象深刻，老板。Artemis 火控系统、蓝盾偏转护盾、高斯步枪……没错，这确实是了不起的设计。奇怪的是，如今零件并不难找——即使这台机甲在组装完成后就已经损坏。

column1: Making these Stalker Functioning again cost a Fortune, but they are very Serviceable 导弹平台s boss. 3 LRM20's Clanspec give it enough missiles, while 6 Medium XPulse Lasers ensure its not to be trifled with in short Range. The 结构 is the same, the Armour has 轻型铁纤维装甲 on it, whilst also being up装甲ed. The 引擎 was changed into a Light, and the 16 Double Heatsinks ensure this is able to Fire all its weapons without too many Problems.
column2: 修复这些 Stalker 机甲花费了巨额资金，但它们仍是非常可靠的作战平台，老板。三具氏族规格 LRM-20 提供充足导弹火力，六具中型 X 脉冲激光器确保近距离不可小觑。结构保持不变，装甲升级为铁纤维装甲并进一步强化。引擎更换为轻型型号，16 具双散热器让它能发射全部武器而不会遇到太多问题。

column1: A Light 引擎 with a 140 Core Make this Stinger faster than its Predecessors. More Armour and Clan Endo Steel make Sure it can fit all of the Upgrades, while the Weapons make sure it stays where its supposed to. 16 Double Heatsinks Cool this stinger, additionally the Lasers are all connected to Laser insulators. This Mech would be a goddamn Sauna if not for all of this. Oh, and dont forget the Laser AMS, gotta stop those LRM's somehow.
column2: 轻型引擎与 140 级核心让这台 Stinger 比前代更快。更多装甲和氏族内骨骼钢确保容纳所有升级，武器则保证它能守住应在的位置。16 具双散热器为 Stinger 降温，所有激光器还连接到激光绝缘器。若没有这些设备，这台机甲早已变成该死的桑拿房。别忘了激光 AMS，它得设法拦住那些 LRM。

column1: Coming from the same project that took a second look at the Phoenix 超级狮鹫 has this Wasp received substantial upgrades to nearly every piece.
column2: 这个 Wasp 来自与 Phoenix Hawk 同一项计划，在重新评估后，几乎每个部件都获得了大幅升级。

column1: This Talos 1B bears an eclectic mixture of technologies spanning from the days of the Star League all through to the end of the 氏族入侵. In fact, it's quite possible that the very same equipment that saw the SLDF leave also saw them return in the form of the Clans. 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 这台Talos 1B融合了从星盟时代一直延续到圣战末期的多种技术。事实上，很可能正是 SLDF 撤离时使用的设备，后来以氏族形式随他们重新归来。 特性：易于驾驶 部署成本倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower

column1: A Special variant of the 雷电5S, The breacher was Adopted into Periphery Units needing a Mech that can Walk in, Take and Deal a lot of Damage. Especially in this Case, it was Refitted with 反应装甲板 and JumpJets, to increase Survivability. AMS and Case Round out the Package Deal, Just to make sure it will get to where it needs to.
column2: 这是 Thunderbolt-5S 的特殊改型，外围部队采用它来获得一台能够承受并造成大量伤害的机甲。该改型特别加装反应装甲板和跳跃喷射器，以提升生存能力；AMS 与 CASE 则完善了整套配置，确保它能抵达应在的位置。

column1: This 雷马 was named after Dragoons, ancient Terran warriors that rode to battle on horseback to then dismount and fight on foot. Some History buff named this 机甲, don't ask me where he learned all that history from though. This 雷马 comes equipped with a Heavy PPC, one 重型高斯步枪 and two Clan LRM20's. While not as fast as its namesake, this thing will still provide ample support from the rear or flanks. It can be counted on to do this well, with Sniper Sensors for eyes and an Angel ECM for ears.

column1: Refurbished on Solaris 7 by a quite successful 机甲Jockey, this Timber Wolf has received a mix of upgrades despite lacking access to a CLAN XL引擎 and losing some Omni Capability.
column2: 一名相当成功的 Solaris 机甲骑手在 Solaris 7 翻修了这台 Timber Wolf。尽管无法获得氏族 XL 引擎并失去部分全能能力，它仍获得了多项升级。

column1: The Volkh was originally designed on Solaris VII by 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队 to serve as a testbed for advanced technology. THIS setup seems to be a testbed for how many "lances" some mechjockey could control at once. There's a lengthy poem in some archaic Terran language carved all throughout the cockpit.
column2: Volkh 最初由某家企业在 Solaris VII 设计，用作先进技术试验平台。这套THIS配置似乎是在测试某位机甲骑手一次能控制多少个“长枪小队”。驾驶舱各处还刻着一首用古老地球语言写成的长诗。

column1: Making its now infamous debut in the Marik Arena, this unusual refit mounts two 等离子炮s in the torsos to disable its victims and replaces the massive LRM payload with SRMs to capitalize on any weaknesses in enemy 装甲.
column2: 这台不同寻常的改装型在 Marik 竞技场首次亮相便声名狼藉。它在躯干中安装两具电击枪来使受害者失能，并用 SRM 替换巨大的 LRM 弹药载荷，以便利用敌方装甲的弱点。

column1: I had to science the shit out of this one.
column2: 我不得不把这台机甲彻底科学化改造。

column1: The Anzu was well-regarded by both 机甲Warriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had 开发 since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 kph, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 米. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard 装甲 with CASE II built in to protect the '机甲 and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: RISC engineers have turned this model into a close range brawling specialist mounting a 短管PPC in each arm along with a massive Rotary AC/20 Autocannon. Mobility is enhanced by the inclusion of three improved jump jets.

column1: An all-rounder mech from Quicsell. It's only got SRMs, but those are pretty versatile. It would technically be cooking itself, if it weren't for the fact that half the missiles are used as temporary Streak modules for the other half, meaning only successful target locks get launched. Watch that 引擎 though, one side torso, and the mech's toast.
column2: 来自Quicsell的全能型机甲。它只装备SRM，但用途相当灵活。从技术上说，它本该把自己烧熟；不过其中一半导弹被用作另一半的临时Streak模块，因此只有成功锁定目标的导弹才会发射。可要当心那台引擎——只要一侧躯干受损，这台机甲就完了。

column1: Another of these damned XL internal combustion engines that I can't touch. And a big part of me is glad of that. If you're looking to interfere with enemy sensors from half way across the map, this is a decent choice, I guess. Just be careful of heat buildup, despite that 引擎.
column2: 又是一台该死的XL内燃机，我碰都不想碰。其实我很庆幸不用碰它。如果你想从半张地图外干扰敌方传感器，这倒是个不错的选择吧。尽管有那台引擎，仍要当心热量积累。

column1: Another Quicsell mech with one of those insane extra-large internal compustion engines. I'd hate them for it, if it weren't for the fact that it allows the mech to field twice as much firepower as it should rightly be able to. Still has the normal XL引擎 vulnerability though, so watch your 装甲 on those side torsos.
column2: 又一台装备疯狂超大型内燃机的Quicsell机甲。要不是它能让机甲搭载正常情况下两倍的火力，我真会恨死这种设计。不过它仍有普通XL引擎的脆弱性，所以要当心两侧躯干上的装甲。

column1: Quicsell's Heavy Laser Brawler. The BL-QS2 is a mech done in true 黑骑士 style. It's got a bunch of REX 中型激光s (King of the battlefield) and a bunch of 装甲. Feel free to close the gap and pummle your enemes. Comes with two complementary bandoleers of Quicsell's finest 机甲 Grenades. 怪癖: Command 机甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: Quicsell的重型激光格斗机。BL-QS2采用真正的黑骑士风格，装备一堆REX中型激光（战场之王）和厚重装甲。尽管靠近敌人，把他们狠狠揍一顿吧。它还配有两条Quicsell顶级机甲手榴弹弹带。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: This is a deathtrap, boss. Since rifle ammo can't pass through the mech's conveyor ports, it has to be stored in the same compartment as the gun. Not a problem, except these idiots decided to store four tons of heavy rifle ammo in a compartment with no CASE. And right next to the 引擎 to boot. Lets not even mention the machineguns with volatile ammo dotted around the mech. You are exactly one bad overheat or one penetrating hit from death in this thing.
column2: 老大，这东西就是死亡陷阱。步枪弹药无法通过机甲的输送端口，只能和火炮存放在同一隔舱里。问题在于，那群蠢货把四吨重型步枪弹药放进了没有CASE的隔舱，而且就在引擎旁边。更别提机甲各处还散布着装有易爆弹药的机枪了。只要一次糟糕的过热或一次穿透命中，这台东西就会要你的命。

column1: A surprisingly competent mech, coming from Quicsell... Yes, the 装甲 is paper, but if you can avoid being shot at and stay at range, it has a huge amount of firepower for a light. Never let the enemy close to melee range though, that Heavy PPC might as well be a boat anchor in that case.
column2: 来自Quicsell、出人意料地合格的一台机甲。没错，它的装甲薄得像纸；但只要避免挨打并保持距离，它对轻型机甲而言拥有惊人的火力。不过千万别让敌人靠近格斗距离，否则那门重型PPC还不如一块船锚。

column1: This Commando is built like a cockroach. While it doesn't have much in the way of advanced tech, it's got as much 装甲 as Quicsell could conceivably shove on there, and then some more litterally glued on top of that. Oh, and get this: to keep those lasers cool without cooking the pilot, the extra-large internal combustion 引擎 is hardwired into the frame. I guess you could turn it into a decent energy boat, but don't expect it to ever move all that fast.
column2: 这台Commando像蟑螂一样结实。它没有多少先进技术，却装上了Quicsell能想办法塞进去的全部装甲，甚至还在上面硬粘了更多装甲。还有一点：为了让激光保持冷却、不把驾驶员烤熟，那台超大型内燃机被直接接入了机体框架。你或许能把它改成一台不错的能量武器平台，但别指望它跑得多快。

column1: On the one hand, that fuel cell is a work of art. 总计ly irreplaceable, and unreproducable. I don't know what 'contractors' (read: pirates) they got to make the thing, but they certainly managed to do something amazing. On the OTHER hand (the metal one, in case you were wondering), it's an abomination against all traditional mech engineering, and I'll be amazed if you don't blow yourself up with it at some point. So it's a bit of a tossup, really.
column2: 一方面，这个燃料电池堪称艺术品：完全不可替代，也无法复制。我不知道他们找了什么“承包商”（说白了就是海盗）来制造它，但对方确实做出了惊人的东西。另一方面（如果你好奇，指的是金属那只手），它又违背了所有传统机甲工程原则；如果你哪天不用它把自己炸上天，我都会感到惊讶。总的来说，这东西很难说是好是坏。

column1: I think Quicsell farmed out the 引擎 shielding on this one, since it's far beyond their usual quality. The guns, on the other hand, are exactly what I would expect from them. I'm pretty sure they rotate just for show. While it's not very fast, at least it's well protected.
column2: 我猜Quicsell把这台机甲的引擎屏蔽外包出去了，因为质量远超他们平时的水平。至于火炮，倒是完全符合我对他们的预期。我很确定那些炮管只是为了炫耀才会旋转。它虽然不快，但至少防护不错。

column1: It's a pretty standard MRM mech. A bit faster than normal for a heavy mech, but not too far out of the bounds of normal. On the one hand, you've got to keep an eye out for that XL vulnerability, since I can't replace the 引擎. On the other hand, if I need to fix the damn thing again, at least it won't hurt the pocket books as much as installing a new one from scratch.
column2: 一台相当标准的MRM机甲。它比普通重型机甲稍快，但没有快到脱离常规。首先，你得留意XL引擎的脆弱性，因为我没法更换引擎。另一方面，如果我又得修理这破玩意儿，至少不会像从零安装一台新引擎那样烧钱。

column1: A very survivable mech. It's got Quicsell's special 装甲 (which doesn't say much), and it's got a lot of it. About as much as the mech can carry, to be honest. Those missiles aren't that bad either. Swap out the Quicsell name brand stuff for the good stuff, and you'll have a decent mech. Just... Uh. Don't ask me to touch that damn 引擎.
column2: 一台非常耐打的机甲。它使用Quicsell的特制装甲（这并不能说明质量有多好），而且装得很多，老实说几乎达到了机体能承载的极限。那些导弹也不算差。把Quicsell的品牌货换成真正的好东西，你就能得到一台不错的机甲。只是……呃，别让我碰那台该死的引擎。

column1: This is a decent anti-missile mech, I guess, but it's really a lot of wasted tonnage to accomplish that. Other than my complaint at the 'standard' Quicsell XL internal combustion 引擎, my main issue with this one is the lack of ability to do anthing to enemies that are outside it's engagement window, which is pretty small, thanks to the falloff of those lasers it mounts.
column2: 我猜这是一台还不错的反导机甲，但为此浪费了太多吨位。除了对Quicsell“标准”XL内燃机的抱怨，我最大的问题是它几乎无法攻击交战窗口之外的敌人；而它的交战范围又很小，因为所装激光存在射程衰减。

column1: Whoever came up with this thing was crazy. Heavy PPC on a light mech, XL internal combustion 引擎, and trying to push an ICE mech into a speedster by replacing the entire leg assemblies. Oh, and be careful with that PPC. If you fired it from a normal light mech, it'd practically fry you alive thanks to the backwash from the heat.
column2: 设计出这东西的人一定疯了。轻型机甲上装重型PPC、XL内燃机，还试图通过更换整套腿部组件，把内燃机机甲变成高速单位。还有，小心那门PPC；如果你从普通轻型机甲上开火，热量反冲几乎会把你活活烤熟。

column1: A competent long range engagement mech, I guess. Just make sure you don't take any fire. It's quite lightly armored for a Heavy mech, and that internal 结构 is a deathtrap as soon as the 装甲 is breached.
column2: 一台合格的远程交战机甲吧。只要确保别挨炮。对于重型机甲来说，它的装甲相当薄；而内部结构一旦装甲被击穿，就会变成死亡陷阱。

column1: Jack of all trades, master of none. It's limited to a normal fusion 引擎, and it's using chem lasers. Admitedly, powerful ones, but still chem lasers. Along with those mortars on the back, you're going to face a severe lack of staying power with this mech. Ten salvos, and you're out.
column2: 万金油，什么都能做，却没有一项精通。它只能使用普通融合引擎，而且采用化学激光。不得不承认，化学激光威力很强，但终究还是化学激光。再加上背部的迫击炮，这台机甲的持续作战能力会严重不足。十轮齐射后，你就弹尽粮绝了。

column1: Decently armored for a fast scouting light, this mech is mostly limited by it's chem laser ammo, as it has nothing to fall back on once that runs out. Oh, and swap out that cockpit ASAP, while it does provide for very good views, it's a deathtrap, with almost no cockpit 装甲 at all. It's not even armored glass!
column2: 对于一台快速侦察轻型机甲来说，它的装甲还算不错；但它主要受化学激光弹药限制，弹药耗尽后没有任何备用手段。还有，尽快换掉那个驾驶舱：它虽然视野极佳，却是个死亡陷阱，几乎没有驾驶舱装甲，甚至连装甲玻璃都不是！

column1: I never thought I'd see this many rifles on one mech. That's not a compliment, boss; rifles are periphery tech for a reason. I suppose they do the job of destabilizing other mechs well enough, but they're really not cut out for penetrating 装甲, especially at these low calibers. Oh, and rip out that '全向-jammer', it jams your mechs too, and you can't turn the damn thing off.
column2: 我从没想过一台机甲上会有这么多步枪。这可不是夸奖，老大；步枪之所以是边疆技术，自有原因。我承认它们足以有效削弱其他机甲，但真的不适合穿透装甲，尤其是这种低口径步枪。还有，把那个“全向干扰器”拆掉，它连你的机甲也会干扰，而且你根本关不掉这该死的东西。

column1: Another Quicsell all-rounder. I would even call it a decent mech, if it weren't for that abomination of an extra-light infernal combustion 引擎. No, I did not choose the wrong word there. You'll be belching smoke as you run around the battlefield, so good luck with stealth.
column2: 又一台Quicsell全能机甲。如果不是那台荒谬的超轻型地狱内燃机，我甚至会称它为一台不错的机甲。不，我没有用错词。你驾驶它在战场上到处跑时会一路喷烟，祝你隐身好运。

column1: Despite the thin 装甲 and lack of weapon variety, this one is nasty. That Heavy Large Chem Laser can rip through other lights like a hot knife through butter. If you see one in the field, make sure you prioritize it with a shot or two in order to set off it's ammo.
column2: 尽管装甲薄、武器种类少，这台机甲仍然很凶狠。那门重型大型化学激光能像热刀切黄油一样撕开其他轻型机甲。要是在战场上遇到它，务必优先开火一两次，引爆它的弹药。

column1: Scary walking firecracker. The torsos are full of incredibly dangerous missile ammo, and the only thing saving you from instant death via through 装甲 critical is an off brand CASE II module. Even I'll admit that it's a lot of firepower for a medium mech, but it's not survivable or good at sustained engagements.
column2: 一枚会走路的可怕爆竹。躯干里塞满极其危险的导弹弹药，唯一能避免穿透装甲暴击让你当场毙命的，是一个杂牌CASE II模块。即使我承认它对中型机甲而言火力很强，它也不耐打，无法胜任持续交战。

column1: Pretty sure the only way we're getting the 装甲 off that thing is by hitting it really hard with '机甲-grade weapons, Boss. It won't budge.
column2: 我敢肯定，想剥掉那东西的装甲，唯一办法就是用“机甲级武器”狠狠地轰它，老大。它纹丝不动。

column1: The Hellbringer 全向Mech was codenamed "Loki" by the Inner Sphere during the 氏族入侵. The pirates who claimed this chassis seem to have taken to the name, and have overwritten every mention of "Hellbringer" with "Loki" in the 'Mech's systems. 特性：集成探照灯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Hellbringer全向机甲在氏族入侵期间被内圈称为“Loki”。夺得这具底盘的海盗似乎接受了这个名字，并在机甲系统中把所有“Hellbringer”字样都改成了“Loki”。 特性：集成探照灯 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

Unlike other 布雷克圣言会 Tanks does this not have a DNI despite its Advanced Electronics. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：7/11 格 / 210/330 米. 装甲： 车辆高级潜行 结构： Vehicle Composite 数值 A S 前方 200 70 左侧 200 70 右侧 200 70 后方 150 70 炮塔 200 70 总计 950 350 特性：主战坦克 全向 Vehicle
column2: Serpentus系列全向车辆Wraith超重型气垫船，是一款隐形支援平台，配备实验型车辆无特征系统、24吨炮塔模块舱空间和充足的6吨CASE弹药供给。与其他布雷克圣言会坦克不同，它虽然拥有先进电子设备，却没有DNI。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：7/11 格 / 210/330 米. 装甲： 高级隐形装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 200 70 左侧 200 70 右侧 200 70 后方 150 70 炮塔 200 70 总计 950 350 特性：主战坦克 全向车辆

column1: First introduced by the 泰拉霸权 in 2568, the 凤鹰 was one of the most well known Battle机甲s in the Inner Sphere. This one, however, fell into the hands of some backwater planet 机甲Techs and has emerged an abomination. Armed with a cobbled-laser pistol and a filed-down vibrosword, this is one '机甲 you wouldn't want to run into on the dark streets of Hardcore. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 黄蜂于2568年由泰瑞安协定首次推出，是内圈最知名的战斗机甲之一。不过，这一台落入了偏远行星技术人员手中，最终变成了一个畸形产物。它装备拼装激光手枪和磨尖的振动剑，是你绝不想在Hardcore昏暗街道上遇到的机甲。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: I'm at a loss for words, boss. I don't even know what this is. I'm not sure I wanna know what this is. So, this is - or was - a Phoenix Hawk model 1. Somebody's given it wings, and a gun. And a knife. Why does it have a knife? And why does it have "P-HAWK WITH SHIV" stamped onto the torso 装甲?
column2: 老大，我已经无话可说了。我甚至不知道这是什么，也不确定自己想不想知道。这东西原本是一台Phoenix Hawk 1型。有人给它装了翅膀、火炮，还有一把刀。它为什么会有刀？为什么躯干装甲上还印着“P-HAWK WITH SHIV”？

column1: Boss, that's a lot of pew pew for the Choo Choo.
column2: 老大，对Choo Choo来说，这火力也太猛了。

column1: Created by a fan of Kuritan 'Kaiju' movies is this remodeled 歼灭者 Chassis equipped to prove its the King of all Monsters.
column2: 这是某位库图伦‘Kaiju’电影爱好者重新改造的歼灭者底盘，用来证明它才是万兽之王。

column1: The Anzu was well-regarded by both 机甲Warriors and technicians for its reliability; the AMSC found the Anzu to be a good fit for the aggressive combat tactics they had 开发 since the Jihad. Although the Anzu's maximum ground speed was 64 kph, the Chilton 465 Jump Jets allowed the Anzu to jump up to 120 米. The Anzu mounted eleven tons of Starshield A Standard 装甲 with CASE II built in to protect the '机甲 and its pilot from ammunition explosions. The Anzu also used the same life support systems as the Shadow Hawk, already well-proven by the time the Anzu entered service, and the RCA Instatrac Mark X targeting and tracking system allowed the Anzu to simultaneously engage multiple targets while also spotting for indirect fire through the installed TAG system. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Anzu因可靠性受到机甲战士和技术人员的共同好评；自圣战以来，AMSC一直在寻找适合其激进作战战术的机甲，Anzu正好符合要求。虽然Anzu的最高地面速度只有64公里/小时，但Chilton 465跳跃喷射器可让它跳跃至120米。Anzu安装了十一吨Starshield A标准装甲，并内置CASE II，以保护机甲和驾驶员免受弹药爆炸伤害。Anzu还采用与Shadow Hawk相同的生命维持系统，该系统在Anzu服役时已经久经验证；RCA Instatrac Mark X瞄准与跟踪系统则让Anzu能同时攻击多个目标，并通过安装的TAG系统为间接火力进行标定。 特性：多重追踪 部署费用倍率：1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: What happens when an 工业机甲 Pilot turns into a Gladiator on the outskirts of the Periphery? With extra spikes, a 破坏球 and industrial Chainsaw it has everything to give someone a bad time. And lets not forget the Redneck Pilot's favorite, the Boomstick!
column2: 一名工业机甲驾驶员跑到边疆外围，变成了角斗士，会发生什么？加上额外尖刺、破坏球和工业链锯，它足以让任何人吃尽苦头。别忘了红脖飞行员的最爱——Boomstick！

column1: A Retro Tech upgrade to the aging Catapult design, remodelled to employ 2 MARS Rocket 火炮 Systems, 部分机翼s and a uncanny ability to redeploy its mighty but limited payload as required.
column2: 这是对老旧Catapult设计的复古科技升级版，改装后使用2套MARS火箭炮系统、机枪，以及一种能按需重新部署强大但有限弹药的诡异能力。

column1: A typical Periphery 机甲, nothing on this Commando actually comes from one. The entire 引擎 block is wired around a definitely stolen large Fuel Cell.....
column2: 典型的边疆机甲，但这台Commando上没有任何部件真正来自边疆。整块引擎组件都接在一块明显偷来的大型燃料电池上……

column1: This Dragon 'P' is in pretty good condition for a pirate '机甲, but all its weapons have been replaced with Incendiary variants and it's covered in all kinds of unicorn graffiti. A real joker owned this.
column2: 这台Dragon“P”作为海盗机甲，状态相当不错，但所有武器都被替换成燃烧型变体，机身还涂满了各种独角兽涂鸦。它曾被一个真正的怪人拥有。

column1: Boss, this is one of 迪法恩斯工业' Fafnirs, but the heavy gauss rifles have been replaced with these idiotic "rotary hammers" and the 引擎 seems to be a homebrew attempt to replicate SLDF tech. They managed to get their hands on a bona fide Capellan stealth suite, though.
column2: 老大，这是一台迪法恩斯工业公司的Fafnir，但重型高斯步枪被替换成了这些愚蠢的“旋转锤”，而引擎似乎是他们试图仿制SLDF技术的土制产物。不过，他们确实弄到了一套正宗的卡佩兰隐形套件。

column1: Reportedly piloted by the more or less infamous pirate "Damio," this "Beekeeper" is 设计ed to fire large stingy "Swarms."
column2: 据说这台“Beekeeper”由或多或少臭名昭著的海盗“Damio”驾驶，并经过改装，可以发射大型、带刺的“Swarms”。

column1: This periphery Hellspawn refit is missing all of its advanced electronics, but what's here is in pretty good shape. Ten and a half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 over an endo-steel frame give it staying power, while leaving room for four 中型激光器 and this hotwired LRM launcher.
column2: 这台边疆Hellspawn改装机拆除了全部先进电子设备，但剩下的部件状态相当不错。十吨半的装甲覆盖在内骨骼钢框架上，为它提供持久力，同时还留出空间安装四门中型激光和这具硬接线的LRM发射器。

column1: This Pirate refit of a 荷兰人 II trades the usual Gauss Rifle for some kind of rotary rifle abomination. To their credit, these pirates at least thought to put some advanced electronics and more than token 装甲 on it.
column2: 这台Hollander II的海盗改装型号用某种旋转步枪怪物替换了常规高斯步枪。值得肯定的是，这些海盗至少考虑安装了先进电子设备，并给它配备了不止象征性的装甲。

column1: This Hunchback nicknamed the 'Flying Debris' is equipped with a jury rigged Silver 'Ware' Gauss rifle, Jury Rigged 引擎 and a Aftermarket EWS.
column2: 这台绰号“飞行碎片”的Hunchback装备了拼装Silver 'Ware'高斯步枪、拼装引擎和一套售后加装的电子战系统。

column1: The Jenner JR7-RX 设计 has been adapted to carry several 多用途导弹发射器.
column2: Jenner JR7-RX设计改装后可搭载数个多用途导弹发射器。

column1: Looks like one of these famed Clanbusters, but theres definitely nothing where it should be. It even got real 手部驱动器s!
column2: 它看起来像著名的氏族克星，但该有的部件绝对一样不少。甚至还配备了真正的手臂驱动器！

column1: Well, it is a Longbow, for the most parts just a pretty normal looking one too, and if it werent for that 引擎 and these weird Thunderbolt '30' id say they just stole it somewhere......
column2: 这是一台Longbow，大体上看起来还算普通；要不是那台引擎和这些怪异的Thunderbolt“30”，我会以为他们只是从某处偷来的……

column1: It's a Quickdraw, whoever stole the parts for it wasnt all to stupid though, giving it 改进的 Jump Jets and a Jump pack turning it into a oversized Mudstomper.
column2: 这是一台Quickdraw。偷零件的人虽然不算聪明，却给它装上了改进型跳跃喷射器和跳跃背包，把它变成了巨大的Mudstomper。

column1: As Pirate refits go, this is mostly not too deranged. The AC/10 has been replaced with a mortar, and the machine guns are still there, if mangled. The small laser has been upgraded to a light PPC, and the SRM launcher has been "upgraded" as well. They've even given it a '机甲-sized "shotgun" to carry. Just don't ask what's going on in the 引擎 and cooling systems.
column2: 作为海盗改装机，这台东西总体还不算太离谱。AC/10被替换成迫击炮，机枪还在，只是已经被胡乱拼装过。小型激光升级成轻型PPC，SRM发射器也被“升级”了。他们甚至给它装了一个机甲尺寸的“霰弹枪”。只是别问引擎和冷却系统到底发生了什么。

column1: This was a 雷电5S until some pirates got their hands on it. All the weapons have been sort of welded into spikes, resulting in a loadout that's much closer ranged, and much hotter.
column2: 这台雷电5S机甲原本状态良好，直到落入海盗手中。所有武器都被粗暴地焊成尖刺，导致武器配置射程更近、发热更高。

column1: This Republic Trebaruna has been turned into some slow walking Monster. The 加固装甲 is still on it, but they reinforced the 结构 as well. Ripping out anything and everything that has to do with speed, don't expect this to move very far. The Armaments have been replaced with various Pirate and Periphery Weapons, some of which are either Genius Engineering or Insanity. They even crammed a 工业级三倍强度人造肌 in there to mount all of these Weapons on the Mech. Looking at what this thing was supposed to do, I nearly think they made a Wannabie Urbanmech. Pirates, Boss, I tell you.
column2: 这台共和国Trebaruna被改造成了缓慢行走的怪物。加固装甲仍在，但他们也加固了结构。为了彻底拆除一切与速度有关的部件，别指望它能走多远。武器被替换成各种海盗和边疆武器，其中有些属于天才工程，有些则纯属疯狂。他们甚至塞进一套工业级增强型外骨骼，用来在机甲上安装这些武器。看着它原本的用途，我几乎以为他们造了一个想成为UrbanMech的东西。海盗，老大，真是无话可说。

column1: All of the offensive weaponry on this Ursa has been replaced or broken down. The Medium Pulse lasers have been 'piratified' and put into the 左侧 and 右侧 Torso, while the RAC2 was wholly replaced by a Pirate AC20 with 稳定外壳, but i'm not even sure it's going to help that much. They put in some kind of TAG System in the Head but its taking up a lot of space. The MASC and XL引擎 have been ripped out to make space for some kind of Fuel intake for a Nitro Canister to increase its speed. Parts of the Armour have been lined with Spalling, to decrease Shrapnel that might come off of this thing for whatever Reason. There is also a Double Heatsink kit in there, to my surprise. This thing will blow itself up anyway as soon as that Nitro reaches the Core.
column2: 这台Ursa的所有进攻武器都被替换或拆解。中型脉冲激光被“海盗化”后装进左、右两侧躯干；RAC2则彻底换成带稳定器的海盗AC20，但我不确定这能帮上多大忙。他们在头部塞进了某种TAG系统，却占用了大量空间。MASC和XL引擎被拆掉，为某种燃料进气装置腾出位置，再通过硝基罐提高速度。部分装甲内衬了防剥落层，以减少各种原因造成的碎片飞散。里面居然还有一套双联散热器组件，真让人意外。不过硝基燃料一旦抵达核心，这东西迟早会把自己炸上天。

column1: A Experimental LandAir机甲 solely 设计ed to give its Rotary Auto Cannon the Wings it so deserves. And they saw their creation and proclaimed all is Good. 特性：陆空两用机甲 部署费用倍率：1.07
column2: 这是一台实验性的陆空机甲，唯一目的就是让它的旋转自动炮拥有应得的翅膀。他们看着自己的造物，宣称一切都好。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.07

column1: A Experimental LandAir机甲 solely 设计ed to give its Rotary Auto Cannon the Wings it so deserves. And they saw their creation and proclaimed all is Good.
column2: 这是一台实验性的陆空机甲，唯一目的就是让它的旋转自动炮拥有应得的翅膀。他们看着自己的造物，宣称一切都好。

column1: What do you get when you take the iconic BRRRRRT away 来自 the Warthog? Not much, except a cheaper LAM.
column2: 从Warthog上拿走标志性的BRRRRRT后，你还剩下什么？没多少，只是一台更便宜的LAM。

column1: A light tracked APC, the Badger was introduced to the Inner Sphere by Wolf’s Dragoons. An 全向 vehicle, it mounts a fusion 引擎 and 6 tons of 装甲 plate, with a 4 ton infantry bay and 5 tons of pod space for weapons. The primary Badger configuration carries a trio of 中型激光s in its turret, supported by a front-mounted SRM-2 launcher supplied with a single ton of reloads. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 格 / 180/270 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 115 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后方 70 15 炮塔 90 15 总计 455 75 特性：加固结构 全向 Vehicle Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. This, along with two Clan built ER 中型激光器, are the only weapons on the unit. This would seem a ridiculously light amount of weaponry, but intelligence reports suggest that the Vengeance uses the Thumper to launch nuclear warheads. 特性：Multi Trac 部署成本倍率：1.18
column2: 圣战期间，Regulus公国开发了Grand Titan Vengeance，用标准型号的武器和装甲换成强化装甲、装甲紧凑型陀螺仪、装甲引擎和装甲驾驶舱。机甲还配备全头弹射系统。如此严密的防护加上60米跳跃半径看似奇怪，但Vengeance只有一门Thumper火炮，弹药为两吨，并存放在CASE II保护的弹舱中。除此之外，它仅有两门氏族制造的ER中型激光器。武器数量看似少得荒谬，但情报报告称Vengeance使用Thumper发射核弹头。 特性：多重追踪 部署成本倍率：1.18

column1: Developed by the Principality of Regulus during the Jihad, the Grand Titan Vengeance trades the weaponry and 装甲 of the standard version for 加固装甲, an Armored 紧凑型陀螺仪, Armored 引擎, and Armored Cockpit. The 'Mech also has a Full-Head Ejection System. All this protection, and a 60-meter jump radius, seems strange, but the Vengeance has a single 重击者火炮 Piece with two tons of ammo in a CASE II protected bin. This, along with two Clan built ER 中型激光s, are the only weapons on the unit. This would seem a ridiculously light amount of weaponry, but intelligence reports suggest that the Vengeance uses the Thumper to launch nuclear warheads.
column2: 圣战期间，Regulus公国开发了Grand Titan Vengeance，用标准型号的武器和装甲换成加固装甲、装甲紧凑型陀螺仪、装甲引擎和装甲驾驶舱。机甲还配备全头弹射系统。如此严密的防护加上60米跳跃半径看似奇怪，但Vengeance只有一门重击者火炮，弹药为两吨，并存放在CASE II保护的弹舱中。除此之外，它仅有两门氏族制造的ER中型激光器。武器数量看似少得荒谬，但情报报告称Vengeance使用Thumper发射核弹头。

column1: Developed to meet customer demand for a cheaper fire support unit, the T3 merely swaps the Arrow IV launcher for the more common Thumper 火炮 piece. Otherwise unchanged, this mech is marketed to budget-conscious customers looking for an 火炮 mech.
column2: T3为满足客户对廉价火力支援单位的需求，仅用更常见的Thumper火炮替换Arrow IV发射器。除此之外机体没有变化，面向预算有限、需要火炮机甲的客户销售。

column1: Cosara built this thing out of pure ambition basically. Project Scuttle they called it, mid 32nd century. Two hundred tons, XXL 引擎, price tag that would make a Lyran noble choke. Draconis Combine bought some, Capellans too. Even Clan Sea Fox picked one up and nobody really knows why. Less than a dozen ever made, not sure if it was good or bad lucky to find one of them to spend money on restoring.
column2: Cosara基本上完全出于野心制造了这台机器。他们在32世纪中叶称其为Scuttle计划：重达200吨，配备XXL引擎，价格足以让莱拉贵族窒息。龙马联盟买了一些，卡佩兰人也买了，甚至连海狐氏族都买了一台，没人真正知道原因。最终产量不到十二台；花钱修复其中一台时，很难说找到它究竟是幸运还是不幸。

column1: 氏族钻石鲨 built this at the turn of the 32nd century and the 引擎 alone takes up 40% of the total mass. Most of the ones produced ended up with wealthy private buyers using them for illegal street racing in the Periphery rather than actual military service. A former pirate named Ryan Reynolds bought one, won a bunch of races, then hit a canyon wall at nearly 400 kph on Tincalunas in 3142. Finding one of these intact and operational is almost unbelievable.
column2: 这台机体由钻石鲨氏族在32世纪初制造，单是引擎就占总质量的40%。大多数成品最终被富有的私人买家购得，用于边疆的非法街头竞速，而非真正服役。一名叫Ryan Reynolds的前海盗买下一台，赢得多场比赛，随后于3142年在Tincalunas以接近400 kph的速度撞上峡谷壁。能找到一台完整且仍可运行的机体，几乎不可思议。

column1: Boss, this thing is one of a kind, literally. Dark Caste built it from Star League parts pulled off a 歌利亚蝎 cache in 2898. No Clan tech, just old hardware put together right. It raided for fifty years before vanishing on Glory. Well, now we know where it ended up. Whoever had it last took good care of it. There is nothing else like it out there.
column2: 老板，这台东西确实独一无二。黑暗卡斯特在2898年用从歌利亚蝎储藏库中拆出的星盟部件制造了它。没有氏族技术，只有精心拼装的老式硬件。它进行了五十年的掠袭，随后在Glory上失踪。现在我们知道它最终去了哪里。上一任拥有者把它保养得很好，外面没有任何同类。

column1: Boss, the Minnesota Tribe took the Abyss design and rebuilt it with everything they could get their hands on. Clan 引擎, Clan PPC, Angel ECM, Artemis V, CASE II, jump jets. They only gave it to their best, so every time one showed up on a Clan homeworld, people paid attention. Getting one of these in our bay is something else. This is not a mech you put a rookie in.
column2: 老板，明尼苏达部落拿到Abyss设计后，用能找到的一切对它进行了重建：氏族引擎、氏族PPC、天使ECM、Artemis V、CASE II和跳跃喷射器。他们只把它交给最优秀的人，所以每当一台出现在氏族母星时，人们都会格外关注。让这样的机体进入我们的维修舱非同小可，绝不能交给新手驾驶。

column1: The BTC-6N pairs a Rotary AC/5 and twin Streak SRM 4s with a 定位 Computer for reliable direct combat output across ranges. Two 中型脉冲激光s add close-range bite, while a 机甲 Mortar 4 with shaped-charge ammunition bypasses 反导系统s entirely and can swap to smoke or airburst rounds as the situation demands. The combination gives Canopian commanders unusual tactical flexibility in a single 75-ton frame. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: BTC-6N将一门转管自动炮/5和两具Streak SRM-4与瞄准计算机结合，在各个射程都能可靠输出直射火力。两门中型脉冲激光器增强近距离打击力；一具装有聚能弹的机甲迫击炮4则可完全绕过反导系统，并能根据战况切换烟幕弹或空爆弹。这样的组合让Canopus指挥官在75吨机体上获得了罕见的战术灵活性。 怪癖: 稳定 武器 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: 塞雷斯金属 put this together as a joint project between the Confederation and the Magistracy, and honestly it shows. 加固结构 under all that 铁纤维装甲 plating means this thing shrugs off punishment that would wreck most other heavies. It is slow, but it does not need to be fast when everything shooting back at it is having such a hard time actually hurting it. Good machine to have on your side in a grinding fight.
column2: 塞雷斯金属将它作为联邦与治安官辖区的联合项目制造出来，成品确实体现了双方风格。铁纤维装甲下的加固结构能够承受足以摧毁多数其他重型机甲的打击。它速度缓慢，但当敌人的火力很难真正伤害它时，也就无需追求速度。在消耗战中，这是值得拥有的可靠机器。

column1: The CRLS-586 replaces the heavy autocannons of earlier variants with twin Rotary AC/5s, shifting the Coriolis away from single devastating strikes toward sustained high-volume fire. A 定位 Computer sharpens everything on the frame while an ER Large Laser and ER 中型激光 cover range brackets the autocannons cannot reach. CASE protects both ammunition bays and an 反导系统 adds defensive depth. Three jump jets keep the chassis signature ambush potential fully intact. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: CRLS-586用两门转管自动炮/5替换早期型号的重型自动炮，使Coriolis从一次性毁灭打击转向持续的高密度火力。瞄准计算机提升整机精度，ER大型激光器和ER中型激光器则覆盖自动炮无法触及的射程。CASE保护两个弹药舱，反导系统进一步增强防御深度。三具跳跃喷射器保留了底盘完整的伏击潜力。 怪癖: 精准 武器 - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: The FDE-1A is one of the most unconventional Capellan 设计s ever fielded, built around twin Arrow IV 火炮 systems carrying a staggering variety of munitions.
