Homing, cluster, Thunder, Inferno and 大卫·克罗克特 nuclear rounds give it an answer to virtually any battlefield situation. A torso-mounted cockpit frees the head for an 反导系统 and heat sink. 中型激光s and 小型脉冲激光s handle self-defense, but the Fusillade was never meant to fight at close range. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: FDE-1A是卡佩兰投入服役的最不寻常设计之一，围绕两套Arrow IV火炮系统打造，能够携带种类惊人的弹药。制导弹、集束弹、雷霆弹、地狱火弹和大卫·克罗克特核弹头使它几乎能应对任何战场情况。躯干驾驶舱腾出头部空间，用于安装反导系统和散热器。中型激光器和小型脉冲激光器负责自卫，但Fusillade从未被设计用于近战。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: Firefly Foundry built this one for Firefly 稳定s on Solaris VII in 3105, same year as the Yun Qi. They wanted a heavy to round out their tournament roster and they got one. Mixed tech from the Sea Foxes, Apollo-guided MRM 40, 大型X脉冲激光 Laser that runs hot but hits hard. Pure arena machine, never saw field service outside the stadiums. Fourteen double heat sinks tell you everything about how they expected pilots to run this thing.
column2: Firefly Foundry于3105年在Solaris VII为Firefly战队制造了这台机体，与Yun Qi同年。他们需要一台重型机甲完善比赛阵容，而这台正好满足要求。它混用了海狐氏族技术、Apollo制导MRM-40和一门发热但威力强劲的大型X脉冲激光器。这是纯粹的竞技场机器，从未离开体育场服役。十四组双重散热器足以说明他们预计驾驶员会如何操纵它。

column1: Hellespont Industrials built this for the Capellan Confederation on Sun Tzu Liao's personal commission. Stealth 装甲, MASC, Vibroblade, the whole package. The HAR-101 uses mixed tech from the Clans while the HAR-111 is a pure Inner Sphere build that they actually exported to the Magistracy and Fronc Reaches. Both versions are built around the same idea, get in faster than anyone expects, do damage, disappear before they can respond. That is a concept that works regardless of what tech you fill it with.
column2: Hellespont Industrials受Sun Tzu Liao亲自委托，为卡佩兰联邦制造了这台机体。隐形装甲、MASC、振动刀，整套配置一应俱全。HAR-101采用氏族混合技术，HAR-111则是纯内天体构型，实际出口到了治安官辖区和Fronc边域。两个版本都围绕同一理念打造：比任何人预想的更快切入，造成伤害，然后在敌人反应前消失。无论填充何种技术，这一理念都有效。

column1: The HAR-111 is the export variant of the Haruna, stripping out all Clan technology while retaining the core 设计 philosophy. 守护者ECM powers the Stealth 装甲, MASC still pushes the 35-ton frame past 170 kph and the Vibroblade remains as the primary close-range threat. A 中型X脉冲激光 Laser replaces the Heavy 中型激光 and twin Streak SRM 2s handle ranged harassment. This model reached the Magistracy of Canopus and 弗朗克边域 markets. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.98
column2: HAR-111是Haruna的出口型，拆除全部氏族技术，同时保留核心设计理念。守护者ECM为隐形装甲供能，MASC仍让这台35吨机体超过170 kph，振动刀继续作为主要近战威胁。一门中型X脉冲激光器替换重型中型激光器，两具Streak SRM-2负责远程骚扰。该型号进入了Canopus治安官辖区和Fronc边域市场。 怪癖: 灵活 掉落成本乘数: 0.98

column1: Majesty Metals built this one for the Magistracy during the Succession Wars when good 装甲 was hard to come by. Primary job is combat rescue, not fighting, though it can do both. That cargo bay is actually a full medical transport for six or seven people with a medic onboard. Star Corporal Sara Evans made a name for herself in a C22 charging into hot zones to pull soldiers out before a pirate Stalker finally got her in 3026.
column2: Majesty Metals在继承战争期间为治安官辖区制造了这台机体，当时优质装甲十分难得。它的主要任务是战斗救援而非作战，不过两者都能胜任。货舱实际上是一间完整的医疗运输舱，可搭载六七人并配备医护人员。Star Corporal Sara Evans凭借C22一战成名：她冲入危险区域救出士兵，直到3026年一台海盗Stalker最终将她击杀。

column1: The Seishin came out of the post-Jihad salvage boom, when pirates across the Periphery suddenly had access to 布雷克圣言会 hardware they had no business owning and the ambition to do something creative with it. The 设计 caught on in the 托尔图加自治领 and built a nasty reputation, because a mech optimized for taking prisoners and capturing hardware intact is genuinely harder to deal with than one that just wants to kill you. The Shield and 可伸缩刀刃 tell you exactly what happens if the taser does not land.
column2: Seishin诞生于圣战后的战场回收热潮。当时边疆各地的海盗突然获得了本不该拥有的布雷克圣言会硬件，并产生了用它做些创造性改装的野心。该设计在托尔图加自治领流行起来并声名狼藉，因为一台专门俘虏人员、完整夺取装备的机甲，确实比只想杀死你的机甲更难对付。护盾和可伸缩刀刃清楚说明了电击器未命中时会发生什么。

column1: The Shadow Wolf has one of the more chaotic production histories you will find, with the Errai factory changing hands between the AFFS, the Combine, and the 布雷克圣言会 in the space of a few years before eventually landing with the 球体共和国. Despite all that upheaval, the 设计 kept getting built, which tells you the demand was real. Stealth 装甲 combined with TAG on a frame this fast makes it genuinely dangerous to anything operating without 火炮 cover, because it can call fire down on targets that never even knew it was there.
column2: Shadow Wolf拥有你能见到的最混乱生产史之一：Errai工厂在几年间先后易手于AFFS、龙马联盟和布雷克圣言会，最终归于球体共和国。尽管经历如此动荡，该设计仍持续生产，这说明需求确实存在。隐形装甲与TAG结合在如此快速的底盘上，对任何缺乏火炮掩护的单位都十分危险，因为它能够向目标呼叫火力，而目标甚至不知道自己已经暴露。

column1: Concordat Telecom built these for under a million C-Bills a unit which tells you everything about what they were going for. Taurian Concordat needed cheap security across dozens of border worlds and this is what they got. Spread all over unstable planets along the Periphery and Federated Suns border. Don't put it up against anything with real 装甲 but for keeping local populations in line it did the job well enough.
column2: Concordat Telecom将这些车辆的单价压到不到一百万C-bill，这已经说明了它们的设计目标。Taurian Concordat需要在数十个边境世界部署廉价安保，而这就是他们得到的结果。车辆遍布边疆与联邦合众国边境的不稳定行星。不要让它对上真正的重装单位，但用于维持当地人口秩序，它已经足够胜任。

column1: The Arrowhead TH-A4B-AHD is a refresh of the original Arrowhead that improves it self-defense against infantry and battle 装甲 and increases its versatility slightly. One of the Arrow IV launchers has been replaced by two Mortar/6, and the 中型激光 and two Machine Guns were replaced by four Small Lasers. To handle the increased heat generation, two more heat sinks were also added. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.14
column2: Arrowhead TH-A4B-AHD是原版Arrowhead的更新型，提升了对步兵和战斗装甲的自卫能力，并略微增强了多用途性。一具Arrow IV发射器被两具Mortar/6替换，中型激光器和两挺机枪则被四门小型激光器替换。为应对增加的热量产生，它还增装了两组散热器。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.14

column1: The BattleMax BM-1 was an early version of the BattleMax that only saw limited production. Compared to the far more common BM-2 it only uses standard heat sinks and lacks the Large Laser and Small Pulse Laser of the final production variant. Instead the BM-1 has two more Medium and two Small Lasers. 特性：﻿Accurate Weapon - AC 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂
column2: BattleMax BM-1是BattleMax的早期型号，仅进行有限生产。与更常见的BM-2相比，它只采用标准散热器，并缺少最终量产型的大型激光器和小型脉冲激光器；作为替代，BM-1多装了两门中型激光器和两门小型激光器。 特性：精准武器—AC 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂

column1: The Candiru CND-201 replaces the Machine Guns and Flamers of the original version with a SRM-2 launcher and a Medium and Small Laser. Enough space remained to also add another heat sink to handle the increased heat generation. The C.A.S.E. protection was also removed, as it proved to be slightly faulty in the original due to a design flaw. 特性：精准武器 - 机枪 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: Candiru CND-201用一具SRM-2发射器以及一门中型激光器和一门小型激光器替换原版的机枪和喷火器。剩余空间还足以增装一组散热器，以应对增加的热量。由于设计缺陷，C.A.S.E.防护在原版中证明略有问题，因此也被拆除。 特性：精准武器 - 机枪 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: The Incursion ICR-N5-2 drops the C.A.S.E. and all of the Small Lasers to instead add three 中型激光器 and an extra heat sink. These changes were a common request for garrison units as they tended to find more utilization for the longer range of the 中型激光器 than the shorter range of the Small Lasers. 特性：Improved Sensors 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂
column2: Incursion ICR-N5-2拆除C.A.S.E.和所有小型激光器，改为增装三门中型激光器和一组散热器。驻军单位经常提出这种改动，因为相比小型激光器较短的射程，他们更需要中型激光器的远射程。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: When utilized in a more defensive role, the Incursion ICR-N5 was often found lacking. The upgraded ICR-N5-3 tried to address this by upgrading to double heat sinks and dropping the AMS and Remote Sensor Dispenser. This allowed adding a 中型激光器 and a SRM-2 launcher. As a final touch three of the Small Lasers were exchanged for two Machine Guns to improve the heat profile. 特性：Improved Sensors 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂
column2: Incursion ICR-N5在承担更偏防御的任务时经常显得不足。升级型ICR-N5-3通过换装双重散热器并拆除AMS和远程传感器分配器来解决这一问题，腾出的空间用于增加一门中型激光器和一具SRM-2发射器。最后，它用两挺机枪替换三门小型激光器，以改善热量特性。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: The LPD-79B is an alternate version of the Leopard that replaces the MASC with a supercharger instead. This change allows improving its damage potential by adding a 中型激光 and another Small Laser. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: LPD-79B是Leopard的另一种型号，用增压器替换MASC。这一改动允许增装一门中型激光器和另一门小型激光器，从而提高伤害潜力。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: A Refresh of the Leopard, the LPD-79R drops the AC/2 and 锁定式SRM-2 launchers to instead add an AC/5 and two 中型激光s. This allows for a slightly shorter range but higher damage output, often useful when working as garrison units. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: LPD-79R是Leopard的更新型，拆除AC/2和锁定式SRM-2发射器，改为安装一门AC/5和两门中型激光器。这样射程略短，但伤害输出更高，作为驻军单位时往往很有用。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Lu Bu LB-182 updates the chassis of the Lu Bu to use Endo-Steel 结构 The extra space allows for adding a Guardian ECM as well as replacing the three 中型激光器 with two Medium Pulse Lasers. The variant never saw much success, mainly due to the increased cost of using an Endo-Steel frame. 特性：Improved Cooling Jacket - PPC 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lu Bu LB-182更新了Lu Bu底盘，采用内骨骼结构。额外空间用于增装守护者ECM，并将三门中型激光器替换为两门中型脉冲激光器。由于内骨骼底盘成本增加，该变型始终没有取得太大成功。 特性：改进型冷却夹套—PPC 部署费用倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The LB-185 is another variant of the Lu Bu that replaces the ER PPC with Snub-Nose variants. The lower heat profile allows for dropping three heat sinks, which in turns enables the fitting of an extra Large Laser. 特性：改良冷却套-PPC 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: LB-185是Lu Bu的另一种变型，用短管型号替换ER PPC。较低的热量特征允许拆除三组散热器，腾出的重量可用于安装另一门大型激光器。 特性：改良冷却套-PPC 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The Neutron NT-5745 replaces the four medium Pulse Lasers and the C.A.S.E. protection of the original NT-5742 with two LRM-10 launchers and two tons of ammunition. Three excessive double heat sinks were also removed. 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Neutron NT-5745用两具LRM-10发射器和两吨弹药替换原版NT-5742的四门中型脉冲激光器及C.A.S.E.防护，并拆除了三组多余的双重散热器。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Neutron NT-5801 is an attempt to make a SLDF Royals worthy variant, but it never saw actual incorporation into those divisions. It upgrades the two arm mounted medium pulse lasers to large ones and adds an Ultra AC/5 in the right torso. To fit this all other lasers, three double heat sinks and the C.A.S.E. protection was removed, as well as switching to an Endo Steel 结构. 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Neutron NT-5801试图打造一款配得上SLDF皇家部队的变型，但从未真正编入这些部队。它将两门安装在手臂上的中型脉冲激光器升级为大型型号，并在右侧躯干增加一门Ultra AC/5。为容纳这些设备，拆除了其他全部激光器、三组双重散热器和C.A.S.E.防护，并改用内骨骼结构。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: A second variant of the Spiner, focused around its 增程PPC. To be able to fit the weapon and the extra cooling needed, the 引擎 core had to be downgraded from the original SPR-SNP-X's 150 rating to the 130 rating. 特性：精准武器 - PPC 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是Spiner的第二种变型，围绕增程PPC打造。为了安装武器及其所需的额外冷却，必须将引擎核心从原始SPR-SNP-X的150额定值降至130额定值。 特性：精准武器 - PPC 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Ariadne ADY-61 mounts a devastating AC/20 in the right torso paired with an LRM 10 backed by Artemis IV fire control in the left. All ammunition is stored in the left torso under CASE protection, though only two tons for the autocannon and one for missiles leaves it prone to running dry. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.04
column2: Ariadne ADY-61在右侧躯干安装一门毁灭性的AC/20，左侧安装一具由Artemis IV火控系统辅助的LRM-10。所有弹药都存放在受CASE保护的左侧躯干中，但自动炮仅有两吨、导弹仅有一吨弹药，因此很容易耗尽。 怪癖: 改进的 冷却夹套 - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.04

column1: The Ariadne ADY-61B swaps the AC/20 for an 超级自动炮-5 with two tons of ammunition, keeping the LRM 10 and Artemis IV fire control. Two medium pulse lasers and a 中型激光器 were added as backup weapons, giving the pilot options once primary ammunition supplies begin to run low. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.04
column2: Ariadne ADY-61B用一门超级自动炮-5和两吨弹药替换AC/20，同时保留LRM-10和Artemis IV火控系统。它增装两门中型脉冲激光器和一门中型激光器作为备用武器，使驾驶员在主要弹药开始耗尽后仍有选择。 怪癖: 改进的 冷却夹套 - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.04

column1: The Ariadne ADY-61C carries an LB-10X autocannon fed by a ton each of cluster and solid ammunition, alongside the retained LRM 10 and Artemis IV fire control. A medium pulse laser and two small lasers serve as backup weapons for when the autocannon or missile stores are depleted. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.04
column2: Ariadne ADY-61C携带一门LB-10X自动炮，配备各一吨的集束弹和实心弹，同时保留LRM-10和Artemis IV火控系统。一门中型脉冲激光器和两门小型激光器作为备用武器，在自动炮或导弹储备耗尽时继续作战。 怪癖: 改进的 冷却夹套 - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.04

column1: The Barrage UAC-BG-412 arms two UAC/5s in each arm for a total of four, delivering devastating sustained autocannon fire. Three tons of ammunition sit in each side torso under CASE protection, though with four hungry cannons the six tons combined can still run dry quickly. No backup weapons are carried. 特性：﻿Accurate Weapon - AC 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂
column2: Barrage UAC-BG-412每条手臂安装两门UAC/5，总计四门，能够持续输出毁灭性的自动炮火力。两侧躯干各有三吨弹药，均受CASE防护；但四门耗弹巨大的火炮仍可能很快耗尽六吨总弹药。它没有携带备用武器。 特性：精准武器—AC 部署费用倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂

column1: The BattleMax BM-2 fights as a sniper, keeping distance with a large laser and AC/5, though the latter suffers from a persistent ammunition feed jam. Two 中型激光器 and a head mounted small pulse laser cover closer engagements. Six tons of standard 装甲 offer only modest protection. 特性：﻿Accurate Weapon - AC 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂
column2: BattleMax BM-2以狙击手方式作战，利用大型激光器和AC/5保持距离，但后者长期存在供弹卡塞问题。两门中型激光器和一门安装在头部的小型脉冲激光器负责近距离交战。六吨标准装甲只能提供有限防护。 特性：精准武器—AC 部署费用倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂

column1: The Big Brother BB-1X mounts two heavy rifles - one in each arm - alongside a machine gun in each side torso to match its Little Brother companion. Seven tons of primitive 装甲 cover the frame, and an IndustrialMech ejection seat gives the pilot an escape option if things go wrong. 特性：Rugged 部署费用倍率：0.77 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂
column2: Big Brother BB-1X在每条手臂安装一门重型步枪，并在两侧躯干各装一挺机枪，以匹配它的Little Brother同伴。机体覆盖七吨原始装甲，工业机甲弹射座椅则在情况失控时为驾驶员提供逃生选择。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：0.77 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂

column1: The Big Brother comes from the short-lived Parallax Corporation, built as an almost exact replica of its 35 ton counterpart the Little Brother, just scaled up with bigger weaponry to match. It shares the same fatal flaw though, an Industrial机甲 frame that dooms it to obsolescence the moment real Battle机甲s enter the picture. Parallax sold the two together as a pair for half a century, and wherever one went, the other typically followed.
column2: Big Brother来自短命的Parallax Corporation，几乎是35吨Little Brother的精确放大复制品，只是配备更大的武器。它同样存在致命缺陷：工业机甲底盘注定会在真正的战斗机甲登场后立即过时。Parallax将两台机体成对销售了半个世纪，一台出现在哪里，另一台通常也会跟随。

column1: The Blackbird SL-SR71 leans into stealth scouting with a Guardian ECM system in place of an active probe. It carries an ER large laser and Streak SRM 2 launcher, giving it noticeably better self defense than its lighter Voodoo counterpart while still filling the same reconnaissance role. 特性：Land Air Mech 部署费用倍率：1.02
column2: Blackbird SL-SR71专注于隐形侦察，用守护者ECM系统替换主动探头。它携带一门ER大型激光器和一具Streak SRM-2发射器，比轻型Voodoo拥有明显更好的自卫能力，同时仍承担相同的侦察任务。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.02

column1: The Blurr BL-U11 mounts two PPCs for primary firepower alongside eight Streak SRM 2 launchers, with two small lasers as backup. Streak SRM ammunition is protected by CASE. A supercharger paired with MASC pushes speeds almost unheard of for a 90 ton frame, though at the risk of strain over time. 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 1.16
column2: Blurr BL-U11装备两门PPC作为主要火力，并配备八具Streak SRM-2发射器，两门小型激光器作为备用。Streak SRM弹药受到CASE保护。增压器与MASC结合，使这台90吨机体达到罕见的高速，但长期承受这种负荷可能造成损伤。 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 1.16

column1: The Candiru CND-101 is purpose built for anti infantry work, mounting four small lasers, two small pulse lasers, two machine guns and two flamers for close range devastation. Two medium pulse lasers add mid-range support. An XL引擎, 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and CASE round out the design. 特性：精准武器 - 机枪 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: Candiru CND-101专为反步兵作战打造，装备四门小型激光器、两门小型脉冲激光器、两挺机枪和两具喷火器，用于近距离毁灭性打击。两门中型脉冲激光器提供中程支援。XL引擎、铁纤维装甲和CASE完善了整套设计。 特性：精准武器 - 机枪 部署成本倍率：0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: The Dakota DKA-18 fields an LRM 20 with Artemis IV fire control and a Class-2 autocannon for long range work, backed by two SRM 6s with their own Artemis IV systems and two 中型激光器 for closer engagements. CASE protects the ammunition, though nine and a half tons of 装甲 is thin for its size. 特性：Improved Cooling Jacket - Missile 部署费用倍率：1.15
column2: Dakota DKA-18装备一具配有Artemis IV火控系统的LRM-20和一门2级自动炮，用于远程作战；两具SRM-6各自配备Artemis IV系统，另有两门中型激光器应对近距离交战。CASE保护弹药，但9.5吨装甲对于其体型而言偏薄。 特性：改进型冷却夹套—导弹 部署费用倍率：1.15

column1: The DemoMax DX-2 wields a wrecking ball in the left arm for pulverizing structures, alongside a dual saw in the right arm for slicing through stubborn materials. A flamer and small laser in each side torso round out the loadout, offering both softening power and precision work. 特性：Easy to Maintain 部署费用倍率：0.77
column2: DemoMax DX-2左臂装备破坏球，用于粉碎结构；右臂装备双锯，用于切割顽固材料。两侧躯干各有一具喷火器和一门小型激光器，兼顾软化目标和精细作业。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：0.77

column1: The DemoMax was built by MaxTech for the exact opposite of its construction focused siblings, dedicated entirely to demolition and destruction work. It became one of the rare MaxTech designs to sell in near record numbers, prized for being easy to pilot and versatile enough to handle nearly any wrecking job. Its heavy industrial 装甲 protects it from the everyday hazards of debris and workplace accidents, though it notably lacks environmental sealing, leaving it grounded compared to something like the SpacerMax.
column2: DemoMax由MaxTech制造，定位与其专注建造工作的同族机体完全相反，专门用于拆除和破坏。它成为MaxTech少数几款近乎创纪录销售的设计之一，因易于驾驶且足以应对几乎所有拆除任务而备受重视。重型工业装甲可抵御碎片和工作场所事故等日常危险，但它明显缺乏环境密封，因此与SpacerMax相比受到更多限制。

column1: The Extinguisher Fire机甲 mounts two sprayers connected to ten ton liquid storage 坦克s, backed by a flamer for controlled burns and a chainsaw for clearing debris. A small laser in the right arm handles precision work near survivors, while a searchlight and paramedic supplies support rescue operations. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 0.87
column2: Extinguisher消防机甲安装两具喷洒器，连接至容量十吨的液体储罐，并配备喷火器进行可控焚烧，配备链锯清理碎片。右臂的小型激光器用于幸存者附近的精确作业，探照灯和急救人员物资则支援救援行动。 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 0.87

column1: The Extinguisher FireMech comes from two brothers out of Rasalhague who built it as a dedicated emergency response unit, well equipped enough to handle fires both large and small. They designed the controls simply enough for even novice pilots to operate with ease, a decision that helped secure a thousand unit order from the Star League. Environmental sealing protects the pilot from smoke, and 24 tons of industrial 装甲 keep it safe in the line of duty, though its modest 54 kph top speed means these 'Mechs typically stay stationed close to the areas they're meant to protect.
column2: Extinguisher消防机甲来自Rasalhague的两兄弟。他们将其打造为专用应急响应单位，足以处理大大小小的火灾。控制系统设计得足够简单，即使新手驾驶员也能轻松操作；这一决定帮助他们获得了星盟的一千台订单。环境密封保护驾驶员免受烟雾影响，24吨工业装甲确保其在执行任务时安全，但54 kph的最高速度不高，因此这些机甲通常驻扎在需要保护的区域附近。

column1: The FarmerMax started out as a quadrupedal design, but MaxTech ran into gyro and stability problems in that configuration and converted it into a bipedal machine instead. Built as an all-in-one farming solution, it combines harvesting, irrigation and land clearing into a single unit, making it valuable enough to replace multiple pieces of separate equipment. Its 11 tons of industrial 装甲 rarely see much use given the low-risk nature of agricultural work, though they've occasionally helped it survive when caught up in conflict.
column2: FarmerMax最初采用四足设计，但MaxTech在该配置下遇到陀螺仪和稳定性问题，于是将其改造成双足机器。它是一体化农业解决方案，将收割、灌溉和土地清理整合在一个单位中，价值足以替代多件独立设备。11吨工业装甲在低风险农业工作中很少派上用场，但偶尔能帮助它在卷入冲突时生存下来。

column1: The Homunculus HCS-21 crams a wide mix of weapons onto its frame, an AC/5 and machine gun in the right arm, large laser and flamer in the left, SRM 4 in the right torso, LRM 10 and 中型激光器 in the left torso, plus a small laser in the head. Jump jets round out the design. 特性：Reinforced 结构 部署费用倍率：1.07
column2: Homunculus HCS-21在机体上塞入了各种武器：右臂一门AC/5和一挺机枪，左臂一门大型激光器和一具喷火器，右侧躯干一具SRM-4，左侧躯干一具LRM-10和中型激光器，头部另有一门小型激光器。跳跃喷射器完善了整套设计。 特性：加固结构 部署费用倍率：1.07

column1: The Incursion ICR-N5 carries an LRM 20 for ranged harassment alongside six small lasers for close defense, all backed by a Guardian ECM suite, Beagle active probe and remote sensor dispenser. An anti-missile system and CASE protect it further, while a supercharger boosts its already high speed. 特性：Improved Sensors 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂
column2: Incursion ICR-N5携带一具LRM-20进行远程骚扰，并以六门小型激光器负责近距离防御；整机还配备守护者ECM套件、比格犬主动探头和远程传感器分配器。反导系统和CASE进一步提供保护，增压器则让它本已很高的速度更上一层楼。 特性：改进型传感器 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: The Justicar SecurityMech arms a machine gun and SRM 2 in the right arm for crowd control, backed by a small laser near the left wrist for close lethal threats. An LRM 5 in the left arm covers ranged engagements against vehicles or fighters. Six tons of heavy industrial 装甲 offer modest protection. 特性：Ubiquitous 部署费用倍率：0.71
column2: Justicar安保机甲右臂装备一挺机枪和一具SRM-2，用于控制人群；左腕附近的小型激光器负责近距离致命威胁。左臂的LRM-5可对车辆或战斗机执行远程交战。六吨重型工业装甲提供有限防护。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：0.71

column1: The Kohlen K-112 arms a rock cutter in the right arm capable of breaking down anything from pebbles to boulders, paired with a mining drill in the left arm for reaching deeper depths. Twin lift hoists, a searchlight and environmental sealing support deep mining operations. A small laser has been added to the left torso for extra flexibility. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87
column2: Kohlen K-112右臂装备岩石切割器，可将从卵石到巨石的任何东西切碎；左臂配备采矿钻头，以深入更深地层。双提升绞车、探照灯和环境密封支援深层采矿作业。左侧躯干另增一门小型激光器，以提高灵活性。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 0.87

column1: The Kohlen comes from a long forgotten 泰拉霸权 concern, built as a Mining机甲 capable of replacing entire teams of miners even in dangerous conditions. Its size works against it in tighter mines, but where it fits, it's usually a welcome sight, able to dig itself out of cave-ins with its own tools. 24 tons of industrial 装甲 protect it from falling debris, though its rock cutter and mining drill have occasionally proven far more dangerous when turned against people rather than stone.
column2: Kohlen源自一个被遗忘已久的泰拉霸权企业项目，最初设计为采矿机甲，即使在危险条件下也能替代整支矿工队伍。它的体型在狭窄矿井中反而成为负担，但只要有足够空间，通常都会受到欢迎，因为它能用自己的工具从塌方中挖出自己。24吨工业装甲可抵御落石，不过岩石切割器和采矿钻头偶尔被用于对付人而非石头时，反而更加危险。

column1: The Leopard LPD-79 uses MASC to blitz targets before retreating, mounting two SRM 6s, two Streak SRM 2s, two small pulse lasers and two small lasers for close range devastation. A single Class-2 autocannon provides the only long range option. Eight tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 round out the design. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Leopard LPD-79使用MASC突袭目标后撤退，装备两具SRM-6、两具Streak SRM-2、两门小型脉冲激光器和两门小型激光器，进行近距离毁灭性打击。一门2级自动炮是它唯一的远程武器。八吨铁纤维装甲完成整套设计。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Little Brother LB-1X arms each arm with a light rifle fed by a total of three tons of ammunition, backed by a machine gun in each side torso with a ton of ammunition in the right torso. Eight tons of primitive 装甲 cover the frame, and an IndustrialMech ejection seat gives the pilot an escape option. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Little Brother LB-1X每条手臂各装备一门轻型步枪，共有三吨弹药；两侧躯干各有一挺机枪，右侧躯干另存一吨弹药。机体覆盖八吨原始装甲，工业机甲弹射座椅为驾驶员提供逃生选择。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：0.73 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Lu Bu LB-179 mounts twin ER PPCs for long range firepower alongside two 中型激光器 as backup, though both weapon types share the arm locations, risking total disarmament if both arms are lost. Double heat sinks keep the extended range cannons firing across sustained engagements. 特性：改良冷却套-PPC 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Lu Bu LB-179装备两门ER PPC提供远程火力，并以两门中型激光器作为备用。两种武器共用手臂位置，因此一旦双臂同时损失，就会有完全失去武装的风险。双重散热器确保远程火炮能在持续交战中保持射击。 特性：改良冷却套-PPC 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The Magellan MN-4 prioritizes stealth and speed over firepower, built for reconnaissance. Its 140 fusion 引擎 pushes 118.8 kph across most terrain. Armed with short range missiles for sabotage runs, it relies on a Guardian ECM suite to mask it from enemy sensors and slip past hostile lines undetected. 特性：Narrow/Low Profile 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂
column2: Magellan MN-4优先考虑隐形和速度而非火力，专为侦察任务打造。140级聚变引擎可让它在大多数地形上达到118.8 kph。它装备短程导弹执行破坏任务，并依靠守护者ECM套件遮蔽敌方传感器，悄无声息地穿过敌方防线。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左上臂, 右上臂

column1: The Maxwell MXW-770 fields an LB-10X autocannon as its primary weapon, supplemented by two LRM 5 launchers with Artemis IV fire control. CASE protects the ammunition, and unusually for its light armament, double heat sinks are included even though the base loadout barely requires them. 特性：Protected Actuators 部署费用倍率：1.17
column2: Maxwell MXW-770以LB-10X自动炮为主要武器，并以两具配备Artemis IV火控系统的LRM-5发射器提供支援。CASE保护弹药；尽管基础武器配置对散热需求很低，该机仍反常地配备了双重散热器。 特性：受保护的驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.17

column1: The Maxwell MXW-773 swaps the LRM 5s for a single LRM 10 with Artemis IV fire control, and replaces the autocannon with two ER PPCs. Without additional heat sinks to compensate, the particle cannons cause serious heat buildup, making it a riskier platform to run at full output. 特性：Protected Actuators 部署费用倍率：1.17
column2: Maxwell MXW-773用一具配有Artemis IV火控系统的LRM-10替换两具LRM-5，并用两门ER PPC替换自动炮。由于没有额外散热器补偿，粒子炮会造成严重热量积累，使这台平台在全功率运行时风险更高。 特性：受保护的驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.17

column1: The Maxwell MXW-779 emphasizes heavy damage output, mounting two 'Mech Mortar 4s backed by two medium pulse lasers. This loadout trades the earlier variants' balanced ranged options for concentrated bombardment, letting it batter targets with sustained mortar fire while the pulse lasers handle closer threats. 特性：Protected Actuators 部署费用倍率：1.17
column2: Maxwell MXW-779强调重型伤害输出，装备两具机甲迫击炮4，并由两门中型脉冲激光器支援。该配置牺牲早期变型均衡的远程选择，换取集中轰击能力，让迫击炮持续打击目标，同时由脉冲激光器处理近距离威胁。 特性：受保护的驱动器 部署费用倍率：1.17

column1: The Merovingian MVN-4S mounts an AC/20 in the left torso with three tons of ammunition for sustained heavy firepower, backed by three 中型激光器. CASE protects the autocannon ammo, while four jump jets giving a 120 meter leap set it apart from the Hunchback it was 设计ed to copy. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.03
column2: Merovingian MVN-4S在左侧躯干安装AC/20，配备三吨弹药以提供持续重火力，并由三门中型激光器支援。CASE保护自动炮弹药，四具跳跃喷射器使其能够跳跃120米，这让它区别于被仿制的Hunchback。 怪癖: 精准 武器 - AC 掉落成本乘数: 1.03

column1: This one's a prototype through and through, boss. Built to test the Narc missile beacon back when the Hegemony was still keeping it secret. Endo steel, 铁纤维装甲, XL引擎, all cutting edge for its day. Most got scrapped for parts during the Clan exodus, real rare find now.
column2: 老板，这台从头到尾都是原型机。它最初用于测试Narc导弹信标，当时霸主还在严密保密。内骨骼、铁纤维装甲、XL引擎，在它的时代全都是尖端技术。氏族大迁徙期间，大多数原型被拆解取件；如今再找到一台实在罕见。

column1: The Neutron NT-5742 hits hard at range, pairing two Gauss rifles with two ER large lasers for devastating alpha strikes, backed by four medium pulse lasers. Nineteen and a half tons of 装甲 make it exceptionally durable, though its 14 double heat sinks struggle to keep pace with the full energy loadout. 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Neutron NT-5742在远距离拥有强大火力，两门高斯步枪与两门ER大型激光器能够发动毁灭性的全弹齐射，另有四门中型脉冲激光器支援。19.5吨装甲使其异常坚韧，但14组双重散热器仍难以跟上完整能量武器组的热量负荷。 特性：精准武器 - 高斯 部署成本倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Nighthawk SL-F117 is the most heavily armed of the Shattered Skies LAMs, mounting two Artemis IV enhanced LRM 5s, two Streak SRM 2s and two medium pulse lasers. Ten and a half tons of 装甲 back up this versatile loadout, making it well suited for a variety of engagement ranges. 特性：Land Air Mech 部署费用倍率：1.05
column2: Nighthawk SL-F117是Shattered Skies系列LAM中武装最重的型号，装备两具装配Artemis IV的LRM-5、两具Streak SRM-2和两门中型脉冲激光器。10.5吨装甲支撑这套多用途配置，使其适合各种交战距离。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.05

column1: The Onryo NSS-X1 harasses from stealth, cloaked by a Null Signature System and Chameleon Light Polarization Shield that render it nearly undetectable. An LRM 10 with Artemis IV fire control provides long range harassment, while a medium pulse laser handles closer threats. CASE protects the missile ammunition. 特性：Accurate Weapon - Missiles 部署费用倍率：0.98
column2: Onryo NSS-X1依靠隐形进行骚扰，虚空信号系统和变色龙轻型偏振护盾使其几乎无法被探测。配备Artemis IV火控系统的LRM-10提供远程骚扰，中型脉冲激光器负责应对近距离威胁。CASE保护导弹弹药。 特性：精准武器—导弹 部署费用倍率：0.98

column1: The Quest QT-314 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm with two tons of ammunition for long range punch, backed by two 中型激光器 in the left arm and two machine guns in the center torso for close defense. Four leg mounted jump jets give it a 120 meter leap for repositioning. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Gauss 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Quest QT-314 右臂安装一门高斯步枪并携带两吨弹药，用于远距离打击；左臂的两具中型激光器和中央躯干的两挺机枪负责近距离防御。四具安装在腿部的跳跃喷射器可让它跳跃 120 米，迅速重新部署。 怪癖：精准武器 - Gauss 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower

column1: The Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 mounts a Gauss rifle in the right arm, two ER large lasers in the left torso and two medium pulse lasers in the right. An enhanced ultra class 20 autocannon in the left arm fires at double speed with four tons of ammunition. 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and integrated CASE round out the design. 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24
column2: Rikki Tikki Tavi 1 右臂安装高斯步枪，左侧躯干装有两具 ER 大型激光器，右侧装有两具中型脉冲激光器。左臂的增强型超重型自动炮/20以四吨弹药提供双倍射速。铁纤维装甲和集成 CASE 完善了设计。 特性：扰乱 部署费用倍率：1.24

column1: The SecuriMax SC-200 mounts two heavy rifles and six machine guns spread across its arms and torsos, backed by two flamers for overkill firepower. An LRM 5 in the left torso and SRM 6 in the right round out the loadout, though both missile systems suffer from their accuracy being hampered due to the limited fire control systems of an Industrial Mech. 特性：Easy to Maintain 部署费用倍率：0.91
column2: SecuriMax SC-200 在双臂和躯干分布安装两支重型步枪和六挺机枪，并以两具火焰喷射器提供压倒性火力。左侧躯干的 LRM-5 和右侧的 SRM-6 完善了装载，但工业机甲有限的火控系统削弱了两套导弹系统的精度。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：0.91

column1: The SecuriMax stands as proof of just how badly MaxTech wanted a proper Battle机甲 to its name, though like other Security机甲s of its era, its industrial roots simply couldn't compete with the real thing. Its heavy rifles and machine guns had little effect against modern 装甲, doing real damage only to similarly outdated equipment or vulnerable infantry. It survived for a time on backwater worlds far from modern militaries, but flawed fire control on its missile systems and overall high cost sealed its fate, making it one of MaxTech's shortest lived 设计s.
column2: SecuriMax 证明了 MaxTech 多么渴望拥有一台名副其实的战斗机甲。然而，和同一时代的其他安保机甲一样，它的工业血统无法与真正的战斗机甲竞争。重型步枪和机枪对现代装甲几乎无效，只能有效打击同样过时的装备或脆弱步兵。它曾在远离现代军队的边远世界服役一段时间，但导弹火控缺陷与高昂成本最终决定了它的命运，使其成为 MaxTech 寿命最短的设计之一。

column1: The Slipshot SST-121 balances speed and firepower, closing on targets before unleashing an LB-10X autocannon fed by both solid and cluster ammunition alongside a trio of 中型激光器. Six tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 protect the frame, with a CASE system in the right torso guarding the autocannon ammo. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: Slipshot SST-121 在速度与火力之间取得平衡，接近目标后以 LB-10X 自动炮开火；自动炮可使用实心弹和集束弹，另有三具中型激光器。六吨铁纤维装甲保护机体，右侧躯干的 CASE 系统则保护自动炮弹药。 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper

column1: The Slipshot SST-122 trades the autocannon for an all energy loadout, mounting three 中型激光器, two medium pulse lasers and an ER large laser. Upgraded heat sinks manage the heat load, while the freed up weight allows for an additional half ton of 装甲 protection over the original. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper
column2: Slipshot SST-122 放弃自动炮，改用全能量武器装载，包括三具中型激光器、两具中型脉冲激光器和一具 ER 大型激光器。升级型散热器管理热量，节省的重量还让它比原型多出半吨装甲。 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Upper

column1: The SpacerMax SP-2 mounts a fluid gun in the left torso with four tons of ammunition for oil, coolant, bonding agents, cleaning solutions and water. A spot welder replaces the right hand for construction work, while a small laser in the left arm handles debris clearing and precision cutting or demolition. 特性：Easy to Maintain 部署费用倍率：0.75
column2: SpacerMax SP-2 左侧躯干安装流体枪，并携带四吨油料、冷却剂、粘合剂、清洁液和水。右手替换为点焊机用于施工，左臂的小型激光器则负责清理碎片、精密切割和拆除作业。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：0.75

column1: This one's a one trick pony boss, built just to see if the 短管PPC could work on something small. Center torso mount caused nasty electromagnetic interference when fired, chalked up to the design rather than the weapon itself. Only six were ever made.
column2: 老板，这台机甲只有一个用途：验证磁轨 PPC 能否安装在小型平台上。中央躯干安装导致开火时产生严重电磁干扰，问题被归咎于设计而非武器本身。最终只制造了六台。

column1: The UrbanMax UX-2 arms an AC/5 in place of the right arm with two tons of ammunition split across the arm and torso, alongside a 中型激光器 and small laser mounted where the left arm would be. Seven tons of heavy industrial 装甲 protect the frame against most small arms fire. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：0.72 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: UrbanMax UX-2 右臂安装 AC/5，并在右臂和躯干之间分配两吨弹药；左臂位置安装一具中型激光器和一具小型激光器。七吨重型工业装甲保护机体，使其能抵御大多数轻武器射击。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：0.72 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Lightest of the four Shattered Skies 设计s, and it shows the moment things get hot. Built for scouting with that Beagle probe doing the heavy lifting, not the 装甲. Named after an old Earth fighter jet, same as the rest of the project. Barely a few dozen were ever built before the whole line got swept up in the civil war.
column2: 四种“破碎天空”设计中最轻的一款，一到高温环境就暴露出弱点。它依靠猎犬探针执行侦察，而不是依靠装甲。它与项目其他型号一样，以一架古老地球战斗机命名。在整条生产线被内战吞没前，只制造了几十台。

column1: The Warthog SL-A10 favors hit and run assaults, arming an Autocannon-5 alongside two RL 15s and a single RL 10 for single shot burst damage. Ten tons of 装甲 plating make it more heavily protected than contemporary lighter LAMs, though this comes at the cost of noticeably reduced speed. 特性：Land Air Mech 部署费用倍率：1.03
column2: Warthog SL-A10 偏好打了就跑的突袭战术，装备一门自动炮/5、两具 RL-15 和一具 RL-10，以单发爆发火力迅速脱离。十吨装甲板使它比同期轻型 LAM 防护更强，但代价是速度明显降低。 特性：陆空机甲 部署费用倍率：1.03

column1: The Warthog was named after the old ground attack plane, and built to hit hard before pulling out fast, at least in theory. It traded speed for 装甲 compared to its siblings, ten tons worth total. Those rocket launchers are one shot deals though, so pilots had to make every volley count. Like the rest of the project, it never got past the Amaris civil war in any real numbers.
column2: Warthog 以古老的对地攻击机命名，理论上用于重击目标后迅速撤离。与同系列相比，它牺牲速度换取总计十吨装甲。火箭发射器只能单发使用，因此驾驶员必须让每次齐射都物有所值。和项目其他型号一样，它在阿马里斯内战结束前都没有形成大规模产量。

column1: Trading speed for 装甲 and raw fire power, the 65 ton Hamilton was the heaviest of a trio of 2604 vintage SLDF armored units. 14.5 tons of 装甲 and a Gauss Rifle supported by 5 中型激光器 poses a deadly threat to Mechs and other vehicles. The inclusion of so much advanced technology would render the Hamilton extinct by the end of the 2nd Succession War. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 305 35 左侧 250 35 右侧 250 35 后方 195 35 炮塔 250 35 总计 1250 175 特性：主战坦克
column2: Hamilton 以速度换取装甲和原始火力，是三种 2604 年星盟装甲单位中最重的一款。14.5 吨装甲、一门高斯步枪和五具中型激光器，对机甲和其他车辆构成致命威胁。如此先进的技术也让 Hamilton 在第二次继承战争结束时走向灭绝。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 305 35 左侧 250 35 右侧 250 35 后方 195 35 炮塔 250 35 总计 1250 175 特性：主战坦克

column1: Created as a heavy assault unit that could take on anything up to and including assault Mechs, the 80 ton Lafayette Heavy MBT was created for the SLDFs exclusive use. A 160 rated XL引擎 allowed designers to cram a pair of ER PPCs and an AC/20 into the vehicles turret. What few Lafayettes survived the Amaris Civil War would be taken by the departing SLDF and are rumoured to still be hidden away on the Clan homeworlds. Comstar and the 布雷克圣言会 maintain a small quantity of salvaged Lafayettes. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 205 40 左侧 170 40 右侧 170 40 后方 135 40 炮塔 170 40 总计 850 200 特性：窄小低矮轮廓
column2: Lafayette 重型主战坦克是 80 吨级重型突击单位，为星盟专门制造，可对抗包括突击机甲在内的任何目标。160 级 XL 引擎让设计师能在炮塔内塞入一对 ER PPC 和一门 AC/20。少数幸存者被撤离的 SLDF 带走，据说仍藏在氏族母星。ComStar 和布雷克圣言会保有少量回收的 Lafayette。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 205 40 左侧 170 40 右侧 170 40 后方 135 40 炮塔 170 40 总计 850 200 特性：窄小低矮轮廓

column1: Fulfilling a desperate need for mobile anti aircraft assets, the Laurens was the SLDFs standard anti aircraft platform following its introduction in 2754. A 100 ton tank, the Laurens mounted a pair of AC/2s and UAC/5s in its turret with an LB-10X for backup at closer ranges. The manufacturing line for the tank was destroyed in 2769, dooming it to a long and slow decline to extinction during the Succession Wars. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 435 50 左侧 335 50 右侧 335 50 后方 275 50 炮塔 335 50 总计 1715 250 特性：防空瞄准系统
column2: 为满足机动防空资产的迫切需求，Laurens 于 2754 年推出，成为 SLDF 的标准防空平台。这款 100 吨坦克在炮塔中安装一对 AC/2 和 UAC/5，并以 LB-10X 负责近距离支援。生产线于 2769 年被摧毁，使它在继承战争期间缓慢走向灭绝。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：2/3 格 / 60/90 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 435 50 左侧 335 50 右侧 335 50 后方 275 50 炮塔 335 50 总计 1715 250 特性：防空瞄准系统

column1: Produced at the heigh of the Star League, the Suzumebachi was House Kuritas premier vtol. Dependant on soon to be lostech, the Suzumebachi was lost to the depredations of the Succession Wars. With a top speed of just shy of 130 kph, the 25 ton Suzumebachi is slow for its size but is well armored with 4 tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 providing protection. A single ER PPC is the VTOLs only weapon. 生物群系限制：该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 110 15 左侧 75 15 右侧 75 15 后方 65 15 总计 340 75 特性：精准武器 - PPC
column2: Suzumebachi 在星盟鼎盛时期生产，是库里塔家的主力 VTOL。它依赖即将失传的失落科技，最终在继承战争的破坏中消失。25 吨的 Suzumebachi 最高速度略低于 130 kph，虽对其吨位而言偏慢，却以 4 吨铁纤维装甲提供良好防护。VTOL 唯一武器是一具 ER PPC。 生物群系限制：该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动：8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲： 铁纤维装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 110 15 左侧 75 15 右侧 75 15 后方 65 15 总计 340 75 特性：精准武器 - PPC

column1: Conceived as a fast and manoeuvrable harasser, the Whiptail was 生产 by the Acme Widgets corporation for the 星际联盟防卫军; and later the armies of the Great Houses. A 10 ton hover 坦克, the Whiptail was known for its speed, and the rear mounted vehicular mine dispenser. A trio of turret mounted machine guns made up the 车辆s only ranged weapons. Production ceased with the fall of the Star League and the last Whiptail was destroyed sometime after the Second Succession War. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 11/17 格 / 330/510 米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 45 5 左侧 30 5 右侧 30 5 后方 25 5 炮塔 30 5 总计 160 25 怪癖: 快速起步
column2: Whiptail 由 Acme Widgets 公司为星际联盟防卫军及后来各大诸侯军队制造，定位为高速机动骚扰单位。10 吨悬浮坦克以速度和后置车辆地雷投放器著称。炮塔上的三挺机枪是车辆唯一的远程武器。星盟陨落后生产停止，最后一台 Whiptail 在第二次继承战争后某个时期被摧毁。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 11/17 格 / 330/510 米. 装甲: 装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 45 5 左侧 30 5 右侧 30 5 后方 25 5 炮塔 30 5 总计 160 25 怪癖: 快速起步

column1: The ERE-P2 is fully focused on long range combat, as it combines the Mass Driver with a 超重型突击高斯 Rifle and two Extended Range Large Pulser Laser. To be able to fit all the weapons and somewhat adequate cooling, the 设计 uses an XXL 引擎, which leaves it more vulnerable to side torso penetration. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.4 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: ERE-P2 完全专注于远程战斗，将质量驱动器、超重型突击高斯步枪和两具扩展射程大型脉冲激光器结合在一起。为容纳全部武器并提供勉强足够的冷却，设计采用 XXL 引擎，但这也让它更容易遭受侧面躯干穿透。 怪癖：稳定武器s 掉落成本乘数: 1.4 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The 002 is a variant sometimes found on the Capellan Confederation's and Free Worlds League's planets and operations. Four ER 中型激光s and three MML-9 launchers are mounted as secondary weapons, making the design more versatile. 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.34 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 002 是一种有时出现在卡佩兰联邦和自由世界联盟行星及行动中的改型。四具 ER 中型激光器和三具 MML-9 发射器作为副武器，使设计更加灵活。 特性：指挥机甲 部署成本倍率：1.34 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The Expunger 1 mounts a total of five Compact PPC, four of them are mounted in the head while the fifth sits in the center torso. Each arm also carries a 转管自动炮/10, meaning the burst potential of the Expunger 1 is quite high. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.47 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Expunger 1 总共安装五具紧凑型 PPC，其中四具位于头部，第五具安装在中央躯干。双臂还各有一门转管自动炮/10，因此 Expunger 1 的爆发潜力相当高。 怪癖：精准武器 - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.47 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: Besides its typical experimental Mauler Laser laser, the Master Orion MO-O3 only mounts a combination of advanced targeting hardware and cooling. It's large 引擎 is an attempt at making the Mauler Laser overcome it's main weakness, the short range. 特性：Improved Cooling Jacket - Laser 部署费用倍率：1.28 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 除实验性的 Mauler 激光器外，Master Orion MO-O3 只搭载先进瞄准硬件和冷却设备。它的大型引擎旨在弥补 Mauler 激光器射程过短这一主要弱点。 特性：Improved 冷却夹套 - 激光 部署费用倍率：1.28 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The last variant of the Subjugator to enter production, but is not significantly more advanced than the other models. A combination of Medium and Large 改进的 Heavy Lasers together with the 改进的 Railgun can keep sustained heavy fire going at most ranges if some basic heat management is utilized. 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.34
column2: Subjugator 最后一个投入生产的改型，技术水平并未明显超过其他型号。中型与大型改进型重型激光器，加上改进型磁轨炮，在基本热管理支持下可在大多数距离持续输出重火力。 怪癖: 令人胆怯 掉落成本乘数: 1.34

column1: The Kugelblitz, also known as the Hypernova, Superluminous Supernova, or 'Type 1A Supernova' is a gigantic Supernova chassis. Nothing really out of the ordinary until one checks the 装甲 plating on it, mounting WarShip class 'Ferro-Carbide Lamellor', this expensive 装甲 is capable of protecting a '机甲's internals without issue, but the price to maintain the 装甲 is something even the richest of 氏族钻石鲨 might have an issue with.
column2: Kugelblitz 又称 Hypernova、超光度超新星或“1A 型超新星”，是一副巨型超新星底盘。它本身并无异常，直到人们检查其装甲板：它使用战舰级铁碳化物层压装甲，昂贵的装甲足以保护机甲内部，但维护成本即使对最富有的钻石鲨氏族也可能难以承受。

column1: The -C1 was 设计ed in response to both A and B series of the Uberjager not meeting the customer's needs. With this new line of 设计s, Independence Weaponry again returns to adding secondary weapons by popular request, in the form of Light PPCs and 小型脉冲激光s, in addition the the main armaments of four Superheavy Rotary AC/2. As a last touch, to enable fitting all the heavy weaponry the 引擎 has been upgraded to an XXL. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -C1 是为解决 Uberjager A、B 系列无法满足客户需求而设计的改型。Independence Weaponry 应大众要求重新加入副武器，采用轻型 PPC 和小型脉冲激光器，配合四门超重型旋转 AC/2。最后，为容纳全部重型武器，引擎升级为 XXL 型号。 怪癖：精准武器 - Ballistics 掉落成本乘数: 1.27 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Produced by some unknown entity in the outer periphery, the Yin-Yang superheavy '机甲 is surprisingly sophisticated. Built around the weapons called Yin and Yang, likely from the same unknown manufacturer, the focus of the '机甲 is long range support, evident by its undersized 引擎.
column2: 这台由外围未知势力制造的阴阳超重型机甲，技术水平出人意料地高。它围绕名为“阴”和“阳”的武器构建，可能来自同一制造商；其重点是远程支援，这从尺寸偏小的引擎即可看出。

column1: The 'Rigor Mortis' project was focused on creating an even further improved version of the Ultralight 引擎. RISC scientists attempted to improve its performance by extending some parts of the 引擎 all the way into the shoulders of the 'Mech. 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: “Rigor Mortis”项目致力于制造进一步改进的超轻型引擎。RISC 科学家试图把引擎的部分结构一直延伸到机甲肩部，以提升性能。 特性：坚固 部署成本倍率：1.43 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Configuration B features a mix of energy and missile weapons, including a 大型脉冲激光 in the left arm and two 大型脉冲激光s in the right arm. It mounts 改进的 ATM 12 missile launchers on both left and right torsos with ample ammo stored in various locations. The mech also includes an Angel ECM Suite for electronic warfare and a 定位 Computer to enhance accuracy. Mobility is supported by Jump Jets in the center torso and both legs. The 设计 is cooled by 18 double heat sinks for effective heat management. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.19 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: B 配置混合使用能量与导弹武器：左臂安装一具大型脉冲激光器，右臂安装两具大型脉冲激光器。左右躯干各安装改进型 ATM-12 发射器，并在多个位置储存充足弹药。机甲还配备天使 ECM 套件和瞄准计算机，以进行电子战并提升精度。中央躯干和双腿的跳跃喷射器提供机动性，18 具双散热器负责有效散热。 怪癖: 多目标追踪 掉落成本乘数: 1.19 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The invasion strategies that created the Boyyi also shaped the Canis II 设计. Though 设计ated second-line, the original Canis was built to aggressively engage Inner Sphere forces. It featured extremely heavy firepower but suffered from severe heat issues and poor speed, limiting its effectiveness in combat. After the Wars of Reaving, Clan Coyote 开发 the Canis II to address these flaws, though it was costly and only a few units were 生产.
column2: 制造 Boyyi 的入侵战略也塑造了 Canis II 设计。原版 Canis 虽被列为二线单位，却专门用于主动攻击内圈部队；它火力极重，但严重过热且速度缓慢，限制了战斗效能。掠夺战争后，乌鸦氏族开发 Canis II 以解决这些缺陷，但成本高昂，最终只生产了少量单位。

column1: The Gryphon D configuration delivers high accuracy and firepower by combining a Class 30 超重型突击高斯 Rifle (split between the left arm and left torso), an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser, and an ER Small Laser. All three weapons are connected to a 定位 Computer, greatly improving their lethality. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Gryphon D 通过组合 30 型超重型突击高斯步枪（分置于左臂和左侧躯干）、改进型重型大型激光器及 ER 小型激光器，提供高精度和强大火力。三件武器都连接到瞄准计算机，大幅提升杀伤力。 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Prime configuration of the Haider sticks to a proven loadout: a single Class 20 Hyper Assault Gauss Rifle delivers long-range power, while twin ER Large Pulse Lasers provide precision and flexibility. It’s a straightforward build that favors efficiency and steady battlefield pressure. 特性：Stable Weapons 部署费用倍率：1.12 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Haider Prime 沿用经过验证的装载：一门 20 型超重型突击高斯步枪提供远程火力，两具 ER 大型脉冲激光器带来精度和灵活性。这是一套直截了当的配置，强调效率和稳定的战场压制。 特性：Stable 武器s 部署费用倍率：1.12 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The KAU-5RB variant, now in field testing, addresses the base model’s long-range weaknesses by replacing the Heavy PPC with an Extended Range version. It also adds a center torso 中型激光 and two additional double heat sinks. Thanks to the spacious chassis and straightforward weapon swap, this upgrade is popular and can be completed within a few hours on the battlefield. 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - PPC 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: 正在进行实地测试的 KAU-5RB 改型，用扩展射程型号替换重型 PPC，以弥补基础型号的远程弱点。它还在中央躯干增加一具中型激光器和两具双散热器。宽敞底盘与简单的武器替换让升级广受欢迎，战场上数小时内即可完成。 怪癖：精准武器 - PPC 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Kestrel began as a worn-out 凤鹰 salvaged by dispossessed '机甲Warrior Steven Faulkner for Solaris VII arena combat. With no funds to restore it, a wealthy fan, Gerald Nezmith, stepped in to finance the rebuild. Nezmith customized the '机甲 to suit Faulkner's fighting style, including a battle claw and gimbal-mounted vector-thrust jump jets. Though heavily modified, the Kestrel retains the core of a PHX-1D, reimagined into a flashy and deadly performer in the arena circuit.
column2: Kestrel 最初是一台破旧的凤鹰，由失去家园的机甲战士 Steven Faulkner 回收，用于 Solaris VII 竞技场战斗。由于没有资金修复，富有的粉丝 Gerald Nezmith 出资重建。Nezmith 按 Faulkner 的战斗风格定制机甲，加入战斗爪和万向矢量推力跳跃喷射器。尽管改动巨大，Kestrel 仍保留 PHX-1D 核心，并成为竞技场上华丽而致命的表演者。

column1: The Krait A configuration focuses on precise energy-based attacks, using a 定位 Computer linked to twin ER Large Pulse Lasers. It is further backed by an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光器, an 改进的 Heavy Small Laser, and an extra Double Heat Sink for better thermal efficiency. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Laser 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Krait A 专注于精确的能量攻击，使用瞄准计算机连接两具 ER 大型脉冲激光器；另有一具改进型重型中型激光器、一具改进型重型小型激光器和一具额外双散热器，提高热效率。 怪癖: 改进的 冷却夹套 - 激光 掉落成本乘数: 1.01 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mikasi A configuration relies solely on a Class 30 超重型突击高斯 Rifle for long-range damage. Though accurate with a 定位 Computer and well-supplied with ammo, its lack of secondary weapons makes it unpopular among most pilots. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mikasi A 完全依靠一门 30 型超重型突击高斯步枪进行远程打击。它配备瞄准计算机且弹药充足，精度很高，但缺乏副武器，因此不受大多数驾驶员欢迎。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Mikasi C configuration excels in close quarters, using five ER 中型脉冲激光s, six Jump Jets for 180 米 of mobility, a 定位 Computer, and robust heat sinking to overwhelm enemies in tight spaces. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Mikasi C 擅长近距离战斗，使用五具 ER 中型脉冲激光器、六具跳跃喷射器（提供 180 米机动范围）、一套瞄准计算机和强大的散热系统，在狭窄空间压倒敌人。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The C configuration specializes in close combat, mounting twin 大型脉冲激光s and six 中型脉冲激光s connected to a 定位 Computer. It also features an ECM Suite and jump jets that allow it to leap 120 米. It has minor heat issues but remains manageable for skilled 机甲Warriors. 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: C 配置专精近战，装备两具大型脉冲激光器和六具中型脉冲激光器，并连接至瞄准计算机。它还配备 ECM 套件和跳跃喷射器，可跳跃 120 米。虽然存在轻微热量问题，但熟练的机甲战士仍能轻松驾驭。 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Pantaleon Prime hits hard with dual Class 30 超重型突击高斯 Rifles, an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser, and a hidden 中型脉冲激光. This balanced weapon load makes it versatile in combat, able to engage enemies effectively at both long and close ranges with precision and power. 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Pantaleon Prime 以两门 30 型超重型突击高斯步枪、一具改进型重型大型激光器和一具隐藏式中型脉冲激光器提供强大火力。这套平衡的武器让它在远近距离都能精准有效地作战。 怪癖: 均衡 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Sidewinder A configuration mounts two 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, an iATM-3 missile launcher, and CASE II 装甲 in the right torso. It includes a 定位 Computer to boost laser accuracy, balancing firepower and defense in a compact 设计. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sidewinder A 双臂各安装一具改进型重型中型激光器，另有 iATM-3 导弹发射器和右侧躯干的 CASE II 装甲。瞄准计算机提升激光精度，使这台紧凑机甲兼具火力与防御。 怪癖: 灵巧 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Sidewinder C configuration combines two 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s with a 定位 Computer and adds six Jump Jets, enabling a 180-meter jump range. This enhances the Sidewinder C’s mobility and close-range striking capability. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sidewinder C 将两具改进型重型中型激光器与瞄准计算机结合，并增加六具跳跃喷射器，使跳跃范围达到 180 米，提升机动性和近距离打击能力。 怪癖: 灵巧 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Siorc Wolf 1 features an impressive jump capacity of 120 米, armed with twin ATM-6s and Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifles, complemented by a Watchdog CEWS for solid offensive capabilities. What truly sets this ‘机甲 apart is its unique torso 设计. Instead of a traditional single pivot, it uses twin torso discs to allow torso twisting. This innovative mechanism protects the 装甲 and CASE II mounts from damage while enabling faster rotation and a wider arc of fire. This 设计 significantly enhances the pilot’s ability to engage enemies across a broader field without repositioning the entire mech. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Siorc Wolf 1 拥有惊人的 120 米跳跃能力，装备两具 ATM-6 和两门 20 型超重型突击高斯步枪，并配备 Watchdog CEWS。它独特的躯干结构是最大特色：不采用传统单轴，而是使用双躯干圆盘实现扭转。该机构保护装甲和 CASE II 挂载免受损坏，同时带来更快旋转和更广射界，使驾驶员无需移动整台机甲即可攻击更大范围的敌人。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 中程 掉落成本乘数: 1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: The Siorc Wolf, 海狐氏族’s latest Assault-class 全向Mech, is based on the Mad Cat MK II 4-6 and quickly became a bestseller. Weighing 100 tons, it combines surprising speed—up to 80+ kph via supercharger—with an endo-composite skeleton maximizing weapon space. Manufactured primarily on Tukayyid, it’s widely available across multiple factions, including 海狐氏族, Federated Suns, and Wolf Empire, with other factions showing varied interest.
column2: Siorc Wolf 是海狐氏族最新的突击级全能机甲，以 Mad Cat MK II 4-6 为基础并迅速成为畅销型号。它重 100 吨，却凭借增压器达到 80+ kph 的惊人速度；内骨骼复合结构最大化武器空间。它主要在 Tukayyid 生产，广泛供应给多个派系，包括海狐氏族、联邦太阳、狼帝国，其他派系也表现出不同程度的兴趣。

column1: The Sköll Prime configuration is a balanced frontline skirmisher, armed with a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle, two 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, and an ER Small Laser. A 定位 Computer ensures accuracy across all ranges, making it a versatile threat. 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 Used with permission from Aries Games and Miniatures.
column2: Sköll Prime 是均衡的前线游击机甲，装备 20 型超重型突击高斯步枪、两具改进型重型中型激光器和一具 ER 小型激光器。瞄准计算机确保全射程精度，使其成为多用途威胁。 怪癖: 战斗计算机 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 经 Aries Games and Miniatures 授权使用。

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy 装甲 and a grown-up-sized Autocannon. R66's carry an experimental RAC/2.
column2: 别被矮小的“Urbie”骗了：它看起来像一只会走路的垃圾桶，却能安装厚重装甲和成人规格的自动炮。R66 型还携带实验性 RAC/2。

column1: The 布雷克圣言会's Bolla Stealth Tank was 设计ed during the early part of the Jihad as part of the Serpentus Series of OmniVehicles. The Bolla's inception was made possible from salvage of Capellan stealth 车辆s in 3069 and was first seen in combat in 3072. The 坦克 was 设计ed to support cybernetically enhanced infantry of the Manei Domini and 生产 by Krupp Armament Works on Terra. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 5/8 格 / 150/240 米. 装甲: 黑色甲壳 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 205 30 左侧 165 30 右侧 165 30 后方 150 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 885 150 怪癖: Off Roader Omni 车辆 Can carry 1 Battle 装甲 Squads.
column2: 布雷克圣言会的 Bolla 潜行坦克于圣战初期设计，属于 Serpentus 全能车辆系列。3069 年从卡佩兰潜行车辆的残骸中获得的技术促成了 Bolla，并于 3072 年首次参战。该坦克旨在支援机械增强步兵，由 Krupp 武器公司在 Terra 生产。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 5/8 格 / 150/240 米. 装甲: 黑色甲壳 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 205 30 左侧 165 30 右侧 165 30 后方 150 30 炮塔 200 30 总计 885 150 怪癖: 越野 全能 车辆 可携带 1 个战斗装甲小队。

column1: This Archer variant, based on the 9K, was introduced during the Dark Ages. It retained the four MML-5 launchers and two of the three Light PPCs of the earlier design, but replaced the third Light PPC and C3 Slave with a C3 Boosted Slave and an ER 中型激光器.
column2: 这款基于 9K 的 Archer 改型于黑暗时代推出。它保留四具 MML-5 发射器和早期设计的三具轻型 PPC 中的两具，但用 C3 增强从属单元和一具 ER 中型激光器替换第三具轻型 PPC 及 C3 从属单元。

column1: An experimental variation first sighted in 3086, the 凤鹰 IIC 8 benefits from the XXL 引擎 first 开发 for the Dasher II, freeing up nine extra tons over the more common 400-rated XL引擎. A shell of standard 装甲 wrapped around an Endo Steel frame, the 8 Variant mounts an ER PPC and two 小型脉冲激光s in each side torso, an ECM Suite and five 改进的 Jump Jets making it agile and deadly. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.2
column2: 这款于 3086 年首次发现的实验改型，凤鹰 IIC 8 采用最初为 Dasher II 开发的 XXL 引擎，相比常见的 400 级 XL 引擎多出九吨可用重量。标准装甲包覆内骨骼钢框架，双侧躯干各安装一具 ER PPC 和两具小型脉冲激光器；ECM 套件与五具改进型跳跃喷射器使其灵活而致命。 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.2

column1: The 凤鹰 L is a light BattleMech, produced originally for the Draconis Combine at the dawn of the thirty-second century. It was modeled to resemble Crosby's old and remodeled 凤鹰, which they had first produced in the 3060s, and was their BattleMechs Research Firm's bid to offer a replacement to the venerable Panther after the Second Combine-Dominion War. Alternately known as the Fenikkusu Taka, the 凤鹰 L retains the movement profile of its heavier predecessor.
column2: 凤鹰 L 是一台轻型战斗机甲，于 32 世纪初最初为龙马联邦生产。它仿照 Crosby 的老式改装凤鹰，后者于 3060 年代首次生产；该机型是其战斗机甲研究机构为在第二次联邦-自治领战争后替代老牌 Panther 提出的方案。它也被称为 Fenikkusu Taka，并保留了更重前代的移动特征。

column1: A Dark Age variant of the classic Cab, the Crab 54 mounts a massive 350-rated Fusion Core and a Supercharger, giving it the speed of a much lighter mech. A Composite 结构 and 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 provide the needed weight and allow for a pair of 等离子步枪s to be mounted. An ER 中型激光 and an ER Small serve as secondary weapons if the Crab runs out of ammo. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.04
column2: 黑暗时代的经典 Cab 改型 Crab 54，装备巨大的 350 级聚变核心和增压器，速度可媲美轻得多的机甲。复合结构和重型铁纤维装甲提供所需重量余量，使其能够安装一对等离子步枪。若 Crab 耗尽弹药，ER 中型激光器和 ER 小型激光器可作为副武器。 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.04

column1: A Dark Age variant of the classic Cab, the Crab 54 mounts a massive 350-rated Fusion Core and a Supercharger, giving it the speed of a much lighter mech. A Composite 结构 and 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲 provide the needed weight and allow for a pair of 等离子步枪s to be mounted. An ER 中型激光 and an ER Small serve as secondary weapons if the Crab runs out of ammo.
column2: 黑暗时代的经典 Cab 改型 Crab 54，装备巨大的 350 级聚变核心和增压器，速度可媲美轻得多的机甲。复合结构和重型铁纤维装甲提供所需重量余量，使其能够安装一对等离子步枪。若 Crab 耗尽弹药，ER 中型激光器和 ER 小型激光器可作为副武器。

column1: The Adder I config carries an Improved Heavy 中型激光 and twin ER 中型激光s. An SRM-6 and a ton of ammunition is mounted in each side torso. To handle the heavy heat load, four extra heat sinks are installed, two in each arm.
column2: Adder I 配置携带一具改进型重型中型激光器和两具 ER 中型激光器。左右侧躯干各安装一具 SRM-6 和一吨弹药。为应对高热负荷，额外安装四具散热器，双臂各两具。

column1: The Araña is a medium Quad Militia机甲 built by the Escorpion Imperrio for their freeborn garrison units. Deployed alongside the Reptar, the 设计 is a stop gap until Clan grade production facilities can be built.
column2: Araña 是一台由 Escorpion Imperrio 为自由出生驻军制造的中型四足民兵机甲。它与 Reptar 协同部署，在氏族级生产设施建成前充当过渡方案。

column1: The late Republic era AS7-S4 retained the majority of the -S3’s armament, but married it to stealth 装甲. The '机甲 was mainly kept within the Lyran Commonwealth forces, but some recently 生产 'S4s disappeared under strange circumstances, only to reappear in the hands of some Mercenary Outfits attacking the Commonwealth's rivals. 怪癖: 战斗铁拳 掉落成本乘数: 1.18
column2: 共和国晚期的 AS7-S4 保留 -S3 的大部分武装，但改用潜行装甲。该机甲主要在莱拉联邦部队中服役，部分最近生产的 S4 却在神秘情况下失踪，随后出现在袭击联邦竞争对手的雇佣兵组织手中。 怪癖: 战斗铁拳 掉落成本乘数: 1.18

column1: The Bane 6 carries the spiritual successors of the original Bane’s weaponry: five ProtoMech-scale AC/2s in each arm tied to a targeting computer, while still keeping the 结构 upgrades the Bane 5 introduced. 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Bane 6 搭载原版 Bane 武器的精神继承者：双臂各有五门原型机甲级 AC/2，并连接瞄准计算机，同时保留 Bane 5 引入的结构升级。 特性：躯干扭转范围扩大 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The original Bane combined with modern Endo-Composite 结构 and a huge targeting computer. Ouch.
column2: 原版 Bane 结合现代内骨骼复合结构与巨型瞄准计算机，效果令人咋舌。

column1: Designed to engage in close-range brawls, the 100-ton Berserker debuted in 3056. A 400-rated cXL 引擎 paired with TSM allows the BRZ-D4 to outrun almost any other heavy- or assault-grade Mech. A Bombast Laser and 4 Clan ER 中型激光器 make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10-ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. Angel ECM and Impact Resistant 装甲 keep the BRZ-D4 safe as it closes in, 4 Jump Jets provide extra mobility and allow the Berserker to execute lethal DFA attacks; while a head-mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor.
column2: Berserker 于 3056 年推出，是一台专为近距离混战设计的 100 吨机甲。400 级 cXL 引擎与三倍肌肉组织让 BRZ-D4 能超过几乎所有重型或突击级机甲。炸弹激光器和四具氏族 ER 中型激光器构成远程武装，近距离则由十吨巨型战斧造成致命打击。天使 ECM 与抗冲击装甲保护 BRZ-D4 接近目标，四具跳跃喷射器提供额外机动并允许执行致命的死亡从天而降攻击；头部火焰喷射器进一步增强威慑力。

column1: A Dark Age update to the Civil War era BJ-4, the Blackjack BJ-5 pairs quad Light PPC’s with a duo of Light AC/2’s. A combination of a Light 引擎 and Endo Steel create the free weight for the weapons.
column2: 黑暗时代对内战时期 BJ-4 的升级型 Blackjack BJ-5，配备四具轻型 PPC 和两具轻型 AC/2。轻型引擎与内骨骼钢的组合为武器释放了可用重量。

column1: The 3 answers the demands from the market, first produced in 3092. Based on the 2 variant, engineers removed the ATM-6s, which free enough space to add two ER 中型激光器 in each arm. The number of double heat sinks was increased to 22 for continued fighting over a longer period of time.
column2: 3 型用于满足市场需求，于 3092 年首次生产。工程师以 2 型为基础移除 ATM-6，为每条手臂增加两具 ER 中型激光器，并将双散热器数量提高到 22 具，以便长时间持续作战。

column1: This Dark Age variant is a direct fire support model introduced by the 球体共和国 in 3125. It carries a light PPC and light AC/2 in each arm; a small cockpit was needed to fit this equipment in place. It is protected by seven and a half tons of reactive 装甲. 怪癖: 模块化武器 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 该黑暗时代改型是联邦共和国于 3125 年推出的直射火力支援型号。双臂各装备一具轻型 PPC 和轻型 AC/2，为容纳设备而采用小型驾驶舱。七吨半反应装甲为其提供防护。 怪癖: 模块化武器 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The Cadaver was introduced by the Taurian Concordat in 3094. With a top speed of 120 km/h, it typically functions as a high speed cavalry unit among Taurian forces, but has also been used as a scouting unit. Protected by six tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, it has a great deal of 装甲 for a light 'Mech, but doesn't possess much in the way of ranged firepower. The Cadaver carries a Full-Head Ejection System and a 守护者ECM suite disrupts enemy communications.
column2: Cadaver 由陶瑞安协约国于 3094 年推出。它最高速度达到 120 km/h，通常在陶瑞安部队中担任高速骑兵，也用于侦察。六吨铁纤维装甲为轻型机甲提供了相当可观的防护，但远程火力有限。Cadaver 搭载全头弹射系统，守护者 ECM 套件则能干扰敌方通信。

column1: The Calliope was primarily 设计ed as a garrison Battle机甲 for the Magistracy Armed Forces to combat infantry and 车辆s. The 设计 was also introduced to replace the aging Snake Battle机甲 commonly used by both the Capellan Confederation and the Magistracy of Canopus for the same role.
column2: Calliope 最初设计为王座联邦武装部队使用的驻军战斗机甲，用于对付步兵和车辆。它还被引入以替代老旧的 Snake 战斗机甲，后者常由卡佩兰联邦和金星王座都使用。

column1: The third variant of the Yen-Lo-Wang, the YLW3 replaces a Gauss rifle, a LRM-20 launcher and a single ER 中型激光器 - all Clan spec. Further it upgrades the 'Mech to use double heat sinks and 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲.
column2: Yen-Lo-Wang 的第三种改型 YLW3 移除一门高斯步枪、一具 LRM-20 发射器和一具 ER 中型激光器，全部为氏族规格；同时升级为双散热器，并采用轻型铁纤维装甲。

column1: The preferred configuration by Clan Wolf, mounting two Improved Heavy 中型激光s, twin LRM-10 launchers with 2 tons of ammo and an 增程PPC.
column2: 狼氏族偏好的配置，装备两具改进型重型中型激光器、两具 LRM-10 发射器及两吨弹药，并配备一具增程 PPC。

column1: Marik factories continued to be the driving force behind further improvements to the Crusader. Kallon intermittently experimented with reduced speed and greater jump capacity, but ultimately consolidated the new weapons suite—mating multi-missile and Streak launchers with light PPCs—with the -5M’s movement profile to create the CRD-7M. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: Marik 工厂继续推动 Crusader 的改进。Kallon 曾间歇性地试验降低速度、增加跳跃能力，但最终将多用途导弹与 Streak 发射器、轻型 PPC 组合成新的武器套件，并沿用 -5M 的移动特征，造就 CRD-7M。 怪癖：稳定武器s 掉落成本乘数: 1.09

column1: With the -8R 卡隆工业 returned to the roots of the Crusader, once again going for long-range firepower instead of the MMLs used in other recent variants. Due to using 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and both an XL引擎 core and XL gyro the -8R allows the mounting of two LRM-15 launchers, two 锁定式SRM-6 and twin Machine Guns, and still have enough weight capacity left to increase the total amount of 装甲 to 12 tons. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: -8R 让 Kallon 工业回归 Crusader 的根本，再次追求远程火力，而不是近期型号使用的 MML。它采用轻型铁纤维装甲、XL 引擎核心和 XL 陀螺仪，因此可安装两具 LRM-15、两具锁定式 SRM-6 和两挺机枪，并将总装甲增加到 12 吨。 怪癖：稳定武器s 掉落成本乘数: 1.09

column1: A formidable Crusader, but still vulnerable in the side torsos due to the XL引擎 core used.
column2: 这是一台强大的 Crusader，但由于使用 XL 引擎核心，侧面躯干仍然容易受损。

column1: Based on the infamous '机甲 'The Rhino' of the former Solaris 7 gladiator Lord Rataxes, this thing hits hard and fast. Without Jump Jets it might not work on all terrains, but still an interesting concept.
column2: 它基于前 Solaris 7 角斗士领主 Rataxes 那台臭名昭著的“犀牛”机甲，火力强、速度快。没有跳跃喷射器意味着它无法适应所有地形，但这个概念仍然很有趣。

column1: Pretty piece of kit, boss. Double heat sinks, ER lasers, double the missiles, and it kept the Gauss up front. Runs cool and reaches out. Trouble is, the folks who want a P-7 can't stretch to a P-9, and those who can already bought a flashier main-line variant. Good '机甲, wrong crowd.
column2: 不错的装备，老板。双散热器、ER 激光器、成倍的导弹，而且高斯步枪仍然置于前方。它运行温度低，射程也很远。问题是，想要 P-7 的人买不起 P-9，而买得起的人已经选择了更华丽的主线型号。机甲不错，只是遇上了错误的客户群。

column1: After ultimately failed Elemental II project, the 地狱马 quest to improve Elemental didn't end. The Elemental III keeps the basic suit relevant for another century, incorporating a one-shot advanced SRM system to extend the suit’s reach and new developed stealth 装甲 to increase survivability. 特性：标准部件 部署成本倍率：0.93 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。
column2: 元素战士 II 项目最终失败后，地狱马氏族改进元素战士的探索并未停止。元素战士 III 让这套基础战斗服又保持了一个世纪的实用性，加入一次性高级 SRM 系统以延伸射程，并采用新开发的潜行装甲提升生存能力。 特性：标准部件 部署成本倍率：0.93 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: After ultimately failed Elemental II project, the Hell's Horses quest to improve Elemental didn't end. The Elemental III keeps the basic suit relevant for another century, incorporating a one-shot advanced SRM system to extend the suit’s reach and new developed stealth 装甲 to increase survivability.
column2: 元素战士 II 项目最终失败后，地狱马氏族改进元素战士的探索并未停止。元素战士 III 让这套基础战斗服又保持了一个世纪的实用性，加入一次性高级 SRM 系统以延伸射程，并采用新开发的潜行装甲提升生存能力。

column1: Despite the standard Elemental's all-around utility, 氏族地狱马 sought to enhance their Elementals mobility. The result of their work, Elemental II, discards Jump Jets and SRM pack in favor of battle 装甲 myomer booster. The 设计 didn't gain popularity and saw no interest from other clans, and Elemental II remains in limited service in 地狱马 garrisons. 怪癖: 标准部件 掉落成本乘数: 0.93 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: 尽管标准元素战士用途全面，地狱马氏族仍希望提升元素战士的机动性。其成果元素战士 II 放弃跳跃喷射器和 SRM 背包，改用战斗装甲肌肉增强器。该设计未能流行，也未引起其他氏族兴趣，元素战士 II 目前仅在地狱马氏族驻军中有限服役。 怪癖: 标准部件 掉落成本乘数: 0.93 可搭载 全能 units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.

column1: The latest mass-生产 执法者 III 设计, the -7D has some interesting 设计 concepts behind it. But I still find it hard to get used to torso mounted cockpits...
column2: 最新量产的执法者 III 设计中，-7D背后有一些有趣的设计理念。不过，我还是很难习惯把驾驶舱安装在躯干里……

column1: Based on the original Flamberge Battle机甲 prototype, the Flamberge 2 is a 70-ton 机甲 and test bed for the 部分机翼. A 280-rated XL引擎 and Endo Steel provide the free weight needed to mount 6 改进的 Jump jets and a 部分机翼. 2 SRM-6's and a 大型脉冲激光 form the main armament with 4 中型脉冲激光s and a 微型 Pulse Laser for closer ranges. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.16
column2: Flamberge 2基于原版Flamberge战斗机甲原型，是一台70吨级机甲和部分机翼的测试平台。280级XL引擎与内骨骼钢提供了所需的余重，用于安装6具改进型跳跃喷射器和部分机翼。2具SRM-6与一门大型脉冲激光构成主武器，近距离则由4门中型脉冲激光和一门微型脉冲激光负责。 特性：改进型定位 - 中 部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: Based on the original Flamberge Battle机甲 prototype, the Flamberge 3 is a 70-ton 机甲 and test bed for the 部分机翼. A 280-rated XL引擎 and Endo Steel provide the free weight needed to mount 6 改进的 Jump jets and a 部分机翼. 2 SRM-4's and a UAC-20 form the main armament with 2 中型脉冲激光s and a 微型 Pulse Laser for closer ranges. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.16
column2: Flamberge 3基于原版Flamberge战斗机甲原型，是一台70吨级机甲和部分机翼的测试平台。280级XL引擎与内骨骼钢提供了所需的余重，用于安装6具改进型跳跃喷射器和部分机翼。2具SRM-4与一门UAC-20构成主武器，近距离则由2门中型脉冲激光和一门微型脉冲激光负责。 特性：改进型定位 - 中 部署费用倍率：1.16

column1: Intended to cripple and capture enemy units, the C configuration's principal tool in its mission is a TSEMP磁脉冲炮 found in the left arm. Its offensive weaponry includes a single 短管PPC and a 轻型自动炮/5 found in the other arm. Both arms' lower actuators have been removed to allow the 'Mech the flexibility of flipping its arms. CASE II has been added to the right torso to prevent any ammunition explosion effects from crippling the 'Mech's 引擎 and arm weapons. One additional heat sink is added as well.
column2: C配置的任务是瘫痪并俘获敌方单位，左臂的TSEMP磁脉冲炮是完成任务的主要工具。其进攻武器还包括另一条手臂上的短管PPC和轻型自动炮/5。两条手臂的下部驱动器都被拆除，使机甲能够灵活翻转手臂。右侧躯干加装CASE II，防止弹药爆炸导致机甲引擎和手臂武器失效。此外还增加了一具散热器。

column1: Following the success of the Hermit Crab, StarCorps on Son Hoa found itself in the curious position of being a profitable advanced Battle机甲 manufacturer on an independent Periphery world. The company's Gladiator line had been running since the Blakist war, producing a few -5R export units every year. With minimal capital expansion costs and only a few newly-sourced components, the -7R refit became both an economical and effective local defense unit as well as a distinctive addition to the Son Hoa branch’s catalog for regional sales.
column2: Hermit Crab取得成功后，Son Hoa的StarCorps发现自己竟成了独立边疆世界上有利可图的先进战斗机甲制造商。该公司的Gladiator产品线自布雷克战争以来一直运转，每年生产少量-5R出口型号。凭借极低的资本扩张成本和少量新采购部件，-7R改装型既成为经济而有效的本地防御单位，也成为Son Hoa分部面向区域销售的特色产品。

column1: This Grand Titan is based on a field refit. It carries a Heavy PPC, two ER 中型激光s, a single ER Large Laser, two 中型激光s, and a 小型脉冲激光 for anti-infantry work. For close combat it carries a Sword. It also has a 90 meter jump radius. A Heavy Duty Gyro has been 装甲ed, as has the cockpit and all the arm and leg actuators. At the same time, this Grand Titan is equipped with 三重肌纤维束 which allows it to inflict twice as much damage in a physical brawl, as well as reach speeds of 64 km/h.
column2: 这台Grand Titan基于战场改装型，装备重型PPC、两门ER中型激光、一门ER大型激光、两门中型激光和一门小型脉冲激光，用于对付步兵。近战时它还携带一把剑，并拥有90米跳跃半径。重型陀螺仪、驾驶舱以及所有手臂和腿部驱动器都得到了装甲强化。同时，这台Grand Titan配备三重肌纤维束，使其在肉搏中造成双倍伤害，并达到64公里/小时的速度。

column1: Taking inspiration from the original Grasshopper 5H, the 8K is a Dark Age re设计 of the Grasshopper that reinvents it as a long ranged skirmisher and raider. Armed with 4 LPPC’s and an ER Large Laser, the 8K retains the 5H’s head mounted LRM-5; albeit with the inclusion of CAE II to protect the ammo bay. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.1
column2: Grasshopper 5H的8K汲取原版5H的设计灵感，是黑暗时代重新设计的Grasshopper，将其改造成远程游击与突袭机甲。它装备4门LPPC和一门ER大型激光，保留5H头部安装的LRM-5，并加入CAE II保护弹药舱。 特性：坚固 部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: The Gray Death Heavy battle 装甲 has a built-in Support PPC, two detachable one-shot SRM-4s, a Basic Manipulator, and 改进型传感器.
column2: Gray Death重型战斗装甲内置支援PPC、两具可拆卸的一次性SRM-4、基础操纵器和改进型传感器。

column1: This is a nod to their touman changing its attitude towards the use of physical attacks, namely using Death from Above maneuver.The second version of the Gyrfalcon would appear in 3112. This version dropped the Reflective 装甲 of the standard model for 铁纤维装甲. Using a less advanced 装甲, this version also drops the 轻型 主动探头 and adds two laser heat sinks.
column2: 这是对其战团改变肉搏战态度的致意，具体体现为采用“天降死神”机动。Gyrfalcon的第二个型号于3112年问世，用铁纤维装甲替换标准型号的反射装甲。由于使用较不先进的装甲，它还取消轻型主动探头，增加两具激光散热器。

column1: The third variant produced in 3112, replacing both LB 2-X ACs with two Type 25 Ultra AC/2s, the original 引擎 and 铁纤维装甲 装甲. The variant retains the original's Targeting Computer, while fitted with Gyrfalcon 2's Ferro 装甲, a Small Cockpit, and carries only 10 Laser Heat Sinks.
column2: 第三个变体于3112年生产，用2门Type 25 Ultra AC/2替换两门LB 2-X AC、原装引擎和铁纤维装甲。该变体保留原版的瞄准计算机，采用Gyrfalcon 2的铁质装甲和小型驾驶舱，并仅携带10具激光散热器。

column1: The F configuration carries an 改进型重型高斯步枪, a Heavy PPC and three 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers. An Angel ECM Suite disrupts enemy communications, and the 改进型重型高斯步枪 is protected by CASE II.
column2: F配置装备一挺改进型重型高斯步枪、一门重型PPC和三门中型X脉冲激光。天使ECM套件可干扰敌方通信，改进型重型高斯步枪则由CASE II保护。

column1: Designed by Adam Tech Industries and manufactured from their plant on Abadan, the Havoc was inspired by the JR7-K Jenner and managed to improve on many of the JR7-K's design features. The combination of almost double the Jenner's 装甲, a 10% increase in speed thanks to the 280 XL引擎 and a weapons loadout that allowed it to battle 'Mechs heavier than itself spurred the Adam Tech advertising campaign, which was geared exclusively towards pilots of light BattleMechs. The key to the Havoc's success was the Octagon Tartrac System E, considered the best short-range targeting and tracking system available on the market at the time and often compared to the highly successful and effective Garret D2j targeting system. The Octagon system identified threats faster than comparable systems, an invaluable aid to MechWarriors in the field. The Havoc also mounted five jump jets distributed throughout the Havoc's torso locations, allowing it to jump up to 150 米.
column2: Havoc由Adam Tech Industries设计，在Abadan工厂制造，灵感来自JR7-K Jenner，并改进了其许多设计特性。它的装甲几乎是Jenner的两倍，280级XL引擎使速度提高10%，武器配置也足以与更重的机甲作战，这推动了Adam Tech专门面向轻型战斗机甲驾驶员的广告活动。Havoc成功的关键是Octagon Tartrac系统E，这是当时市场上最优秀的短程瞄准与跟踪系统，常与广受好评的Garret D2j瞄准系统相提并论。Octagon系统比同类系统更快识别威胁，是战场机甲战士不可或缺的助力。Havoc还在躯干各处安装了五具跳跃喷射器，可跳跃至150米。

column1: A 65-ton design that emphasizes overwhelming firepower over speed or装甲, the Hellbringer 是a Clan OmniMech. 由 a 325-rated XL引擎, the Hellbringer has 28.5 tons of pod space. Hellbringer G 是装备 an Inner Sphere 改进型重型高斯步枪 and an Improved Heavy 大型激光. A trio of ER Small Lasers cover close range combat. 特性：Searchlight部署费用倍率：1.1
column2: 这台65吨级机甲强调压倒性火力而非速度或装甲，是一台氏族全向机甲Hellbringer。它由325级XL引擎驱动，拥有28.5吨模块舱空间。Hellbringer G装备一挺内圈改进型重型高斯步枪和一门改进型重型大型激光，三门ER小型激光负责近战。特性：探照灯部署费用倍率：1.1

column1: Geared as a Fire-Support role, the B's heavy firepower focused in its 长 Tom Cannon and ER Large Laser, while four 中型脉冲激光s round out the '机甲's defensive weaponry. The Cannon's three tons of ammunition is found in the right torso with one of the '机甲's three additional heat sinks.
column2: B配置作为火力支援平台，主要火力集中在长程Tom火炮和ER大型激光上，四门中型脉冲激光完善了机甲的防御武器。火炮的三吨弹药存放在右侧躯干，并与机甲额外三具散热器中的一具同处一处。

column1: The Hel HL-1 does not bring anything more fancy than a Heavy PPC, a single 锁定式SRM-6 launcher and two ER 中型激光s, but this also keeps the mech quite reliable and easy to maintain. The Endo Steel 结构 saves enough weight to also fit a 250 XL引擎, making the '机甲 quite mobile. Five jump jets add to the mobility, resulting in the '机甲s common role of a fast flanker performing hit and run strikes. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Hel HL-1没有追求花哨配置，只装备重型PPC、一具锁定式SRM-6发射器和两门ER中型激光，因此可靠且易于维护。内骨骼钢结构节省的重量足以安装250级XL引擎，使机甲相当灵活。五具跳跃喷射器进一步提升机动性，让它成为快速侧翼突袭机甲。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右侧下臂

column1: Based on the 161, and producted by Coalition 装甲y Inc. this Hornet variant was 生产 by using a 100XL 引擎 with ten 紧凑型散热器s. It is protected by three and a half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, and uses an Endo Steel chassis. It carries a Small Re-Engineered Laser, Small Laser, and an MML-5 with two tons of ammunition in a CASE protected bay. It is most frequently seen in the service of AFFS and 菲尔特维尔特联盟 militias.
column2: 该Hornet变体基于161型，由Coalition Armor Industries生产，使用100XL引擎和十具紧凑型散热器。它由三吨半铁纤维装甲保护，并采用内骨骼钢底盘。武器包括小型重构激光、小型激光，以及装在CASE防护舱内、配备两吨弹药的MML-5。它最常见于AFFS和菲尔特维尔特联盟民兵部队。

column1: A field refit of the 181 Hornet, this model replaces the small lasers with standard 中型激光s.
column2: 这是181 Hornet的战场改装型，用标准中型激光替换了小型激光。

column1: Originally developed by 氏族火狒狒 during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 140-rated Fusion Core the Howler HWR-6 uses a combination of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry a pair of SRM-6’s with 2 tons of ammo in a shoulder Turret.
column2: 20吨级Howler最初由火狒狒氏族在黄金世纪开发，是一台轻型支援机甲。Howler HWR-6围绕140级融合核心构建，采用铁纤维装甲与内骨骼钢，使其能够在肩部炮塔中搭载2具SRM-6及2吨弹药。

column1: This upgrade of the R40 model drops both the ER large laser and medium pulse laser, one ton of ammo, and an actuator to add an XL gyro, stealth 装甲, 守护者ECM suite and a PPC with PPC capacitor.
column2: R40型号的这次升级移除了ER大型激光、中型脉冲激光、一吨弹药和一具驱动器，换装XL陀螺仪、隐形装甲、守护者ECM套件以及带PPC电容器的PPC。

column1: A 球体共和国 redesign of the 500 year-old Icarus II, the -2R completely replaces the autocannon and laser payload of most Icarus II designs in favor for a pair of debilitating TSEMP磁脉冲炮s and a Tag. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: 这是球体共和国对有500年历史的Icarus II进行的重新设计，以2门压制性的TSEMP磁脉冲炮和一具TAG彻底替换大多数Icarus II型号的机炮与激光配置。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂

column1: Any 机甲Warrior piloting this '机甲 needs to be careful, it is quite prone to overheating.
column2: 任何驾驶这台机甲的机甲战士都必须小心，因为它很容易过热。

column1: Manufactured by Ishikawajima-Harima Battle 装甲 Industries on Luthien, the Kishi battle 装甲 is a byproduct of the 设计 and testing process that 生产 the 氏族新星猫 Thunderbird series of battle 装甲 suits. As Kishi suits don't require oversized body types to operate it comfortably and can be easily maintained, it has rapidly become the primary battle 装甲 suit of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery. 怪癖: 标准部件 掉落成本乘数: 0.886 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: Kishi战斗装甲由卢希恩的石川岛播磨战斗装甲工业制造，是设计和测试氏族新星猫Thunderbird系列战斗装甲的副产品。Kishi战斗装甲不需要超大体型即可舒适操作，也易于维护，因此迅速成为龙辰联合体常备部队的主力战斗装甲。 特性：标准部件 部署费用倍率：0.886 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Manufactured by Ishikawajima-Harima Battle 装甲 Industries on Luthien, the Kishi battle 装甲 is a byproduct of the 设计 and testing process that 生产 the 氏族新星猫 Thunderbird series of battle 装甲 suits. As Kishi suits don't require oversized body types to operate it comfortably and can be easily maintained, it has rapidly become the primary battle 装甲 suit of the Draconis Combine Mustered Soldiery.
column2: Kishi战斗装甲由卢希恩的石川岛播磨战斗装甲工业制造，是设计和测试氏族新星猫Thunderbird系列战斗装甲的副产品。Kishi战斗装甲不需要超大体型即可舒适操作，也易于维护，因此迅速成为龙辰联合体常备部队的主力战斗装甲。

column1: The Lightning 'Mech was developed as a partner for the Thunder-2L BattleMech. It uses the same chassis, 引擎, gyro, and communications systems as the Thunder. This greatly simplifies logistics and repair operations.
column2: Lightning机甲是作为Thunder-2L战斗机甲的伙伴开发的。它与Thunder使用相同的底盘、引擎、陀螺仪和通信系统，大幅简化了后勤与维修工作。

column1: A good scout '机甲, fast, agile and still with enough weapons to get out of hairy situations.
column2: 一台优秀的侦察机甲，速度快、机动灵活，而且拥有足够的武器来摆脱棘手局面。

column1: An interesting take on a modern Locust. Those twin MagShots combined with a 中型X脉冲激光 really is not something we have seen before on one.
column2: 这是对现代化Locust的有趣尝试。两门MagShot与一门中型X脉冲激光结合，在同一台机甲上实属少见。

column1: A Star League era fire support platform, the 长bow is an 85 ton Assault 机甲 and one of the most used fire support mechs in existence.
column2: 一台星盟时代的火力支援平台，长弓是一台85吨级突击机甲，也是现存使用最广泛的火力支援机甲之一。

column1: While never a showstopper, the Merlin has been a solid, ubiquitous addition to every Periphery realm, and it remains popular in the mercenary market. It is as iconic in the Periphery as the 凤鹰 or Warhammer are in the Inner Sphere. With the debut of new upgrades, Mountain Wolf’s classic Merlin is receiving renewed attention.
column2: Merlin从未成为改变战局的机甲，却一直是每个边疆领域中坚实而普遍的存在，在雇佣兵市场也很受欢迎。它在边疆的标志性不亚于内圈的凤凰鹰或Warhammer。随着新升级型号问世，Mountain Wolf的经典Merlin重新受到关注。

column1: Designed as a close range brawler, the Merlin 1E is marketed to smaller periphery states and mercenary commands in the market for a cut price heavy mech. Replacing the traditional PPC with an AC/10 and removing the anti-personnel weapons, allows for an extra pair of 中型激光器 to be added.With a third less heatsinks than the usual Merlin designs, pilots will need to be careful with their heat or risk a premature ammo explosion.
column2: Merlin 1E定位为近距离格斗机甲，面向寻求低价重型机甲的小型边疆国家和雇佣兵部队销售。它用AC/10替换传统PPC，并移除反人员武器，从而增加一对中型激光器。散热器比常规Merlin设计少三分之一，驾驶员必须小心热量，否则可能提前引发弹药爆炸。

column1: The Orion 2K is a prototype upgrade of an already impressive design, adding 2 PPCs with upgraded capacitors, and an AC/5 with specialized ammo as well as heat-dissipating 装甲.
column2: Orion 2K是优秀原型设计的升级版，增加2门带升级电容器的PPC、一门配备特种弹药的AC/5，以及散热装甲。

column1: A light field 火炮, experimental BattleMech, the Pandarus, named for a famous archer from the mythical battle of Troy on ancient Terra, is an 增程LRM Missile boat. Originally a Kali Yama design team proposal for an 全向Mech missile boat capable of carrying both common and Experimental Technology missile systems, ultimately the high cost of building an all new design with all new 全向Pods proved too high, with the design team forced to scale back their project to a non-全向 ELRM-equipped prototype built on a mothballed Orion chassis.
column2: Pandarus是一台轻型野战实验战斗机甲，以古老泰拉神话特洛伊战争中的著名弓箭手命名；它是一艘装有ELRM的导弹机甲。最初，Kali Yama设计团队提出制造一台全向导弹机甲，可搭载常规与实验技术导弹系统；但全新设计和全新全向模块舱的建造成本过高，团队被迫将项目缩减为基于封存Orion底盘、搭载ELRM的非全向原型机。

column1: A one of a kind Rattlesnake 开发 by Headhunter 稳定s of Solaris 7; the 响尾蛇 JR7-31R was piloted by Gideon Wozniak during his arena fight with the wanted war criminal and ex ROM agent, Victor Reskov. Built from a Rattlesnake JR7-37, the 37R model upgrades the 机甲 with Clan made 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and MASC. 2 Clan ER 中型激光s, 3 中型激光s and a Clan ER Small Laser form the 机甲s armament; with Angel ECM and a Clan made 定位 Computer enhancing the 机甲s effectiveness. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是Solaris 7上由Headhunter武器制造商打造的独一无二的Rattlesnake。Rattlesnake JR7-31R由Gideon Wozniak驾驶，参加了与通缉战犯、前ROM特工Victor Reskov的竞技场决斗。37R型号基于Rattlesnake JR7-37，将氏族制造的铁纤维装甲和MASC升级到机体上。2门氏族ER中型激光、三门中型激光和一门氏族ER小型激光构成其武器；天使ECM和氏族制造的瞄准计算机进一步提升机甲效能。 特性：敏捷 部署费用倍率：1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧上臂，右侧上臂

column1: Taking a cue from 玉鹰氏族’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’机甲’s flexibility, while the remainder maximized 装甲 coverage to see the Clan’s precious Omni机甲s and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III A configuration features only a ER Large Laser in each arm. Mobility has been substantially increased with the retention of the MASC system and the inclusion of eight pod mounted 改进的 Jump Jets to increase jump ranges 50% over the original Shadow Cat. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: Nova Cat科学家借鉴了玉鹰氏族前十年推出的Thor II，移除原版Shadow Cat的固定跳跃喷射器以释放重量。剩余大部分吨位分配给模块舱空间，增强机甲灵活性；其余部分最大化装甲覆盖，确保珍贵的氏族全向机甲及战士安全返航。Shadow Cat III A配置每条手臂仅装一门ER大型激光。保留MASC系统并加装8具模块舱跳跃喷射器后，机动性大幅提升，跳跃距离比原版Shadow Cat增加50%。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Taking a cue from 玉鹰氏族’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’Mech’s flexibility, while the remainder maximized 装甲 coverage to see the Clan’s precious 全向Mechs and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III A configuration features only a ER Large Laser in each arm.
