Mobility has been substantially increased with the retention of the MASC system and the inclusion of eight pod mounted 改进型跳跃推进器 to increase jump ranges 50% over the original Shadow Cat.
column2: Nova Cat科学家借鉴了玉鹰氏族前十年推出的Thor II，移除原版Shadow Cat的固定跳跃喷射器以释放重量。剩余大部分吨位分配给模块舱空间，增强机甲灵活性；其余部分最大化装甲覆盖，确保珍贵的氏族全向机甲及战士安全返航。Shadow Cat III A配置每条手臂仅装一门ER大型激光。保留MASC系统并加装八具模块舱改进型跳跃喷射器后，机动性大幅提升，跳跃距离比原版Shadow Cat增加50%。

column1: Taking a cue from 玉鹰氏族’s Thor II, introduced during the previous decade, Nova Cat scientists removed the original Shadow Cat’s fixed jump jets to free valuable mass. Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’机甲’s flexibility, while the remainder maximized 装甲 coverage to see the Clan’s precious Omni机甲s and its warriors home safely. The Shadow Cat III C configuration does away with all Jump Jets in favor of extreme ground mobility in the form of the standard MASC system and an 引擎 Supercharger allowing it to reach burst speeds of up to 162 km/h. Complimenting this speed is massive firepower in the form of an LB 20-X Autocannon and an 改进的 Heavy Large Laser. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: Nova Cat科学家借鉴了玉鹰氏族前十年推出的Thor II，移除原版Shadow Cat的固定跳跃喷射器以释放重量。剩余大部分吨位分配给模块舱空间，增强机甲灵活性；其余部分最大化装甲覆盖，确保珍贵的氏族全向机甲及战士安全返航。Shadow Cat III C配置取消所有跳跃喷射器，改用标准MASC系统和增压器获得极强地面机动性，爆发速度最高可达162公里/小时。与速度相配的是LB 20-X自动炮和改进型重型大型激光带来的强大火力。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署费用倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：全向

Most of the remaining tonnage was allotted for pod space, enhancing the ’Mech’s flexibility, while the remainder maximized 装甲 coverage to see the Clan’s precious 全向Mechs and its warriors home safely. column2: Nova Cat科学家借鉴了玉鹰氏族前十年推出的Thor II，移除原版Shadow Cat的固定跳跃喷射器以释放重量。剩余大部分吨位分配给模块舱空间，增强机甲灵活性；其余部分最大化装甲覆盖，确保珍贵的氏族全向机甲及战士安全返航。Shadow Cat III C配置取消所有跳跃喷射器，改用标准MASC系统和增压器获得极强地面机动性，爆发速度最高可达162公里/小时。与速度相配的是LB 20-X自动炮和改进型重型大型激光带来的强大火力。

column1: Introduced in 3115, the second variant of the Shrike replaces the ER Large Lasers with ER 中型激光s allowing the autocannons to be upgraded to pair of 超级自动炮/10s.
column2: Shrike的第二个变体于3115年推出，用ER中型激光替换ER大型激光，使自动炮升级为一对RAC/10。

column1: This Dark Age era variant carries two "King David" 轻型高斯步枪s and is equipped with a Battle 装甲 机甲anical 跳跃放大器. It is protected by 改进的 Stealth 装甲.
column2: 这个黑暗时代变体装备两门“King David”重型高斯步枪，并配备战斗装甲机械跳跃系统。它由改进型隐形装甲保护。

column1: The PAB-28 Sniper Suit wasn't 设计ed for frontline combat, and the 设计ation given to the suit by Federated Industries was intended to be a clear reminder of that fact. Manufactured in the Federated Industries plant on Novaya Zemlya, the PAB-28 excels in areas where a conventional un装甲ed sniper would be unable to operate. Lightly 装甲ed and slow, the PAB-28 is intended to move into position and wait for targets to present themselves, not to engage enemy units directly or fight in the open; when used within its mission parameters, the PAB-28 proves itself an effective suit, even if it lacks the reputation or appeal of heavier battle 装甲. 怪癖: Ambusher 掉落成本乘数: 0.8832 可搭载 Omni units, 可以近战, 可以群聚.
column2: PAB-28狙击战斗装甲并非为前线作战设计，联邦工业给予它的涂装正是对此的明确提醒。PAB-28在新地岛的联邦工业工厂制造，擅长在传统无装甲狙击手无法行动的区域作战。它装甲轻薄、速度缓慢，任务是进入阵地等待目标出现，而不是直接交战或在开阔地战斗；在任务参数范围内使用时，PAB-28证明了自己是一套有效装备，尽管缺乏重型战斗装甲的声望和吸引力。 特性：伏击者 部署费用倍率：0.8832 可搭载全向单位，可近战，可群聚。

column1: Developed by the 天蝎帝国, the OmniMech version of the Snow Fox borrows much of its initial design of the its older brother, the standard Snow Fox. Protected by four tons of 装甲, an Endo Steel chassis and XL引擎 allow the 'Mech to reach top speeds of 120 km/h. Finally a permanently-mounted MASC system allows the Prime to sprint at speeds of up to 164 km/h.
column2: Snow Fox的全向机甲版本由云蛇氏族开发，大体借鉴其前身标准Snow Fox的设计。四吨装甲、内骨骼钢底盘和XL引擎使机甲最高速度达到120公里/小时；永久安装的MASC系统最终让Prime配置的冲刺速度达到164公里/小时。

column1: Though the Stinger IIC has a relatively low ground speed by Jihad Era standards, it is still fast enough to act as a harasser unit as well as a recon platform. The 180 meter jump capability is also useful, allowing the pilot to get out of tight terrain very quickly. The upgraded 装甲 protection is valued by those warriors used to the older Stinger as well, but this 装甲 is still too light to allow the '机甲 to operate in a stand up fight. 怪癖: Ubiquitous 掉落成本乘数: 1.01
column2: 尽管Stinger IIC按圣战时代标准而言地面速度较低，但仍足以担任骚扰单位和侦察平台。180米跳跃能力也很有用，能让驾驶员迅速脱离复杂地形。升级后的装甲防护同样受到熟悉旧款Stinger的战士重视，但这层装甲仍太薄，无法让机甲正面作战。 特性：无处不在 部署费用倍率：1.01

column1: The Stormbird was commissioned by 玉鹰氏族 and intended as a bridge between the available Elemental and Ironhold battlesuits, being the result of collaboration between Falcon resources and 雪鸦氏族 science. The proposed anti-infantry role for the Stormbird interested the Snow Ravens, who desired a similar-sized suit with a similar operational profile. The final result was not the versatile platform expected by the Falcons, with the design closely matching the already available Salamander. For the Snow Ravens however, the Stormbird proved to be an immense success providing them with fire-resistant 装甲 that had thus far proved impossible to produce.
column2: Stormbird由玉鹰氏族委托开发，旨在弥合现有Elemental与Ironhold战斗装甲之间的空缺，是猎鹰资源与雪鸦氏族科学合作的成果。Stormbird拟议的反步兵角色吸引了雪鸦氏族，他们希望拥有一套尺寸和作战特性相近的装备。最终结果并非猎鹰预期的多用途平台，其设计与现有Salamander高度相似；但对雪鸦氏族而言，Stormbird极其成功，为他们提供了此前一直无法制造的耐火装甲。

column1: Originally rumored to be a light or ultralight LAM, the Svartalfa was a well-kept secret until its live-fire test against Clan Wolf where it saw great success. At first confusing the Wolves as to what it was -- too small to be a 'Mech, too large to be a Proto or battle 装甲 -- the defending Wolf warriors were forced into deploying medium and heavy 'Mechs to deal with even a single Svartalfa.
column2: Svartalfa最初被传闻为轻型或超轻型LAM，在与狼族的实弹测试中取得巨大成功前一直是严守的秘密。起初，狼族战士困惑于它的身份——太小，不能算机甲；又太大，不属于原型机或战斗装甲——最终不得不部署中型和重型机甲来对付哪怕一台Svartalfa。

column1: A custom configuration used by the Blessed Order's revived First Division's Unending Faith III, the Mad Cat BLO carries a ER PPC in each arm supported by 锁定式SRM-6 rack in each side torso and a ER Small Laser in the center torso.
column2: Blessed Order复兴第一师Unending Faith III使用的定制配置Mad Cat BLO，双臂各装备一门ER PPC，两侧躯干各有一具锁定式SRM-6发射架，中央躯干配备一门ER小型激光。

column1: A Dark Age re设计, this Titan variant carries a pair of ER PPCs and a mixed arsenal of 中型激光器 and SRM-4s for closer range combat. Jump Jets, double heatsinks and case round out the 设计.
column2: 这是黑暗时代重新设计的Titan变体，装备一对ER PPC，并混合使用中型激光和SRM-4进行近距离作战。跳跃喷射器、双联散热器和CASE完善了这台机甲。

column1: This version removes the standard weaponry and replaces it with a 大型脉冲激光, Snub Nose PPC, single ER 中型激光, and a 中型脉冲激光. These weapons are all tied into a 定位 Computer to improve accuracy. Mobility is improved by five Jump Jets, and to provide additional protection during landings the legs have received an extra half-ton of 装甲 protection between them. 怪癖: 超伸展驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: 该型号移除标准武器，换装一门重型中型激光、一门短管PPC、一门ER中型激光和一门重型中型激光。所有武器都连接至瞄准计算机以提高精度。五具跳跃喷射器提升机动性；为加强着陆防护，双腿之间额外增加了半吨装甲。 特性：增强型跳跃喷射器 部署费用倍率：1.09

column1: An ambush predator that originated in the Solaris VII arenas, Harmony MetalWorks' Violator originally rose to prominence through both the arena fights and the actions of a band of aces from the Regulan Fiefs during the late thirty-first century. The Violator's reputation continued to improve in the thirty-second century from continued arena performances and combat actions featuring the mech in service with the Regulan Hussars. The flashy reputation the Violator earned in the arenas belied the ease with which the Violator can be maintained and repaired, but despite the nine tons of Heavy standard 装甲 and an Armored Cockpit the Violator wasn't suited for line combat.
column2: Violator是源自Solaris VII竞技场的伏击捕食者。Harmony MetalWorks的Violator在三十一世纪末通过竞技场战斗和Regulan Fiefs王牌部队的行动声名鹊起。进入三十二世纪后，它随Regulan Hussars服役并持续参加竞技场和战斗，声誉进一步提升。Violator在竞技场上获得的华丽名声掩盖了其易于维护和修理的特点；但即使拥有九吨重型标准装甲和装甲驾驶舱，它仍不适合线列作战。

column1: A close-quarters fighter, the C Configuration utilizes eight 锁定式SRM-6 launchers split between the side torsos. Additionally, the 'Mech uses four 微型 Pulse Lasers. The launchers are fed by four tons of ammunition.
column2: C配置是一台近距离战斗机，两个侧面躯干各分配四具锁定式SRM-6发射器，共八具；此外，机甲还使用四门微型脉冲激光。发射器由四吨弹药供给。

column1: Configuration D is rare, focused around a pair of Clan-生产 转管自动炮/5s, each mounted in the '机甲's side torsos. The Rotary Cannons are supplied with 120 rounds of ammunition. A 机甲Warrior only has a pair of arm-mounted 中型脉冲激光s for backup. 怪癖: Variable Range 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: D配置十分罕见，核心是一对氏族RAC/5，分别安装在机甲两侧躯干。旋转机炮配备120发弹药。机甲战士仅有一对安装在手臂上的重型中型激光作为备用。 特性：可变范围定位 部署费用倍率：1.09 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Configuration D is rare, focused around a pair of Clan-生产 转管自动炮/5s, each mounted in the '机甲's side torsos. The Rotary Cannons are supplied with 120 rounds of ammunition. A 机甲Warrior only has a pair of arm-mounted 中型脉冲激光s for backup.
column2: D配置十分罕见，核心是一对氏族RAC/5，分别安装在机甲两侧躯干。旋转机炮配备120发弹药。机甲战士仅有一对安装在手臂上的重型中型激光作为备用。

column1: This advanced Capellan variant of the Warhammer, introduced in 3081, replaced the PPCs with Plasma Rifles. Three ER 中型激光器 and a Streak SRM-4 provided close-in support, while improved jump jets allowed the Warhammer to jump 150 米 at a time. 特性：Integrated Searchlight 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这款3081年推出的高级卡佩兰Warhammer变体，用等离子步枪替换PPC。三门ER中型激光和一具Streak SRM-4提供近距离支援，改进型跳跃喷射器让Warhammer每次可跳跃150米。 特性：集成探照灯 部署费用倍率：1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: This advanced Capellan variant of the Warhammer, introduced in 3081, replaced the PPCs with 等离子步枪s. Three ER 中型激光s and a 锁定式SRM-4 provided close-in support, while improved jump jets allowed the Warhammer to jump 150 米 at a time.
column2: 这款3081年推出的高级卡佩兰Warhammer变体，用脉冲步枪替换PPC。三门ER中型激光和一具锁定式SRM-4提供近距离支援，改进型跳跃喷射器让Warhammer每次可跳跃150米。

column1: In the thirty-second century, the 渡鸦同盟 restarted production of the 黑蟒, renaming it the White Raven. The White Raven was one of the first production BattleMechs to use Ferro-Lamellor 装甲.
column2: 三十二世纪，白鸦同盟重新启动了该型号生产，并将其更名为White Raven。White Raven是最早采用铁质层状装甲的量产战斗机甲之一。

column1: Focused on bringing the 短管PPC into battle as fast as possible, this 'Mech can reach some real high speeds. But that is also its weakness, if that PPC goes down or misses, the remaining weapons are not very impressive.
column2: 这台机甲专注于尽快将短管PPC送入战场，因此速度极高。但这也是它的弱点：如果那门PPC损坏或未命中，剩余武器就不太出色了。

column1: One ton more of 装甲 at the cost of the two 中型脉冲激光s turning into a single 中型X脉冲激光 Laser is probably a worth trade.
column2: 用一吨额外装甲换取将两门中型X脉冲激光改成一门中型X脉冲激光，大概是值得的交易。

column1: Manufactured on Kwangjong-ni by Defiance, the Zeus X was both a poster child for excellence in production engineering and an innovative high-technology platform. The -X3 carried four ER 中型激光s in the right arm and an ER PPC in the left arm, connected to a 定位 Computer. The true uniqueness of the 设计 came in its use of 改进的 Jump Jets: the -X3 could jump up to 240 米, which rivaled the jumping capability of any light '机甲. This combination of heavy 装甲, speed and firepower made -the X3 the nightmare of any light or medium '机甲 and could outmaneuver any heavy or assault '机甲. The -X3 mounted seventeen double heat sinks. 怪癖: Command 机甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Defiance在广宗里制造了Zeus X。它既是生产工程卓越性的典范，也是创新的高科技平台。-X3右臂装有四门ER中型激光，左臂装有一门ER PPC，并连接至瞄准计算机。该型号真正独特之处在于使用改进型跳跃喷射器：-X3可跳跃至240米，媲美任何轻型机甲。重型装甲、速度和火力的结合，使-X3成为任何轻型或中型机甲的噩梦，并能机动胜过重型或突击机甲。-X3安装了十七具双联散热器。 特性：指挥机甲 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧下臂，右侧下臂

column1: The Anat 装甲ed Personnel Carrier is an early Dark Age 设计 which was first 生产 by 氏族地狱马 in 3092. The Horses wanted a fast 车辆 that could handle multiple terrain types. For this reason the 车辆 was given a wheeled chassis and 有限两栖 Equipment. The wheeled chassis can handle more terrain types than a hovercraft, and the amphibious equipment allows it to cross small water obstacles.
