column2: 6C由布雷克圣言会自3070年起生产，以便让他们的Vulcan接入C3网络。这一5M升级型分别用ER大型激光器和ER中型激光器替换原有激光器。节省的重量用于安装C3i计算机。拆除一组散热器后，又将机枪替换为三挺连接机枪阵列的轻型机枪。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.02 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: This ridiculous experimental carries three 浮夸激光s on a prototype Crab chassis designed to reduce the Lasers' immense heat generation. Is it scary? Yes. Effective? Only in arctic conditions. Just evade it once and watch it try to cool off. Do NOT get hit by its Alpha though...
column2: 这台荒谬的试验机将三门浮夸激光器安装在经过改造的Crab底盘上，专门降低激光器巨大的热量产生。它可怕吗？是的。有效吗？只有在极地环境中有效。躲过一次攻击，然后看它努力冷却。千万别被它的全弹齐射命中……

column1: Based on the 11-C variant and first fielded in 3073, this Cyclops is a company command-level machine that carries a pair of C3 Master Computers. To make room for these massive computers, the Gauss Rifle, its ammunition, and some 装甲 were replaced by a single ER PPC. This leaves the Cyclops slightly undergunned for an assault '机甲, but it shouldn't be engaging the enemy closely anyway
column2: 这台Cyclops以11-C变型为基础，于3073年首次投入战场，是一台连级指挥机。它携带两具C3主计算机。为腾出空间，拆除了高斯步枪、弹药和部分装甲，换成一门ER PPC。这使Cyclops对于突击机甲而言火力略显不足，但它本来就不应与敌人近距离交战。

column1: A second variant of the CP-11-C3, which tries cutting costs by using cheaper weapon technology and 装甲. Since the main purpose of the 'Mech is the experimental boosted C3 Master computer, it was deemed weapons were a far lower priority.
column2: 这是CP-11-C3的第二种变型，试图通过采用更便宜的武器技术和装甲来降低成本。由于机甲的主要目的在于试验强化型C3主计算机，武器被认为远不如其他方面重要。

column1: With these new Land air mechs, 布雷克圣言会 has to be up to something. Time will tell if its any good.
column2: 有了这些新的陆空机甲，布雷克圣言会肯定在谋划什么。它究竟是否有效，时间会给出答案。

column1: Precentor Dantalion of the 49th Shadow Division equipped his personal '机甲 with some experimental equipment. A 小型驾驶舱 allows a Laser AMS to be mounted in the head, while a Heavy-Duty Gyro and 轻型引擎 make the '机甲 harder to kill. Protection was upgraded as well, using 重型铁纤维装甲 装甲. Finally, a 守护者ECM Suiteprotects against enemy electronics. Offensively, Dantalion's custom Albatross uses an ER PPC with PPC Capacitor in the left arm, balanced by a Large VSP Laser in the right. For close combat, the left and right torso each get an ER 中型激光 and 中型脉冲激光, and the right torso mounts a single ER Small Laser. In addition, the '机甲 is equipped with 三重肌纤维束, making it a deadly foe in melee combat.
column2: 第49影师团的Precentor Dantalion为自己的机甲装备了实验设备。小型驾驶舱允许在头部安装激光AMS，重型陀螺仪和轻型引擎让机甲更难被摧毁。防护也得到升级，采用重型铁纤维装甲。最后，守护者ECM套件可抵御敌方电子设备。Dantalion定制的Albatross左臂使用带PPC电容器的ER PPC，右臂则装备大型VSP激光器以取得平衡。近战时，左右躯干各有一门ER中型激光器和中型脉冲激光器，右侧躯干另装一门ER小型激光器。此外，机甲配备三重肌纤维束，在近战中极其致命。

column1: Similar in some respects to the Dominus, the Infernus also mounts a Heavy PPC in the arm, but the other arm contains two Light PPCs. The weight saved allows the Archangel B to carry two 短管PPCs.
column2: Archangel B在手臂安装一门重型PPC，另一条手臂则有两门轻型PPC；节省的重量让它能够携带两门短管PPC。

column1: The odd variant out, the Archangel C eschews PPCs in favor of two MRM 40s, each of which are fed by a two-ton, CASE-protected ammunition bin. They are supplemented by a pair of ER 中型激光器 and a rear-mounted ER Small Laser. A Guardian ECM Suite protects it from enemy electronics.
column2: Archangel C是与众不同的变型，放弃PPC，改为两具MRM-40，每具由两吨CASE保护弹药供给。另有两门ER中型激光器和一门后向ER小型激光器提供支援。守护者ECM套件保护它免受敌方电子设备影响。

column1: The Invictus, or primary, version of the Archangel carries a 守护者ECM Suite to allow the '机甲 to disrupt enemy electronics and targeting systems. For ranged combat, the Archangel Invictus carries a 等离子步枪 and Heavy PPC, both of which are slaved to an advanced targeting computer. The Invictus also includes jump jets, allowing the 100-tonner to hop 90 米. Finally, a 可伸缩刀刃 gives the 设计 added defense in close combat situations.
column2: Archangel的Invictus（基础）版本携带守护者ECM套件，可干扰敌方电子设备和瞄准系统。远程作战时，Archangel Invictus使用一把等离子步枪和一门重型PPC，两者都连接至先进瞄准计算机。Invictus还配备跳跃喷射器，使这台100吨机体能够跳跃90米。最后，可伸缩刀刃为该设计提供额外的近战防御。

column1: Developed during the Jihad, the Avatar H has a Heavy PPC in each arm, backed by two MML-3s equipped with 阿尔忒弥斯IV火控. Sixteen double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool.
column2: Avatar H在圣战期间开发，双臂各装一门重型PPC，并由两具配备阿尔忒弥斯IV火控系统的MML-3支援。16组双重散热器让机甲保持冷却。

column1: The Avatar I uses two torso-mounted 雷电15 missile launchers for long range striking power. These missile launchers carry two tons of ammunition each, and are backed up by an ER 中型激光 in each arm. This version also carries sixteen double heat sinks. 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: Avatar I使用两具安装在躯干的雷电15导弹发射器提供远程打击力。每具发射器携带两吨弹药，双臂各有一门ER中型激光器作为支援。该版本还携带16组双重散热器。 特性：通信增强 部署成本倍率：1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Avatar I uses two torso-mounted Thunderbolt 15 missile launchers for long range striking power. These missile launchers carry two tons of ammunition each, and are backed up by an ER 中型激光器 in each arm. This version also carries sixteen double heat sinks.
column2: Avatar I使用两具安装在躯干的Thunderbolt 15导弹发射器提供远程打击力。每具发射器携带两吨弹药，双臂各有一门ER中型激光器作为支援。该版本还携带16组双重散热器。

column1: A weak attempt to hide from 布雷克圣言会 sensors. I wouldn't say the 守护者ECM makes a real difference, and the price in reduced weapons might be too high.
column2: 这是一次试图躲避布雷克圣言会传感器的拙劣尝试。我不认为守护者ECM真的起到了多大作用，而且以减少武器为代价换来的隐蔽性可能并不值得。

column1: A 玉鹰氏族 variant that uses Experimental Technology extensively, the Kraken-XR was first spotted at Olivetti Weaponry on Sudeten. Replacing most Weapons with 4 Rotary AC/2 and 2 Streak LRM-10.
column2: 这是玉鹰氏族广泛采用实验技术的变型。Kraken-XR最初在Sudeten的Olivetti武器公司被发现，用4门转管自动炮/2和2具Streak LRM-10替换了大部分武器。

column1: This upgrade of the 8S was 生产 by 迪法恩斯工业 at their Kwangjong-ni annex while 布雷克圣言会 held Hesperus II. It retains the light 引擎 of earlier models, but returns to the speed of the earliest versions. It carries a Defiance 753 Heavy PPC, Defiance 250 Light PPC, and Poland Main Model A Gauss Rifle for long range combat. Should an enemy survive long enough to close with the 9S, it can utilize three Defiance E3M ER 中型激光s and a single Defiance B3M 中型激光. A TharHes Maxi SRM-6 can exploit weaknesses in an opposing unit's 装甲, while CASE keeps the ammunition from doing too much damage in the event of an explosion. In order to make room for all of these things, the XL Gyro of the 8S is also retained. Finally, a 定位 Computer improves the accuracy of all the weapons except for the missile launcher.
column2: 这一8S升级型由迪法恩斯工业在布雷克圣言会占领Hesperus II期间，于其Kwangjong-ni分厂生产。它保留早期型号的轻型引擎，却恢复了最早版本的速度。远程作战武器包括Defiance 753重型PPC、Defiance 250轻型PPC和Poland Main Model A高斯步枪。若敌人存活到足以接近9S，它还能使用三门Defiance E3M ER中型激光器和一门Defiance B3M中型激光器。TharHes Maxi SRM-6可利用敌方装甲弱点，CASE则能在爆炸时防止弹药造成过大伤害。为容纳全部设备，8S的XL陀螺仪也被保留。最后，瞄准计算机提高了除导弹发射器外所有武器的精度。

column1: The Basilisk Proto机甲 was 设计ed and built by 云蛇氏族 to support their Elemental and Omni机甲 forces. Unlike most second generation Protos, the Basilisk has a relatively low top speed. This version carries a single ER 中型激光. For improved mobility on the battlefield, it's equipped with five Extended Jump Jets
column2: Basilisk原型机由云蛇氏族设计并制造，用于支援他们的元素战士和全向机甲部队。与大多数第二代原型机不同，Basilisk最高速度相对较低。该版本携带一门ER中型激光器，并装备五具延伸跳跃喷射器以提高战场机动性。

column1: A loadout mainly seen with the capellan forces, the C configuration uses Stealth 装甲, a Beagle probe and an Angel ECM to gain an Electronic Warfare advantage. It's weapons were downgraded to a Light Gauss Rifle and one ER 中型激光器. 特性：Easy to Pilot 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 这一主要由卡佩兰部队使用的配置采用隐形装甲、比格犬探头和天使ECM，以获得电子战优势。武器降级为一门轻型高斯步枪和一门ER中型激光器。 特性：易于驾驶 部署费用倍率：0.95 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The BJ-2A was a late-Jihad project of the Snow Ravens and their Outworlds Alliance allies. Returning to the spirit of the original model, the -2A features a pair of LB 2-X autocannons for long-range support against airborne targets and 车辆s. Anyone closing will find the four heavy lasers a nasty surprise.
column2: BJ-2A是雪鸦氏族及其渡鸦同盟盟友在圣战后期开发的项目。它回归原版精神，配备两门LB 2-X自动炮，为远程支援空中目标和车辆提供火力。任何试图接近的敌人都会遭遇四门重型激光器的凶猛伏击。

column1: Here We Have the OX Variant Of The Blackjack Omni机甲. This Loadout Changes The Omni机甲 Into A PPC Monster.
column2: 这里展示的是Blackjack全向机甲的OX变型。这套配置将全向机甲改造成PPC火力怪物。

column1: A rare refit of the venerable 黑骑士 Chassis often found among Mercenaries and Pit Fighters, exchanges most of the Energy Weapons for a Sawed-Off Thumper, Active 战斗盾牌 and advanced Electronics.
column2: 这是著名黑骑士底盘的罕见改装型，常见于佣兵和斗士之中。它用一门削短型Thumper、主动战斗盾牌和先进电子设备替换了大部分能量武器。

column1: The Black Hawk carries eight and a half tons of standard 装甲, a ton and a half less than the Nova, and uses an endo steel internal 结构. The weight saved enables it to mount a pair of ER large lasers for direct fire support and four 锁定式SRM-4s for close range work. The Streak launchers were located in the '机甲's arms, but the lasers were mounted in the left and right torso, while four tons of ammunition for the Streak launchers were split across the left and right torsos.
column2: Black Hawk携带8.5吨标准装甲，比Nova少1.5吨，并采用内骨骼内部结构。节省的重量使其能够安装两门ER大型激光器用于直射支援，以及四具锁定式SRM-4用于近战。Streak发射器安装在机甲双臂中，激光器则安装在左右躯干；Streak发射器的四吨弹药分置于左右躯干。

column1: Intorduced during the Jihad, the 4F exchanges the Mechs 铁纤维装甲 for 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous and the standard Gyro for a XL Gyro. This allows for the addition of Jump Jets, a 瞄准计算机, a C3 Slave Computer, and a Heavy PPC.
column2: 这款3070年圣战期间推出的4F，用轻型铁纤维装甲替换机甲的铁纤维装甲，用XL陀螺仪替换标准陀螺仪。由此可增装跳跃喷射器、瞄准计算机、C3从属计算机和一门重型PPC。

column1: We call the Cataphract the "FrankenMech" because it's got a little bit of everything stitched together on it. The 1E variant was upgraded to employ an EWS and a 虚无信号系统.
column2: 我们把Cataphract称为“弗兰肯机甲”，因为它身上缝合了各种各样的部件。1E变型经过升级，采用EWS和虚空信号系统。

column1: The Catapult 1R retrofit arose from a shortage of Materials and proper factories, it still carries 2 impressive 雷电15 Cruise Missiles, though.
column2: Catapult 1R改装型源于材料和合适工厂短缺，但仍携带两枚威力惊人的雷电15巡航导弹。

column1: The Catapult C1M is a common Mercenary refit to the old C1 设计ed a selection of Multi-Missile Launchers to help with supply shortages.
column2: Catapult C1M是对旧式C1的常见佣兵改装型，增加了多用途导弹发射器，以应对补给短缺。

column1: 这一分型采用 Hollis Marik III Endo Steel 骨架，由 Magna 260 超轻引擎驱动；节省的重量使 C2 成为专用远程机甲。主要武器是两组增程 LRM-15，配备 4 吨弹药，另有两门轻型 PPC 支援。
column2: 这一分型采用Hollis Marik III内骨骼结构，由Magna 260超轻引擎驱动；节省的重量使C2成为专用远程机甲。主要武器是两组增程LRM-15，配备4吨弹药，另有两门轻型PPC支援。

column1: 这一分型采用 Hollis Marik III Endo Steel 骨架，由 Magna 260 超轻引擎驱动；节省的重量使 C2 成为专用远程机甲。主要武器是两组增强型 LRM-15，配备 4 吨弹药，另有两门中型变速脉冲激光支援。
column2: 这一分型采用Hollis Marik III内骨骼结构，由Magna 260超轻引擎驱动；节省的重量使C2成为专用远程机甲。主要武器是两组增强型LRM-15，配备4吨弹药，另有两门中型变速脉冲激光支援。

column1: The Catapult K9 is a refit of the venerable K2 variant, carrying twin Gauss rifles in place of PPCs, and featuring enhanced 装甲.
column2: Catapult K9是著名K2变型的改装型，用两门高斯步枪替换PPC，并采用增强型装甲。

column1: The first purely Marian mech to come from hegemony Factories. It keeps costs down with both primitive 装甲 and 引擎 but counteracts this with a massive alpha from it's 5 火箭发射器s.
column2: 这是霸主工厂生产的第一台纯粹玛丽安机甲。它用原始装甲和原始引擎压低成本，却以5具火箭发射器带来的巨大全弹齐射抵消了性能不足。

column1: Intended for use in broken or rough terrain, the Cephalus-A carried a single Laser AMS in the left torso. The 模块化装甲 and Light TAG of the primary variant were also removed. In their place the 'Mech carried a TAG system and enough jump jets for a 210 meter jump capability.
column2: Cephalus-A原本用于破碎或崎岖地形，左侧躯干安装一套激光AMS。基础配置的模块化装甲和轻型TAG也被拆除，改为搭载一套TAG系统以及足够的跳跃喷射器，使其能够跳跃210米。

column1: Apparently intended as a capture '机甲, this Cephalus configuration keeps the Light TAG but replaces the Modular 装甲 and anti-missile systems with a Battle机甲 Taser.
column2: 这款Cephalus配置显然是为捕获机甲而设计，保留轻型TAG，但用战斗机甲电击器替换模块化装甲和反导系统。

column1: The Cephalus D mounts a single 改进的 Heavy Large Laser backed up by a trio of 改进的 Heavy Small Lasers. 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: Cephalus D安装一门改进型重型大型激光器，并由三门改进型重型小型激光器支援。 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率：1.01 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Cephalus D mounts a single 改进的 Heavy Large Laser backed up by a trio of 改进的 Heavy Small Lasers.
column2: Cephalus D安装一门改进型重型大型激光器，并由三门改进型重型小型激光器支援。

column1: The Cephalus was 开发 by The Society as an escort unit for their Septicemia series Omni机甲. This light '机甲 was 设计ed to carry the 诺瓦综合电子战系统 (CEWS) onto the battlefield. To insure that the Cephalus would survive, the 设计ers used a 250-rated XXL 引擎  alongside a Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield. As its role is limited to electronic targeting support and occasional reconnaissance, the Cephalus wasn't often equipped with weaponry. The primary configuration of the Cephalus carried twin Laser AMS systems, one in each side torso. To further protect the '机甲, it mounted three Modular 装甲 units on the front torsos.
column2: Cephalus 由社会开发，作为 Septicemia 系列全能机甲的护航单位。这台轻型机甲用于将诺瓦综合电子战系统（CEWS）带上战场。为确保生存，设计师采用 250 级 XXL 引擎和变色龙轻型偏振护盾。由于任务仅限电子瞄准支援和偶尔侦察，Cephalus 通常不配备武器；主配置在左右躯干各装一套激光 AMS，前部躯干安装三块模块化装甲。

column1: This one-off Q-Mech variant of the Chameleon hunted down and attacked senior officers in several academies across the Inner Sphere. It was equipped with a Heavy PPC and PPC Capacitor, and three Improved Heavy 中型激光s tied into an advanced 氏族瞄准计算机. An Angel ECM Suite is mounted in the center torso to disguise its weapons. Despite the increased scrutiny and security at academies caused by this 'Mech, it wasn't a success on the field, with only one confirmed KIA.
column2: 这台 Chameleon 的独特 Q-Mech 改型曾在内圈数所学院追杀并袭击高级军官。它装备重型 PPC 和 PPC 电容器，三具改进型重型中型激光器连接至先进氏族瞄准计算机。中央躯干安装天使 ECM 套件以隐藏武器。尽管学院因此加强审查和安保，这台机甲在战场上并不成功，仅确认击杀一人。

column1: This Chimera variant introduced in 3069, carries a C3 Slave unit and replaces the standard weaponry with a 短管PPC, Small Laser, 小型脉冲激光, and a quartet of 中型激光s. It also carries a Sword in the right arm, and uses 三重肌纤维束 to maximize damage. It's also equipped with a larger XL引擎 that permits a cruising ground speed of 76 km/h. When the 三重肌纤维束 activates, it reaches a maximum ground speed of 120 km/h. The 2K also has a 210 meter jump range.
column2: 该 Chimera 改型于 3069 年推出，携带 C3 从属单元，并将标准武器换成短管 PPC、小型激光器、小型脉冲激光器和四具中型激光器。右臂安装长剑，并使用三倍肌纤维束最大化伤害。更大的 XL 引擎使巡航速度达到 76 km/h；三倍肌纤维束启动后最高速度可达 120 km/h。2K 还拥有 210 米跳跃范围。

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty 米, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. A Jihad-era upgrade of the 3U, the 3UL swaps out the weapons for a Plasma Rifle with three tons of ammunition and two ER 中型激光器.
column2: Clint 主要作为廉价侦察单位设计，具备武装良好的低端中型机甲能力，并很好地履行了职责。最高速度 97.2 km/h、跳跃距离 180 米，使其能轻松跟上侦察部队并穿越山地或城市。圣战时代的 3U 升级型 3UL 换装等离子步枪和三吨弹药，以及两具 ER 中型激光器。

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty 米, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 6S variant put into production following the fall of Hesperus II to Blakist forces at the outbreak of the Jihad, the 6S uses the 5U as a base, dropping the jump jets in favor of a larger 280-rated XL引擎 and Heavy 铁纤维装甲 装甲. Two ER Large Lasers provide long-range firepower with only two ER 中型激光器 as back up, while the TAG and C3 unit have been removed and a Small Cockpit used to make room for a head-mounted ER Small Laser.
column2: Clint 主要作为廉价侦察单位设计，最高速度 97.2 km/h、跳跃距离 180 米。圣战初期黑色教派攻陷 Hesperus II 后，6S 投产并以 5U 为基础，放弃跳跃喷射器，换用 280 级 XL 引擎和重型铁纤维装甲。两具 ER 大型激光器提供远程火力，另有两具 ER 中型激光器；TAG 和 C3 被移除，改用小型驾驶舱以容纳头部 ER 小型激光器。

column1: A Jihad-era update of the Commando 2D, the COM-2Dr drops all of the existing weaponry and replaces it with a CASE-protected MML-7 and a single ER 中型激光.
column2: 这是圣战时代对 Commando 2D 的升级型，COM-2Dr 移除全部原有武器，改为一具由 CASE 保护的 MML-7 和一具 ER 中型激光器。

column1: Following the conquest of Coventry by the 布雷克圣言会, the Jihadists modified the 7S to meet their specifications. The 7B keeps one ER 中型激光 in the left arm, but adds two Flamers to it, making the 7B a lethal threat to un装甲ed infantry. A small cockpit makes room for two SRM-4s, which are still fed by a CASE-protected ammunition bin. The weight savings enabled engineers to add enough jump jets to rocket the Commando up to one hundred-twenty 米 at a time. They also added an additional ton of 装甲.
column2: 布雷克圣言会征服 Coventry 后，圣战分子按自身规格改造 7S。7B 保留左臂 ER 中型激光器并增加两具火焰喷射器，成为对无装甲步兵的致命威胁。小型驾驶舱腾出空间安装两具 SRM-4，弹药由 CASE 保护。节省的重量使工程师增加足够跳跃喷射器，让 Commando 一次跃进 120 米，并额外增加一吨装甲。

column1: The C-1FC variant first appeared during the Jihad, where it was given minor Advanced Technology upgrades to its arsenal. The '机甲s 装甲 was switched from standard 铁纤维装甲 装甲 to 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous, which allowed for an increase in protection of the '机甲s vitals. All weapons were removed in favor of three 火箭发射器 10s, spread across the Cossack's torso sections. The only energy weapon available, a Medium 变速脉冲激光, is mounted in the left arm.
column2: C-1FC 改型首次出现在圣战期间，对武器进行少量先进科技升级。机甲装甲由标准铁纤维装甲改为轻型铁纤维装甲，以提高关键部位防护。所有武器被移除，换成分布于 Cossack 躯干的三具 RL-10 发射器；唯一能量武器是左臂的一具中型可变脉冲激光器。

column1: This Cronus variant was apparently built for the 布雷克圣言会 in 3072. It carries an 改进的 C3 Computer, 定位 Computer and 守护者ECM Suite. The 守护者ECM powers the Stealth 装甲. The Cronus-TD9 is equipped with three Small 变速脉冲激光s, and each hand has been replaced by a Claw. A MASC system allows the Cronus to reach 120 km/h for short bursts.
column2: 该 Cronus 改型据称为布雷克圣言会于 3072 年制造，配备改进型 C3 计算机、瞄准计算机和守护者 ECM 套件。守护者 ECM 为潜行装甲供能。Cronus-TD9 装备三具小型可变脉冲激光器，双手替换为利爪；MASC 系统让它能短时间达到 120 km/h。

column1: It carries two 锁定式SRM-4 launchers in the legs, while each arm carries a Light PPC and MML-7. The 'Mech's top speed was reduced, so engineers fitted 改进型跳跃推进器 to compensate.
column2: 双腿各装有一具锁定式 SRM-4，双臂各有轻型 PPC 和 MML-7。机甲最高速度降低，因此工程师安装改进型跳跃喷射器进行补偿。

column1: Say what you will about the Light 机甲 Circuit at Solaris but you should probably not let Haley Flannigan hear it. Armed with a 等离子步枪 and two of those 可伸缩刀刃s, Haley's Cyclone is a force to be reckoned with in the arenas.
column2: 别管你怎么评价 Solaris 的轻型机甲赛道，但最好别让 Haley Flannigan 听见。她的 Cyclone 装备一具等离子步枪和两把可伸缩刀刃，在竞技场上不可小觑。

column1: A Jihad-era variant, by using a Light Fusion 引擎 and removing the other weapons, engineers were able to install a Light PPC and ER Small Laser connected to a Targeting Computer.
column2: 圣战时代改型。工程师使用轻型聚变引擎并移除其他武器，安装一具轻型 PPC 和一具 ER 小型激光器，二者连接至瞄准计算机。

column1: Another of the 布雷克圣言会's Celestial series OmniMechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion 引擎, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. Meant to stay a good distance back from enemy units, the Deva B carries an ER PPC in each arm. The Infernus piles on enough heat sinks that the MechWarrior has no real heat concerns. Adding to that A pair of 中型脉冲激光s that also benefit from the advanced computer can be utilized should an enemy get within range. Defensively, a 守护者ECM Suite ensures that enemies cannot benefit from electronics against the Deva or its nearby allies.
column2: Deva 是布雷克圣言会 Celestial 系列的全能机甲之一，以印度教天界生物命名，并广泛使用新技术。它采用轻型聚变引擎、可承受额外一半伤害的重型陀螺仪，以及 Celestial 通用的小型驾驶舱。Deva B 旨在保持距离，双臂各装一具 ER PPC；Infernus 配备足够散热器，机甲战士几乎无需担心热量。敌人接近时，可使用连接先进计算机的两具中型脉冲激光器。守护者 ECM 套件则阻止敌人对 Deva 及附近友军实施电子战。

column1: Another of the 布雷克圣言会's Celestial series OmniMechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion 引擎, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. The custom config of Opacus Venatori member Adept Achillius St. John carries a pair of arm-mounted Ramtech 9500V Large 变速脉冲激光s supported by two 多元光学 ER 中型激光s in the head, all four lasers linked to a 瞄准计算机. A Supercharger ensures St. John reaches optimum range in an instant while three extra 双散热器 allow him to constantly fire as he does.
column2: Deva 是布雷克圣言会 Celestial 系列全能机甲之一。Opacus Venatori 成员 Adept Achillius St. John 的定制配置双臂各装一具 Ramtech 9500V 大型可变脉冲激光器，头部装两具多元光学 ER 中型激光器，四具激光器全部连接瞄准计算机。增压器使 St. John 瞬间进入最佳射程，三具额外双散热器让他能够持续开火。

column1: Another of the 布雷克圣言会's Celestial series OmniMechs, the Deva (named for celestial beings from the Hindu belief system) also makes extensive use of new technologies. It is built with a light fusion 引擎, a heavy-duty gyro that can take half again as much punishment as its standard counterpart, and the small cockpit common to all of the Celestials. The Invictus model makes good use of its C3i Computer with a Gauss Rifle and a trio of Light PPCs. Obviously meant as a direct-fire support model, the inclusion of the 可伸缩刀刃 is somewhat confusing to outsiders, as is the paltry ton of ammunition devoted to the design's main gun.
column2: Deva 是布雷克圣言会 Celestial 系列全能机甲之一。Invictus 型号充分利用 C3i 计算机，装备一门高斯步枪和三具轻型 PPC。它显然用于直射火力支援，但可伸缩刀刃令外人困惑，主炮却只有一吨弹药也同样令人费解。

column1: Reportedly 开发 in a mobile facility en route to the Inner Sphere, the Elemental II (X) is a prototype battle 装甲 开发 by 氏族地狱马 to integrate the capabilities of the standard Elemental battlesuit (known to many in the Inner Sphere as "Toad " 装甲) with myomer-boosting technology. The goal of this experimental 设计 was to enhance the Elemental as the Clans' "gold standard" in battle 装甲 设计, and produce a more effective general-purpose suit.
column2: 据称 Elemental II（X）是在前往内圈的移动设施中开发的原型战斗装甲，由地狱马氏族制造，用于将标准 Elemental 战斗服（内圈常称“蟾蜍”装甲）与肌纤维增强技术结合。实验设计旨在把 Elemental 打造成氏族战斗装甲的“黄金标准”，并生产更有效的通用战斗服。

column1: The Federated Suns variant replaces the autocannons with twin 转管自动炮/5s. All the lasers were upgraded to extended range models, and the weight savings went into an extra pair of double heat sinks. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Laser 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 联邦太阳改型用两门转管自动炮/5替换自动炮。所有激光器升级为扩展射程型号，节省的重量用于增加一对双散热器。 怪癖：改进型冷却夹套 - 激光 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: The Federated Suns variant replaces the autocannons with twin 转管自动炮/5s. All the lasers were upgraded to extended range models, and the weight savings went into an extra pair of double heat sinks.
column2: 联邦太阳改型用两门转管自动炮/5替换自动炮，所有激光器升级为扩展射程型号，节省的重量用于增加一对双散热器。

column1: A field refit, this minor upgrade to the END-6S replaces the LB 10-X AC with a pair of Light AC/5s. This allows the Enfield to use Precision and 装甲-Piercing ammunition.
column2: 这是一项战地改装，将 END-6S 的 LB 10-X 自动炮替换为两门轻型 AC/5，使 Enfield 能使用精准弹药和穿甲弹。

column1: A full energy version of the 执法者 III, which means worse heat management in warmer climates. So be careful where you plan to use it.
column2: 执法者 III 的全能量版本，在温暖气候下热管理更差，因此要谨慎选择使用地点。

column1: A Jihad era upgrade of the EXT-5E, the Exterminator EXT-5F is used by Comstar. Boasting the same specs as the 5E, the 5F upgrades the ER 中型激光器 to a pair of Light PPCs and swaps the iNarc for an MML-7. An ER Small Laser is added with the remaining free weight.
column2: 圣战时代对 EXT-5E 的升级型，Exterminator EXT-5F 由 ComStar 使用。它保留 5E 的规格，将 ER 中型激光器升级为两具轻型 PPC，并用 MML-7 替换 iNarc；剩余重量增加一具 ER 小型激光器。

column1: An experimental 机甲 生产 by Comstar during the Jihad, the 灭绝者 EXT-6CS is built around a rare Chameleon Light Polarisation Shield. A 390-rated XL引擎 and Endo Steel allow the 机甲 to mount paired Light PPCs and 中型脉冲激光s. AN MML-7 provides additional firepower with CASE II protecting the munitions. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: 这是 ComStar 在圣战期间生产的实验机甲，围绕罕见的变色龙轻型偏振护盾构建。390 级 XL 引擎和内骨骼钢让它能安装两具轻型 PPC 和中型脉冲激光器，MML-7 提供额外火力，CASE II 保护弹药。 怪癖：灵巧 掉落成本乘数: 1.09

column1: This 布雷克圣言会 variant replaces the torso weapons with an 改进的 C3 Computer and four plasma rifles. The arms retain the ER 中型激光 of the original Fafnir. It also carries twenty-two double heat sinks. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 该布雷克圣言会改型用改进型 C3 计算机和四具等离子步枪替换躯干武器，双臂保留原版 Fafnir 的 ER 中型激光器，并携带 22 具双散热器。 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The Falconer FLC-10R attempts to address the most common complaint of the FLC-8R, the tendency of its Gauss Rifle to take catastrophic damage, by increasing the amount of effective 装甲 the 机甲 carries by utilizing 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 and dropping one heat sink. While updating the 设计 the lasers were also all upgraded to Extended Range versions. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Falconer FLC-10R 通过增加有效装甲来解决 FLC-8R 高斯步枪易受灾难性损伤的问题，采用轻型铁纤维装甲并减少一具散热器。升级过程中，所有激光器也换成扩展射程型号。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: This Fireball unique variant built in 3077 was equipped with a 320 XXL 引擎, MASC, and Supercharger. This combination of speed systems gives it a consistent running speed of 240 km/h, with bursts of up to 400 km/h possible. This Fireball has a pair of ER Small Lasers as its only weapons and a mere three and a half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 protect it. Despite these limitations, and the fragile XL Gyro, the owner (noted as a criminal) didn't see this as a problem. The Fireball-XF (which stands for `Extra Fast`) is used only in illegal street races.
column2: 这台 3077 年制造的 Fireball 独特改型配备 320 级 XXL 引擎、MASC 和增压器，稳定速度达到 240 km/h，短时爆发可达 400 km/h。它唯一的武器是一对 ER 小型激光器，仅以三吨半铁纤维装甲防护。尽管存在这些限制和脆弱的 XL 陀螺仪，作为罪犯的所有者并不在意。Fireball-XF（意为“极速”）仅用于非法街头竞速。

column1: Born from the Terran Hegemony's attempts to create a medium fire-support platform that would be more advanced than the RLN-1N Rifleman, Mitchell Vehicles unveiled the GLH-1D Galahad in 2570. Though it outgunned the earlier design and found significant acceptance within the Hegemony Armed Forces, the Galahad suffered from the same heat issues as the BattleMech it was meant to replace. The Word of Blake's version of the Galahad, the GLH-3D variant, employs a 240-rated Light Fusion 引擎 and a small cockpit. For weapons it uses two Light Gauss Rifles with four tons of ammo to split between them. It was also given more sophisticated electronics, in the way of an improved C3 computer and a Guardian ECM Suite.
column2: Mitchell Vehicles 为创造比 RLN-1N Rifleman 更先进的中型火力支援平台，于 2570 年推出 GLH-1D Galahad。它火力超过早期设计并获星盟军方采用，却有与替代对象相同的热量问题。布雷克圣言会的 GLH-3D 使用 240 级轻型聚变引擎和小型驾驶舱，装备两具轻型高斯步枪及四吨弹药，并配备改进型 C3 计算机和守护者 ECM 套件。

column1: This custom variant of the Galahad was used by Phantom Demi-Precentor Delta Laodices, a commander of the 40th Shadow Division. It uses a 小型驾驶舱, an 改进的 C3 Computer, one 轻型高斯步枪, and a 守护者ECM Suite - just like a standard 3D Galahad. It differs, however, in that it drops the other 轻型高斯步枪 and one ton of ammunition, replacing them with an ER PPC enhanced by an experimental PPC Capacitor in the right arm. In addition, a Light PPC is mounted in the center torso. These modifications allow the '机甲 to remain in combat for far longer. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这台 Galahad 定制型由第 40 暗影师团指挥官、幻影副主教 Delta Laodices 使用。它采用小型驾驶舱、改进型 C3 计算机、一具轻型高斯步枪和守护者 ECM，类似标准 3D。不同之处在于移除另一具轻型高斯步枪及一吨弹药，换成右臂 ER PPC，并以实验 PPC 电容器增强；中央躯干另装一具轻型 PPC。这些改装让机甲能在战场停留更久。 怪癖：多目标追踪 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: This custom variant of the Galahad was used by Phantom Demi-Precentor Delta Laodices, a commander of the 40th Shadow Division. It uses a 小型驾驶舱, an 改进的 C3 Computer, one 轻型高斯步枪, and a 守护者ECM Suite - just like a standard 3D Galahad. It differs, however, in that it drops the other 轻型高斯步枪 and one ton of ammunition, replacing them with an ER PPC enhanced by an experimental PPC Capacitor in the right arm. In addition, a Light PPC is mounted in the center torso. These modifications allow the '机甲 to remain in combat for far longer.
column2: 这台 Galahad 定制型由第 40 暗影师团指挥官 Delta Laodices 使用。它采用小型驾驶舱、改进型 C3 计算机、一具轻型高斯步枪和守护者 ECM；另一具轻型高斯步枪及一吨弹药被替换为右臂带实验 PPC 电容器强化的 ER PPC，中央躯干另装轻型 PPC，使机甲拥有更长持续作战能力。

column1: The -4L was the only variant of the Gnat to be sold in the Inner Sphere as well. By switching to Double instead of single Heat Sinks, the variant can without issues run a total of four ER 中型激光s while still keeping its probe and ECM. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: -4L 是 Gnat 唯一同时销往内圈的型号。改用双散热器后，它能无压力运行四具 ER 中型激光器，同时保留探针和 ECM。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The production version of Arc-Royal MechWorks' GHR-7X prototype, the 7P uses a 躯干挂载 Cockpit, Endo Steel and  a Light Fusion 引擎, and mounts four 改进型跳跃推进器. The Type VI 血猎犬主动探头 was also retained. It carries 2 X-Pulse LL, and 3 ER ML.
column2: 这是 Arc-Royal 机甲工坊 GHR-7X 原型的量产型。7P 使用躯干挂载驾驶舱、内骨骼钢和轻型聚变引擎，安装四具改进型跳跃喷射器，并保留 VI 型血猎犬主动探头。它携带两具 X 脉冲大型激光器和三具 ER 中型激光器。

column1: The F configuration carries a ATM-6 launcher in the right torso, and two 等离子炮s in the right arm.
column2: F 配置右侧躯干安装一具 ATM-6 发射器，右臂安装两具等离子炮。

column1: The personal ‘Mech of Leftenant Natasha Ergen of the Fifth FedCom RCT, her stock Griffin had been refitted with 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and a light fusion 引擎. Fourteen double heat sinks and a targeting computer allowed Ergen to obtain maximum effect from an all-energy weapons array consisting of an ER PPC, two standard 中型激光器 mounted one per side torso alongside three ER 中型激光器, one mounted in each torso component.
column2: 这是联邦第五 RCT 中尉 Natasha Ergen 的私人机甲。她的制式 Griffin 改装为铁纤维装甲和轻型聚变引擎；14 具双散热器和瞄准计算机让她充分发挥全能量武器阵列，包括 ER PPC、双侧躯干各一具标准中型激光器及三具 ER 中型激光器。

column1: A 布雷克圣言会 design which emerged in 3076, the Griffin 4R uses 改进型跳跃推进器 to cover 270 米 at a time, and a larger 引擎 brings the top speed to 97 km/h. Carrying a 短管PPC, an MML-5 launcher, and an ER 中型激光, the 4R is a close range brawler. Endo Steel forms the chassis, and eleven double heat sinks keep the 'Mech cool.
column2: 布雷克圣言会于 3076 年推出的 Griffin 4R 使用改进型跳跃喷射器一次跃进 270 米，更大的引擎将最高速度提升至 97 km/h。它携带短管 PPC、MML-5 和 ER 中型激光器，是近战斗士；内骨骼钢构成底盘，11 具双散热器保持机甲冷却。

column1: A vintage Griffin refitted to the 6S standard and beyond with captured 布雷克圣言会 technology, when Francine rescued the Black Widow Company at the Royal Pass of the Ridges in 3070, her 'Mech carried half a ton less 装甲 and swapped the 6S's ER PPC for an advanced 短管PPC as well as adding an extra ER 中型激光器 to the left arm and a rear-facing small laser.
column2: 这是一台按 6S 标准及更高规格改装的老式 Griffin，使用缴获的布雷克圣言会技术。3070 年 Francine 在山脊皇家隘口救出黑寡妇连队时，她的机甲少了半吨装甲，将 6S 的 ER PPC 换成先进短管 PPC，并在左臂增加 ER 中型激光器和后向小型激光器。

column1: Cicada 于 2740 年推出，重 40 吨，是作为 Locust 的竞争对手而开发的。Slightly better armed and just as fast, the Cicada’s heavier 装甲 and better melee capabilities enable it to function as an effective Light Mech hunter and scout. Cicada 3X 由 280 级 XL 发动机提供动力，配备一对中型 X 脉冲激光激光器和一对 MML-7。隐形装甲和守护者 ECM 完善了该变体。
column2: Cicada 于 2740 年推出，重 40 吨，作为 Locust 的竞争者。它武装略强而速度相同，更厚装甲和更出色近战能力使其成为有效的轻型机甲猎手和侦察机。Cicada 3X 由 280 级 XL 引擎驱动，装备一对中型 X 脉冲激光器和一对 MML-7；潜行装甲与守护者 ECM 完善了配置。

column1: Poltergeist Precentor Sigma Tamiel of the 47th Shadow Division uses a custom weapons configuration. His Grigori mounts two 雷电10 missile launchers and a 短管PPC. A head-mounted 守护者ECM Suite provides an additional layer of defense. For increased mobility, the Grigori Tamiel carries four Jump Jets.
column2: 第 47 暗影师团的幻影副主教 Sigma Tamiel 使用定制武器配置。她的 Grigori 装备两具雷霆 10 导弹发射器和一具短管 PPC，头部守护者 ECM 套件提供额外防御，四具跳跃喷射器提升机动性。

column1: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。This command Mech variant piloted by Manei Domini Precentor Avitue during her actions on New Avalon during the Blakist Jihad equipped with improved weapons and systems.
column2: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于弥补康卫在图卡伊德战役中的严重损失。布雷克圣言会夺取地球后继续生产它，以重建和扩充民兵，因此世俗与狂热阵营军队中都有一定数量。作为通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器。这台由 Manei Domini 副主教 Avitue 驾驶的指挥机甲改型，在新亚瓦隆行动中装备了改进型武器和系统。

column1: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。This custom Mech was developed by Com Guard Adept Einar Halldórsson and focuses on survivability and using clan tech weaponry.
column2: 死神是康星设计的通用机甲。这台定制机甲由康卫圣职者 Einar Halldórsson 开发，重点提升生存能力并使用氏族科技武器。

column1: Following the Blakist defeat, many of their weapons were changed for the victorious powers. This version of the GLT-6WB Guillotine introduced in 3080 exchanges the 改进的 C3 CPU for a 守护者ECM and a C3 slave CPU. 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper
column2: 布雷克圣言会战败后，胜利者改装了许多缴获武器。3080 年推出的 GLT-6WB Guillotine 用守护者 ECM 和 C3 从属计算机替换改进型 C3 CPU。 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper

column1: A prototype improvement of the -6WB that never went into larger production due to the defeat of the Blakist forces. Through the combination of both Endo Steel 结构 and 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the prototype managed to fit both an ER Large Laser and a 轻型高斯步枪 in the left arm. Four ER 中型激光s and a Streak SRM4 launcher provides closer range firepower as needed. 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper
column2: 这是 -6WB 的原型改进型，因布雷克势力战败而未大规模生产。内骨骼钢结构与铁纤维装甲的组合让它能在左臂安装 ER 大型激光器和轻型高斯步枪；四具 ER 中型激光器与 Streak SRM-4 提供近距离火力。 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower, 左侧 Upper

column1: A Helepolis refit that trades the 火炮加农炮 for an Arrow IV System.
column2: Helepolis 改装型用 Arrow IV 系统替换火炮加农炮。

column1: Originally a prototype 设计, nick-named 'Big Bertha' by the 设计 team, the Helepolis 7H model sports two monstrous Sniper火炮 Pieces and 5 tons of ammunition. The Big Bertha model has entered very limited production at 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队's facilities on Solaris VII. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Helepolis 7H 最初是原型设计，设计团队称其为“大贝莎”。它装备两门巨大的狙击炮和五吨弹药；Big Bertha 型号仅在 Solaris VII 的瓦伊宁工程与打捞队设施小规模生产。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Boss, with two of those Sniper火炮 Pieces, this Helepolis is capable of leveling entire city block in one or two salvos. I don't know what they were thinking but I'm sure it involved a bunch of craters.
column2: 老板，这台 Helepolis 配备两门狙击炮，一两轮齐射就能夷平整条城市街区。我不知道设计者在想什么，但肯定和制造一堆弹坑有关。

column1: The personal '机甲 of Crucis March Militia deserter-turned-bandit Greta Halperin, her Hellspawn introduced in 3072 had been extensively modified with experimental technologies to turn it into a deadly first strike backstabber. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - Missile 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是 Crucis March 民兵逃兵转为匪徒的 Greta Halperin 的私人机甲。她的 Hellspawn 于 3072 年推出，经过大量实验技术改装，成为致命的先发背刺机甲。 怪癖：改进型冷却夹套 - 导弹 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: A variant used exclusively by the Blakists starting in 3068, the 4WB swaps out the 铁纤维装甲 装甲 for stealth 装甲, resulting in a '机甲 that is more difficult to target at the cost of overall 装甲 protection. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: 布雷克分子自 3068 年起专用的改型，4WB 用潜行装甲替换铁纤维装甲，使机甲更难被锁定，但牺牲了整体装甲防护。 怪癖：改进型通信 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower

column1: The 休伦战士 RX4 carries a 银弹高斯 Rifle and a 大型X脉冲激光 Laser. Protected by ten tons of Reactive 装甲, it is also equipped with a Supercharger that allows it to reach sprint speeds of 100 km/h. The '机甲 was originally refit for Republic Legate Dean Singer, but was stolen by a minor criminal.
column2: 休伦战士 RX4 携带银弹高斯步枪和大型 X 脉冲激光器。十吨反应装甲提供防护，增压器使其冲刺速度达到 100 km/h。该机甲原本为共和国执政官 Dean Singer 改装，后来被一名小罪犯盗走。

column1: Project CORAL INTENT goal is to refit 渗透者 Mk II with reverse-engineered Mimetic 装甲 and C3 systems captured from Blakists during New Avalon assault
column2: CORAL INTENT 项目旨在为渗透者 Mk II 安装逆向工程的拟态装甲和从新亚瓦隆袭击中缴获的 C3 系统。

column1: An experimental field refit kit for the -1532 Jackal 开发 by Earthwerks, the -1579 retained the ER PPC and anti-missile system while switching to double heat sinks to free up weight for a few appliqué 装甲 panels. The main difference was the replacement of the unloved 锁定式SRM-2 launcher and its attendant ammo with a PPC capacitor to boost the effectiveness of its sole offensive weapon, and an advanced Angel ECM suite to protect the 设计 from enemy electronics. 怪癖: 改进的 Cooling Jacket - PPC 掉落成本乘数: 0.99
column2: 这是 Earthwerks 为 -1532 Jackal 开发的实验性战地改装套件。-1579 保留 ER PPC 和反导系统，改用双散热器，为附加装甲板腾出重量。它用 PPC 电容器替换不受欢迎的锁定式 SRM-2 及弹药，并加装先进天使 ECM 保护设计免受敌方电子战影响。 怪癖：改进型冷却夹套 - PPC 掉落成本乘数: 0.99

column1: The D4 variant, introduced in 3073, changes out the '机甲's 装甲 for 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲. The '机甲's double heat sinks have been increased to 16 to handle the '机甲's additional weapons. These additional weapons include a second pair of 中型激光s added to the center torso. In the arms, the Ultra AC/2s have been replaced by Light PPCs. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: D4 改型于 3073 年推出，将机甲装甲替换为轻型铁纤维装甲。双散热器增加到 16 具，以应对新增武器：中央躯干增加第二对中型激光器，双臂的 Ultra AC/2 换成轻型 PPC。 怪癖：防空瞄准 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: The Jager机甲 JO is a field refit that carries 2 轻型高斯步枪s in place of its ACs.
column2: Jager 机甲 JO 是战地改装型，用两具轻型高斯步枪替换自动炮。

column1: An experimental variant of the Jenner 开发 by Luthien 装甲 Works in 3072. Using the JR7-K as its base the 设计ers sought to update the mech with new technology. The internal 结构 was swapped for a composite version. Its 引擎 was replaced with a 245-rated XL引擎, maintaining the original speed. The forward jutting cockpit was replaced with a 躯干挂载 Cockpit. The old SRM's were completely dropped in favor of increasing the '机甲's 中型激光器 armament to six 中型激光s. For the '机甲's protection, it has Angel ECM and its hull has been encased with seven tons of 装甲. For its stealth capacities, the '机甲 has been given an Experimental Null-Signature System. Only seven of these '机甲s were known to have been built. 怪癖: 改进的 Lifesupport 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是 Luthien 装甲工坊于 3072 年开发的 Jenner 实验改型，以 JR7-K 为基础更新技术。内部结构换成复合结构，引擎替换为 245 级 XL 引擎以保持原速度，前置驾驶舱改为躯干挂载驾驶舱。旧 SRM 全部移除，机甲中型激光器增加至六具；天使 ECM 和七吨装甲提供防护，实验型零信号系统增强潜行能力。已知仅制造七台。 怪癖：改进型生命维持 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: This was test-bed '机甲 which was fitted out with experimental weaponry and equipment by Warrior House Imarra. The Jinggau's main weaponry was replaced with an experimental Sniper Cannon and four 中型X脉冲激光 Lasers. The '机甲 was equipped with an XL Gyro, TAG, and a C3 Slave. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是 Warrior House Imarra 为试验武器和设备改装的试验台机甲。Jinggau 主武器换成实验狙击炮和四具中型 X 脉冲激光器，并装备 XL 陀螺仪、TAG 和 C3 从属单元。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: A deadly campaign configuration, the Karhu D mounted a pair of ER PPCs in its left arm, supported by a 锁定式SRM-6 in its left torso and three ER 中型激光s in its right arm. Packed with advanced electronics, a 定位 Computer enhanced its weaponry alongside an 主动探头 and ECM Suite in its right torso. Protected by a pair of anti-missile systems, four extra double heat sinks were added to prevent the '机甲's single ton of AMS and streak reloads from exploding. 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: Karhu D 是致命的战役配置，左臂装一对 ER PPC，左侧躯干配锁定式 SRM-6，右臂装三具 ER 中型激光器。先进电子设备包括瞄准计算机、右侧躯干主动探头和 ECM 套件。两套反导系统提供防护，额外四具双散热器防止机甲一吨 AMS 与 Streak 再装弹药爆炸。 怪癖: 易于驾驶 掉落成本乘数: 1.1 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: The KGC-009 King Crab is notoriously difficult to put down, thanks to heavy 装甲 and a reinforced gyro that can keep the machine on its feet even when faced with withering fire.
column2: KGC-009 King Crab 因厚重装甲和强化陀螺仪而臭名昭著，后者即使在猛烈火力下也能让机体保持站立。

column1: Ghost Bear always is looking to use advanced technology in there mech re-设计s. This one looks to be a prototype of the upcoming II model. I shudder to think if they can actually get a self healing mech.
column2: 幽灵熊氏族总在其机甲重新设计中追求先进技术。这台似乎是即将推出的 II 型原型。我不敢想象他们真的造出自我修复机甲会怎样。

column1: This upgrade of the Legacy utilizes a Light Fusion 引擎 to increase the '机甲's top speed to 64 km/h, though its jumping capacity does not increase commensurately. All of the '机甲's backup weapons remain the same, but the autocannons are replaced with a pair of Heavy PPCs. The '机甲's heat dissipation capability has also not kept up, utilizing only fourteen double heat sinks.
column2: Legacy 的升级型使用轻型聚变引擎，将机甲最高速度提高到 64 km/h，但跳跃能力没有相应提升。所有备用武器保持不变，自动炮替换为一对重型 PPC；散热能力也未跟上，只使用 14 具双散热器。

column1: This Legacy uses the same frame and 引擎 as the 03 model but uses a 紧凑型陀螺仪 to provide enough room to add MASC. This means it can reach a speed of 86 km/h. The weaponry has been replaced with a pair of 短管PPCs, and the hand actuators have been replaced by Claws. The standard 装甲 is replaced by 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous.
column2: Legacy 采用与 03 型相同的底盘和引擎，但使用紧凑型陀螺仪腾出空间安装 MASC，速度可达 86 km/h。武器换成一对短管 PPC，手部执行器替换为利爪，标准装甲改为轻型铁纤维装甲。

column1: The 5V Locust is similar to the 3V Locust, carrying a pair of ER 中型激光器, two 火箭发射器 10s and protected by 铁纤维装甲 装甲. Built in 3068, its relatively low-tech 设计 made it attractive to Periphery powers, namely the Magistracy of Canopus and Taurian Concordat. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 5V Locust 类似 3V，携带一对 ER 中型激光器和两具 RL-10，并由铁纤维装甲保护。它于 3068 年制造，低技术设计吸引了外围势力，包括金星王座和陶瑞安协约国。 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: Developed by the 布雷克圣言会 in 3076 this Locust uses MASC to top out at speeds of over 180 km/h. It's equipped with a pair of ER 中型激光s, TAG, and an Improved C3 Computer. 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲 protects the Endo Steel 结构. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 布雷克圣言会于 3076 年开发的 Locust 使用 MASC，最高速度超过 180 km/h。它装备一对 ER 中型激光器、TAG 和改进型 C3 计算机；轻型铁纤维装甲保护内骨骼钢结构。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：0.97 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper

column1: A good scout with its speed and improved C3/TAG combination. They are however rather rare due to being a 布雷克圣言会 设计.
column2: 它凭借速度和改进型 C3/TAG 组合成为优秀侦察机，但由于是布雷克圣言会设计，数量相当稀少。

column1: When th是'Mech goes at full speed the MechWarri或 在side that 小型驾驶舱 gets an almost surreal experience, the pace 是that fast. Just don't check your underwear afterwards...
column2: 当这台机甲全速前进时，坐在小型驾驶舱一侧的机甲战士会经历近乎超现实的体验，因为速度实在太快。只是之后千万别检查你的内裤……

column1: The Longinus "Hacked" Battle 装甲 is an experimental refit of the Longinus by Mark "Chiphead" Japalucci, a Tech in the Principality of Regulus, working in conjunction with Apple Computers Interstellar to help rebuild the Regulan military using salvaged technology. Taking a standard Longinus suit, reducing its jumping ability to sixty 米, shedding 120 kg of 装甲, and limiting the weapons payload capability, "Chiphead" was able to install an experimental battle 装甲 C3i system captured from the 布雷克圣言会.
column2: Longinus“黑客”战斗装甲是 Regulus 公国技术员 Mark “Chiphead” Japalucci 对 Longinus 的实验改装，他与 Apple Computers Interstellar 合作，利用回收技术重建 Regulus 军队。Chiphead 通过将标准 Longinus 跳跃能力降至 60 米、减轻 120 kg 装甲并限制武器载荷，安装了从布雷克圣言会缴获的实验型战斗装甲 C3i 系统。

column1: The E configuration makes use of a 超突击高斯 Rifle 30 in each arm, though each one only has a single ton of ammunition to draw upon.
column2: E 配置双臂各使用一门 30 型超重型突击高斯步枪，但每门只有一吨弹药。

column1: The Mad Dog F has a pair of HAG 20s. Though they don't have the sheer power of the larger guns, the four tons of ammunition provide substantially better staying power than the E variant has. To back the Gauss Rifles up, the F mounts four ER 中型激光器.
column2: Mad Dog F 装有两门 HAG/20。虽然威力不如更大型火炮，但四吨弹药使其续航远胜 E 型。为支援高斯步枪，F 型安装四具 ER 中型激光器。

column1: An underwater configuration, this version uses Battle机甲 HarJel System to prevent hull breaches. It's equipped with five UMUs to maintain a high cruising speed underwater. Its weaponry consists of twin LRT-15s with Artemis IV guidance and each arm carries a 中型脉冲激光 and ER 中型激光. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 这是水下配置，使用战斗机甲 HarJel 系统防止船体破裂，并配备五具 UMU 维持水下高速巡航。武器为两具带 Artemis IV 制导的 LRT-15，双臂各有一具中型脉冲激光器和 ER 中型激光器。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：Omni

column1: The A configuration of this scout 'Mech uses a pair of ER 中型激光s as its heavy weapons. Two sets of three 轻型 Machine Guns, each linked to a 机枪 Array, give the 'Mech the capability to devastate conventional infantry, as can the pair of torso-mounted Flamers. A single ER Small Laser rounds out the weapons array.
column2: 这台侦察机甲 A 配置使用两具 ER 中型激光器作为重型武器。两组各三挺轻型机枪，每组连接至机枪阵列，可摧毁常规步兵；躯干安装的一对火焰喷射器也有同样作用。另有一具 ER 小型激光器完善武装。

column1: A medium-range saber-fighter, most of the Infernus variant's pod space is taken up by a head-mounted 短管PPC. Each arm mounts an ER 中型激光, giving the Malak the ability to cover its flanks. To protect it from enemy electronics, the Malak B also carries a 守护者ECM Suite.
column2: Infernus 改型是中程剑士，大部分 pod 空间被头部短管 PPC 占据。双臂各装一具 ER 中型激光器，使 Malak 能覆盖侧翼；Malak B 还配备守护者 ECM 套件，防止敌方电子战。

column1: The Invictus variant of this light '机甲 features a Light PPC, an ER 中型激光, and a Flamer that allow it to operate far from supply lines. The SRM-2 is capable of mounting inferno munitions, which can make quick work of 车辆s and infantry. To protect the '机甲 from ammunition explosions it mounts CASE in the right torso. For close combat it carries a 可伸缩刀刃.
column2: 该轻型机甲 Invictus 改型装备轻型 PPC、ER 中型激光器和火焰喷射器，可脱离补给线作战。SRM-2 能装填 Inferno 弹药，迅速消灭车辆和步兵。右侧躯干安装 CASE 防止弹药爆炸，近战时携带可伸缩刀刃。

column1: The custom configuration of Opacus Venatori member Mi Tomitaki, her 全向Mech was outfitted with a pair of experimental Ramtech 5500V Medium 变速脉冲激光s, one in each arm, supported by a head-mounted ER Small Laser. A Supercharger allowed her to close in an instant to optimal weapons range.
column2: 这是 Opacus Venatori 成员 Mi Tomitaki 的定制配置。她的全能机甲双臂各装一具实验型 Ramtech 5500V 中型可变脉冲激光器，头部另有 ER 小型激光器；增压器让她能瞬间接近最佳武器射程。

column1: A customized variant of the 掠夺者 IIC, the Helion mounts a HAG/40, backed up by an ER PPC in each arm supported by two ER 中型激光s split between each side torso. Twelve tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 protect the Helion and it carries six tons of HAG ammo and fourteen double heat-sinks. 怪癖: 超伸展驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是掠夺者 IIC 的定制改型。Helion 装备 HAG/40，双臂各有一具 ER PPC，左右躯干各分担一具 ER 中型激光器。十二吨铁纤维装甲保护机体，另携六吨 HAG 弹药和 14 具双散热器。 怪癖: 超伸展驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.21 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower

column1: This Dark Age-era variant was created by the Capellan Confederation. It uses a light fusion 引擎 to reduce vulnerability to 引擎 destruction, and carries a Gauss Rifle in each arm. These are supported by a single torso mounted ER PPC. A 守护者ECM Suite powers the Stealth 装甲 that encases this 设计. It retains the ability to jump 90 米 at a time.
column2: 这是黑暗时代的变体，由坎培拉联盟制造。它采用轻型聚变引擎，以降低遭受引擎毁坏的风险；双臂各装备一门高斯步枪，躯干上还安装了一门ER PPC作为支援。内置的隐形装甲由一套ECM套件驱动，覆盖并保护整台机甲。它仍保留一次跳跃90米的能力。

column1: The Marauder II 5D is a Davion refit to showcase both UAC/10 and a Massive 400XXL 引擎.
column2: 掠夺者II 5D是戴维昂的改装型号，旨在同时展示UAC/10与一台大型400XXL引擎的性能。

column1: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，把 75 吨重型机甲变成 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。由 a 300-rated Fusion Core, the Marauder II MAD-6D 是装备 a RAC/5, paired Snub Nose and Light PPC’s. 改进型跳跃推进器 add additional mobility.\n\n部署费用倍率：1.18.
column2: 掠夺者II于3012年问世，是为了满足戴维昂对更强重型机甲的需求。它以75吨级机体换取100吨级的火力与防护，直到3030年后继型号出现才逐步退出生产。采用300额定功率的聚变核心后，掠夺者II MAD-6D安装了一门RAC/5，并配备一对短管PPC和轻型PPC。改进的跳跃系统进一步提升了机动性。\n\n装甲倍率：1.18。

column1: Designed and constructed during the Jihad, the 4S updated the design of the popular 3S series of Marauders with new technology designed to improve its effectiveness on the modern battlefield. Built around 18 双散热器, the 4S has similar design principles to its predecessor; designed for ease of maintenance and repair. With an extra ton of 装甲 and a targeting computer, it is capable of taking a heavier pounding at close range and boasts superior accuracy at mid to long range. Aside from this it is functionally similar to it’s predecessor, retaining the 中型激光器 and PPC loadout; though the PPCs have been updated to ER versions and the old single heat sinks swapped for more efficient double heat sinks. Production has been brisk, with 通用汽车 taking orders from across the Inner Sphere and the Periphery; as mercenaries and planetary militias look to upgrade the older Marauders in their arsenals.
column2: 4S是在圣战期间设计并制造的型号，使用新技术更新了广受欢迎的掠夺者3S系列，以提升其在现代战场上的效能。它围绕18组双重散热器构建，仍采用前代便于维护和修理的设计理念。额外增加一吨装甲并安装瞄准计算机后，它能在近距离承受更猛烈的打击，同时在中远距离拥有更高精度。除此之外，它基本保留前代的武器布局和PPC配置；不过PPC已升级为ER型号，原有单散热器也换成效率更高的双散热器。产量增长迅速，通用动力公司接到了来自内圈和边缘区域的大量订单，佣兵与行星民兵都在设法升级军械库中的老式掠夺者。

column1: A departure from the standard Marauder 设计 philosophy, the 3068 9M is built using an XL引擎 and twelve and a half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲. The '机甲 carries, as its primary weapons, four ER Large Lasers for long-range combat. In the event that the '机甲 closes, it has two 锁定式SRM-6 launchers. The 9M also carries TAG to 设计ate targets for Arrow IV 火炮 strikes and an ECM Suite for protection against electronic warfare systems. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 3068年的9M偏离了标准掠夺者的设计理念，采用XL引擎和十二吨半的强化装甲。这台机甲的主要武器是四门ER大型激光，适合远程作战；敌人逼近时，则由两具连续射击SRM-6发射器应对。9M还配备TAG，用于为箭IV导弹打击标记目标，并安装ECM套件抵御电子战系统。 特性：坚韧/远程。 击杀倍率：1.11 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: This is a Sherrif's mech, It brings a piece of mind to folk, but is not heavy on technology. This is a Magistracy of Canopus variant of the Marshal, that was developed during the Jihad. This model saw introduction of a Light Fusion 引擎, and some modern weaponry to the Marshal's arsenal. 右侧 Torso's 中型脉冲激光 is retained, while a Light PPC, 等离子步枪, and a MML-9 is introduced for ranged attacks. For dedicated anti-infantry work, the Machine Guns are exchanged for pair of 轻型 Machine Guns in a 机枪 Array.
column2: 这是治安官的机甲，能让民众安心，却没有堆砌过多高科技。它是金星合众国在圣战期间开发的元帅改型。该型号为元帅换装了轻型聚变引擎，并加入了一些现代武器。右侧躯干的中型激光得到保留，同时新增轻型PPC、短管步枪和MML-9，用于远程攻击。为专门对付步兵，原有机枪被一对机枪阵列取代，每个阵列都装有两挺机枪。

column1: This overhaul replaces the lasers with 短管PPCs. The autocannons were replaced with the same number of 轻型自动炮/5s, along with enough ammo bins to take advantage of special munitions. It's also fitted with an additional double heat sink, giving this version of the Mauler adequate heat-dissipation capabilities.
column2: 这次改装用短管PPC替换了原有激光器。自动火炮也换成数量相同的AC/5，并配备足够的弹药舱来使用特种弹药。此外还加装了一组双散热器，使该型号掠夺者拥有足够的散热能力。

column1: The Mauler has had a lack of new variants since the Jihad. LAW's developmental experimentation in the late 3060s sought to perfect a new weapons suite focused on medium ranges while  improving the 装甲 to suit an assault 'Mech. It did not fare well. As in a prior attempt to update the BattleMech most liked variant — 3062's MAL-3R — the Mauler's volatile CASE had to be discarded to accommodate new autocannon solutions, thereby undermining the quest for increased resilience. Increased 装甲 mass required the use of a bulky endo-steel 结构, reducing internal space, and allowing only a small cockpit. This aggregation of compromises eventually resulted in the flawed MAL-1KX, many of its shortcomings were never fixed, as the final production version that eventually became the MAL-1K was instead based on the MAL-1R.
column2: 圣战之后，掠夺者长期没有新变体。3060年代后期，LAW的开发试验试图完善一套专注中距离作战的武器系统，并强化这台突击机甲的装甲，但结果并不理想。此前对战斗机甲的改进尝试中，最受欢迎的是3062年的MAL-3R；而为了容纳新的自动火炮方案，掠夺者脆弱的CASE不得不拆除，提升生存力的目标也因此落空。增加的装甲重量迫使设计采用笨重的内骨骼结构，压缩了内部空间，只能安装狭小驾驶舱。层层妥协最终造就了问题重重的MAL-1KX。许多缺陷始终未能修复，最终量产的MAL-1K反而以MAL-1R为基础。

column1: The second configuration conceived during the Jihad, this in role of a brawler. The 'Mech receives a 短管PPC in each arm linked to a 瞄准计算机; the 'Mech equipment also includes TAG.
column2: 这是圣战期间构想的第二种配置，定位为近战斗士。机甲双臂各安装一门短管PPC，并连接至瞄准计算机；此外还配备TAG。

column1: Based on the Minotaur XP, this version reduces the SRM to an SRM-4 with eight reloads. It uses the same 改进的 Heavy Small Lasers, however, and retains the maximized 装甲 protection. To overcome the Minotaur's low speed, engineers added a Proto机甲-scale Magnetic Clamp system that allows the Proto机甲 to "hitch a ride" on friendly units. 怪癖: Resilient 掉落成本乘数: 0.984
column2: 该型号以米诺陶XP为基础，将SRM缩减为一具配备八次装填的SRM-4。它仍使用相同的改进型重型小型激光，并保留最大化的装甲防护。为弥补米诺陶速度低下的问题，工程师加装了原型机甲规模的磁力夹持系统，使这台原型机甲能够“搭便车”跟随友军单位。 特性：坚韧 击杀倍率：0.984

column1: An originally experimental variant 设计ed by the 布雷克圣言会, the NX-90 was instead eventually fielded by the Draconis Combine. This version of the '机甲 removes the laser weaponry and Beagle active probe to employ a unique method of attack: a pair of Battle机甲 lances. The 设计 was seen to use its speed and these physical weapons to deliver these piercing attacks against its opponents. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 0.99 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: NX-90最初是星盟的试验型变体，最终却由龙之联邦投入实战。这一型号移除了激光武器和猎犬主动探测器，改用独特的攻击方式：一对战斗机甲长矛。它利用自身速度和这些近战武器，向敌人发动穿透性突袭。 特性：坚韧/远程。 击杀倍率：0.99 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: This custom variant mounts a Heavy Machine Gun and ER 中型激光器 in each arm, with another laser mounted in the left torso and a Light PPC in the right torso. Two extra Jump-Jets are added, allowing the Sekhmet to jump 180 米.
column2: 该定制型号双臂各装备一挺重型机枪和一门ER中型激光，左侧躯干另装一门激光，右侧躯干装有一门轻型PPC。额外增加两具跳跃喷射器后，塞赫麦特一次可跳跃180米。

column1: Introduced in 3074 by the 布雷克圣言会, the Osprey Osp-25 is a minor upgrade of the original Osp-15 which swaps the 中型激光s for Extended Range versions.
column2: Osprey Osp-25由星盟于3074年推出，是原始Osp-15的小幅升级型，将原有中型激光换成了延伸射程型号。

column1: A customized variant created in 3085 for Lawrence Sawyer of the Lamenkov's Liability, only the MML-7 and Beagle were kept, with the rest of the weaponry replaced with a Heavy PPC, two 中型脉冲激光s, and a C3 Slave. For improved cross-country handling it also mounted five 改进的 Jump Jets. A 紧凑型陀螺仪 was also installed.
column2: 这是3085年为兰科夫责任公司的劳伦斯·索耶定制的变体。只有MML-7和猎犬主动探测器得到保留，其余武器换成一门重型PPC、两门中型激光和一台C3从属计算机。为改善越野机动性，它还安装了五具改进型跳跃喷射器，并加装了一套增强型传感器。

column1: A close-combat version, the Osteon C carries four 中型脉冲激光s and two 大型脉冲激光s tied to a 瞄准计算机.  改进型跳跃推进器 provide a surprise 150 meter jump radius.
column2: 近距离作战型的奥斯顿C携带四门中型激光和两门小型激光，并接入瞄准计算机。改进型跳跃系统带来150米的突袭跳跃半径。

column1: The Osteon-D carries four 大型脉冲激光s. Unlike the Osteon-C this version lacks jump jets and the 瞄准计算机. Instead it carries nineteen double heat sinks which allow it to stay in the fight for a long time.
column2: 奥斯顿D携带四门中型激光。与奥斯顿C不同，该型号没有跳跃喷射器和瞄准计算机，转而安装十九组双散热器，使其能够长时间留在战场上。

column1: The Osteon-E carries a HAG 20 in each arm. The head sports an ER Large Laser and ER 中型激光.
column2: 奥斯顿E双臂各装备一门HAG 20，头部安装一门ER大型激光和一门ER中型激光。

column1: The Osteon-F uses an ER Large Laser, Gauss Rifle, and Rotary AC/5 for its main weaponry. These are supplemented by eight Machine Guns split into two 机枪 Arrays of four. Four tons of autocannon and two tons of Gauss Rifle ammo are carried.
column2: 奥斯顿F以ER大型激光、高斯步枪和旋转AC/5作为主要武器，另配八挺机枪，分成两个各装四挺机枪的阵列。它携带四吨自动火炮弹药和两吨高斯步枪弹药。

column1: A fire-support variant, the Osteon-G carries two Arrow IV missile launchers with 5 tons of ammunition. Two ER 中型激光器 and two Medium Pulse Lasers provide close-range firepower.
column2: 作为火力支援型，奥斯顿G携带两具箭IV导弹发射器和五吨弹药。两门ER中型激光与两门中型脉冲激光为它提供近距离火力。

column1: This version was introduced by House Kurita in 3077. A Heavy Duty Gyro allows it to stay in the fight longer, making good use of twin 短管PPCs and ER 中型激光s. Though it's slightly slower than the standard Ostroc, jump jets allow it to maneuver around the battlefield, striking where it will inflict the most damage. After the Jihad ended, this model went into factory production.
column2: 该型号由库里塔家族于3077年推出。重型陀螺仪让它能在战场上坚持更久，并充分发挥双联短管PPC和ER中型激光的威力。虽然速度略低于标准奥斯卓克，但跳跃喷射器使它能在战场上灵活机动，攻击最能造成伤害的位置。圣战结束后，该型号进入工厂量产。

column1: Based on the 4C, this Taurian version introduced in 3082 uses an XL引擎, Endo Steel chassis, and five jump jets. The armament has been replaced with a Heavy PPC and Light PPC.
column2: 这一陶里安型号于3082年推出，以4C为基础，采用XL引擎、内骨骼结构和五具跳跃喷射器。武器改为一门重型PPC和一门轻型PPC。

column1: Based on the 8M version of the Ostsol this version from 3079 removes the Triple Strength Myomer and uses a battery of ER large and ER 中型激光器 to damage a foe at long range. For close combat it carries a Snub-Nose PPC and medium pulse laser. In addition to its heavy 装甲, it uses a Guardian ECM Suite to disrupt enemy electronics and a MASC system to engage and disengage at will. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.08
column2: 该型号以3079年的奥斯托尔8M为基础，移除三重强力肌肉，改用一组ER大型激光和ER中型激光进行远程打击。近战时则使用一门短管PPC和一门中型脉冲激光。除了厚重装甲外，它还配备守护者ECM套件干扰敌方电子设备，并使用MASC系统随时加速或减速。 特性：坚韧/远程 击杀倍率：1.08

column1: Based on the 8M version of the Ostsol this version from 3079 removes the 三重肌纤维束 and uses a battery of ER large and ER 中型激光器 to damage a foe at long range. For close combat it carries a 短管PPC and medium pulse laser. In addition to its heavy 装甲, it uses a 守护者ECM Suite to disrupt enemy electronics and a MASC system to engage and disengage at will.
column2: 该型号以3079年的奥斯托尔8M为基础，移除三重强力肌肉，改用一组ER大型激光和ER中型激光进行远程打击。近战时则使用一门短管PPC和一门中型脉冲激光。除了厚重装甲外，它还配备守护者ECM套件干扰敌方电子设备，并使用MASC系统随时加速或减速。

column1: The variant produced by the 布雷克圣言会 replaces the PPC with a 短管PPC. To supplement close-range combat, the -14S carries a pair of 火箭发射器 10s. The Endo Steel chassis supports enough 改进型跳跃推进器 to vault the Panther up to 180 米 at a time. Thirteen heat sinks keeps heat in check, made possible by the inclusion of a 小型驾驶舱.
column2: 星盟制造的这个变体用一门短管PPC替换了原有PPC。为加强近距离作战，-14S携带一对SRM-10发射器。内骨骼结构支撑足够的改进型跳跃喷射器，使猎豹一次可跃过180米。十三组散热器控制热量，驾驶舱改装也为此提供了帮助。

column1: The Panther 9L carries an experimental 等离子炮 on a improved Weapons mount and is supported by a Haywire Launcher and Flamer.
column2: 猎豹9L在改良武器挂架上安装了一套试验型武器系统，并配备电弧发射器和火焰喷射器。

column1: This Perseus configuration has a Rotary AC/5, MRM-20, PPC, and 锁定式SRM-4. Each leg carries a Small Laser. A 守护者ECM Suite disrupts enemy networks, while a head mounted TAG system allows the Perseus-P to designate 火炮 targets.
column2: 这套珀耳修斯配置拥有旋转AC/5、MRM-20、PPC和连续射击SRM-4。双腿各装一门小型激光。守护者ECM套件可干扰敌方网络，头部安装的TAG系统则让珀耳修斯-P能够标记目标。

column1: This version was apparently created by the 布雷克圣言会, as it removes the 比格犬探头 and a 中型激光 from the PHX-HK1R and replaces that equipment with an Improved C3 Computer. The 短管PPC remains and the two remaining lasers are extended-range models.
column2: 该型号据称由星盟制造。它从PHX-HK1R上移除了猎犬主动探测器和一门中型激光，换成一台改进型C3计算机。短管PPC得到保留，剩余两门激光则升级为延伸射程型号。

column1: The second MWO 开发 variant, the Piranha B carries a pair of ER Small Lasers in each arm supported by a pair of Heavy Machine Guns in each side torso and twin ER 中型激光s in the center torso. Built on the same body as the Piranha A, the B variant carries a single ton of heavy machine gun reloads.
column2: 这是第二种来自《机甲战士：在线》的食人鱼变体。食人鱼B双臂各装备一对ER小型激光，左右躯干各装一对重型机枪，中央躯干则装有双联ER中型激光。它沿用了食人鱼A的机体，并携带一吨重型机枪弹药。

column1: This version is more properly adapted to a scouting role by the addition of a 轻型 主动探头. It also uses upgraded heat sinks to allow for an all-energy configuration. Eight ER Micro Lasers and two 微型 Pulse Lasers replace the pair of ER 中型激光s. A 瞄准计算机 improves the accuracy of all the weapons.
column2: 通过加装猎犬主动探测器，这一型号更适合侦察任务。升级后的散热器使它能够采用全能量武器配置：八门ER微型激光和两门微型脉冲激光取代了原有的两门ER中型激光。瞄准计算机提升了全部武器的命中率。

column1: The Preta E utilizes an experimental 雷电15, though it only has enough ammunition to fire four times. Nonetheless, CASE protects the ammo bin. A pair of ER Mediums provide respectable firepower, while a 火箭发射器 10 should make smaller enemies wary until it is expended.
column2: 普雷塔E使用试验型高斯步枪15，但弹药仅够射击四次；CASE仍会保护弹药舱。一对ER中型激光提供可靠火力，而一具SRM-10能在弹药耗尽前让小型敌人有所顾忌。

column1: The Preta S uses experimental ER 中型脉冲激光s and an ER 大型脉冲激光 captured from Clan sources. It also carries six Jump Jets for additional mobility.
column2: 普雷塔S使用试验型ER中型激光，并装备一门从星盟缴获的ER中型激光。它还携带六具跳跃喷射器，以提高机动性。

column1: The customized configuration of the Opacus Venatori member Demi-Precentor Kendali Morris mounts enough 改进的 Jump Jets to leap 240 米; the '机甲 also is equipped with TAG and a Light PPC fitted with a capacitor supported by a single Small Variable Speed Laser. 怪癖: 改进的 Communications 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 欧帕库斯猎手组织副领唱肯达利·莫里斯的定制配置，安装了足够的改进型跳跃喷射器，可跃过240米。该机甲还配备TAG，以及一门装有电容器的轻型PPC，并由一门小型变速激光提供支援。 特性：改进型通讯 击杀倍率：1.03 左下部装甲：全向

column1: The customized configuration of the Opacus Venatori member Demi-Precentor Kendali Morris mounts enough Improved Jump Jets to leap 240 米; the 'Mech also is equipped with TAG and a Light PPC fitted with a capacitor supported by a single Small Variable Speed Laser.
column2: 欧帕库斯猎手组织副领唱肯达利·莫里斯的定制配置，安装了足够的改进型跳跃喷射器，可跃过240米。该机甲还配备TAG，以及一门装有电容器的轻型PPC，并由一门小型变速激光提供支援。

column1: The Quickdraw 7X is an attempt to create a sturdy and fast energy platform, sporting 加固结构 and a 躯干挂载 Cockpit with a head mounted 等离子炮 alongside a 400XXL 引擎.
column2: 快速抽取7X试图打造坚固而快速的能量平台，采用加固结构、先进驾驶舱，并在头部安装一套传感器，同时配备400XXL引擎。

column1: The Rabid Coyote was 设计ed by scientists from Clan Coyote to be a complement to other, slower Battle机甲s. First deployed in 3066, the '机甲 was deployed in an effort to stave off the slow decline of the previous decades that had befallen the Clan that created the Omni机甲. Curiously, as the '机甲 is intended to be a bodyguard for larger '机甲s like the 野蛮郊狼, front-line warriors spurn the 设计 because they do not wish to be seen merely as "support". 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 短 掉落成本乘数: 1.11
column2: 狂暴郊狼由郊狼星族的科学家设计，用来补充其他速度较慢的战斗机甲。它于3066年首次部署，目的是遏制创造这台全能机甲的星族在此前数十年间持续衰落的趋势。奇怪的是，狂暴郊狼本应为巨型机甲担任护卫，例如巨兽，但前线战士却厌恶它，因为他们不愿被视为只会提供“支援”的部队。 特性：改进型单位通讯 - 近战 击杀倍率：1.11

column1: A Solaris refit of the Rakshasa that upgrades its Electronics with Stealth and ECM technology. Named for Shapeshifting Hindu Demons of ancient Terra. A fan favorite during its time in the arenas, 设计ed to ambush its prey from close range.
column2: 这是太阳神七号竞技场对拉克沙萨的改装，升级了隐形与ECM电子设备。它以古泰拉传说中的变形印度恶魔命名，曾是竞技场时期广受欢迎的机甲，善于从近距离伏击猎物。

column1: This version uses enough 改进的 Jump Jets to vault up to 150 米 at a time. Nineteen double heat sinks keep the heat from three ER Large Lasers and two 中型脉冲激光s in check. The IIC 5 is a capable mobile sniper. 怪癖: 集成探照灯 掉落成本乘数: 1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 该型号安装了足够的改进型跳跃喷射器，一次可跃过150米。十九组双散热器控制三门ER大型激光和两门中型激光产生的热量。IIC 5是一台能力出色的机动狙击机甲。 特性：改进型侦察 击杀倍率：1.15 左上部装甲，右上部装甲

column1: Mad Cat II设计成功后，该设计增加了Mad Cat的吨位和武器配置，幽灵熊氏族将这些改进同样应用于中型Ryoken。The ''Gunboat'' variant carries a heavier weapons payload. 特性：Stable 部署成本倍率：1.15 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 在Mad Cat II取得成功后，这个型号重新思考了Mad Cat的定位，将这些改进应用到Ryoken的机体上。“炮艇”变体携带更重的武器载荷。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.15 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: Mad Cat II设计成功后，该设计增加了Mad Cat的吨位和武器配置，幽灵熊氏族将这些改进同样应用于中型Ryoken。The ''Gunboat'' variant carries a heavier weapons payload.
column2: 在Mad Cat II取得成功后，这个型号重新思考了Mad Cat的定位，将这些改进应用到Ryoken的机体上。“炮艇”变体携带更重的武器载荷。

column1: The Satyr Proto机甲 was 设计ed to serve as a deep raider and reconnaissance unit. Offering only slightly more protection than a Harpy or Siren, the Satyr's best defense is to remain hidden from enemy units. Developed during the Jihad, this 设计 improves upon the intended spotter role with the addition of a Clan Light TAG. It is only armed with a torso mounted AP Gauss Rifle.
column2: 萨提尔原型机甲的设计目标是执行深入敌后的袭击和侦察任务。它提供的防护只比哈比或塞壬略强，最好的防御就是不被敌军发现。该机甲在圣战期间开发，通过加入星盟轻型TAG改进了原本的目标指示任务。它仅装备一挺安装在躯干上的AP高斯步枪。

column1: The Satyr Proto机甲 was 设计ed to serve as a deep raider and reconnaissance unit. Offering only slightly more protection than a Harpy or Siren, the Satyr's best defense is to remain hidden from enemy units.  开发 by 氏族新星猫 to support battle 装甲 formations, The Satyr-XP has a lower maximum speed (97 km/h) and adds a 180 meter jump capability. To make room for the jump jets, the weapons were replaced by a single SRM-2 with ten reloads.
column2: 萨提尔原型机甲的设计目标是执行深入敌后的袭击和侦察任务。它提供的防护只比哈比或塞壬略强，最好的防御就是不被敌军发现。为支援战斗装甲编队，萨提尔-XP降低了最高速度（97公里/小时），并增加了180米的跳跃能力。为容纳跳跃喷射器，原有武器被替换为一具配备十发弹药的SRM-2。

column1: The B configuration excels at close-quarters combat in restricted terrain, such as an urban environment. Seven improved jump jets enable the Septicemia to leap up to 210 米 in the air. Two 大型脉冲激光s and three 小型脉冲激光s allow the 机甲Warrior to make full use of the '机甲's jumping capabilities and still be accurate. Additional heat sinks keep heat levels under control.
column2: B配置擅长在城市等受限地形进行近距离战斗。七具改进型跳跃喷射器让脓毒症能够跃至210米高空。两门中型激光和三门小型激光使这台战斗机甲可以充分利用跳跃能力，并保持准确射击。额外的散热器帮助控制热量。

column1: Based on configuration C, this Septicemia is also intended for battle against conventional forces. Three plasma cannons, six AP Gauss rifles, and six machine guns in two machine gun arrays provide devastating firepower against conventional infantry and 车辆s. Two medium pulse lasers in each arm deal with more heavily 装甲ed foes, while still remaining effective against infantry. Finally, the Society's engineers equipped this model with a Nova CEWS.
column2: 这台脓毒症以C配置为基础，同样用于对抗常规部队。三门等离子炮、六挺AP高斯步枪，以及两个机枪阵列中的六挺机枪，能对常规步兵和战斗装甲造成毁灭性火力。双臂各装两门中型脉冲激光，用来对付更重装甲的敌人，同时仍能有效压制步兵。最后，星盟工程师为该型号装备了一套Nova综合电子战系统。

column1: Based on the D configuration, this version mounts an ER PPC and Ultra AC/20, both of which are tied into a 定位 Computer. It also has five jump jets. The Small Lasers of the D configuration are replaced by a Nova CEWS.
column2: 该型号以D配置为基础，安装一门ER PPC和一门超强AC/20，两者都接入瞄准计算机。它还拥有五具跳跃喷射器。D配置的小型激光被一套Nova综合电子战系统取代。

column1: Based on the Infernus, the custom config of Opacus Venatori member Adept Havalah Cazer carries a Brandt DragonMaw Ultra AC/20 supplied with a whopping six tons of reloads supported by a Ramtech 9500V Large and 5500V Medium 变速脉冲激光. While a 定位 Computer ensures she hits what she targets, a Brandt Whipsaw 反导系统 wards off missile fire for as long as it single ton of reloads lasts. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 这套配置以地狱火为基础，是欧帕库斯猎手组织助理领唱阿德普特·哈瓦拉·卡泽尔的定制机。它装备Brandt龙噬超强AC/20，并携带足足六吨装填弹药；同时由Ramtech 9500V大型激光和5500V中型激光提供支援。瞄准计算机确保她能击中目标，而Brandt劈锯导弹防御系统则能在一吨备用弹药耗尽前持续拦截导弹。 特性：改进型传感器 击杀倍率：1.12 左下部装甲：全向

column1: Based on the Infernus, the custom config of Opacus Venatori member Adept Havalah Cazer carries a Brandt DragonMaw Ultra AC/20 supplied with a whopping six tons of reloads supported by a Ramtech 9500V Large and 5500V Medium 变速脉冲激光. While a 定位 Computer ensures she hits what she targets, a Brandt Whipsaw 反导系统 wards off missile fire for as long as it single ton of reloads lasts.
column2: 这套配置以地狱火为基础，是欧帕库斯猎手组织助理领唱阿德普特·哈瓦拉·卡泽尔的定制机。它装备Brandt龙噬超强AC/20，并携带足足六吨装填弹药；同时由Ramtech 9500V大型激光和5500V中型激光提供支援。瞄准计算机确保她能击中目标，而Brandt劈锯导弹防御系统则能在一吨备用弹药耗尽前持续拦截导弹。

column1: This is a custom, heavily modified Shootist by Precentor Apollyon, commander of the Word of Blake Shadow Divisions. Apart from the Gauss Rifle, which was kept from the C9 Shootist variant the rest of the weaponry was changed into various type of PPCs and the whole mechs skeleton 结构 was rebuilt into Endo Steel.
column2: 这是文字之神阴影师团指挥官阿波利昂领唱定制并大幅改装的射手机甲。除了从C9射手变体保留的高斯步枪外，其他武器全部更换为不同型号的PPC，整台机甲的骨架也重建为内骨骼结构。

column1: This refit of the 2B variant replaces the standard autocannon with a pair of 等离子步枪s. Though amazingly effective against battle 装甲, the 等离子步枪s can quickly run out of ammunition. Like many other newly manufactured machines the variant contains Stealth 装甲 for better protection.
column2: 这次改装以2B变体为基础，用一对短管步枪替换了标准自动火炮。短管步枪对战斗装甲极其有效，但弹药会很快耗尽。和许多新制造的机体一样，该变体配备隐形装甲以获得更好的防护。

column1: A more radical variant removes the jump jets and mounts an ER Large Laser and twin ER 中型激光器. It retains the Stealth 装甲 and Guardian ECM, but adds a Targeting Computer to make the lasers more accurate. MASC enables the ST to move in bursts up to 151 km/h.
column2: 更激进的变体移除了跳跃喷射器，换装一门ER大型激光和双联ER中型激光。它保留隐形装甲与守护者ECM，并增加瞄准计算机以提高激光精度。MASC使ST能够以最高151公里/小时的速度短时突进。

column1: Debuting in 3072, the Sprite SPT-15 is one of the Society’s premier frontline ‘Superheavy’ Proto机甲s. 设计 as a highly survivable, highly mobile fire support unit, the Sprite mates four LRM5 launchers to a rugged chassis fitted with five Extended Jump Jets and 3.25 tons of 装甲, over 20% of the unit’s mass. While not the most mobile unit on the ground, and a little light on ammunition, grouped Sprite formations have proved to be a lethal and stubborn foe to dislodge time and time again.
column2: Sprite SPT-15于3072年亮相，是星盟最优秀的前线“超重型”原型机甲之一。它被设计成生存力和机动性都很高的火力支援单位，坚固的机体搭载四具LRM-5发射器、五具延伸跳跃喷射器和3.25吨装甲，装甲超过全机质量的20%。它在地面上的机动性并非顶尖，弹药也略显不足，但成群行动的Sprite编队一次又一次证明自己是难以击退的致命敌人。

column1: Taking something of an alternate approach to the same battlefield niche, the Sprite 2 trades it’s quartet of LRM launchers for a single ‘Mech-scale ERLL. While it lacks the raw offensive power of the 1, it is able to deal highly concentrated damage, and turns the Sprite into a mobile, hardy, and lethal sniping platform. Both patterns operate with great synergy, the 2 punching holes in 装甲 for the 1’s launchers to exploit, much to the chagrin of forces facing the Society in combat.
column2: Sprite 2以不同方式承担同一战场职责，用一门机甲规模的ER大型激光替换了四具LRM发射器。它缺少1型的持续火力，却能集中造成高额伤害，使Sprite成为机动、坚固而致命的狙击平台。两种型号配合默契：2型先在装甲上打孔，1型的导弹随后便能从缺口中倾泻而入，让面对星盟的部队苦不堪言。

column1: A stark departure from the standard 设计 doctrine of the Sprite, the 3 mounts a pair of the new Fusillade launcher systems, backed by a pair of Medium 化学激光s. While limited in it’s main punch and entirely dependent on ammunition, the sheer versatility in available munition types for the Fusillade system allow it a great degree of battlefield versatility, from dealing heavy direct damage to disabling and overheating hostile 车辆s and Battle机甲s. 怪癖: Resilient 掉落成本乘数: 0.99
column2: Sprite 3大幅偏离了标准的原型机甲设计理念，安装一对新式齐射发射系统，并由一对中型脉冲激光提供支援。它的直接火力有限且完全依赖弹药，但齐射系统拥有丰富的弹种，因而能灵活应对战场：既可造成重型直接伤害，也能瘫痪并过热敌方战斗装甲和战斗机甲。 特性：坚韧 击杀倍率：0.99

column1: A stark departure from the standard 设计 doctrine of the Sprite, the 3 mounts a pair of the new Fusillade launcher systems, backed by a pair of Medium 化学激光s. While limited in it’s main punch and entirely dependent on ammunition, the sheer versatility in available munition types for the Fusillade system allow it a great degree of battlefield versatility, from dealing heavy direct damage to disabling and overheating hostile 车辆s and Battle机甲s.
column2: Sprite 3大幅偏离了标准的原型机甲设计理念，安装一对新式齐射发射系统，并由一对中型脉冲激光提供支援。它的直接火力有限且完全依赖弹药，但齐射系统拥有丰富的弹种，因而能灵活应对战场：既可造成重型直接伤害，也能瘫痪并过热敌方战斗装甲和战斗机甲。

column1: A Jihad-era repair yard refit of the venerable Stinger unveiled in 3071, the 3P was built on an Endo Steel chassis and carried, as its only weapon, either a Fusigon Mini or a Lord's Light 3 Light PPC capable of striking a target at up to five hundred and forty 米.
column2: 这是一台在圣战时期修理厂改装、于3071年公开的老式毒刺机甲。3P采用内骨骼结构，唯一武器是Fusigon迷你PPC或领主之光3轻型PPC，射程可达五百四十米。

column1: A 氏族地狱马 variant made use of two 大型脉冲激光s in each arm and two ATM 9s with four tons of ammo in the torso. Two ER Micro Lasers to protect the 'Mech's rear arc, while the other equipment was removed to add heat sinks. 特性：扰乱 部署成本倍率：1.24 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 该星盟变体双臂各安装两门中型激光，并在躯干中装有两具ATM-9和四吨弹药。两门ER微型激光负责保护机甲后方，其他设备则被拆除以腾出空间增加散热器。 特性：精准 击杀倍率：1.24 左上部装甲，右上部装甲

column1: A 氏族地狱马 variant made use of two 大型脉冲激光s in each arm and two ATM 9s with four tons of ammo in the torso. Two ER Micro Lasers to protect the 'Mech's rear arc, while the other equipment was removed to add heat sinks.
column2: 该星盟变体双臂各安装两门中型激光，并在躯干中装有两具ATM-9和四吨弹药。两门ER微型激光负责保护机甲后方，其他设备则被拆除以腾出空间增加散热器。

column1: This Society variant carries an iATM 9 with three tons of ammunition and an Improved Heavy 中型激光 in each arm. To offset the lower skills of The Society's MechWarriors, it also mounts a Nova CEWS.
column2: 这台星盟变体携带一具iATM-9和三吨弹药，双臂各安装一门改进型重型中型激光。为弥补星盟机甲战士较低的技能，它还配备了一套Nova综合电子战系统。

column1: Hey Boss, the clans call these things the Summoner but I've always called em' the Thor.  These Omni机甲s are a tad light on available pod space for their weight class and those early structural mounts are not compatible with anything else. But with that huge 引擎 and lots of Jump Jet hardpoints you will be hard pressed to find many '机甲s its size that are faster. There is something a little off about this particular one and it appears to be a repurposed underwater model. Look at all these watertight seals on everything!
column2: 老板，星族把这些东西叫作召唤者，但我一直称它们为雷神。这些全能机甲对于自身重量级别来说可用挂载空间偏少，早期的结构挂点也不兼容其他设备。不过，凭借那台巨大的引擎和大量跳跃喷射器挂点，很难找到同级别中比它更快的机甲。这一台似乎有些不对劲，看起来像是改造自水下型号。看看这些遍布全身的水密封条！

column1: Boss, I don't know how this got past the design review board, but this thing has two Sniper 火炮 pieces and nothing else. If anything gets in close, there isn't much it can do. However, those cannons will pulverize most things that are unfortunate enough to be spotted.
column2: 老板，我不知道这东西怎么通过了设计审查，但它只有两门狙击炮，除此之外什么也没有。敌人一旦近身，它几乎无计可施。不过，那些火炮能把任何不幸被发现的目标轰成碎片。

column1: 另一种comm和 variation, th是配置 安装 a C3 Master computer. It 携带 three 中型脉冲激光s, a Heavy PPC, 和 a 轻型高斯步枪. Four jump jets give it a 120 meter jump 射程.
column2: 这是一个通讯型变体，安装了一台C3主计算机。它装备三门中型激光、一门重型PPC和一挺机枪。四具跳跃喷射器让它能够跳跃120米。

column1: This variation carries an MRM-30 with Apollo FCS in each arm. These are supported by a pair of Light PPCs. An ER Flamer provides anti-infantry support, and a 定位 Computer enhances the accuracy of the energy weapons. A C3 Slave unit allows the Templar to share targeting data with lancemates, and additional mobility is provided via four jump jets.
column2: 该变体双臂各携带一具配有阿波罗火控系统的MRM-30，并由一对轻型PPC提供支援。一门ER火焰喷射器负责反步兵作战，瞄准计算机则提升能量武器的精度。C3从属单元让圣殿骑士能够与同编队成员共享目标数据，四具跳跃喷射器进一步提供机动性。

column1: A newer weapon configuration, the 2PA is designed for work against domestic insurgents. It has a pair of Plasma Rifles, four 中型激光器, retains the Streak SRM launcher, and mounts two Machine Gun Arrays, each with four Machine Guns. It can also utilize a Beagle Active Probe to find hidden units.
column2: 这是一套更新的武器配置，2PA专门用于对付国内叛乱分子。它装备一对等离子步枪、四门ER中型激光，保留连射SRM发射器，并安装两个机枪阵列，每个阵列装有四挺机枪。它还可使用猎犬主动探测器寻找隐藏单位。

column1: This Taurian variant does not use mimetic 装甲, opting instead for standard 装甲 that is easier to replace. It usually mounts a much easier to maintain Medium Recoilless Rifle, which actually deals half as much damage as the standard 等离子步枪, but is supplied with twice as much ammunition. 特性：Accurate 部署成本倍率：0.89 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。
column2: 该陶里安变体不再使用拟态装甲，而是采用更容易更换的标准装甲。它通常安装一门更易维护的中型无后坐力步枪；这件武器造成的伤害只有标准短管步枪的一半，但配备了两倍弹药。 特性：精准 击杀倍率：0.89 可安装全方位垂直起降战斗群袭击

column1: The Tunder Wolf 3 variant removes an additional three tons of 装甲 and two of the 中型激光器 from the second variant. An additional ER PPC was added, though this necessitated the removal of the 瞄准计算机 and the 锁定式SRM-4 of the base design. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 雷霆狼3型从第二型上进一步减少三吨装甲，并拆下两门ER中型激光。它新增一门ER PPC，但因此不得不移除基础设计中的瞄准计算机和连射SRM-4。 特性：改进型耐久 击杀倍率：1.17 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: Introduced during the Jihad in 3070, the 都市机甲 IIC 2 swaps the autocannon and laser for a Class 20 超重型突击高斯 Rifle with 2 tons of ammunition and a Flamer.
column2: 灰熊IIC 2于3070年圣战期间推出，用一门20级火炮高斯步枪、两吨弹药和一具火焰喷射器替换了原有的自动火炮与激光器。

column1: Built on Solaris VII, the Valiant K7 is a light skirmisher that relies on a trio of ER 中型激光s, a deadly Hatchet, and MASC.
column2: 勇士K7在太阳神七号建造，是一台依靠三门ER中型激光、致命战斧和MASC作战的轻型游击机甲。

column1: A desperate field refit of the Confederations existing VND-1AA’s, the 1AAX was intensely loathed by the warriors assigned to it. Possessing less 装甲 and weaponry than many comparable mechs, the 1AAX was 设计ed as a highly mobile battlefield sniper; but struggled to survive once engaged by the enemy. A 部分机翼 significantly boosted the 设计s mobility, whilst an 驱动器增强系统 bolstered the accuracy of the HPPC that constituted most of the 设计s firepower. The 小型X脉冲激光 Laser and ER 中型激光 were insufficient firepower for anything other than anti-infantry work, posing little threat to heavily 装甲ed targets. The inclusion of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 allowed the 设计 team to somewhat improve protection, even if it still fell far behind that off other comparable mechs, whilst the Laser AMS provided a degree of protection against incoming missiles. Unsurprisingly the 设计 suffered high losses in combat and many mech warriors refused their assignments; only accepting them once the alternatives were made clear. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 这是对联邦现有VND-1AA的绝望战地改装，分配到它的战士都深恶痛绝。1AAX的装甲和武器少于许多同级机甲，却被定位为高度机动的战场狙击手；一旦遭到敌人接战，它往往难以生存。超级充能器显著提升了机甲的机动性，改进型瞄准系统则提高了HPPC的命中率，而HPPC是它大部分火力的来源。小型X脉冲激光和ER中型激光的火力只够反步兵，对重装甲目标几乎没有威胁。加入强化装甲后，维护组多少改善了防护，但它仍远逊于其他同级机甲；激光AMS则提供了一定的来袭导弹防御。毫不意外，1AAX在战斗中损失惨重，许多机甲战士拒绝接受这项任务，除非他们清楚地知道没有其他选择。 特性：脆弱 击杀倍率：1.03 右下部装甲

column1: This custom-设计ed model is piloted by a Capellan bounty hunter, who goes by the moniker Dao. It has been rebuilt using Clan-technology heat sinks, 铁纤维装甲 装甲, and Endo Steel. A Clan ER PPC is the primary weapon, and the '机甲 also carries a Battle机甲 Taser to aid in capturing targets alive. A Supercharger and an 驱动器增强系统 add to the Vindicator's speed and accuracy.
column2: 这台定制型号由一名坎培拉赏金猎人驾驶，代号“道”。它使用星盟技术散热器、强化装甲和内骨骼结构重建。主要武器是一门星盟ER PPC，同时还携带一件战斗机甲电击器，以便活捉目标。超级充能器和改进型瞄准系统提升了维克多的速度与精度。

column1: It's a decent '机甲, and the 守护者ECM can be useful on the battlefield. But it would have been nice to have better sensors too, so it could be used as a scout.
column2: 这是一台还算不错的机甲，守护者ECM在战场上很有用。不过，如果传感器也能更好一些就好了，那样它就能真正承担侦察任务。

column1: A 布雷克圣言会 variant of the Wolverine, which as most of their variants use a lot of modern tech.
column2: 一款布雷克圣言会的狼獾变体；与他们大多数变体一样，采用了大量现代技术。

column1: Another Solaris custom, the Wolverine X was 设计ed by a wealthy Heir to compete in the Arenas as a pasttime.
column2: 另一款索拉里斯定制型号，狼獾 X 由一位富有的继承人设计，用于在竞技场参赛消遣。

column1: Drawn on a blank sheet of paper in a museum on Terra, this marvelous craft was inspired by an ancient airplane that followed a curious 设计 ethos. Rather than 设计ing a plane and then mounting weapons, They 设计ed a gun before mounting a plane on it. The same holds true here. 生物群系限制: 该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动: 8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 15 左侧 125 15 右侧 125 15 后方 100 15 总计 525 75 怪癖: 精准 Weapon - PPC
column2: 这台出色的载具是在泰拉博物馆的一张白纸上构思的，灵感来自一架遵循奇特设计理念的古老飞机。与其先设计飞机再安装武器，他们先设计火炮，再在其上安装飞机。本机也是如此。 生物群系限制: 该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动: 8/12 格 / 240/360 米. 装甲: 重型铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 160 15 左侧 125 15 右侧 125 15 后方 100 15 总计 525 75 怪癖: 精准武器 - PPC

The variant only retains the twin ER 中型激光器 of the base model while it replaces all other equipment. A XL Fusion 引擎 replaces the 标准聚变, making room for new weaponry while doubling its 装甲 protection. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 3/5 格 / 90/150 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲(氏族) 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 360 40 左侧 280 40 右侧 280 40 后方 180 40 炮塔 220 40 总计 1320 200 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - Medium

An 全向 vehicle, it mounts a fusion 引擎 and 6 tons of 装甲 plate, with a 4 ton infantry bay and 5 tons of pod space for weapons. This version carries a single Light PPC and SRM-2 in its turret. 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 格 / 180/270 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 110 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后方 70 15 炮塔 90 15 总计 450 75 特性：防护机构 全向 Vehicle Can carry 1 战斗装甲 Squads. Has firing ports.
column2: 轻型履带式装甲运兵车獾由狼之龙骑兵团引入内圈。作为全向载具，它装有聚变引擎和 6 吨装甲板，配备 4 吨步兵舱以及可容纳武器的 5 吨模块舱空间。该版本在炮塔中搭载一门轻型 PPC 和一具 SRM-2。 生物群系限制：无。 移动：6/9 格 / 180/270 米. 装甲： 装甲 结构： 结构 数值 A S 前方 110 15 左侧 90 15 右侧 90 15 后方 70 15 炮塔 90 15 总计 450 75 特性：防护机构 全向载具 可搭载 1 个战斗装甲小队。配有射击孔。

column1: Despite the original being introduced in 2564 updated Condors are still in production as of the start of the 32nd Century. Substantial 装甲 of at least six tons and various mid and long range weapon packages keep the Condor relevant. A heavy cavalry unit 设计ed for rapid reaction to a shifting battle, the Condor was one of the few heavy hover 坦克s available at the time of it's introduction. This immense hovercraft is capable of a flank speed of 129 km/h and a cruising speed of 86 km/h, making it one of the fastest 车辆s in its weight class. 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 9/14 格 / 270/420 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 175 25 左侧 105 25 右侧 105 25 后方 75 25 炮塔 100 25 总计 560 125 怪癖: 快速起步
column2: 尽管最初于 2564 年投入使用，更新后的神鹰在 32 世纪初仍在生产。至少六吨的厚重装甲以及各种中远程武器套件，让神鹰始终具备战斗力。神鹰是一款为应对战局变化而设计的快速反应重型骑兵单位；在问世时，它是少数可用的重型气垫坦克之一。这艘庞大的气垫载具最高侧向速度可达 129 千米/时，巡航速度为 86 千米/时，使其成为同重量级中速度最快的载具之一。 生物群系限制: 无. 移动: 9/14 格 / 270/420 米. 装甲: 铁纤维装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前方 175 25 左侧 105 25 右侧 105 25 后方 75 25 炮塔 100 25 总计 560 125 怪癖: 快速起步

column1: 3 x Gauss Rifles mounted in the 炮塔, which is linked to a 定位 Computer and a C3 Slave. The 车辆's 引擎 is downgraded to a 200 XL Fusion, and its 装甲 reduced by two and half tons. Named for Morgan Hasek-Davion, the DI Morgan was created as fire support 车辆 as a replacement of the aging Schrek PPC carrier in House Steiner's armed forces.
