column2: 黄蜂以波兰C型高斯步枪为核心建造。后续版本安装了其他系统，但始终围绕一件重型武器进行设计。虽然速度不及大多数垂直起降机，它仍比大多数战斗装甲和全能机甲更快。远程武器、可靠的速度和相对厚重的装甲，让这台载具比许多同类单位更安全。 生物群系限制：该单位无法在月球生物群系部署。 移动：9/14 米/秒 / 270/420 米。 装甲: 反应式装甲 结构: 结构 数值 A S 前部 125 15 左侧 100 15 右侧 100 15 后部 90 15 总计 430 75 特性: 突破一击

column1: Boss, this thing has as much 装甲 as an assault mech and it ain't no pirate junkhead doing it either, it was purposely designed like this for some reason. Sure, it's heavily armored but it's gonna need it because it's gonna be outpaced by even dismounted infantry..at a walk.
column2: 老板，这东西的装甲和一台突击机甲一样厚，而且可不是哪个海盗废物随便拼出来的，它似乎就是出于某种原因被刻意设计成这样。没错，它装甲极厚，但这是必要的，因为就算是徒步步兵慢慢走，也能超过它的速度。

column1: This model is 生产 by both Oriente Weapon Works and 卡隆工业 using the latest innovations to move the Rifleman towards a more prominent role again. Compared to its brother 设计, the RFL-7N2, the RFL-7N focuses more on direct energy weapons over ballistics. This model is 生产 by both Oriente Weapon Works and 卡隆工业, although not in as great numbers as the -7N2. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这台型号由东方武器工坊与卡隆工业共同制造，采用最新技术，试图让射手重新承担更重要的角色。与其兄弟型号RFL-7N2相比，RFL-7N更偏重直接能量武器，而非弹道武器。两家公司也制造了该型号，但产量不如-7N2。 特性：防空单位 击杀倍率：1.08 左上部装甲，右上部装甲

column1: A collaboration between Oriente Weapon Works and Kallon of Talon, the RFL-7N2 carries two LB/X 10 Autocannons, 2 Light PPCs and 2 ER 中型激光s. To fit the weaponry the 'Mech uses a 240 XL引擎, but does come with CASE II to protect the volatile ammunition bins.
column2: 东方武器工坊与塔隆的卡隆工业合作制造了RFL-7N2。它携带两门LB/X 10自动火炮、2门轻型PPC和2门ER中型激光。为容纳这些武器，机甲使用240额定功率的XL引擎，并配备CASE II保护易爆弹药舱。

column1: Well, this is new, Commander! 氏族地狱马 has developed a brand-new BattleMech inspired by the Arion Quadvee, and they're calling it the Jumping Jack. This thing is a beast! It's armed with a bunch of AP Gauss rifles, perfect for short-range engagements. And the best part? It's got jump jets for enhanced mobility, maxed 装甲 for increased durability, and its unique quadrupedal design allows it to move swiftly across the battlefield. This bad boy is going to be a hunter of infantry and battle 装甲 units, clearing the way for our forces. I can't wait to see it in action, Commander. This is going to be a game-changer for us!
column2: 指挥官，这可是新东西！星盟制造了一台受Arion四足车启发的全新战斗机甲，并把它命名为跳跃杰克。这东西强得惊人，装备大量AP高斯步枪，非常适合近距离交战。更棒的是，它拥有跳跃喷射器来增强机动性，最大化装甲来提高耐久；独特的四足结构还能让它迅速穿越战场。这家伙会专门猎杀步兵和战斗装甲单位，为我们的部队扫清道路。我迫不及待想看它投入战斗，指挥官。这将彻底改变战局！

column1: A dark ages variant of the Blackjack, replacing almost every part of it with update clan technology. The '机甲 mainly sees use within the Inner Sphere clans and their allies as well as with the Wolf's Dragoons. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 1.09 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是黑暗时代的黑杰克变体，几乎每个部件都换成了更新的星盟技术。该机甲主要由内圈星族及其盟友，以及狼之龙骑兵使用。 特性：长距离转向 击杀倍率：1.09 左上部装甲，右上部装甲

column1: Here We Have the OG Variant Of The Blackjack Omni机甲. This Loadout Replaces The UAC/5's With Twin RAC AC/5's For Added Punch.
column2: 这是黑杰克全能机甲的原始配置。该装载用双联RAC AC/5替换了UAC/5，以获得更强的爆发火力。

column1: This Dark Age version of the 黑骑士 uses a 轻型引擎 to reach a top speed of 54 km/h. It also has an advanced Endo-Composite skeleton protected by thirteen and a half tons of 装甲. Seventeen Clan-spec double heat sinks keep heat load under control. The right arm carries a Medium Shield, and it has an advanced 定位 Computer. Its weaponry is all Clan-spec. An ER PPC, two ER Large Lasers, two ER 中型激光s, two ER Small Lasers and twin 小型脉冲激光s arm the 黑骑士.
column2: 这个黑暗时代版本的武士使用一台超级充能器，最高速度达到54公里/小时。先进的内骨骼复合结构由十三吨半装甲保护。十七组星盟规格双散热器控制热负荷。右臂携带一面中型盾牌，机体还配备先进的瞄准计算机。所有武器均为星盟规格：一门ER PPC、两门ER大型激光、两门ER中型激光、两门ER小型激光，以及双联中型脉冲激光。

column1: This Bombard variant uses engines and 紧凑型散热器s originally intended for the HNT-181 Hornet. It also carries 轻型高斯步枪s and a 变色龙光极化护盾.
column2: 这台轰炸型使用原本为HNT-181黄蜂设计的引擎和散热器。它还携带重型高斯步枪和一套彩虹光谱干扰系统。

column1: Commander, the 地狱战马 have 开发 a new configuration for the Boreas Prime that focuses on long-range fire support. They've equipped it with a 20-tubed Streak LRM and two tons of ammunition. This will allow it to rain down missiles on enemy positions from afar, providing invaluable support to our ground forces. It won't be as effective up close, so we'll need to pair it with some heavier mechs to protect it in case of close-range engagements. Overall, I think it's a solid addition to our arsenal and I'm looking forward to seeing it in action.
column2: 指挥官，星盟为北风至尊开发了一套专注远程火力支援的新配置。他们装备了一具20管连射LRM和两吨弹药。这样它就能从远处向敌方阵地倾泻导弹，为地面部队提供宝贵支援。近距离作战时它的效率会下降，因此需要与更重型的机甲协同，防止敌人接近。总的来说，这是加入我们军械库的可靠力量，我很期待看到它投入战斗。

column1: Commander, the 地狱战马 have 开发 another variant of the Boreas, known as Configuration C. This one is a generalist configuration, equipped with an ATM-12 missile launcher for long-range attacks and two ER 中型激光器 for closer engagements. The scientists have also managed to allow it to carry up to three tons of ammunition, giving it plenty of staying power on the battlefield. It's a versatile configuration that can adapt to a variety of situations, making it a valuable addition to any lance.
column2: 指挥官，星盟还为北风开发了另一种名为C配置的变体。这是一套通用配置，装备ATM-12导弹发射器进行远程攻击，并以两门ER中型激光应对近距离目标。科学家还让它能够携带最多三吨弹药，从而拥有很强的战场持续力。它能适应多种情况，是任何机甲小队都很有价值的成员。

column1: The Catapult II retains the original's movement, jump capabilities and has a half ton more 装甲 protection than its predecessor. The Catapult's most notable weapons are its two TSEMP磁脉冲炮s mounted in the side torsos, which allow it to potentially disable an enemy '机甲. Serving as back up are more conventional weapons, a pair of 多元光学 Sunfire Extended Range 中型激光s that are located in the center torso. A Chameleon Light Polarization Suite is integrated into the chassis as well.
column2: 弹射者II保留了原型的移动力和跳跃能力，装甲防护比前代多半吨。它最醒目的武器是安装在两侧躯干的两具TSEMP炮，可以使敌方机甲暂时失效。作为备用火力，中央躯干安装了一对双元太阳火延伸射程中型激光。机体还整合了一套变色龙轻型偏振套件。

column1: Cuchulainn Support 装甲 was named for a hero from Irish mythology and was the product of a joint program between Clan Wolf-in-Exile and the Kell Hounds. Limited to moving at just over 10 km/h while carrying its Detachable Weapon Pack, Cuchulainn suits were designed to provide direct firepower support to other battle 装甲 units, engaging enemy units at long range while lighter suits swarmed units that attempted to get close to the Cuchulainns. Almost half a ton of improved stealth 装甲 helped protect the Cuchulainns while they engaged the enemy at range, but while the Cuchulainn mounted a Basic Manipulator on each arm and could ride on mechanized transport it was incapable of making swarm or leg attacks.
column2: 库丘林支援战斗装甲以爱尔兰神话中的英雄命名，是狼之流亡星族与凯尔猎犬联合计划的产物。携带可拆卸武器包时，它的速度被限制在略高于10公里/小时；这些战斗装甲旨在为其他战斗装甲单位提供直接火力支援，在轻型战斗装甲围攻试图接近的敌人时，从远距离交战。近半吨改进型隐形装甲帮助库丘林在远距离作战时保持生存；但它虽然双臂各安装一个基础操纵器，也能搭乘机械化运输工具，却无法发动集群攻击或腿部攻击。

column1: It's a decent '机甲, but it does suffer from not using more recent technological breakthroughs. Still, there are a lot worse ones out there.
column2: 这是一台还算不错的机甲，但它没有采用较新的技术突破，性能因此受到限制。不过，外面还有很多更糟的型号。

column1: A Dark Age variant first 生产 in 3148, the 灭绝者 EXT-7X is used by the 球体共和国 for special operations work. Built around a 325-rated XXL 引擎, it is slower then most other 灭绝者 models; though a Supercharger and Stealth 装甲 help to alleviate this issue. An MRM-10 and 4 Medium VSPLs make up the 机甲s armament with a Laser AMS providing additional protection against missiles.
column2: 这是3148年首次服役的黑暗时代变体，猎鹰者EXT-7X由星盟用于特种作战。它围绕325额定功率的XXL引擎建造，速度比大多数猎鹰者型号更慢；超级充能器和隐形装甲可以缓解这一问题。它的武器包括一具MRM-10和4门中型变速脉冲激光，激光AMS则提供额外的导弹防御。

column1: The Falconer FLC-11R solves the most common complaint of the FLC-9R, the slightly low amount of 装甲. By switching to the use of 轻型铁纤维装甲-Fibrous 装甲, another 1.5 tons of effective 装甲 was added. The 设计 also upgrades the 中型激光s to Extended Range variants. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.11 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 猎鹰者FLC-11R解决了FLC-9R最常见的问题：装甲略显不足。改用强化纤维装甲后，它增加了1.5吨有效装甲。该机甲还将中型激光升级为延伸射程型号。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.11 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: Designed for long-range combat, the Gambit was a solid, light BattleMech, the second 'Mech to have been brought to market by Adam Tech Industries. Straightforward to maintain and built around some of the most popular items on the market including 装甲 plating, heat sinks, and myomer bundles, the Gambit was very popular with 'Mech technicians following its entry to service in 3136. Adding to the Gambit's appeal for MechWarriors was the cockpit, which in addition to featuring a reliable emergency release mechanism, was also armored to resist battle 装甲-scale weapons for at least 10 seconds - a feature clearly intended to make the Gambit suitable for use in the battlefields of the Dark Ages.
column2: 甘比特专为远程战斗设计，是一台坚固的轻型战斗机甲，也是亚当科技工业推向市场的第二款机甲。它易于维护，采用市场上最受欢迎的装甲板、散热器和肌束等部件；自3136年服役后，深受机甲技师欢迎。驾驶舱进一步提升了甘比特对机甲战士的吸引力：除了配备可靠的紧急脱离机构，还能抵御战斗装甲规模武器至少10秒的攻击，这一设计显然是为了让甘比特适应黑暗时代的战场。

column1: The increased presence of Sea Fox traders on Son Hoa has lead to the introduction of the unusual -9SF. Only 生产 by special request, the -9SF is almost always seen in Shoal Clusters (where it is considered a somewhat better prospect for glory in battle than most Industrial机甲s). Some merchants bring them on trade ships to increase cargo space by combining Battle机甲 and Industrial机甲 capabilities in a single bay, but finding pilots can be difficult; few Trueborn warriors are willing to be perceived as glorified stevedores, leaving freeborn, solahma, or contract pilots as the go-to options for such expeditions.
column2: 海狐贸易商在松华的活动日益增加，促成了不寻常的-9SF问世。该-9SF它只有在特殊请求下才会制造，几乎总能在浅滩集群中看到；在那里，与大多数工业机甲相比，它被认为更有机会在战斗中赢得荣耀。一些商人把它们带上贸易船，通过在同一货舱中结合战斗机甲和工业机甲的能力来增加货运空间。但飞行员很难寻找：很少有真生战士愿意被视为高级搬运工，因此自由生、索尔玛或合同飞行员成了这类远征的常见人选。

column1: Another laser focused configuration, the T loads 2 Improved Heavy 中型激光s, an Improved Heavy Small Laser, a 大型脉冲激光 and an ER Small Laser. A SRM6 with 1 ton of ammunition is added as extra support.
column2: 这是一套同样专注激光的配置。T型装备2门改进型重型中型激光、一门改进型重型小型激光、一门中型激光和一门ER小型激光，另加一具配备1吨弹药的SRM6作为支援。

column1: What is now known as the Hellcat had its humble origins in a Clan's desperation nearly a century ago. One of the many projects born out of 氏族新星猫's post-Abjurement rebuilding program was a radical take on the Conjurer BattleMech. Jade Falcon merchants took advantage of their old rival's panic, swapping sorely needed raw materials for access to the Cats' ballooning catalog of 'Mech chassis. Falcon technicians and scientists reworked an atypical Conjurer variant to emphasize flexible firepower over the Nova Cat model's speed and energy-based weaponry. Named as a subtle wink to both the BattleMech's creators and the Conjurer's Spheroid name, their early Hellcat saw only limited production before the Jihad.
column2: 如今被称为地狱猫的机甲，起源于近一个世纪前某个星族的绝望。它是星族解盟后重建计划的众多项目之一，也是对召唤者战斗机甲的一次激进改造。玉蜥星族商人利用老对手的恐慌，以急需的原材料换取大量机甲骨架。猎鹰技术人员和科学家重新设计了一种非典型的召唤者变体，强调灵活火力，而不是新星猫型号的速度与能量武器。早期地狱猫的名称同时向机甲创造者和召唤者的球状星域名称致意，但在圣战前只进行了有限生产。

column1: One of the most popular Star League BattleMechs, many a Highlander accompanied General Aleksandr Kerensky into exile. Some were mothballed, but many found their way into the toumans of the Clans. As technology advanced, the weapons systems were upgraded until the design known as the 高地人 IIC finally emerged. Though no new Highlanders have been produced in over a century, several hundred are still in scattered use throughout the touman of every Clan.
column2: 高地人是最受欢迎的星盟战斗机甲之一，许多高地人曾随亚历山大·克伦斯基将军流亡。有些被封存，但更多进入了各星族的战斗编制。随着技术进步，武器系统不断升级，最终诞生了被称为高地人IIC的设计。尽管高地人已有一个多世纪没有生产，数百台仍分散在每个星族的战斗编制中服役。

column1: This 3134 field refit of a Hunchback-6S was developed after a minor LCAF officer replaced a damaged LB 20-X with more ER 中型激光s and an extra SRM-6.
column2: 这台3134年的战地改装型以驼背6S为基础，由一名轻微受伤的行星联盟军官将损坏的LB 20-X替换为更多ER中型激光和一具额外的SRM-6后开发而成。

column1: A special '机甲 for a very special Lady, who will be long missed. May she now rest in eternal peace and her legacy spread amongst the stars forever, bringing love to all as she always desired.
column2: 这是一台献给一位特殊女士的特别机甲。我们会长久思念她；愿她如今在永恒安宁中长眠，让她的遗产永远传播于群星之间，带着她一直渴望给予所有人的爱。

column1: A custom made adaptation of the JHK-03 ordered by Celina Santos. It replaces the the SRM-6s with an 高级战术导弹 System and an LB-X Autocannon/5. It was the first Jade Hawk to become (in)famous in the Inner Sphere.
column2: 这是塞丽娜·桑托斯订购的JHK-03定制改型。它用原有的SRM-6替换为一套高级战术系统和一门LB-X自动火炮/5。这是第一台在内圈声名大噪、也臭名昭著的玉鹰。

column1: The D loadout as usual for the Jade Falcon line of 机甲s mounts no Jump Jets, even though the chassis has 部分机翼s permanently attached. Instead it combines two ER PPC and a Gauss Rifle as the main weapons, with a single ER 中型激光 for close range support. All the weapons are bound together through a state of the art Tergeting Computer. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 按照玉蜥星族机甲生产线的惯例，D配置不安装跳跃喷射器，尽管底盘永久连接着跳跃喷射器。它改用两门ER PPC和一挺高斯步枪作为主武器，并以一门ER中型激光提供近距离支援。所有武器都通过最先进的瞄准计算机联接。 特性：分心 击杀倍率：1.16 左下部装甲，右下部装甲：全能

column1: A Dark Age re设计 of the King Crab, the KGC-011 is an unusual take on the classic assault mech. A 400-rated XXL 引擎 and a Supercharger make the KGC-011 the fastest King Crab to ever walk off of Cosara’s production line. A pair of LB-20X’s and a 等离子步枪 provide a devastating close range punch, whilst a 火箭发射器 acts as a backup weapon should an enemy survive to close in.
column2: 这是黑暗时代对帝王蟹的重建型，KGC-011以独特方式重新诠释了这台经典突击机甲。400额定功率的XXL引擎和超级充能器，让KGC-011成为迄今最快驶下科萨拉生产线的帝王蟹。一对LB-20X和一门短管步枪提供毁灭性的近距离爆发，而一具导弹发射器则作为备用武器，防止敌人侥幸接近。

column1: As long as you don't miss you can deliver a big oof to any approaching hostile '机甲s.
column2: 只要别打偏，你就能给任何逼近的敌方机甲送上一记沉重的痛击。

column1: A variant with firepower on par with the ancient Awesome, the '机甲 comes with three Extended Range Particle Projection Cannons, mounted in each arm and left torso.
column2: 这是一台火力足以媲美古老的强袭者的变体，双臂和左侧躯干各安装一门延伸射程粒子投射炮，共三门。

column1: A simple variation of the 3C, where the C3 Slave unit is swapped out in favor an additional 小型X脉冲激光 Laser in the head.
column2: 这是3C的简单变体，将C3从属单元换成了安装在头部的另一门小型X脉冲激光。

column1: With the re设计 of the Lancelot to share common parts with the 巨龙 the mech had a comeback. ClanTech ER and pulse lasers provide the -09’s primary and secondary weapons, supported with a deadly plasma rifle. Much-strengthened 装甲 improves its endurance. It is often paired with newer 巨龙s, providing fire support as the Dragons close in. 怪癖: Anti-Air 定位 掉落成本乘数: 1.08 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 兰斯洛特重新设计为使用与龙骑士相同的通用部件后，这台机甲重新焕发生机。星盟技术的ER激光和脉冲激光构成-09型的主、副武器，并由一门致命的等离子步枪支援。大幅强化的装甲提高了耐久性。它经常与更新的机甲搭配，在龙骑士逼近时提供火力支援。 特性：防空单位 击杀倍率：1.08 左上部装甲，右上部装甲

column1: A Dark Age variant of the Lupus, the Lupus C pairs 改进的 Heavy Lasers with a 定位 Computer and a Supercharger.
column2: 这是黑暗时代的狼獾变体，狼獾C将改进型重型激光与瞄准计算机和超级充能器组合在一起。

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. 设计 as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL引擎 is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of 装甲 which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 这是黑暗时代对掠夺者的重建型。掠夺者4K是库里塔家族对旧式3R变体的更新，定位为重型近战斗士和城市突击单位。4K将LRM-20（3K配置）换成配备阿波罗增强系统的MRM-30，并以短管PPC替换LB-10X。XL引擎被移除以降低成本、提高耐久性，代价是损失3吨装甲，但这被视为可以接受的交换。C3从属单元得到保留，使4K能够传输数据，让远程长机获益。16组双散热器维持4K的热量平衡，CASE保护舱中的4吨MRM弹药则为导弹提供充足火力。 特性：分心 击杀倍率：1.16 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: A Dark Age rebuild of the Mauler, the Mauler 4K is a Kuritan update of the older 3R variant. Designed as a heavy brawler and urban assault unit, the Mauler 4K swaps the LRM-20’s of the 3K for Apollo enhanced MRM-30’s and the LB-10X’s for Snub Nose PPC’s. The XL引擎 is removed to lower costs and increase durability, though this has resulted in the loss of 3 tons of 装甲 which is seen as an acceptable trade-off. The C3 Slave is retained, allowing the 4K to transmit data which it’s longer range lance mates can take advantage of. 16 DHS keep the 4K cool while 4 tons of MRM ammo in CASE protected bays give the MRM’s plenty to shoot with.\n\n部署成本倍率：1.16.
column2: 这是黑暗时代对掠夺者的重建型。掠夺者4K是库里塔家族对旧式3R变体的更新，定位为重型近战斗士和城市突击单位。4K将LRM-20（3K配置）换成配备阿波罗增强系统的MRM-30，并以短管PPC替换LB-10X。XL引擎被移除以降低成本、提高耐久性，代价是损失3吨装甲，但这被视为可以接受的交换。C3从属单元得到保留，使4K能够传输数据，让远程长机获益。16组双散热器维持4K的热量平衡，CASE保护舱中的4吨MRM弹药则为导弹提供充足火力。\n\n击杀倍率：1.16。

column1: Intended for intermediate and close range combat, the C configuration has a varied array of weapons. Its main anti-车辆 and -机甲 firepower comes from a pair of 改进的 Heavy 中型激光s, backed up by three 6-Tubed 短 Range Missile Launchers. A pair of Anti-Personnel Gauss Rifles is added to help the 设计 deal with battle 装甲 and other infantry threats. The configuration also features an active probe, ECM Suite, and Light TAG to give the 设计 better utility to other combat units on the field. 怪癖: 受保护的驱动器 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: C配置用于中距离和近距离战斗，拥有多样化的武器。它对反机甲和反战斗装甲的主要火力来自两门改进型重型中型激光，另有三具6管中程导弹发射器支援。两挺反人员高斯步枪帮助该单位应对战斗装甲和其他步兵威胁。配置还包括主动探测器、ECM套件和轻型TAG，为战场上的其他作战单位提供更好的支援能力。 特性：近距离火力支援 击杀倍率：1.09

column1: Developed by 海狐氏族, this Ostsol carries fifteen double heat sinks. It uses a 300-rated 引擎 to move at a top speed of 86 km/h. The side torso weapons are an ER Large Laser and an 改进的 Heavy 中型激光器. Two ER 中型激光器 are mounted in the center torso and cover the rear. All these weapons are tied into an advanced 定位 Computer. For protection, the Ostsol C carries nine tons of Reflective 装甲. 怪癖: 窄/低调 掉落成本乘数: 1.14
column2: 该奥斯托尔由星盟开发，携带十五组双散热器。它使用300额定功率的引擎，最高速度达到86公里/小时。两侧躯干的武器是一门ER大型激光和一门改进型重型中型激光；中央躯干安装两门ER中型激光，负责覆盖后方。所有武器都接入先进的瞄准计算机。为提高防护，奥斯托尔C携带九吨反射装甲。 特性：坚韧/远程 击杀倍率：1.14

column1: Cutting edge technology in a small frame with a supercharger makes for a really good flanker and ambusher. The 装甲 also makes it a lot more durable than one would think.
column2: 小型机体结合尖端技术和超级充能器，造就了出色的侧翼与伏击单位。它的装甲也让它比看起来耐打得多。

column1: When 卡隆工业 reintroduced the Penetrator, they switched to endo steel and reflective 装甲, allowing the arm weapons to be upgraded to snubnosed PPCs aimed with enhanced actuators. This 'Mech is now quite deadly for its weight.
column2: 卡隆工业重新推出穿透者时，换用了内骨骼和反射装甲，使双臂武器升级为短管PPC，并通过强化执行器进行瞄准。这台机甲以自身重量而言如今极其致命。

column1: Few Battle机甲s 设计ed and 生产 in the Inner Sphere after the fall of the first Star League managed to become as beloved as the Penetrator. A mainstay of AFFS, LCAF, and mercenary heavy lances, it has a well-deserved reputation for phenomenal staying power. The variant was initially created by refitting battle-damaged Penetrators, but soon multiple production lines were dedicated to building this new variant. For the AFFS, struggling to recover from devastating losses of personnel and materiel, the PTR-8D has been a lifeline, and demand is sky-high.
column2: 第一星盟覆灭后，内圈很少有战斗机甲能像穿透者一样受到喜爱。它是行星联盟军、行星联盟防卫军和佣兵重型机甲小队的中坚，以惊人的持续作战能力赢得了当之无愧的声誉。该变体最初通过修复战损穿透者制造，但很快便有多条生产线专门生产新型号。对于正努力从人员和物资惨重损失中恢复的行星联盟军而言，PTR-8D是一条生命线，需求极其旺盛。

column1: The most advanced loadout, the X configuration has a large melee potential by mixing an Inner Sphere Mech Lance with the firepower of seven Improved Heavy Small Lasers and a Supercharger. A 等离子炮 and a Laser AMS are also mounted as secondary weapon systems. 特性：空中突击 部署成本倍率：1.03 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 最先进的X配置将内圈机甲长矛与七门改进型重型小型激光和一台超级充能器结合，拥有极强的近战潜力。它还安装了一套高级战术系统和激光AMS作为辅助武器。 特性：近战突击 击杀倍率：1.03 部位装甲：全能

column1: The Rattler RT-L3R has a very unusual 设计, as practically every available bit of space is filled to the brim with weapons. Each arm houses two custom 开发 锁定式SRM-2 quad-launcher package, while the side torsos each contain two Machine Gun arrays and a Dual Machine Gun. A single 中型激光器 in the head was added as a last ditch weapon if all ammunition was used. The '机甲 also carries three Jump Jets to improve its mobility. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: 响尾蛇RT-L3R拥有极不寻常的武器布局，几乎每一寸可用空间都塞满了武器。双臂各安装两套定制的四联装SRM-2发射器，左右两侧躯干各装有两个机枪阵列和一挺双联机枪。头部增加一门中型激光，作为弹药耗尽后的最后手段。该机甲还携带三具跳跃喷射器，以提高机动性。 特性：多重追踪 击杀倍率：1.18 左下部装甲，右下部装甲

column1: The Rattler was originally intended as an anti-infantry '机甲 but never reached any large acceptance into the Great Houses' armies. Instead the only production run of the mech was eventually sold to various mercenary outfits, with some '机甲s eventually even finding their way into pirate hands.
column2: 响尾蛇原本设计为反步兵机甲，但始终未能在各大贵族的军队中获得广泛接受。最终，这台机甲唯一的生产批次被卖给不同的佣兵组织，其中一些甚至落入海盗之手。

column1: The C configuration only carries two weapons, but they are both able to do a very high amount of damage. The 左侧 Torso mounts a HAG/40, with four tons of available 装甲, while the 右侧 Torso contains an 改进的 重型高斯步枪 with three tons of ammo available. 怪癖: 易于维护 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: C配置只携带两件武器，但两者都能造成极高伤害。左侧躯干安装一门HAG/40，并配有四吨弹药；右侧躯干则装有一挺改进型重型高斯步枪，并配备三吨弹药。 特性：强化纤维 击杀倍率：1.17 部位装甲：全能

column1: The second '机甲 personally built by Sneede of Cranston Snord's Irregulars, this Franken机甲 combines several laser weapons, an ER PPC and an Artemis V-enabled LRM-20. A simple ECM suite provides rudimentary electronic warfare capabilities.
column2: 这是克兰斯顿·斯诺德非正规军的斯尼德亲自制造的第二台机甲。弗兰肯机甲结合了数种激光武器、一门ER PPC和一具启用阿耳忒弥斯V的LRM-20。简单的ECM套件提供基础电子战能力。

column1: The customized '机甲 of Anastasia Kerensky, also known as Tassa Kay, utilizes twelve tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the most the 设计 can mount. Two ER PPCs provide long range damage capability, while a pair of ER 中型激光s and 锁定式SRM-6s can exploit the holes the PPCs makes in an enemy's 装甲. Fifteen double heat sinks keeps the '机甲 relatively cool, while jump jets enable her to vault up to 150 米 at a time. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.17
column2: 这台由阿纳斯塔西娅·克伦斯基（又名塔莎·凯）定制的机甲，使用十二吨强化纤维装甲，这是它能够安装的最大装甲量。两门ER PPC提供远程伤害，一对ER中型激光和连续射击SRM-6则能利用PPC在敌方装甲上撕开的缺口。十五组双散热器让机甲保持相对低温，跳跃喷射器则使她一次能够跃过150米。 特性：稳定 击杀倍率：1.17

column1: The Shiro BattleMech was originally produced for the Draconis Combine's armed forces. Named for House Kurita's founder, Shiro Kurita, the Shiro was made to embody the spirit of bushido, the Way of the Warrior, its 装甲 designed to resemble the Samurai 装甲 of ancient Japan. When it was first presented to the DCMS, it was ordered only to those who are acclaimed and honor would be granted with the chance to pilot the Shiro.
column2: 志罗战斗机甲最初为龙之联邦军队生产。它以库里塔家族创始人志罗·库里塔命名，旨在体现武士道，也就是“武士之道”；机甲的装甲外形仿照古代日本的武士装甲。志罗首次呈交龙之联邦军事部时，只有获得赞誉的人才会被授予驾驶资格。

column1: The A configuration changes the role of the Sojourner to be more of a close quarters brawler with its weaponry of a Rotary AC/2, a 原型机甲自动炮/8, a 大型脉冲激光 and 4 ER Micro Lasers.
column2: A配置改变了漫游者的角色，使其更像近距离斗士，武器包括一门旋转AC/2、一门原型中型自动火炮/8、一门中型激光和4门ER微型激光。

column1: Configuration D combines an Ultra AC/10 with an ER PPC and two 中型脉冲激光s for better mid range performance.
column2: D配置将一门Ultra AC/10与一门ER PPC及两门中型脉冲激光器组合，提升中距离作战性能。

column1: A Spartan with all new, fancy tech. Not sure how I feel about this, the hayday of the chassis was a long time ago. But that Stealth 装甲 might just make the chassis be of use again.
column2: 这是一台搭载全新尖端技术的Spartan。我不知道该作何感想，这个底盘的辉煌时代早已过去。不过，隐形装甲或许能让它重新派上用场。

column1: The Star Crusader was created by Scorpion engineers by modifying the never realized Blakist plans, an 全向Mech version of the 大十字军.
column2: Star Crusader由蝎子氏族工程师改造未实现的布雷克圣言会方案而成，是大十字军的全向机甲版本。

column1: The '机甲's primary configuration allows it to be effective at both medium and long ranges. Its primary armament is a rotary AC/5 with three tons of ammo protected by CASE II, while for shorter ranges it carries a single ER 中型激光器. A light TAG is carried for target 设计ation. Ten double heat sinks are sufficient to keep the '机甲 cool, under most circumstances. 怪癖: Distracting 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：Omni
column2: 机甲的基础配置能够在中远距离有效作战。主要武器是一门转管自动炮/5，配备3吨CASE II保护弹药；近距离则携带一门ER中型激光器。轻型TAG用于标定目标。10组双重散热器在大多数情况下足以让机甲保持冷却。 怪癖: 干扰 掉落成本乘数: 1.05 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: A cheaper alternative to the expensive TBT-9R, the Trebuchet TBT-9N is built around an Endo Steel skeleton, paired with an XL Gyro and a XL引擎. A pair of Clan LRM-15’s are fed by a CASE II protected magazine, while 3 Medium VSPL’s offer a heavy punch at closer ranges. 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Trebuchet TBT-9N是昂贵的TBT-9R的廉价替代型，采用内骨骼结构、XL陀螺仪和XL引擎。两具氏族LRM-15由CASE II保护的弹舱供弹，3门中型VSP激光器则在近距离提供强劲火力。 特性：易于维护 部署成本倍率：1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: Don't let the stubby 'Urbie' fool you, it may look like a walking trash can, but it can mount heavy 装甲 and a plasma cannon. R93s aren't known for their speed, but they are very useful if you can draw the enemy into their firing range.
column2: 别被矮胖的“Urbie”骗了，它看起来像会走路的垃圾桶，却能安装厚重装甲和等离子炮。R93并不以速度见长，但只要能把敌人引入射程，就非常有用。

column1: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤 IIC。This version uses an XXL 引擎 to reach top speeds of 86 km/h. Its weapon load hearkens back to the original Warhammer, carrying ER PPCs in the arms and a single ER 中型激光 and ER Small Laser in the left and right torso. An SRM-6 is also carried in the right torso, and an ECM Suite disrupts enemy communications and targeting. This version is protected by Heat-Dissipating 装甲.
column2: 最初的战锤被设计为突击战斗机甲。尽管后来被更重的机甲设计取代，它仍是一个强大的武器平台。氏族明智地在这一坚固框架上维护并建造出真正的突击机甲——战锤IIC。这一版本采用XXL引擎，最高速度可达86 km/h。武器配置回归原始Warhammer：双臂各一门ER PPC，左右躯干各有一门ER中型激光器和ER小型激光器；右侧躯干还装有一具SRM-6，ECM套件则干扰敌方通信和瞄准。该型号由散热装甲提供防护。

column1: Configured to be a sniper, the C comes with a Coolant Pod. The Pod handles the heat load caused by pair of shoulder-mounted ATM-9 launchers and pair each of ER Large and ER 中型激光s. The Launchers each have enough reloads for 14 volleys of fire. 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: C配置专为狙击作战打造，配备冷却舱。冷却舱负责处理双肩安装的两具ATM-9发射器以及各两门ER大型激光器和ER中型激光器产生的热量。每具发射器都携带足够进行14轮齐射的备用弹药。 特性：瞄准增强—近程 部署成本倍率：1.11 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: Before it entered full production, the Wendigo had limited number of prototypes made. These similar forerunners were also 全向Mechs featuring a smaller 引擎 with only 10 double heat sinks, but had Pod capacity. These slower designs were among units first sent into the Republic as part of the Combine's invasion force. However, these prototypes were flawed and fraught with glitches. It was decided to sacrifice its large carrying capacity for more speed and thus were scrapped in favor of the production model.
column2: Wendigo在全面生产前只制造了少量原型机。这些相似的先行型号同样是全向机甲，采用较小的引擎和仅10组双重散热器，但拥有舱位容量。这些速度较慢的设计曾随龙马联盟入侵部队最早派往共和国。然而原型机存在缺陷且故障频发，最终决定牺牲巨大运载能力换取速度，因此被废弃，转而生产正式型号。

column1: Competing with the Panther -14R, it is a close race for which is better. Hah, who am I kidding. This is obviously the better '机甲. It has more weapons after all!
column2: 它与Panther -14R竞争时，谁更好几乎难分高下。哈，我是在开玩笑吧。这台显然更好的战斗机甲，毕竟它的武器更多！

column1: A sidegrade of the Yeoman, replacing the traditional Missile Weapons with 火箭发射器s and adding 2 Heavy PPC. The addition of energy weapons frees the Yeoman from the ammunition dependencies that plagued the earlier models.
column2: 这是Yeoman的侧重调整型，用火箭发射器替换传统导弹武器，并增加两门重型PPC。能量武器的加入让Yeoman摆脱了早期型号长期受弹药限制的问题。

column1: A Dark Age variant first 生产 in 3148, the 灭绝者 EXT-7X is used by the 球体共和国 for special operations work. Built around a 325-rated XXL 引擎, it is slower then most other 灭绝者 models; though a Supercharger and Stealth 装甲 help to alleviate this issue. An MRM-10 and 4 Medium VSPLs make up the 机甲s armament with a Laser AMS providing additional protection against missiles. 怪癖: Nimble 掉落成本乘数: 1.09
column2: 灭绝者EXT-7X是3148年首次生产的黑暗时代变型，由球体共和国用于特种作战。它以325额定XXL引擎为核心，速度低于大多数其他灭绝者型号；增压器和隐形装甲可部分弥补这一缺点。机甲装备一具MRM-10和4门中型VSP激光器，激光AMS则提供额外导弹防护。 怪癖: 灵活 掉落成本乘数: 1.09

column1: Danielle Peterson's Awesome, the 'Pretty Baby' Hero 'Mech has some unexpected speed, achieved through the use of an 340-rated Extralight 引擎. The Pretty Baby (serial number AWS8V99TG-2957) also features a unique weapon loadout as well - mounting a standard PPC in the right arm, a LRM-15 in the right torso, a 中型激光 in the head, Large Laser in the left torso and an SRM-4 in the left arm. 19 双散热器, two tons of LRM and three of SRM missiles keep it in the thick of battle.
column2: Danielle Peterson的Awesome英雄机甲“Pretty Baby”拥有出人意料的速度，得益于一台340额定超轻引擎。Pretty Baby（序列号AWS8V99TG-2957）还拥有独特武器配置：右臂一门标准PPC，右侧躯干一具LRM-15，头部一门中型激光器，左侧躯干一门大型激光器，左臂一具SRM-4。19组双重散热器、两吨LRM弹药和三吨SRM弹药让它能持续投入战斗。

column1: A upgrade Battlemaster 1DC Command refit, carrying advanced Technologies and 加固装甲 to stay in the fight as long as possible.
column2: 这是Battlemaster 1DC指挥型的升级改装，携带先进技术和加固装甲，以尽可能长时间坚持战斗。

column1: The 黑骑士 6B was the harder-hitting, cooler-running Star League ancestor to the standard BL-6-KNT we have today. It did everything the 6 does, but better. Mostly thanks to its 双散热器.
column2: 黑骑士6B是如今标准BL-6-KNT的前身，也是火力更强、散热更好的星盟时代祖型号。它完成6型能做的一切，而且更好，主要得益于双重散热器。

column1: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to 星际联盟防卫军s Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed 星团工业 facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander.
column2: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至2502年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的90吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于2592年开始生产）。2612年，StarCorps推出升级型Emperor EMP-6A，专为星际联盟防卫军皇家部队设计并独家配发。Emperor持续生产，直到第二次继承战争期间Marik部队在Son Hoa用核武器摧毁星团工业设施。3057年，Emperor与传奇Highlander一同恢复生产。

column1: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至 2502 年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的 90 吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于 2592 年开始生产）。In 2612, StarCorps introduced an upgraded Emperor, EMP-6A designed for and distributed exclusively to 星际联盟防卫军s Royal Units. The Emperor was produced continuously until Marik forces destroyed 星团工业 facility with nuclear arms on Son Hoa during the Second Succession War. Production of the Emperor resumed in 3057 alongside the legendary Highlander. 特性：改良冷却套-激光 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右下臂
column2: 皇帝是最早的突击战斗机甲之一，可追溯至2502年。它还享有另一项殊荣：首款装备跳跃推进器的90吨以上战斗机甲（著名的高地人于2592年开始生产）。2612年，StarCorps推出升级型Emperor EMP-6A，专为星际联盟防卫军皇家部队设计并独家配发。Emperor持续生产，直到第二次继承战争期间Marik部队在Son Hoa用核武器摧毁星团工业设施。3057年，Emperor与传奇Highlander一同恢复生产。 特性：改良冷却套-激光 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂, 右下臂

column1: The personal '机甲 of David Kalasa, the Founding Khan of 海狐氏族, later renamed to 氏族钻石鲨. He was killed piloting it during Operation KLONDIKE, and while his '机甲 was recovered afterwards it somehow got "misplaced" during transport back from the battlefield. The '机甲 was heavily converted to use Clan tech, being able to convert all the lasers to Extended Range variants and still improve the cooling capabilities. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是海狐氏族创始可汗David Kalasa的私人机甲，后来更名为钻石鲨氏族。他在KLONDIKE行动中驾驶此机甲阵亡；机甲随后被回收，却在运回战场途中不知怎的“遗失”。它被大幅改造以使用氏族技术，能够将所有激光器转换为增程型号，同时改善散热能力。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The Griffin 2N is an old Star League model that was among the most versatile 'Mechs in its heyday. Its weapons generated a lot of heat, but the old 双散热器 were put in to handle it.
column2: Griffin 2N是古老的星盟时代型号，在其鼎盛时期属于最为多用途的机甲之一。它的武器会产生大量热量，但古老的双重散热器足以处理这些热量。

column1: The Clans upgraded and lightened the venerable Griffin 设计 until the Battle机甲 now known as the Griffin IIC emerged. Seven tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 are mounted on an Endo Steel frame, giving the Griffin IIC almost maximum 装甲 protection for its size. It is slightly faster than its antecedent, and it correspondingly mounts enough jump jets to leap up to 180 米 at a time. 特性：战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.08
column2: 氏族对著名Griffin设计进行了升级和轻量化，最终诞生了被称为Griffin IIC的战斗机甲。内骨骼框架上安装7吨铁纤维装甲，使Griffin IIC几乎达到该体型的最大装甲防护。它比前身略快，并相应安装了足够的跳跃喷射器，一次可跳跃180米。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.08

column1: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon 装甲, the 旗本-血 shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced 双散热器, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the 旗本-血 a high heat curve in heavy combat.
column2: 它采用Earthwerks VOL内骨骼底盘，配备CASE保护弹舱，并覆盖15.5吨Mitchell Argon装甲。旗本-血继承了母型设计几乎不可摧毁的“僵尸机甲”特征。龙马联盟无法复刻Thug的主要部分，是旧设计的先进双重散热器；18组标准散热器让旗本-血在重型战斗中拥有很高的热量曲线。

column1: This customized 'Mech is equipped with 270 XL引擎, two ER Micro Lasers and Heavy Machine Guns in both torsos, Streak SRM 4 with it's one ton of ammo in central torso and two Streak SRM 2's in the right arm, along with 10 双散热器 to cope with the heat, half ton of HMG ammo in left torso and one full ton of HMG and Streak SRM 4 ammo bins in right torso.
column2: 这台定制机甲装备270级XL引擎，双侧躯干各有两门ER微型激光器和重型机枪，中央躯干有一具Streak SRM-4及一吨弹药，右臂有两具Streak SRM-2；另有10组双重散热器应对热量，左侧躯干存放半吨重机枪弹药，右侧躯干存放一整吨重机枪和Streak SRM-4弹药。

column1: The switch to 双散热器 does wonders, even with more lasers it still runs cooler! It might still overheat if you keep firing them constantly, but at least it takes more than one salvo now.
column2: 换装双重散热器效果惊人，即使激光器更多，机甲运行起来仍然更凉！如果持续射击，仍可能过热，但至少现在要超过一轮齐射才会出问题。

column1: A lumbering mountain of 装甲 and weaponry, Solaris Arms' massive assault 'Mech definitely lives up to the name of Juggernaut in the Solaris Games. While not a flashy design, Solaris Arms kept up steady production of the design since the early 3050s. Sixteen and half tons of Valiant Chainmail 装甲 protect a GM 270 Fusion 引擎, propelling the 'Mech at fairly standard assault 'Mech speed of 54 km/h. 特性：Improved Lifesupport 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Solaris Arms的巨型突击机甲是一座由装甲和武器堆成的迟缓山岳，在Solaris赛事中完全配得上Juggernaut之名。虽然设计并不华丽，Solaris Arms自3050年代初一直稳定生产。16.5吨Valiant Chainmail装甲保护GM 270聚变引擎，使机甲以54 km/h的标准突击机甲速度前进。 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署费用倍率：1.16 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: Developed by both ComStar and the 布雷克圣言会, the KTO-21 was the first 'Mech to utilize both the new Improved Narc Missile Beacon (iNarc for short) and the improved C3 computer system. In order to utilize these new systems, the KTO-21 was refitted with an Endo Steel chassis and carried half a ton less 装甲 than the KTO-19. Retaining only the two SRM launchers, the LRM launcher was dropped and the standard 中型激光器 were upgraded to more advanced ER 中型激光s, enhanced by a switch to 双散热器.
column2: ComStar与布雷克圣言会共同开发KTO-21，这是第一台同时采用改进型Narc导弹信标（简称iNarc）和改进型C3计算机系统的机甲。为使用这些新系统，KTO-21改用内骨骼底盘，装甲比KTO-19少半吨。它保留两具SRM发射器，拆除LRM发射器，并将标准中型激光器升级为更先进的ER中型激光器，同时换装双重散热器。

column1: This experimental variant was made at Ronin Incorporated's facility on Wallis in 3039. Techs removed the standard weaponry from a Marauder and replaced the arm mounted weapons with a 二元激光 Cannon in each arm, while the torso mounted autocannon was replaced by twin SRM-6 launchers backed by one ton of ammunition. The Marauder-4X was also noteworthy because it used a Prototype Endo Steel chassis. To keep the heat under control, technicians installed twelve single heat sinks and six prototype 双散热器.
column2: 这一实验型于3039年在Wallis的Ronin Incorporated工厂制造。技术人员拆除Marauder的标准武器，将双臂武器替换为每臂一门二元激光炮，并把躯干自动炮换成两具SRM-6发射器和一吨弹药。Marauder-4X还采用原型内骨骼底盘。为控制热量，技术人员安装12组单重散热器和6组原型双重散热器。

column1: The MAL-1P utilizes just about the same weapons as stock maulers, except this version carries a PPC in each arm. It retains both LRMs, downgrading these from the LRM-15s to LRM-10s, and keeps the MAL-1R's four Autocannon/2s. A extra-light 270 引擎 keeps it moving and eleven 双散热器 keep the heat at bay.
column2: MAL-1P使用与标准Mauler基本相同的武器，但双臂各携带一门PPC。它保留两具LRM，将LRM-15降为LRM-10，并保留MAL-1R的四门自动炮/2。270级超轻引擎确保机体移动，11组双重散热器压制热量。

column1: The Mauler MAL-2P should be considered a prototype. Unlike the -1P or MX90, the -2P carries a pair of Lasers in each arm; it's rumored that more than two can affixed if need be. Its twin LRM-10s allow it to send missiles at a greater distance and two 超级自动炮/5s give it long to close range support. Both the LRMs and UAC/5s have two tons of ammunition a piece, and like the -1P and MX90, the 2P has Cellular Ammunition Storage Equipment to help protect it from ammo explosions. Eleven 双散热器 and a 270 Standard 引擎 round out the rest of it load out.
column2: Mauler MAL-2P应视为原型机。与-1P或MX90不同，-2P双臂各装两门激光器，据说必要时还能安装更多。两具LRM-10使它能在更远距离发射导弹，两门超级自动炮/5提供远近程支援。每具LRM和UAC/5都配有两吨弹药；与-1P和MX90一样，2P拥有细胞弹药储存设备，以防弹药爆炸。11组双重散热器和一台270级标准引擎完成其配置。

column1: A refresh of the Ostwar OWR-2M, the OWR-2MX replaces the LRM and 中型激光s with an upgrade to double SRM6 launchers and 3 Extended Range Large Lasers. Using an XL引擎 and Endo Steel 结构 allows the switch to 双散热器 for better cooling performance as well as an upgrade to a 325-rated fusion core. One large oddity is the fact the SRM6 launchers are in the legs, leading a strange angle of launching that can surprise enemy Mech Warriors.
column2: OWR-2M的更新型OWR-2MX用两具SRM-6发射器和3门增程大型激光器替换LRM和中型激光器。XL引擎与内骨骼结构允许换装双重散热器并升级为325额定聚变核心。一个显著怪异之处是SRM-6发射器安装在腿部，导致发射角度奇特，能够出其不意地打击敌方机甲战士。

column1: A modern Clan take on the classic Succession Wars era RFL-3N Rifleman, the A variant carries a 大型脉冲激光 and 超级自动炮/5 in each arm, supported by an ER 中型激光 in each side torso. Built around a 260-rated XL引擎, Endo Steel frame, and ten tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲, the A is fitted with sixteen 双散热器 and four tons of UAC ammo.
column2: 这是氏族对继承战争时代经典RFL-3N Rifleman的现代改造。A配置双臂各装一门大型脉冲激光和一门超级自动炮/5，两侧躯干各有一门ER中型激光器支援。它以260额定XL引擎、内骨骼框架和10吨铁纤维装甲为核心，配备16组双重散热器和4吨UAC弹药。

column1: Of the relatively few Sorcerers built before the Amaris Coup, the Sorcerer 1CC variant was considered an exceptionally rare design. Originally planned as a replacement for the 90 ton Cyclops, it quickly became apparent that the design teams at StarCorps Industries were not going to be able to best its incredible computer systems. Rather than spending several more decades of development, the design team decided that modifying the Sorcerer 1A would be a suitable method to cut corners. The 1CC drops the Snub-Nose PPCs, lasers and five Double Heat Sink in order to mount an additional Ceres Arms Smasher PPC, a quintet of Magna 400P Medium Pulse Lasers, and the advanced Command Console. 特性：Battle Fists 部署费用倍率：1.19
column2: 在阿玛里斯政变前制造的少数Sorcerer中，1CC变型被视为极其罕见的设计。它原本计划取代90吨Cyclops，但StarCorps Industries的设计团队很快发现自己无法超越其惊人的计算机系统。与其再花数十年开发，设计团队决定改造Sorcerer 1A以走捷径。1CC拆除短管PPC、激光器和5组双重散热器，改装一门Ceres Arms Smasher PPC、五门Magna 400P中型脉冲激光器和先进指挥控制台。 特性：战斗铁拳 部署费用倍率：1.19

column1: With the STR-7 variant being designed for space operations, its full weaponry is energy based as to work efficiently in a vacuum environment, and the leg actuators have been reinforced to handle higher loads. The variant mounts a 大型脉冲激光 on each Arm, a ER Larger Laser in each torso location and a 小型脉冲激光 in the Head. 14 external 双散热器 allows the STR-7 to operate its weapons and three Jump Jets inside an atmosphere.
column2: STR-7为太空作战设计，全部武器采用能量系统，以便在真空环境高效运行；腿部驱动器也经过强化以承受更高负荷。该变型每条手臂安装一门大型脉冲激光，双侧躯干各有一门ER大型激光器，头部安装一门小型脉冲激光器。14组外置双重散热器让STR-7能够在大气中运行武器和三具跳跃喷射器。

column1: The advanced model employed by the 星际联盟防卫军 Royal Divisions in 2743 changed the role of the 'Mech from a missile to an energy boat, replacing the LRM launcher with an ER Large Laser, retaining one 中型激光器 and downgrading the other to a Small Laser. Dropping the no longer required CASE, the 'Mech also used a MASC system for temporary speed bursts and 双散热器 to vent its increased waste heat output. The THE-Nb mounted an XL引擎 to save the weight to mount this extra equipment, at the cost of reduced survivability.
column2: 星际联盟防卫军皇家部队于2743年采用的先进型号，将机甲从导弹平台转变为能量平台：用一门ER大型激光器替换LRM发射器，保留一门中型激光器并将另一门降级为小型激光器。拆除不再需要的CASE后，机甲还采用MASC实现临时加速，并使用双重散热器排出增加的废热。THE-Nb安装XL引擎以腾出重量容纳这些额外设备，但生存能力因此降低。

column1: The first custom configuration used by the infamous Bounty Hunter of the time of the initial 氏族入侵, it mounted a 大型脉冲激光 and a 中型脉冲激光 in each arm. It also had a 中型脉冲激光 in both the left and right torso with a Clan Light TAG in the center torso. A 轻型 主动探头, ECM suite, and a 瞄准计算机 provided stealth and increased accuracy.
column2: 这是初次氏族入侵时期臭名昭著的赏金猎人使用的第一种定制配置，双臂各安装一门大型脉冲激光和一门中型脉冲激光。左右躯干也各有一门中型脉冲激光，中央躯干安装氏族轻型TAG。轻型主动探头、ECM套件和瞄准计算机提供隐蔽性并提升精度。

column1: A mix of the Prime and the D configurations, alternate configuration N mounts an ER PPC in each arm alongside an LRM-15 rack in the left and right torsos. These weapons are supported at short range by paired Machine Guns and 中型脉冲激光s in each side torso. Two tons of LRM reloads and a half ton of machine gun rounds force a focus on the energy weapons with an extra 双散热器 tries to assist in managing their heat.
column2: 这是Prime与D配置的混合型，替代配置N在双臂各安装一门ER PPC，左右躯干各有一具LRM-15发射架。两侧躯干的机枪和中型脉冲激光器在近距离提供支援。两吨LRM弹药和半吨机枪弹药迫使机甲更多依赖能量武器，额外双重散热器则尝试控制热量。

column1: Constructed with an Earthwerks VOL Endo Steel chassis, fitted with CASE protected ammo bins and clad in fifteen and a half tons of Mitchell Argon 装甲, the Hatamoto-Chi shared the features which made its parent design a nearly indestructible zombie 'Mech. The main area that Combine was unable to replicate the Thug was the older design's advanced Double Heat Sink, eighteen standard Heat Sinks giving the Hatamoto-Chi a high heat curve in heavy combat. 特性：Easy to Maintain 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂
column2: 它采用Earthwerks VOL内骨骼底盘，配备CASE保护弹舱并覆盖15.5吨Mitchell Argon装甲。Hatamoto-Chi继承了母型设计几乎不可摧毁的“僵尸机甲”特征。龙马联盟无法复刻Thug的主要部分，是旧设计的先进双重散热器；18组标准散热器让Hatamoto-Chi在重型战斗中拥有很高的热量曲线。 特性：易于维护 部署费用倍率：1.14 手臂驱动器限制：左下臂

column1: The Raven LR 'Dagger' sports a prototype Electronics Warfare suite, Stealth 装甲, TAG, and HayWire and NARC launchers.
column2: Raven LR“Dagger”配备原型电子战套件、隐形装甲、TAG以及HayWire和NARC发射器。

column1: The Vulcan II VLC-N4M trades a 中型脉冲激光 for an 反导系统 and CASE. 短程火箭s are often the most common anti-'Mech weapon encountered at the infantry level, and so an AMS would increase the Vulcan II's survivability at little cost to its effectiveness.
column2: Vulcan II VLC-N4M用一套反导系统和CASE替换中型脉冲激光器。短程火箭通常是步兵层面最常见的反机甲武器，因此AMS能以很低成本提高Vulcan II的生存能力，而几乎不影响其效能。

column1: Based off of the Crab Battle机甲, the Aquagladius was a creation of the 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队, or VEST, for the Solaris VII games. 设计 specifically for usage in underwater combat, the Aquagladius featured state-of-the-art environmental sealing to ensure that the '机甲's internals were well protected from water in the event of inevitable hull breaches. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: Aquagladius以Crab战斗机甲为基础，由瓦伊宁工程与打捞队（VEST）为Solaris VII赛事制造。Aquagladius专为水下战斗设计，采用先进环境密封，确保即使船体不可避免地破损，机甲内部仍能受到水体防护。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: Based off of the Crab Battle机甲, the Aquagladius was a creation of the 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队, or VEST, for the Solaris VII games. The Aquagladius 4 fields a more conventional Battle机甲 loadout as opposed to the more unorthodox weapons wielded by its older brother. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: Aquagladius以Crab战斗机甲为基础，由瓦伊宁工程与打捞队（VEST）为Solaris VII赛事制造。Aquagladius 4采用更传统的战斗机甲武器配置，与其前代使用的非传统武器形成对比。 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: Based off of the Crab Battle机甲, the Aquagladius was a creation of the 瓦伊宁工程与打捞队, or VEST, for the Solaris VII games. The Aquagladius 4 fields a more conventional Battle机甲 loadout as opposed to the more unorthodox weapons wielded by its older brother.
column2: Aquagladius以Crab战斗机甲为基础，由瓦伊宁工程与打捞队（VEST）为Solaris VII赛事制造。Aquagladius 4采用更传统的战斗机甲武器配置，与其前代使用的非传统武器形成对比。

column1: The 3D variant is designed as a direct fire mech. 2 UAC/5's and LRM-10 provide the bulk of the firepower, whilst a Machine Gun and two 中型激光s provide close in protection.
column2: 3D变型设计为直射机甲。两门UAC/5和一具LRM-10构成主要火力，机枪和两门中型激光器则提供近距离防护。

column1: Abandoned during Operation BULLDOG, this Balar was later recovered by DCMS forces. The damage to the original chassis was extensive, but the modularity of the 全向Pods allowed it to be restored to battlefield service in short order. 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向
column2: 这台Balar在BULLDOG行动期间被遗弃，后来由龙马联盟军队回收。原始底盘损坏严重，但全向舱位的模块化设计使其很快恢复战场服役。 特性：窄小低矮轮廓 部署成本倍率：1.07 手臂驱动器限制：全向

column1: The Bane 4 is 设计ed to address the ammunition-dependency of the earlier Banes. In this upgrade, 玉鹰氏族 scientists changed many elements of the Bane slightly, resulting in a '机甲 with a different appearance than its predecessors. Its focus is also short range, as evidenced by twin 超级自动炮/20s. Six tons of ammunition is adequate, though only barely. Three ATM 6s, along with four tons of ammunition, give the 设计 great flexibility at all ranges. A single ER Large Laser allows the '机甲 to stay in the fight in the event its ammunition bins have run dry. Seventeen double heat sinks are unequal to the task assigned to them.
column2: Bane 4旨在解决早期Bane对弹药的依赖。升级过程中，玉鹰氏族科学家对Bane的多个部件略作修改，使这台机甲外观不同于前代。它同样专注短程作战，双门超级自动炮/20便是证明。6吨弹药基本够用，但余量很小。三具ATM-6及4吨弹药让该设计在所有射程都具备很高灵活性。一门ER大型激光器确保弹舱耗尽后机甲仍能继续战斗。17组双重散热器却不足以承担全部任务。

column1: The K306 variant is a modification of the Battle Hawk that looks to make the '机甲 more durable. This is accomplished by removing the XL引擎 and replacing it with a Light Fusion 引擎, which allows the '机甲 to withstand the destruction of a side torso. Additionally, the 中型脉冲激光s have been upgraded to ER 中型激光s and the 锁定式SRM-2 launcher has been replaced with a 锁定式SRM-4 launcher.
column2: K306变型是Battle Hawk的改装型，目标是提高机甲耐久性。它拆除XL引擎，换装轻型聚变引擎，使机甲能够承受一侧躯干被摧毁。中型脉冲激光器升级为ER中型激光器，锁定式SRM-2发射器也换成锁定式SRM-4发射器。

column1: Designed to engage in close range brawls, the 100 ton Berserker debuted in 3056. A 400-rated Light 引擎 paired with TSM allows the BRZ-C3 to outrun almost any other heavy or assault grade Mech. An ER PPC and 6 ER 中型激光器 make up the Mech’s ranged armament while a colossal 10 ton Hatchet is lethal at close range. AMS and Guardian ECM keep the Mech safe as it closes in, a C3 Slave allows the Berserker to act as a scout; while a head mounted Flamer adds to the Mechs intimidation factor.
column2: Berserker重100吨，专为近距离缠斗打造，于3056年首次亮相。400额定轻型引擎配合TSM，使BRZ-C3能够超过几乎所有重型或突击级机甲。ER PPC和6门ER中型激光器构成远程武器，10吨巨型战斧则在近距离极其致命。AMS与守护者ECM保护机甲接近目标，C3从属单元让Berserker能够担任侦察机甲；头部安装的喷火器进一步增强威慑力。

column1: Something of a quick strike version of the Brigand also 开发 in 3066, the X2 removes the two medium pulse lasers and replaces them with four 火箭发射器 15s. These give the '机甲 an astounding amount of firepower in one shot making it a serious threat to other light '机甲s when encountered. 怪癖: 空中突击 掉落成本乘数: 0.98
column2: Brigand的快速突击型同样于3066年开发。X2拆除两门中型脉冲激光器，换成四具火箭发射器15，一次齐射即可释放惊人火力，遇到其他轻型机甲时构成严重威胁。 怪癖: 空中突击 掉落成本乘数: 0.98

column1: 该型号采用 Hollis Marik III Endo Steel 底盘，并由 Magna 260 超轻型引擎驱动；节省出的重量使 C2 成为专精远程作战的机甲。主武器是两具联邦 LRM-15 发射器，并配有 Artemis IV 火控系统。中型激光被两门 Defiance Shredder LB-X 自动炮/2取代。虽然这种改装使弹射者更容易受到近战攻击，却也让它在远距离极具杀伤力。
column2: 这一分型采用Hollis Marik III内骨骼底盘，由Magna 260超轻型引擎驱动；节省出的重量使C2成为专精远程作战的机甲。主武器是两具联邦LRM-15发射器，并配有Artemis IV火控系统。中型激光器被两门Defiance Shredder LB-X自动炮/2替换。虽然这种改装使弹射者更容易受到近战攻击，却也让它在远距离极具杀伤力。

column1: A Periphery modification of the Charger, the 2A2 had one ton of 装甲 removed and its weapons stripped out. In their place, the 2A2 carried a 中型激光器 and five 火箭发射器 10s. This modification gave the Charger an immense amount of firepower that could be used in one shot or over the course of a battle. With the Charger's role as a heavy scout, the one-shot nature of the 火箭发射器s was not considered much of a hindrance as if they had been placed on a dedicated assault '机甲. 怪癖: Barrel Fist 掉落成本乘数: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: 这是Charger的边疆改装型。2A2拆除一吨装甲并卸下原有武器，改为携带一门中型激光器和五具火箭发射器10。这一改装赋予Charger巨大的火力，既可一次释放，也可在整场战斗中逐步使用。由于Charger担任重型侦察机，火箭发射器的一次性特性不像安装在专用突击机甲上那样构成严重缺点。 怪癖: Barrel Fist 掉落成本乘数: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: The scientists of 血灵氏族 and 雪鸦氏族 worked together to start their Proto机甲 programs. The six-meter tall Chrysaor was the first Proto机甲 the two clans 设计ed. Combining high speed with ammunition-independent ER Micro Lasers and good 装甲 make the Chrysaor a dangerous foe.
column2: 血灵氏族和雪鸦氏族的科学家合作启动原型机甲项目。六米高的Chrysaor是两族设计的第一台原型机甲。它结合高速、无需弹药的ER微型激光器和良好装甲，成为危险的敌手。

column1: The Clint was primarily designed as a cheap recon unit, with the capabilities of a well-armed, low-end medium weight 'Mech, and in this regard it served well. With a top speed of 97.2 km/h and a jumping capability of one hundred and eighty 米, the Clint can easily keep up with other recon elements and maneuver through mountainous or urban terrain. The 5U Clint is a complete rework of the design, adopted by the Lyran Alliance Armed Forces on the eve of the FedCom Civil War. It is constructed using an Endo Steel chassis and is powered with a Light Fusion 引擎, freeing up weight for a Maxell ER Large Laser as its primary weapon. This is backed up by three ER 中型激光器. The 5U also carries an advanced C3 slave unit and a TAG spotting laser to allow it to designate targets for friendly units.
column2: Clint最初主要设计为廉价侦察单位，具备武装良好、性能中等的机甲能力，在这方面表现出色。97.2 km/h的最高速度和180米跳跃能力让Clint轻松跟上其他侦察部队，并穿越山地或城市地形。5U Clint是该设计的全面重制型，在联邦内战前夕被莱拉联盟武装部队采用。它采用内骨骼底盘和轻型聚变引擎，节省重量用于安装Maxell ER大型激光器作为主武器，另有三门ER中型激光器支援。5U还携带先进C3从属单元和TAG标定激光器，可为友军标定目标。

column1: This Conjurer variant uses an XL引擎 to achieve the same speed as the original, but saves weight for added components. A short-range powerhouse, the 设计ers included four Heavy 中型激光s that max out the fourteen double heat sinks. Despite that, they also included a 中型脉冲激光 and two 锁定式SRM-6s to aid to hunting battle 装甲. For work against conventional infantry, it includes two 轻型 Machine Guns. A 定位 Computer improves the accuracy of the lasers.
column2: 这一Conjurer变型采用XL引擎，在保持原版速度的同时为额外部件腾出重量。设计师加入四门重型中型激光器，几乎耗尽14组双重散热器，使其成为近距离火力强者。此外还配备一门中型脉冲激光器和两具锁定式SRM-6，用于猎杀战斗装甲；对付普通步兵时则使用两挺轻型机枪。瞄准计算机提高激光器精度。

column1: The Conjurer 5 mounts two ATM 6s, each of which is allocated a single ton of ammunition. A pair of ER 中型激光s back up this model.
column2: Conjurer 5装备两具ATM-6，每具分配一吨弹药，并由两门ER中型激光器提供支援。

column1: Copperhead 的主武器是安装在左臂的 Sutel 精密线性中型 X 脉冲激光器，三门安装在躯干的 Diverse Optics 增程中型激光器提供支援。右臂的一具 Holly Streak SRM-4 和头部安装的 Poland Main Model C Magshot 能在近距离带来意外打击，每件武器都配有一吨备用弹药。
column2: Copperhead的主武器是安装在左臂的Sutel精密线性中型X脉冲激光器，三门安装在躯干的Diverse Optics增程中型激光器提供支援。右臂的一具Holly Streak SRM-4和头部安装的Poland Main Model C Magshot能在近距离带来意外打击，每件武器都配有一吨备用弹药。

column1: XL引擎, Endo Steel 结构, a 重型高斯步枪 and two LRM-10 launchers. The -8S carries a heavy punch for its size, but it comes at the cost of being less durable.
column2: XL引擎、内骨骼结构、一门重型高斯步枪和两具LRM-10发射器构成这台机体。-8S对于自身尺寸而言火力强大，但代价是耐久性较低。

column1: The Dreka 1S prototype was built to showcase the 2 massive Defiance Hammerfist 重型高斯步枪s and is the testbed for what one day will become the Fafnir.
column2: Dreka 1S原型机用于展示两门巨大的Defiance Hammerfist重型高斯步枪，也是未来Fafnir的试验平台。

column1: As far as Excalibur '机甲s go, Boss, this one is a tough nut to crack. Getting rid of the Gauss rifle freed up a lot of tonnage that got used for 装甲 and heat sinking.
column2: 老板，就Excalibur机甲而言，这台很难对付。拆除高斯步枪后腾出的重量被用于增加装甲和散热能力。

column1: The Fafnir was intended to become 迪法恩斯工业 of Hesperus' flagship BattleMech. This rare but not uncommon field refit replaces the 重型高斯步枪s with 2 LBX 20 Autocannons and upgrades the Electronics.
column2: Fafnir原本计划成为Hesperus迪法恩斯工业的旗舰战斗机甲。这一罕见但并非罕见到绝无仅有的战地改装型，用两门LBX 20自动炮替换重型高斯步枪，并升级电子设备。

column1: Just an 8K with a C3 instead of a Flamer, nothing else different about it. Still is a good '机甲 for many smaller mercenary companies though.
column2: 这只是一台用C3替换喷火器的8K，其他方面没有变化。不过对于许多小型佣兵公司来说，它仍是一台优秀机甲。

column1: The 3LL is an alternative to the 3L, replacing the ER PPC with a ER Large Laser. The savings in weight permits adding one double heat sink and an additional ton of 装甲. Range and damage would be reduced, but the added protection and ability to fire both main weapons while in stealth mode – with no chance of overheating – is too good to resist.
column2: 3LL是3L的替代型，用ER大型激光器替换ER PPC。节省的重量允许增加一组双重散热器和一吨装甲。射程与伤害会降低，但额外防护以及隐形模式下可同时发射两种主武器且不会过热的能力实在难以拒绝。

column1: The 5S combines an Artemis IV LRM-10 with an ER Large Laser and two ER 中型激光s. It also has C.A.S.E. protection and a small 瞄准计算机 and uses Endo Steel to carry it all on the frame.
column2: 5S将装配Artemis IV的LRM-10与一门ER大型激光器和两门ER中型激光器组合。它还配备C.A.S.E.防护和小型瞄准计算机，并采用内骨骼结构承载全部设备。

column1: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。The PR30 Grim Reaper modifies the 'Mech to have a little more direct fire capability.
column2: Grim Reaper由康星设计，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失；布雷克圣言会夺取地球后继续生产它，以协助重建和扩充布雷克圣言会民兵。因此，世俗派与狂热派军队都装备了数量适中的Grim Reaper。作为通用士兵机甲，它携带多样而非专精的武器配置。PR30 Grim Reaper改装后拥有更强的直射能力。

column1: 死神是康星设计的机甲，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失，布雷克之言在夺取地球后维持生产，以协助重建和扩充布雷克之言民兵。因此死神在世俗与狂热两方的军队中都有中等数量的装备。作为一款通用士兵机甲，死神携带多样而非专精的武器配置。The PR31 variant's modification focuses on long range combat and overall speed.
column2: Grim Reaper由康星设计，用于补充康卫在图卡伊德战役中遭受的严重物资损失；布雷克圣言会夺取地球后继续生产它，以协助重建和扩充布雷克圣言会民兵。因此，世俗派与狂热派军队都装备了数量适中的Grim Reaper。作为通用士兵机甲，它携带多样而非专精的武器配置。PR31变型重点强化远程作战和整体速度。

column1: An upgrade of the Hazard HZD-1A first seen in the later stages of the 马里安霸权 invasion of the 圆规座联合会, the HZD-2 upgrades the SHS to DHS models and adds an extra ton of ammo for the SRM launchers. 中型脉冲激光s replace the standard 中型激光s.
column2: 这是Hazard HZD-1A的升级型，最早出现在马里安霸权入侵圆规座联合会的后期。HZD-2将单重散热器升级为双重散热器，并为SRM发射器增加一吨弹药；中型脉冲激光器替换标准中型激光器。

column1: Approximately twice as expensive as the original, the Hellfire 2 uses an 300-rated XL引擎 to increase the '机甲's speed to 86 km/h. In place of the LRMs are a pair of ATM 6s. The heavy smalls are replaced with a single ER Small Laser and an additional double heat sink.
column2: Hellfire 2的价格约为原版两倍，采用300额定XL引擎，将机甲速度提升至86 km/h。它用两具ATM-6替换LRM，用一门ER小型激光器和一组额外双重散热器替换重型小型激光器。

column1: A uniquely customized Hercules created for Hauptmann Julius Walker of the Coventry CPM. The '机甲's ER PPC, single 小型脉冲激光, and LB 10-X Autocannon were replaced by a massive LB 20-X with several tons of ammunition. Also, the techs added an additional 中型脉冲激光, two standard 中型激光器 and CASE to the 设计. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower
column2: 这是为Coventry CPM的Hauptmann Julius Walker定制的Hercules。机甲原有的ER PPC、单门小型脉冲激光器和LB 10-X自动炮被一门巨大的LB 20-X及数吨弹药替换。技术人员还为设计增加一门中型脉冲激光器、两门标准中型激光器和CASE。 怪癖: 稳定 武器 掉落成本乘数: 1.12 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 下臂

column1: Introduced during the FedCom Civil War, this Highlander variant replaces the missiles, 中型激光器, and jump jets with two Large Lasers and a 重型高斯步枪.
column2: 这一Highlander变型在联邦内战期间推出，用两门大型激光器和一门重型高斯步枪替换导弹、中型激光器和跳跃喷射器。

column1: Originally 开发 by 氏族火狒狒 during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 120-rated XL引擎 the Howler HWR-2 uses a combination of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and Endo Steel; allowing the 机甲 to carry 4 ATM-3’s with 2 tons of ammo. MASC boosts the 机甲s speed. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 0.97
column2: Howler是火狒狒氏族在黄金世纪开发的20吨轻型支援机甲。Howler HWR-2以120额定XL引擎为核心，采用铁纤维装甲与内骨骼结构，携带4具ATM-3和2吨弹药。MASC提升机甲速度。 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 0.97

column1: Originally developed by 氏族火狒狒 during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 120-rated XL引擎 the Howler HWR-2 uses a combination of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and Endo Steel; allowing the Mech to carry 4 ATM-3’s with 2 tons of ammo. MASC boosts the Mechs speed.
column2: Howler是火狒狒氏族在黄金世纪开发的20吨轻型支援机甲。Howler HWR-2以120额定XL引擎为核心，采用铁纤维装甲与内骨骼结构，携带4具ATM-3和2吨弹药。MASC提升机甲速度。

column1: Originally 开发 by 氏族火狒狒 during the Golden Century, the 20-ton Howler is a light support mech. Built around a 120-rated XL引擎 the Howler HWR-3 uses a combination of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and Endo Steel; allowing the 机甲 to carry an ER PPC and a 定位 Computer. MASC boosts the 机甲s speed. 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 0.97
column2: Howler是火狒狒氏族在黄金世纪开发的20吨轻型支援机甲。Howler HWR-3以120额定XL引擎为核心，采用铁纤维装甲与内骨骼结构，携带一门ER PPC和瞄准计算机。MASC提升机甲速度。 怪癖: 延长躯干扭转 掉落成本乘数: 0.97

column1: Debuting in 3063, the 5E is a 布雷克圣言会 设计ed upgrade to the older 4E 设计. Intended for deployment with Protectorate Militia units and Free Worlds League formations, the Blakists sought to rebuild the 设计 with newer technology and correct some of the flaws apparent in the older 设计. Installing an Endo Steel chassis enabled the 设计ers to swap the Thumper for the much larger and more powerful Sniper火炮 Piece. Defensively the 设计 mounts CASE to protect against the ammunition explosions that plagued the older 4E model. A swap to ER Lasers and DHS round out the 设计, giving it increased range and striking power. Popular with Hunchback pilots and 火炮 units, the 设计 is slated for continuous production; with Kali Yama having to expand their Hunchback line to keep up with demand.
column2: 5E于3063年推出，是布雷克圣言会对旧式4E的升级设计，计划配发给保护国民兵和自由世界联盟编队。它采用更新技术并修正旧型号缺陷：内骨骼底盘让设计师能将Thumper替换为更大、更强的Sniper火炮。CASE可防止困扰旧4E的弹药爆炸，ER激光器和双重散热器则提升射程与打击力。该设计深受Hunchback驾驶员和火炮部队欢迎，计划持续生产，Kali Yama甚至必须扩建Hunchback生产线以满足需求。

column1: A simple modification of the R4L model, the 3065 R4O model of the 休伦战士 carries double heat sinks, enabling it to drop one heat sink and carry an additional ton of ammunition for the Gauss Rifle.
column2: R4O是R4L的简单改装型。3065年型号采用双重散热器，因此可拆除一组散热器，并为高斯步枪增加一吨弹药。

column1: Intended to serve as a medium assault unit, the Hydra carries heavy 装甲 and a decent weapon suite. Introduced in 3066, the Hydra 2 was centered around the use of a set of Jump Jets, at the expense of 装甲 protection and weaponry.
column2: Hydra旨在担任中型突击单位，拥有厚重装甲和可靠武器套件。Hydra 2于3066年推出，围绕一组跳跃喷射器打造，但牺牲了装甲防护和武器。

column1: Clan Ice Hellion, always prolific users of fast light 'Mechs, copied the original redesign of the Incubus, but decided to create their own variant. This fifth version mounts an ATM 6 with two tons of ammunition, two ER 中型激光s, and four 轻型 Machine Guns.
column2: 冰狱氏族一向大量使用高速轻型机甲，他们复制了Incubus的原始重设计，并决定创建自己的变型。第五版装备一具ATM-6和两吨弹药、两门ER中型激光器及四挺轻型机枪。

column1: The Jager机甲 H is a 马里安霸权 retrofit 设计ed as a multipurpose command mech. Able to support at range while still crippling any over eager headhunting unit with a barrage of rockets.
column2: Jager机甲H是马里安霸权的改装设计，定位为多用途指挥机甲。它能在远距离提供支援，同时用火箭弹幕击垮任何过于冒进的猎头单位。

column1: A short-ranged energy boat, the A variant carries three 小型脉冲激光s in both the right and left arm, with two extra double heat sinks to keep up a sustained rate of fire.
column2: A配置是近程能量平台，左右双臂各携带三门小型脉冲激光器，并增加两组双重散热器以维持持续射速。

column1: Reportedly piloted by Zane Nova Cat, the Jenner IIC Hero '机甲 mounts a Heavy Machine Gun and twin standard Machine Guns in each arm fed by five tons of Machine Gun rounds and three tons of Heavy Machine Gun ammunition, supported by a single center torso-mounted ER 中型激光. Defensively the Fury trades speed for 装甲, mounting an 280-rated XL引擎 to carry four and half tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲.
column2: 据称由Zane Nova Cat驾驶的Jenner IIC英雄机甲Fury，双臂各装一挺重型机枪和两挺标准机枪，携带5吨机枪弹药和3吨重型机枪弹药；中央躯干另有一门安装在躯干上的ER中型激光器。Fury牺牲速度换取装甲，采用280额定XL引擎，携带4.5吨铁纤维装甲。

column1: Mercenary custom refitted variant that removes the jump capabilities and uses Endo Steel and 铁纤维装甲 to free weight. As a result it mounts an impressive armament of three 锁定式SRM-4 launchers, with two ER 中型激光s as backup, as well as a 280 XL引擎. 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: 这是佣兵定制改装型，拆除跳跃能力并采用内骨骼和铁纤维装甲以腾出重量。它因此安装三具锁定式SRM-4发射器，配备两门ER中型激光器作为备用，并采用280级XL引擎。 特性：改进型生命维持系统 部署成本倍率：0.98 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The 3C variant that entered service in 3064, is a radical modification of the Komodo that makes it capable of commanding a C3 lance. This is done by removing two double heat sinks and two 中型激光s as well as the TAG designator and adding a C3 Master Computer.
column2: 3064年服役的3C变型是Komodo的激进改装型，使其能够指挥一个C3小队。改装拆除两组双重散热器、两门中型激光器和TAG标定器，增加一具C3主计算机。

column1: Produced exclusively for the 布雷克圣言会, the LHW uses the same Endo Steel chassis and 铁纤维装甲 装甲 that worked so well in the LH8. A direct upgrade of the LH2, the LHW mounts an ER large Laser, twin LRM-5s, and four ER 中型激光s. The crown jewel, however, is the C3i Computer that allows the '机甲 to share target data with five other units.
column2: LHW专为布雷克圣言会生产，采用与LH8同样出色的内骨骼底盘和铁纤维装甲。它是LH2的直接升级型，装备一门ER大型激光器、两具LRM-5和四门ER中型激光器。最大亮点是C3i计算机，使机甲能与另外五个单位共享目标数据。

column1: 掠夺者 II 于 3012 年问世，是经典掠夺者的重新设计，把 75 吨重型机甲变成 100 吨突击机甲。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到 3030 年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。Arm Actuator Limit: LeftArm lower RightArm lower\nThe Marauder II was first built in 3012 in an attempt to take the firepower of the Marauder and combine it with the reliability and ruggedness of an assault chassis.This Steiner variant was built to carry a 重型高斯步枪.
column2: Marauder II于3012年问世，是经典Marauder的重新设计，试图将75吨重型机甲的火力提升到100吨突击机甲的水平。它最初是狼之龙骑兵的专属机甲，直到3030年第四次继承战争之后才流传到龙骑兵之外。手臂驱动器限制：左臂 下臂 右臂 下臂\nMarauder II最初建造于3012年，旨在将Marauder的火力与突击底盘的可靠性和坚固性结合。这一Steiner变型搭载一门重型高斯步枪。

column1: The C3B variant of the Naginata removes one of the LRM-15 launchers in order to add a larger 引擎, a 比格犬主动探头 and a 守护者ECM suite to the 设计. The '机甲 also had an ER 中型激光器 and an ER Small Laser added for close range defense. 怪癖: Cowl 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: Naginata的C3B变型拆除一具LRM-15发射器，以便增加更大的引擎、比格犬主动探头和守护者ECM套件。机甲还增装一门ER中型激光器和一门ER小型激光器用于近距离防御。 怪癖: 头部护甲 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: An LRM-5 with a ton of ammo in the right torso provides long-range fire-support, while the right arm-mounted ER 中型激光器 remain. A 锁定式SRM-4 with a ton of ammo and an ER Small Laser provide close-range defense. 装甲 protection is increased to 5 tons.
column2: 右侧躯干的LRM-5配备一吨弹药，提供远程火力支援；右臂安装的ER中型激光器得以保留。锁定式SRM-4配备一吨弹药，ER小型激光器负责近距离防御。装甲防护增加到5吨。

column1: This infantry-hunter variant moves the ER 中型激光s to the left arm, while the right arm now mounts 2 Flamers, with a third Flamer in the center torso. A Machine Gun in each side-torso with 3 tons of ammo rounds off the -2V's weapons. Five and a half tons of 装甲 provides excellent durability.
column2: 这一反步兵变型将ER中型激光器移至左臂，右臂则安装两具喷火器，中央躯干再装一具喷火器。两侧躯干各有一挺机枪和3吨弹药，完成-2V的武器配置。5.5吨装甲提供出色耐久性。

column1: The Katya upgrades the two ER Large Lasers of the standard 穿透者 PTR-4D to Clan specification, and adds two extra double heat sinks to deal with higher heat generation of the Clan weapons. The '机甲 also has some minor improvements to its electronics and sensor package. 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Katya将标准穿透者PTR-4D的两门ER大型激光器升级为氏族规格，并增加两组双重散热器以处理氏族武器更高的热量。机甲的电子设备和传感器套件也得到小幅改进。 怪癖: 稳定 掉落成本乘数: 1.13 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: Following the surprise invasion of Huntress, most of the Clans looked to upgrade the defenders of their homeworlds. In so doing, 云蛇氏族 decided to upgrade their aging 步枪手IICs. The IIC 3 first entered service in the early part of 3062. Based upon the original 设计, it nonetheless uses two Model HHC-30 超级自动炮/2s to plink at a target from long range. Any opponent who believes he or she is facing a IIC 2 is quickly surprised, however, when the IIC 3 opens up with its paired Series 4D-2 Heavy Large Lasers. Twenty one double heat sinks keep this 设计 cool-running. This rebuilt version still mounts the 主动探头.
column2: Huntress遭到突然入侵后，大多数氏族都开始升级母星防御者。云蛇氏族决定升级老旧的步枪手IIC。IIC 3于3062年初服役。它基于原始设计，却使用两门Model HHC-30超级自动炮/2从远距离骚扰目标。任何以为自己面对IIC 2的对手，都会在IIC 3用成对的Series 4D-2重型大型激光器开火时大吃一惊。21组双重散热器让设计保持低热运行，同时保留主动探头。

column1: The Salamander 设计 incorporates fire-based weapons, its primary armaments being a pair of flamers slung under the arms and a single, one-shot 短-Range Missile strapped to the shoulder, invariably one with an Inferno payload. This makes the Salamander especially potent against infantry and combat 车辆s, though that does not mean it is less intimidating to 机甲Warriors: few would want to get caught in the sights of a Salamander Point.
column2: Salamander设计采用火焰武器，主要武器是悬挂在双臂下方的两具喷火器，以及肩部固定的一具一次性短程导弹，通常装填地狱火弹。这使Salamander对步兵和战斗车辆尤其有效，但并不意味着机甲战士会低估它：很少有人愿意被Salamander小队瞄准。

column1: The 4D adds a Davion touch to the Sentinel. The SRM launcher has been completely done away with on this model and the 超级自动炮 has been replaced with a rotary model. The 中型激光 from the 3M version has been upgraded to an ER 中型激光, and its five and a half tons of standard 装甲 have been replaced with seven tons of 铁纤维装甲 plate.
column2: 4D为Sentinel加入了Davion特色。该型号完全拆除SRM发射器，用转管型号替换超级自动炮。3M的中型激光器升级为ER中型激光器，5.5吨标准装甲则替换为7吨铁纤维装甲板。

column1: At the urging of then-Archon Katherine Steiner-Davion, Norse-Storm opened up talks with 胜利兵工 to secure Stealth 装甲 for the light '机甲. Though the deal did not work out exactly as they had hoped, the 5S incorporates Stealth 装甲. Space constraints force the consolidation of the 中型激光s into one 中型脉冲激光.
column2: 在当时的Archon Katherine Steiner-Davion敦促下，Norse-Storm与胜利兵工展开谈判，为轻型机甲获取隐形装甲。虽然交易结果并不完全符合预期，5S仍采用了隐形装甲。受空间限制，中型激光器被合并为一门中型脉冲激光器。

column1: A customized 1D model variant created for Captain Anna Ramirez during the FedCom Civil War. Ramirez collected several 中型脉冲激光s and additional 中型激光s and had techs fit them in place of her SRM-6 launcher. In addition, she had a half ton of additional 装甲 added to the thin hulled 设计.
column2: 这是联邦内战期间为Anna Ramirez上尉定制的1D变型。Ramirez收集了数门中型脉冲激光器和额外中型激光器，让技术人员用它们替换SRM-6发射器。此外，她还为这台薄装甲设计增加了半吨装甲。

column1: Another modification of the 2D model, the 2D2 removes the 主动探头 from the 2D model and replaces it with a TAG target designator, allowing it to spot for Arrow IV 火炮 bombardments.
column2: 这是2D的另一种改装型，2D2拆除2D的主动探头，换成TAG目标标定器，使其能够为Arrow IV火炮轰击进行标定。

column1: A workhorse configuration, the Templar B can engage an enemy at either short or long ranges. For long range combat, the Templar B carries an ER PPC. For intermediate ranges, the 'Mech has three Rotary Autocannon/2s and also has two ER 中型激光器 for close combat. To handle the 'Mech's heat load, the Templar B has four additional double heat sinks.
column2: Templar B是一种多用途配置，可在近距离或远距离与敌人交战。远程作战时携带一门ER PPC；中距离配备三门转管自动炮/2，近战则使用两门ER中型激光器。为处理热量，Templar B额外安装四组双重散热器。

column1: A close combat configuration, the C configuration of the Templar carries a devastating LB-X Autocannon/20 as its primary weapon, which can fire both solid rounds and shotgun-like cluster rounds. Also for close range, the Templar C has five 中型脉冲激光s and an ER 中型激光, which can be used to devastating effect at short range. For long range defense, the Templar carries a single ER PPC. To add mobility to the 'Mech, it has four pod-mounted jump jets that let the Templar C jump up to one hundred and twenty 米. An additional heat sink is added to help handle the 'Mech's heat.
column2: Templar C专为近战打造，主要武器是一门LB-X自动炮/20，可发射实心弹和霰弹式集束弹。近距离还配备五门中型脉冲激光器和一门ER中型激光器，可造成毁灭性效果。远程防御由一门ER PPC负责。为提升机动性，机甲装备四具舱载跳跃喷射器，使Templar C能够跳跃120米，并增加一组散热器以处理热量。

column1: This Draconis Combine variant of the Thug 12E, introduced in 3067; replaces the C3i with a C3 Slave and a 守护者ECM Suite.
column2: 这是3067年推出的龙马联盟Thug 12E变型，用C3从属单元和守护者ECM套件替换C3i。

column1: A Crusader variant, the Turkina H uses three Heavy 中型激光s, two 中型脉冲激光s, and two 超级自动炮/10s. Five additional double heat sinks keep heat under control.
column2: 这是Crusader变型，Turkina H使用三门重型中型激光器、两门中型脉冲激光器和两门超级自动炮/10。额外5组双重散热器负责控制热量。

column1: This Free Worlds League variant upgrades the autocannon to an 超级自动炮/10 and the laser to an ER Small Laser. This is all made possible by the upgrade to five tons of 铁纤维装甲 装甲 and the removal of the eleventh heat sink. While the ultra-class autocannon provides superior firepower, it can also eat through the single ton of ammunition at an alarming rate.
column2: 这一自由世界联盟变型将自动炮升级为超级自动炮/10，将激光器升级为ER小型激光器。它通过增加至5吨铁纤维装甲并拆除第11组散热器实现升级。超级自动炮能提供更强火力，但也会以惊人速度耗尽唯一一吨弹药。

column1: Boss, this beauty is one of those Valkyrie IIs from the Solaris stables; I've seen these in action. 'Sigrun' here has a BattleMech Sword and TSM allowing it to cleave limbs clean off many 'Mechs. Her left-hook is also pretty damn brutal with that Plasma Cannon. Roll that all together with that monstrous 引擎 and six jump jets, this 'Mech can chase down and murder most 'Mechs.
column2: 老板，这台漂亮机体是Solaris马厩里的Valkyrie II之一，我见过它们实战。“Sigrun”配备战斗机甲剑和TSM，能干净利落地砍下许多机甲的肢体。它的左拳同样凶狠，因为装有等离子炮。再加上那台怪物般的引擎和六具跳跃喷射器，这台机甲能追上并杀死大多数机甲。

column1: Intended to stay back and let faster units spot for it using the C3i system, the Vanquisher carries a pair of Corean 轻型高斯步枪s backed up by two 多元光学 Sunbeam ER Large Lasers, giving the Vanquisher almost unparalleled reach on the battlefield. For close combat, the 'Mech has three 多元光学 Type ER 中型激光s, which are usually enough to dissuade most lighter 'Mechs.
column2: Vanquisher旨在留在后方，由更快的单位通过C3i系统为其标定目标。它携带两门Corean轻型高斯步枪和两门多元光学Sunbeam ER大型激光器，使其在战场上拥有近乎无与伦比的射程。近战时，三门多元光学Type ER中型激光器通常足以劝退大多数轻型机甲。

column1: An upgrade of the Watchman made after the incursion into the Draconis Combine by James Sandoval, the Duke of Robinson, the 4DM upgrades the Watchman to make it more potent on the modern battlefield. The 'Mech has had the Large Laser and Machine Guns replaced with a PPC, giving the 'Mech a great deal of long range firepower. The 'Mech has also upgraded its heat sinks to double heat sinks and the 装甲 has been upgraded to 铁纤维装甲 装甲, providing the 'Mech with better 装甲 protection.
column2: 这是James Sandoval、Robinson公爵在龙马联盟入侵后对Watchman进行的升级改装，使其更适合现代战场。机甲用一门PPC替换大型激光器和机枪，大幅增强远程火力；散热器升级为双重散热器，装甲升级为铁纤维装甲，提供更好防护。

column1: Good '机甲 this, can be used for both offensive support and defensive ambushes. Let's buy a few of them. Oh, who I am kidding. All you care about is getting Superheavys, Boss.
column2: 这是一台好机甲，既可用于进攻支援，也可用于防御伏击。我们买几台吧。呃，我在说什么？老板，你只关心获得超重型机甲。

column1: The Albatross was 设计ed by the Free Worlds League in 3053 with an eye toward a possible future conflict with the then advancing Clans. The '机甲 is built using a Hermes 380 XL引擎 to minimize weight and maximize free tonnage for its weapon loadout. The Albatross also uses a variety of weapons in an attempt to make the '机甲 effective at any range. The '机甲 has average mobility with a maximum speed of 64.8 km/h and also makes use of double heat sinks for their greater heat dissipation capability. 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower, 右侧 Lower
column2: Albatross由自由世界联盟于3053年设计，着眼于未来可能与当时正在推进的氏族发生冲突。机甲采用Hermes 380 XL引擎以减轻重量，为武器配置腾出最大舱位。它使用多种武器，力求在任何射程都有效。机甲机动性一般，最高速度64.8 km/h，并使用双重散热器以获得更强散热能力。 怪癖: 改进的 定位 - 长 掉落成本乘数: 1.17 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂, 右侧 下臂

column1: The Blue Flame's primary armament is two ER Large Lasers that allow the '机甲 to engage the enemy at long ranges. It also has three 锁定式SRM-2 launchers for close range combat. The '机甲 is built around a Endo Steel chassis that cradles a 225 Light Fusion 引擎 that gives the '机甲 a top speed of 86.4 km/h. The Blue Flame carries an impressive eleven tons of 装甲 and has ten double heat sinks. To allow the '机甲 to share targeting data with friendly units, it is equipped with an improved C3 computer that allows it to exchange information with other C3i equipped units 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.03
column2: Blue Flame的主要武器是两门ER大型激光器，可在远距离与敌人交战。它还装备三具锁定式SRM-2进行近战。机体以能容纳225级轻型聚变引擎的内骨骼底盘为核心，最高速度86.4 km/h。Blue Flame配备11吨装甲和10组双重散热器；改进型C3计算机使其能与友军共享瞄准数据，并与其他配备C3i的单位交换信息。 怪癖: 稳定 武器 掉落成本乘数: 1.03

column1: The Fafnir was intended to become 迪法恩斯工业 of Hesperus' flagship Battle机甲. This rare but not uncommon field refit replaces the 重型高斯步枪s with 2 LBX 20 Autocannons and upgrades the Electronics. 怪癖: 稳定 Weapons 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Upper, 右侧 Upper
column2: Fafnir原本计划成为Hesperus迪法恩斯工业的旗舰战斗机甲。这一罕见但并非罕见到绝无仅有的战地改装型，用两门LBX 20自动炮替换重型高斯步枪，并升级电子设备。 怪癖: 稳定 武器 掉落成本乘数: 1.18 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 上臂, 右侧 上臂

column1: The 5D uses some of the newest technology available to the Federated Suns in 3067. The '机甲 is built based on the rugged older 1H chassis and standard 引擎. The '机甲 carries as its primary weapon a 转管自动炮/5. This is backed up by four ER 中型激光s and two Machine Guns. The lasers and autocannon are all linked to an advanced 定位 Computer which gives the Goliath deadly accuracy at long ranges. 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.14
column2: 5D使用3067年联邦合众国可获得的部分最新技术。机体基于坚固的旧式1H底盘和标准引擎，主要武器是一门转管自动炮/5，另有四门ER中型激光器和两挺机枪。激光器和自动炮都连接至先进瞄准计算机，使Goliath在远距离拥有致命精度。 怪癖: Multi Trac 掉落成本乘数: 1.14

column1: The R4N is a 3063 modification that looks to the original 设计 of the 休伦战士 and reverts the '机甲 back to its original fire support role. This is done by stripping the '机甲s weapons and ammunition payload and replacing them with a pair of LRM-15 launchers and four 中型激光s. The '机甲 is also 装甲ed with new Stealth 装甲 and carries a 守护者ECM Suite. This combination of LRM-15s and Stealth 装甲 makes the R4N an incredibly powerful fire support '机甲. 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 Lower
column2: R4N是3063年的改装型，回归休伦战士的原始设计，将机甲恢复为最初的火力支援角色。它拆除原有武器和弹药，换成两具LRM-15发射器和四门中型激光器。机甲还配备新的隐形装甲和守护者ECM套件。LRM-15与隐形装甲的组合使R4N成为极其强大的火力支援机甲。 怪癖: 改进的 Sensors 掉落成本乘数: 1.04 手臂驱动器限制：左侧 下臂

column1: The -0H is quite different from the other Longbow variants whose designation starts with -0x. column1: The 4HP is a further modified 4H, which mounts an ER PPC and 中型激光器 in each arm supported by quad 火箭发射器 20s in each side torso. column2: 这一Taurian变型不采用拟态装甲，而选择更易更换的标准装甲。它通常安装更易维护的中型无后坐力步枪，伤害只有标准等离子步枪的一半，但弹药供应量为两倍。 特性：精准 部署成本倍率：0.888 可安装全向单位，可近战，可群袭。

column1: The 4L Vindicator is a major upgrade to the 设计, part of 塞雷斯金属' efforts to revive the line in 3063. The 引擎 has been replaced with a 225-rated XL引擎, granting the '机甲 a top speed of 86.4 km/h, and its jumping distance was increased to 150 米 with an additional jump jet. The '机甲 uses double heat sinks for its advanced weapons load, which includes an ER PPC and LRM-5 for striking power at long range and an ER 中型激光器 and medium pulse laser for short range work. Finally, the '机甲 carries a 守护者ECM Suite and is protected with nine tons of Stealth 装甲, making it harder to target at range. The 4L became a common 设计 among Shadow Lances following their introduction. 怪癖: 坚固 掉落成本乘数: 1.03 手臂驱动器限制：右侧 Lower

column1: This custom Solaris variant debuted in 3128 in Noisiel and piloted first by Natalia Porter and then by her daughter Carolyn Fischer, this Clint IIC upgrade reverses the trend of Clan-modified-Inner-Sphere machines. Starting from the Clan-built frame, the variant drops the Jump Jets to change the weapon load. It keeps the two Clan Extended Range 中型激光 and swaps the Clan LB 10-X AC for a Large 变速脉冲激光 and a Medium Re-Engineered Laser mating them all to a 氏族瞄准计算机. The standard plate 装甲 is replaced with Ballistic-加固装甲.
column2: 这台定制的太阳神七号变体于3128年在诺瓦谢尔首次亮相，最初由娜塔莉亚·波特驾驶，后来交给她的女儿卡罗琳·费舍尔。这个克林特IIC升级型逆转了星盟改造内圈机器的惯例：它以星盟制造的骨架为基础，拆除跳跃喷射器以调整武器配置。它保留两门星盟延伸射程中型激光，并将星盟LB 10-X自动火炮替换为一门大型激光和一门中型重构激光，全部接入一台瞄准计算机。标准板式装甲则换成了弹道强化装甲。

column1: Developed under the guidance of Angelique Claw for Zellbrigen Stables, the Wraith Alexander combines Experimental Technology from the Clans and Inner Sphere to create a unique 'Mech. The use of a Clan-made XL引擎 keeps the speed high, and allows for the installation of more equipment. The jump jets, Endo Steel 结构, and 短管PPC are of Inner Sphere manufacture, but the two ER 中型激光s, 铁纤维装甲, and twin 部分机翼s were built by the Clans. The partial wings increase the Wraith's jump range to 270 米.
column2: 在泽尔布里根马厩的安吉丽克·克劳指导下，幽灵·亚历山大融合星盟与内圈的试验技术，打造出一台独特的机甲。星盟制造的XL引擎保证了高速度，并为安装更多设备留出空间。跳跃喷射器、内骨骼结构和短管PPC由内圈制造；两门ER中型激光、强化装甲和双联超级充能器则由星盟制造。部分机翼将幽灵的跳跃距离提高到270米。
